rows.source: From your first note to fingerstyle, blues and lead
rows.translation: No pirmās nots līdz spēlei ar pirkstiem, blūzam un solo
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold it, tune it, play your first notes.
rows.translation: Turiet, noskaņojiet un spēlējiet pirmās notis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 6.
rows.translation: Resnākā stīga skan viszemāk. Spēlējot tā atrodas vistuvāk jūsu sejai. To saucam par 6. stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each string has a tuning peg on the head. Turning it changes the pitch. Timbre listens and tells you which way.
rows.translation: Katrai stīgai uz galvas ir skaņošanas tapa. To pagriežot, mainās skaņas augstums. Timbre klausās un rāda, uz kuru pusi griezt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Strings count from the thinnest (1) to the thickest (6).
rows.translation: Stīgas skaita no tievākās (1) līdz resnākajai (6).
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pluck the thickest string and let it ring.
rows.translation: Iesvārstiet resnāko stīgu un ļaujiet tai skanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E A D G B E
rows.translation: E A D G B E
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: From thick to thin: E, A, D, G, B, E. Try: Every Amateur Does Get Better Eventually.
rows.translation: No resnākās līdz tievākajai: E, A, D, G, B, E. Iegaumējiet: Esmu Apņēmīgs, Dziesmu Galā Būšu Eksperts.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play strings 6, 5 and 4, one at a time.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Put your fingertip just behind the metal fret, not on top of it. Press firmly enough for a clean ring.
rows.translation: Novietojiet pirksta galu tieši aiz metāla ladas, nevis uz tās. Spiediet pietiekami stingri, lai skaņa būtu tīra.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open, fret 1, fret 3: E, F, G.
rows.translation: Brīva stīga, 1. lada, 3. lada: E, F, G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Between two frets, in the middle
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E minor uses two fingers on fret 2, strings 5 and 4. Every string rings.
rows.translation: E minoram divus pirkstus liek uz 5. un 4. stīgas 2. ladā. Skan visas stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Brush across all six strings from thick to thin, one smooth motion. Keep your wrist loose.
rows.translation: Ar vienu plūstošu kustību pārvelciet visas sešas stīgas no resnākās līdz tievākajai. Turiet plaukstas locītavu brīvu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This challenge mixes the whole unit: the open strings, E, F and G on string 1, and E minor. Take a breath between steps.
rows.translation: Šajā pārbaudījumā apvienota visa nodaļa: brīvās stīgas, E, F un G uz 1. stīgas un E minors. Starp soļiem ievelciet elpu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: From thick to thin, the open strings are…
rows.translation: No resnākās līdz tievākajai brīvās stīgas ir…
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E B G D A E
rows.translation: E B G D A E
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A D G B E A
rows.translation: A D G B E A
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every Amateur Does Get Better Eventually: E A D G B E, string 6 to string 1.
rows.translation: Esmu Apņēmīgs, Dziesmu Galā Būšu Eksperts: E A D G B E, no 6. līdz 1. stīgai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb: trīs notis
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: open string 2 is B, fret 2 on string 3 is A, and open string 3 is G. Your second finger plays the A.
rows.translation: Dziesmai Mary Had a Little Lamb vajag trīs notis: brīva 2. stīga ir B, 3. stīgas 2. lada ir A, bet brīva 3. stīga ir G. A spēlē otrais pirksts.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 3, fret 2, second finger. That's A.
rows.translation: 3. stīga, 2. lada, otrais pirksts. Tā ir A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B A G A B B B: open string 2, then string 3.
rows.translation: B A G A B B B: brīva 2. stīga, tad 3. stīga.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Notes on strings 1 and 2, reading tab, and your first two tunes.
rows.translation: Notis uz 1. un 2. stīgas, tabulatūras lasīšana un divas pirmās melodijas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 2 works like string 1. Open, it's B. Fret 1 with your first finger is C. Fret 3 with your third finger is D.
rows.translation: 2. stīga darbojas tāpat kā 1. Brīva tā skan B. 1. ladā ar pirmo pirkstu — C. 3. ladā ar trešo pirkstu — D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Iesvārstiet brīvu 2. stīgu. Tā ir B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 2, fret 1, first finger. That's C.
rows.translation: 2. stīga, 1. lada, pirmais pirksts. Tā ir C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 2, fret 3, third finger. That's D.
rows.translation: 2. stīga, 3. lada, trešais pirksts. Tā ir D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: One finger per fret: fret 1 gets finger 1, fret 2 gets finger 2, fret 3 gets finger 3.
rows.translation: Katrai ladai savs pirksts: 1. ladai — 1. pirksts, 2. ladai — 2. pirksts, 3. ladai — 3. pirksts.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rest your thumb on the back of the neck, behind your second finger. Your fingers can then arch and land on their tips.
rows.translation: Atbalstiet īkšķi grifa aizmugurē pretī otrajam pirkstam. Tad pārējos pirkstus varat izliekt un uzlikt uz stīgām ar galiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Tab draws six lines, one per string, with string 1 on top. A number on a line is the fret to press. A 0 means play that string open.
rows.translation: Tabulatūrā ir sešas līnijas — pa vienai katrai stīgai; 1. stīga ir augšā. Skaitlis uz līnijas rāda, kurā ladā jāspiež. 0 nozīmē spēlēt brīvu stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In tab, a 3 on the top line means…
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The top line is string 1, the thinnest. The number is the fret.
rows.translation: Augšējā līnija ir 1. stīga, tievākā. Skaitlis norāda ladu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A 0 on the second line means…
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A note that lasts two beats
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A half note rings for two beats. Pick once, count one, two, and let it sustain until the next note.
rows.translation: Pusnots skan divus sitienus. Iesvārstiet stīgu vienreiz, skaitiet „viens, divi” un ļaujiet tai skanēt līdz nākamajai notij.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How long does a half note last?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Half of a four-beat bar is two beats. A quarter note lasts one beat.
rows.translation: Puse no četru sitienu takts ir divi sitieni. Ceturtdaļnots ilgst vienu sitienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Going from string 2 to string 1 is a tiny move. Keep your picking hand close to the strings so the next note is ready.
rows.translation: Pāreja no 2. uz 1. stīgu ir pavisam maza kustība. Turiet spēlējošo roku tuvu stīgām, lai tā būtu gatava nākamajai notij.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret 3 on string 2, then open string 1. Lift your finger as you pick.
rows.translation: 3. lada uz 2. stīgas, tad brīva 1. stīga. Iesvārstot stīgu, paceliet pirkstu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1.
rows.translation: C un D uz 2. stīgas, tad E, F un G uz 1. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This melody comes from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony. It uses C, D, E, F and G, and it moves mostly one step at a time.
rows.translation: Šī melodija ir no Bēthovena Devītās simfonijas. Tajā ir C, D, E, F un G, un tā pārsvarā virzās pa vienai pakāpei.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first line, slowly: E E F G G F E D.
rows.translation: Pirmā rinda lēni: E E F G G F E D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Then: C C D E E D D.
rows.translation: Tad: C C D E E D D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each line ends with a lilt: a longer note, a quick one, then a held one. Count one-and-two, and slip the quick note in on the and.
rows.translation: Katra rinda beidzas šūpojoši: garāka nots, īsa nots, tad izturēta nots. Skaitiet „viens-un-divi” un īso noti ievietojiet uz „un”.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This nursery tune walks on C, D and E, then jumps up to G. The jump is open string 1 to fret 3.
rows.translation: Šī bērnu dziesma soļo pa C, D un E, tad lec augšup uz G. Lēciens ir no brīvas 1. stīgas uz 3. ladu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, down to string 2 and back.
rows.translation: E D C D E E E: brīva 1. stīga, lejup uz 2. stīgu un atpakaļ.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D D D on string 2, then E and G on string 1.
rows.translation: D D D uz 2. stīgas, tad E un G uz 1. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Letters in a Shoebox is a Timbre Original, a slow ballad in C. Its chorus lives on strings 1 and 2, and its hook opens with the long, short lilt you played in Ode to Joy. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Letters in a Shoebox ir Timbre oriģināldziesma, lēna balāde C tonalitātē. Piedziedājums skan uz 1. un 2. stīgas, un galvenais motīvs sākas ar garo–īso ritmu no dziesmas „Oda priekam”. Visa dziesma atrodama sadaļā Dziesmas → Oriģināldziesmas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The hook: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1, and back to D.
rows.translation: Galvenais motīvs: C un D uz 2. stīgas, tad E, F un G uz 1. stīgas un atpakaļ uz D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Does the chorus end at home?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No, it wants to go on
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: E, F and G on string 1, B, C and D on string 2. Start slow, then hold a steady tempo.
rows.translation: Nekā jauna: E, F un G uz 1. stīgas, B, C un D uz 2. stīgas. Sāciet lēni, tad saglabājiet vienmērīgu tempu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Did the tune go up or down?
rows.translation: Vai melodija virzījās augšup vai lejup?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: All six notes, low to high.
rows.translation: Visas sešas notis no zemākās līdz augstākajai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ode to Joy, a little faster
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb, faster
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb, ātrāk
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E minor, E, A minor and A, played cleanly, and your first chord changes.
rows.translation: Tīri nospēlēti E minors, E, A minors un A, un pirmās akordu maiņas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Press with your fingertips, arched like a bridge, so no finger leans on the string below it. Short nails make this much easier.
rows.translation: Spiediet ar pirkstu galiem, pirkstus izliecot kā tiltu, lai neviens nepieskartos stīgai zem tā. Īsi nagi to krietni atvieglo.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pick the strings one at a time, thick to thin. A dull thud means a finger is touching that string. Adjust and pick it again.
rows.translation: Iesvārstiet stīgas pa vienai no resnākās līdz tievākajai. Dobja skaņa nozīmē, ka stīgai pieskaras pirksts. Pielabojiet un mēģiniet vēlreiz.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: One string sounds dull. What's the likely cause?
rows.translation: Viena stīga skan dobji. Kāds ir iespējamais iemesls?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A fingertip leaning on a neighboring string stops it ringing. Arch your fingers more.
rows.translation: Ja pirksta gals pieskaras blakus stīgai, tas aptur tās skanējumu. Vairāk izlieciet pirkstus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: E minors un vēl viens pirksts
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Keep your E minor shape and add your first finger on string 3, fret 1. That one note turns minor into major.
rows.translation: Saglabājiet E minora tvērienu un pievienojiet pirmo pirkstu uz 3. stīgas 1. ladā. Šī viena nots pārvērš minoru mažorā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Major chords tend to sound bright and settled. Minor chords sound darker. E and E minor differ by just one note.
rows.translation: Mažora akordi parasti skan gaiši un stabili. Minora akordi skan tumšāk. E un E minors atšķiras tikai ar vienu noti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Tas pats tvēriens uz blakus stīgām
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minor is the E shape moved one string thinner: fingers 2 and 3 on fret 2, finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
rows.translation: A minors ir E tvēriens, pārcelts par stīgu tievāk: 2. un 3. pirksts 2. ladā, 1. pirksts uz 2. stīgas 1. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The root is the note a chord is named after. In A minor it's open string 5, so start your strum there and skip string 6.
rows.translation: Pamattonis ir nots, kuras vārdā nosaukts akords. A minorā tā ir brīva 5. stīga, tāpēc sāciet pārvilkumu no tās un izlaidiet 6. stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which string do you skip in A minor?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minor's root is open string 5. Start the strum there.
rows.translation: A minora pamattonis ir brīva 5. stīga. Sāciet pārvilkumu no tās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A packs fingers 1, 2 and 3 side by side on fret 2, on strings 4, 3 and 2. Strum from string 5.
rows.translation: A akordā 1., 2. un 3. pirksts ir blakus 2. ladā uz 4., 3. un 2. stīgas. Pārvelciet no 5. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: If your fingers feel cramped, slant them so each sits just behind the fret at a slight angle. Keep string 1 clear so it rings.
rows.translation: Ja pirkstiem ir par šauru, sasveriet tos, lai katrs atrastos mazliet slīpi tieši aiz ladas. Neaizskariet 1. stīgu, lai tā skanētu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which fret holds all three fingers in A?
rows.translation: Kurā ladā A akordā atrodas visi trīs pirksti?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: From E minor to A minor
rows.translation: No E minora uz A minoru
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Move the shape, not the fingers
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: From E minor to A minor, fingers 2 and 3 hop together to strings 4 and 3. Then finger 1 lands on string 2. Your hand barely moves.
rows.translation: No E minora uz A minoru 2. un 3. pirksts reizē pārlec uz 4. un 3. stīgu. Tad 1. pirksts uzliekas uz 2. stīgas. Roka gandrīz nekustas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Strum once, then use the rest of the bar to change. Aim to land the new chord right on beat one. Speed comes later, by itself.
rows.translation: Pārvelciet vienreiz, tad atlikušajā takts laikā mainiet akordu. Jaunajam akordam jāskan tieši uz pirmā sitiena. Ātrums vēlāk nāks pats.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How should your fingers travel between chords?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Moving the fingers as a unit is faster and lands cleaner. Keep them low, just above the strings.
rows.translation: Pārvietot pirkstus kopā ir ātrāk, un tvēriens izdodas tīrāks. Turiet tos zemu, tieši virs stīgām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every finger moves from A to E. Picture the E shape before you lift, then move all three together. Aim finger 2 at string 5.
rows.translation: Pārejot no A uz E, kustas visi pirksti. Pirms pacelšanas iztēlojieties E tvērienu un pārvietojiet visus trīs reizē. Virziet 2. pirkstu uz 5. stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Dust on the Dashboard is a Timbre Original: country in A. Every verse ends on two bars of E and two of A, the change you just learned. See the shape, move early and land on beat one. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Dust on the Dashboard ir Timbre oriģināldziesma — kantrī A tonalitātē. Katrs pants beidzas ar divām E un divām A taktīm: tikko apgūto maiņu. Iztēlojieties tvērienu, mainiet laikus un trāpiet uz pirmā sitiena. Visa dziesma: Dziesmas → Oriģināldziesmas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Over E: open B, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3.
rows.translation: Virs E: brīva B, brīva E, D uz 2. stīgas 3. ladā, C diēzs 2. ladā, tad G diēzs uz 3. stīgas 1. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: E minor, E, A minor and A. Land each shape cleanly, then keep the changes steady.
rows.translation: Nekā jauna: E minors, E, A minors un A. Katru tvērienu uzlieciet tīri un saglabājiet vienmērīgas maiņas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which finger turns E minor into E?
rows.translation: Kurš pirksts pārvērš E minoru par E?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Finger 1 on string 3, fret 1 is the one note that makes E major.
rows.translation: 1. pirksts uz 3. stīgas 1. ladā dod vienīgo noti, kas veido E mažoru.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Downstrokes, down-up eighths, accents and a strumming hand that never stops.
rows.translation: Vēzieni lejup, astotdaļas lejup–augšup, akcenti un roka, kas nekad neapstājas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Strum down on every beat and count out loud: one, two, three, four.
rows.translation: Ceturtdaļnots ilgst vienu sitienu. Katrā sitienā pārvelciet lejup un skaitiet skaļi: viens, divi, trīs, četri.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Let the motion come from a loose wrist and forearm, like shaking water off your hand. A stiff arm sounds harsh.
rows.translation: Lai kustību rada brīva plaukstas locītava un apakšdelms, kā nokratot no rokas ūdeni. Stīva roka rada asu skaņu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many quarter-note strums fill a bar of four?
rows.translation: Cik ceturtdaļu pārvilkumu aizpilda četru sitienu takti?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Split each beat in two. Strum down on the number and up on the and: one and two and. That's eight strums per bar.
rows.translation: Sadaliet katru sitienu divās daļās. Uz skaitļa pārvelciet lejup, uz „un” — augšup: viens un divi un. Tie ir astoņi pārvilkumi taktī.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where does the up strum fall?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down on the number, up on the and. Your hand goes down and up once per beat.
rows.translation: Uz skaitļa — lejup, uz „un” — augšup. Katrā sitienā roka vienreiz virzās lejup un augšup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Up strums are naturally softer. Brush just the thinner three or four strings on the way up. That gives the groove its lift.
rows.translation: Pārvilkumi augšup dabiski ir klusāki. Virzoties augšup, aizskariet tikai trīs vai četras tievākās stīgas. Tas ritmam dod pacēlumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: An accent is a note played a little louder. Strum beat one harder than the rest. It tells everyone where the bar begins.
rows.translation: Akcents ir mazliet skaļāk nospēlēta nots. Pirmajā sitienā pārvelciet spēcīgāk nekā pārējos. Tas visiem norāda takts sākumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beat one starts the bar. A slightly louder first strum keeps you, and anyone listening, in time.
rows.translation: Pirmais sitiens sāk takti. Mazliet skaļāks pirmais pārvilkums palīdz gan jums, gan klausītājiem turēties ritmā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Say the bar number on beat one: one, two, three, four; two, two, three, four. You always know where you are.
rows.translation: Pirmajā sitienā nosauciet takts numuru: viens, divi, trīs, četri; divi, divi, trīs, četri. Vienmēr zināsiet, kur esat.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your strumming hand swings down and up all the time, like a pendulum. To skip a strum, keep swinging and simply miss the strings.
rows.translation: Pārvilkumu roka visu laiku šūpojas lejup un augšup kā svārsts. Lai izlaistu pārvilkumu, turpiniet kustību, bet neaizskariet stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: To skip a strum, your hand…
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Keeps moving and misses the strings
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A hand that never stops keeps steady time. The skipped strum is a swing that doesn't touch the strings.
rows.translation: Roka, kas neapstājas, uztur vienmērīgu ritmu. Izlaists pārvilkums ir vēziens, kas nepieskaras stīgām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This pattern drives countless songs. On beat three your hand swings down without touching the strings, then catches the up strum.
rows.translation: Šis raksts virza neskaitāmas dziesmas. Trešajā sitienā roka vēzējas lejup, neaizskarot stīgas, un tad pārvelk augšup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In this pattern, which beat has no strum on the number?
rows.translation: Kurā sitienā šajā rakstā nav pārvilkuma uz skaitļa?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: On three the hand swings down past the strings, then strums up on the and.
rows.translation: Uz „trīs” roka vēzējas lejup garām stīgām, tad uz „un” pārvelk augšup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Low Tide Radio is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae on E minor and A. The guitar plays only the ands. Keep your hand swinging down and up, miss the strings on each number and catch every and. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Low Tide Radio ir Timbre oriģināldziesma — mierīgs regejs ar E minoru un A. Ģitāra spēlē tikai uz „un”. Vēzējiet roku lejup un augšup: uz katra skaitļa neaizskariet stīgas, uz katra „un” pārvelciet. Visa dziesma atrodama sadaļā Dziesmas → Oriģināldziesmas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where does the guitar play in Low Tide Radio?
rows.translation: Kad dziesmā Low Tide Radio spēlē ģitāra?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bass and drums hold the numbers. The guitar answers between them, on the ands.
rows.translation: Bass un bungas tur skaitļus. Ģitāra atbild starp tiem, uz „un”.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: quarters, eighths and the folk strum on the chords you know. Keep the hand swinging and lean on beat one.
rows.translation: Nekā jauna: ceturtdaļas, astotdaļas un folka pārvilkums ar pazīstamiem akordiem. Turpiniet vēzēt roku un akcentējiet pirmo sitienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down-up eighths: where are the up strums?
rows.translation: Astotdaļas lejup–augšup: kad ir vēzieni augšup?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, G, D and D minor, two classic progressions, and the one-minute change.
rows.translation: C, G, D un D minors, divas klasiskas akordu secības un maiņas vienas minūtes garumā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C climbs like a staircase: finger 3 on string 5, fret 3; finger 2 on string 4, fret 2; finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
rows.translation: C kāpj kā pa kāpnēm: 3. pirksts uz 5. stīgas 3. ladā; 2. pirksts uz 4. stīgas 2. ladā; 1. pirksts uz 2. stīgas 1. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which string do you skip in C?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Start the strum there.
rows.translation: C pamattonis ir uz 5. stīgas 3. ladā. Sāciet pārvilkumu no tās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minor to C: one finger
rows.translation: No A minora uz C: viens pirksts
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fingers 1 and 2 stay exactly where they are. Only finger 3 moves, from string 3 to string 5, fret 3.
rows.translation: 1. un 2. pirksts paliek tieši turpat. Kustas tikai 3. pirksts: no 3. stīgas uz 5. stīgas 3. ladu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G spreads out: finger 2 on string 6, fret 3; finger 1 on string 5, fret 2; finger 3 on string 1, fret 3. All six strings ring.
rows.translation: G ir plašs tvēriens: 2. pirksts uz 6. stīgas 3. ladā; 1. pirksts uz 5. stīgas 2. ladā; 3. pirksts uz 1. stīgas 3. ladā. Skan visas sešas stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In G, which strings ring open?
rows.translation: Kuras stīgas G akordā skan brīvas?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: When you change, land the finger for the lowest string first. It's the first note your strum hits, which buys a moment for the rest.
rows.translation: Mainot akordu, vispirms uzlieciet zemākās stīgas pirkstu. Tā ir pirmā nots, ko aizskar pārvilkums, tāpēc pārējiem pirkstiem vēl ir mirklis laika.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D lives on the thinnest three strings: finger 1 on string 3, fret 2; finger 3 on string 2, fret 3; finger 2 on string 1, fret 2.
rows.translation: D atrodas uz trim tievākajām stīgām: 1. pirksts uz 3. stīgas 2. ladā; 3. pirksts uz 2. stīgas 3. ladā; 2. pirksts uz 1. stīgas 2. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where does a D chord's strum start?
rows.translation: No kuras stīgas sāk D akorda pārvilkumu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D's root is open string 4. Strings 5 and 6 stay quiet.
rows.translation: D pamattonis ir brīva 4. stīga. 5. un 6. stīga paliek klusas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: For D minor, the note on string 1 drops to fret 1. Reshuffle: finger 1 on string 1, finger 2 on string 3, finger 3 stays on string 2.
rows.translation: D minoram nots uz 1. stīgas nolaižas uz 1. ladu. Pārkārtojiet pirkstus: 1. uz 1. stīgas, 2. uz 3. stīgas, 3. paliek uz 2. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A key is a song's home base. In the key of G, the chords G, C and D do most of the work. Countless folk and rock songs use only these three.
rows.translation: Tonalitāte ir dziesmas mājas. G tonalitātē galveno darbu dara akordi G, C un D. Neskaitāmas folka un roka dziesmas izmanto tikai šos trīs.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: You keep landing late on a change. What helps most?
rows.translation: Akordu maiņa jums arvien kavējas. Kas palīdz visvairāk?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slow, early changes build the habit. Speed follows on its own.
rows.translation: Lēnas, laikus sāktas maiņas veido ieradumu. Ātrums nāk pats.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A progression is a chord sequence that repeats. A minor, C, G, D starts dark and brightens as it climbs.
rows.translation: Akordu secība atkārtojas. A minors, C, G, D sākas tumši un kāpjot kļūst gaišāka.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Away from the app, pick two chords and switch for one minute, one strum each. Count your clean changes and beat that score tomorrow. Start with D and D minor.
rows.translation: Ārpus lietotnes izvēlieties divus akordus un mainiet tos vienu minūti, katru pārvelkot vienreiz. Skaitiet tīrās maiņas un rīt pārspējiet rezultātu. Sāciet ar D un D minoru.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In a one-minute change, what do you count?
rows.translation: Ko skaita, mainot akordus vienu minūti?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Kite Weather is a Timbre Original: bright campfire pop on G, D, E minor and C, around and around. Change early, and land the finger for the lowest string first. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Kite Weather ir Timbre oriģināldziesma — gaišs pops pie ugunskura ar G, D, E minoru un C, atkal un atkal. Mainiet laikus un vispirms uzlieciet zemākās stīgas pirkstu. Visa dziesma atrodama sadaļā Dziesmas → Oriģināldziesmas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord in Kite Weather skips strings 5 and 6?
rows.translation: Kurš akords dziesmā Kite Weather izlaiž 5. un 6. stīgu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D's root is open string 4, so strings 5 and 6 stay quiet.
rows.translation: D pamattonis ir brīva 4. stīga, tāpēc 5. un 6. stīga paliek klusas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The verse adds A on string 3, fret 2: the note finger 1 holds in D. Open G, A, then open B.
rows.translation: Pants pievieno A uz 3. stīgas 2. ladā: noti, ko D akordā tur 1. pirksts. Brīva G, A, tad brīva B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: C, G, D and D minor join E minor, E, A minor and A. Change early, strum steady and let each chord ring.
rows.translation: Nekā jauna: E minoram, E, A minoram un A pievienojas C, G, D un D minors. Mainiet laikus, pārvelciet vienmērīgi un ļaujiet katram akordam skanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G and A on string 3, D, E and F on string 4, the C major scale and two traditional tunes.
rows.translation: G un A uz 3. stīgas, D, E un F uz 4. stīgas, C mažora gamma un divas tautas melodijas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open string 3 is G. Put finger 2 on fret 2 and you get A. The same rule holds: the finger matches the fret.
rows.translation: Brīva 3. stīga ir G. Uzlieciet 2. pirkstu 2. ladā, un iegūsiet A. Spēkā tas pats noteikums: pirksts atbilst ladai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Iesvārstiet brīvu 3. stīgu. Tā ir G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G and A on string 3, then B, C and D on string 2.
rows.translation: G un A uz 3. stīgas, tad B, C un D uz 2. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G up to D and back
rows.translation: No G augšup līdz D un atpakaļ
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open string 4 is D. Fret 2 is E and fret 3 is F. Keep your thumb low behind the neck so your fingers can reach.
rows.translation: Brīva 4. stīga ir D. 2. lada ir E, bet 3. lada — F. Turiet īkšķi zemu aiz grifa, lai pirksti varētu aizsniegt notis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Iesvārstiet brīvu 4. stīgu. Tā ir D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret 2, then fret 3: E, then F.
rows.translation: 2. lada, tad 3. lada: E, tad F.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open string 4 and string 2, fret 3 share which name?
rows.translation: Kāds ir kopīgais nosaukums brīvai 4. stīgai un 2. stīgai 3. ladā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Both are D, an octave apart: the same note name, one higher than the other.
rows.translation: Abas ir D ar oktāvas starpību: vienāds nots nosaukums, bet viena skan augstāk par otru.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, E and F on string 4, then G and A on string 3.
rows.translation: D, E un F uz 4. stīgas, tad G un A uz 3. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Put finger 3 on string 5, fret 3. That's C, the note the C major scale starts on.
rows.translation: Uzlieciet 3. pirkstu uz 5. stīgas 3. ladā. Tā ir C — nots, ar kuru sākas C mažora gamma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 5, fret 3, third finger. That's C.
rows.translation: 5. stīga, 3. lada, trešais pirksts. Tā ir C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A scale climbs note by note from one letter to the same letter an octave higher. C major uses only plain letter names: C D E F G A B C.
rows.translation: Gamma kāpj noti pa notij no viena burta līdz tam pašam burtam oktāvu augstāk. C mažorā ir tikai burti bez zīmēm: C D E F G A B C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 5 fret 3, then strings 4, 3 and 2. Go slowly.
rows.translation: 5. stīgas 3. lada, tad 4., 3. un 2. stīga. Spēlējiet lēni.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many different letter names are in C major?
rows.translation: Cik dažādu burtu nosaukumu ir C mažorā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C D E F G A B, then C again an octave higher.
rows.translation: C D E F G A B, tad atkal C oktāvu augstāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: When the Saints Go Marching In
rows.translation: When the Saints Go Marching In
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This traditional spiritual became a jazz standard. It uses C, D, E, F and G on strings 5, 4 and 3.
rows.translation: Šis tradicionālais spiričuels kļuva par džeza standartu. Tajā ir C, D, E, F un G uz 5., 4. un 3. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening: C, E, F, then open G.
rows.translation: Sākums: C, E, F, tad brīva G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into a strong beat. Here beat one is silent, and C, E and F lead into a long G.
rows.translation: Uztakts ir dažas notis, kas ievada stipro sitienu. Šeit pirmais sitiens ir kluss, un C, E un F ievada garu G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chorus: E E D C, then C E G G G F.
rows.translation: Piedziedājums: E E D C, tad C E G G G F.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Amazing Grace is in three: count one, two, three, with the weight on one. Its notes sit on strings 4, 3 and 2.
rows.translation: Amazing Grace ir trijdaļu metrā: skaitiet viens, divi, trīs, ar uzsvaru uz „viens”. Tās notis atrodas uz 4., 3. un 2. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many beats are in each bar here?
rows.translation: Cik sitienu šeit ir katrā taktī?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A bar of three feels like a gentle sway: strong, weak, weak.
rows.translation: Trīs sitienu takts maigi šūpojas: stiprs, vājš, vājš.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening: D, G, B G, B, A. Open strings 4, 3 and 2, plus A.
rows.translation: Sākums: D, G, B G, B, A. Brīvas 4., 3. un 2. stīgas, un vēl A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Then down: G, E, D, D.
rows.translation: Tad lejup: G, E, D, D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The high part: open B up to D at fret 3, then down through B, G and A.
rows.translation: Augstā daļa: brīva B augšup līdz D 3. ladā, tad lejup caur B, G un A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Halogen is a Timbre Original: desert rock in D minor. Its riff uses the notes you just learned: open D, F at fret 3, open G, and C on string 5, fret 3. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Halogen ir Timbre oriģināldziesma — tuksneša roks D minorā. Tās rifā ir tikko apgūtās notis: brīva D, F 3. ladā, brīva G un C uz 5. stīgas 3. ladā. Visa dziesma atrodama sadaļā Dziesmas → Oriģināldziesmas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open string 4, F at fret 3, open string 3, then C at fret 3 on string 5.
rows.translation: Brīva 4. stīga, F 3. ladā, brīva 3. stīga, tad C uz 5. stīgas 3. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: every note from C on string 5 up to G on string 1, plus both tunes. Keep your thumb low and your fingers arched.
rows.translation: Nekā jauna: visas notis no C uz 5. stīgas līdz G uz 1. stīgas un abas melodijas. Turiet īkšķi zemu un pirkstus izliektus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C major from string 5, up to G on string 1.
rows.translation: C mažors no 5. stīgas augšup līdz G uz 1. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A mini F, D7, and two traditional songs with both chords and melody.
rows.translation: Mazais F, D7 un divas tautasdziesmas ar akordiem un melodiju.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This small F uses four strings. Finger 1 lies flat across strings 1 and 2 at fret 1, finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
rows.translation: Šis mazais F izmanto četras stīgas. 1. pirksts guļ pāri 1. un 2. stīgai 1. ladā, 2. pirksts ir uz 3. stīgas 2. ladā, bet 3. — uz 4. stīgas 3. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Tilt finger 1 slightly onto its thumb side. The bonier edge presses two strings more easily. Check that string 2 rings.
rows.translation: Mazliet sasveriet 1. pirkstu uz īkšķa pusi. Cietākā mala vieglāk nospiež divas stīgas. Pārbaudiet, vai 2. stīga skan.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This progression climbs step by step from A minor and lands on your new F. Strum twice per chord and change early.
rows.translation: Šī akordu secība soli pa solim kāpj no A minora un nonāk pie jaunā F. Katru akordu pārvelciet divreiz un mainiet laikus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This English tune is over 400 years old. Its chords are all ones you know: A minor, C, G, E minor, F and E. It's in three: strum once per bar, then on every beat.
rows.translation: Šī angļu melodija ir vairāk nekā 400 gadu veca. Visi akordi jau pazīstami: A minors, C, G, E minors, F un E. Tā ir trijdaļu metrā: pārvelciet vienreiz taktī, tad katrā sitienā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which strings does the mini F leave silent?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The mini F starts on string 4. Begin your strum there and skip strings 5 and 6.
rows.translation: Mazais F sākas uz 4. stīgas. Sāciet pārvilkumu no tās un izlaidiet 5. un 6. stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A sharp raises a note by one fret. Greensleeves uses G sharp on string 3, fret 1, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.
rows.translation: Diēzs paaugstina noti par vienu ladu. Greensleeves ir G diēzs uz 3. stīgas 1. ladā un F diēzs uz 4. stīgas 4. ladā. To aizsniedziet ar mazo pirkstu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G sharp, A, B: string 3 at frets 1 and 2, then open string 2.
rows.translation: G diēzs, A, B: 3. stīga 1. un 2. ladā, tad brīva 2. stīga.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening: A, C D, E F E, D B.
rows.translation: Sākums: A, C D, E F E, D B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sharp means one fret higher. G sharp sits between G and A.
rows.translation: Diēzs nozīmē vienu ladu augstāk. G diēzs atrodas starp G un A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chorus starts high: G on string 1, fret 3, then F sharp at fret 2.
rows.translation: Piedziedājums sākas augstu: G uz 1. stīgas 3. ladā, tad F diēzs 2. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A seventh chord adds a note that pulls toward home. D7 wants to move to G. Fingers: 2 on string 3, fret 2; 1 on string 2, fret 1; 3 on string 1, fret 2.
rows.translation: Septakords pievieno noti, kas velk uz toniku. D7 tiecas pāriet uz G. Pirksti: 2. uz 3. stīgas 2. ladā; 1. uz 2. stīgas 1. ladā; 3. uz 1. stīgas 2. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This American ballad from the 1880s needs only G and D7. It's in three, like Amazing Grace. Strum once per bar, then on every beat.
rows.translation: Šai amerikāņu balādei no 1880. gadiem vajag tikai G un D7. Tā ir trijdaļu metrā kā Amazing Grace. Pārvelciet vienreiz taktī, tad katrā sitienā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Clementine's melody sits on strings 4, 3 and 2. Its last line uses F sharp again: string 4, fret 4, little finger.
rows.translation: Dziesmas Clementine melodija atrodas uz 4., 3. un 2. stīgas. Pēdējā rindā atkal ir F diēzs: 4. stīga, 4. lada, mazais pirksts.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening: G G G, down to open D, up to open B.
rows.translation: Sākums: G G G, lejup līdz brīvai D, augšup līdz brīvai B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D7's extra note leans toward G. When G arrives, the tension lets go.
rows.translation: D7 papildu nots tiecas uz G. Kad atskan G, spriedze izzūd.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The last line: A, open D, F sharp at fret 4, A, then home to G.
rows.translation: Pēdējā rinda: A, brīva D, F diēzs 4. ladā, A, tad mājup uz G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ghost Light is a Timbre Original: a slow, dark ballad. Its verse walks A minor, F, C and E, so your mini F gets a song, and the G sharp in E pulls the tune back home. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Ghost Light ir Timbre oriģināldziesma — lēna, tumša balāde. Pants virzās pa A minoru, F, C un E: mazais F nu skan dziesmā, bet G diēzs E akordā velk melodiju atpakaļ mājup. Visa dziesma atrodama sadaļā Dziesmas → Oriģināldziesmas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Listen to the verse's last chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Klausieties panta pēdējo akordu. Mažors vai minors?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The ballad strum: one big strum on beat one and let it ring, another on three, then down-up on four. The space after each strum is part of the song.
rows.translation: Balādes pārvilkums: spēcīgi pārvelciet uz pirmā sitiena un ļaujiet skanēt, vēlreiz uz trešā, tad lejup–augšup uz ceturtā. Arī tukšums pēc pārvilkuma ir dziesmas daļa.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The verse's last line: open B, C at fret 1, B, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, B, then open E.
rows.translation: Panta pēdējā rinda: brīva B, C 1. ladā, B, G diēzs uz 3. stīgas 1. ladā, B, tad brīva E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Divas dziesmas no sākuma līdz beigām
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: the mini F, D7 and both songs from this unit. Change chords early and let the melodies sing.
rows.translation: Nekā jauna: mazais F, D7 un abas šīs nodaļas dziesmas. Mainiet akordus laikus un ļaujiet melodijām dziedāt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord pulls hardest toward G?
rows.translation: Kurš akords visspēcīgāk tiecas uz G?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E7, A7, G7 and B7, sus chords, the shuffle and your first 12-bar blues.
rows.translation: E7, A7, G7 un B7, sus akordi, šafls un pirmais 12 taktu blūzs.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play E, then lift finger 3 off string 4. The open D that rings is the seventh, a note that adds bluesy tension.
rows.translation: Spēlējiet E, tad paceliet 3. pirkstu no 4. stīgas. Brīvā D ir septīma — nots, kas piešķir blūza spriedzi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play A, then lift finger 2 off string 3. Open G rings, and A becomes A7.
rows.translation: Spēlējiet A, tad paceliet 2. pirkstu no 3. stīgas. Atskan brīva G, un A kļūst par A7.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How do you turn E into E7 here?
rows.translation: Kā šeit E pārvērst par E7?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G7 keeps the low G but puts F on top: finger 3 on string 6, fret 3; finger 2 on string 5, fret 2; finger 1 on string 1, fret 1.
rows.translation: G7 saglabā zemo G, bet augšā liek F: 3. pirksts uz 6. stīgas 3. ladā; 2. pirksts uz 5. stīgas 2. ladā; 1. pirksts uz 1. stīgas 1. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Build B7 from string 5: finger 2 at fret 2, finger 1 on string 4, fret 1, finger 3 on string 3, fret 2, little finger on string 1, fret 2. String 2 rings open.
rows.translation: Veidojiet B7 no 5. stīgas: 2. pirksts 2. ladā, 1. uz 4. stīgas 1. ladā, 3. uz 3. stīgas 2. ladā, mazais uz 1. stīgas 2. ladā. 2. stīga skan brīva.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord does B7 lead to most naturally?
rows.translation: Uz kuru akordu B7 ved visdabiskāk?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B7 pulls toward E. Its tension melts into E minor or E.
rows.translation: B7 tiecas uz E. Tā spriedze izkūst E minorā vai E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A shuffle splits each beat unevenly: a long strum down, a short one up. It's the heartbeat of the blues. Think hum-pty, dum-pty.
rows.translation: Šafls katru sitienu sadala nevienādi: garš pārvilkums lejup, īss augšup. Tā ir blūza sirdspukstu izjūta. Domājiet „tāā-ta, tāā-ta”.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In a shuffle, each beat splits into…
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Many blues songs follow one 12-bar plan. In E: four bars of E7, two of A7, two of E7, then one each of B7, A7, E7 and B7.
rows.translation: Daudzas blūza dziesmas seko vienai 12 taktu shēmai. E tonalitātē: četras E7 taktis, divas A7, divas E7, tad pa vienai B7, A7, E7 un B7 taktij.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many bars of E7 open the 12-bar blues?
rows.translation: Cik E7 taktu sāk 12 taktu blūzu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The last four bars move faster: B7, A7, E7, then B7, which turns you around to the top. Change early and keep the shuffle going.
rows.translation: Pēdējās četrās taktīs maiņas ir ātrākas: B7, A7, E7, tad B7, kas atgriež jūs sākumā. Mainiet laikus un turpiniet šaflu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A sus chord swaps the note that makes it major or minor for a neighbor. It sounds open and unresolved until it settles home.
rows.translation: Sus akordā noti, kas nosaka mažoru vai minoru, aizstāj ar blakus noti. Tas skan atvērti un neatrisināti, līdz atgriežas mājās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lift finger 2 off string 1 to get Dsus2. For Asus4, play A and add your little finger on string 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Paceliet 2. pirkstu no 1. stīgas, lai iegūtu Dsus2. Asus4 iegūst, spēlējot A un pieliekot mazo pirkstu uz 2. stīgas 3. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rust Belt Shuffle is a Timbre Original: a 12-bar blues in E, the plan you just strummed, with a swung tune on top. Keep the long-short feel in both hands. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Rust Belt Shuffle ir Timbre oriģināldziesma — 12 taktu blūzs E tonalitātē ar tikko spēlēto shēmu un svingojošu melodiju. Abās rokās saglabājiet garo–īso ritmu. Visa dziesma atrodama sadaļā Dziesmas → Oriģināldziesmas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open G, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, then open B: the bluesy slide in bar two.
rows.translation: Brīva G, tad G diēzs uz 3. stīgas 1. ladā, tad brīva B: blūza slīdiens otrajā taktī.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bar two slides from G to G sharp. Which one belongs to E7?
rows.translation: Otrajā taktī ir slīdiens no G uz G diēzu. Kura nots pieder E7?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E7 is E, G sharp, B and D. G is the blue note: it rubs against the chord, then slides into it.
rows.translation: E7 ir E, G diēzs, B un D. G ir blūza nots: tā rada berzi ar akordu, tad ieslīd tajā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bar nine, over B7: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D sharp at fret 4 on string 2 with your little finger, then B.
rows.translation: Devītā takts virs B7: F diēzs uz 1. stīgas 2. ladā, brīva E, D diēzs uz 2. stīgas 4. ladā ar mazo pirkstu, tad B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: seventh chords, sus chords and the 12-bar shuffle. Keep the long-short swing steady through every change.
rows.translation: Nekā jauna: septakordi, sus akordi un 12 taktu šafls. Katrā maiņā saglabājiet vienmērīgu garo–īso svingu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord uses all four fingers?
rows.translation: Kurā akordā izmanto visus četrus pirkstus?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Power chords, open and movable, palm muting and a riff of your own.
rows.translation: Kvintakordi ar brīvām stīgām un pārvietojami tvērieni, slāpēšana ar plaukstu un savs rifs.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A power chord plays only the root and the fifth, the note five letters up. Neither major nor minor, it stays punchy, even loud. E5 is the bottom of E minor.
rows.translation: Kvintakordā skan tikai pamattonis un kvinta — nots piecus burtus augstāk. Tas nav ne mažors, ne minors un saglabā spēku arī skaļi. E5 ir E minora apakšējā daļa.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Move the same two fingers to strings 4 and 3. With open string 5, that's A5. Aim your strum at strings 5, 4 and 3 only.
rows.translation: Pārceliet tos pašus divus pirkstus uz 4. un 3. stīgu. Kopā ar brīvu 5. stīgu tas ir A5. Pārvelciet tikai 5., 4. un 3. stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which notes make a power chord?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rest the edge of your hand
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lay the outer edge of your picking hand on the strings, right where they meet the bridge. Strum, and the notes turn short and chunky.
rows.translation: Uzlieciet spēlējošās rokas ārējo malu uz stīgām tieši pie tiltiņa. Pārvelciet, un notis kļūs īsas un blīvas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where does your palm rest for palm muting?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: At the bridge the strings still sound, just shorter. Move forward and they go dead.
rows.translation: Pie tiltiņa stīgas vēl skan, tikai īsāk. Pārvietojot roku uz priekšu, skaņa izdziest.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rock often builds with muted eighths, then lands on an open chord. Lift your palm for the big strum and let it ring.
rows.translation: Rokā bieži kāpina enerģiju ar slāpētām astotdaļām, tad atver akorda skanējumu. Spēcīgajam pārvilkumam paceliet plaukstu un ļaujiet akordam skanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Finger 1 on string 6, fret 3, then fingers 3 and 4 two frets higher on strings 5 and 4. That's G5. Slide it and the name follows the fret.
rows.translation: 1. pirksts uz 6. stīgas 3. ladā, tad 3. un 4. pirksts divas ladas augstāk uz 5. un 4. stīgas. Tas ir G5. Pabīdiet tvērienu, un nosaukums mainīsies līdzi ladai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your root is on string 6, fret 5. Which power chord is it?
rows.translation: Pamattonis ir uz 6. stīgas 5. ladā. Kurš kvintakords tas ir?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count up string 6: E open, F at 1, G at 3, A at 5.
rows.translation: Skaitiet augšup pa 6. stīgu: brīva E, F 1. ladā, G 3. ladā, A 5. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The same shape works from string 5. Finger 1 on string 5, fret 3 gives C5. Let the tip of finger 1 touch string 6 to keep it quiet.
rows.translation: Tas pats tvēriens darbojas no 5. stīgas. 1. pirksts uz 5. stīgas 3. ladā dod C5. Ar 1. pirksta galu pieskarieties 6. stīgai, lai tā neskanētu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A riff is a short, catchy phrase that repeats. This one bounces off open low E. Rest your palm at the bridge to keep it tight.
rows.translation: Rifs ir īsa, lipīga frāze, kas atkārtojas. Šis atspēžas no brīvās zemās E. Turiet plaukstu pie tiltiņa, lai skaņa būtu stingra.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open E, string 6 at fret 3, then open A.
rows.translation: Brīva E, 6. stīga 3. ladā, tad brīva A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The second bar climbs string 5: fret 2, then fret 5 with your little finger, then back to fret 2. Keep finger 1 parked near fret 2.
rows.translation: Otrā takts kāpj pa 5. stīgu: 2. lada, tad 5. lada ar mazo pirkstu, tad atpakaļ uz 2. ladu. Turiet 1. pirkstu pie 2. ladas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 5: fret 2, fret 5 with your little finger, fret 2 again.
rows.translation: 5. stīga: 2. lada, 5. lada ar mazo pirkstu, atkal 2. lada.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What makes a riff a riff?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Songs often answer a riff with power chords. Play the riff, then hit the chords on one, the and of two, and four.
rows.translation: Dziesmās uz rifu bieži atbild kvintakordi. Nospēlējiet rifu, tad akordus uz „viens”, „divi-un” un „četri”.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slide G5 up two frets. What do you get?
rows.translation: Pārbīdiet G5 divas ladas augstāk. Ko iegūstat?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two frets above G is A. The chord's name moves with its root.
rows.translation: Divas ladas virs G ir A. Akorda nosaukums pārvietojas līdzi tā pamattonim.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Basement Weather is a Timbre Original: garage rock in A. A riff on the low strings opens it, then power chords punch back on one, the and of two, and four. Keep your palm at the bridge. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Basement Weather ir Timbre oriģināldziesma — garāžroks A tonalitātē. To sāk rifs uz zemajām stīgām, tad kvintakordi atbild uz „viens”, „divi-un” un „četri”. Turiet plaukstu pie tiltiņa. Visa dziesma atrodama sadaļā Dziesmas → Oriģināldziesmas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open A, C at fret 3 on string 5, open D, then G at fret 3 on string 6 and open low E.
rows.translation: Brīva A, C uz 5. stīgas 3. ladā, brīva D, tad G uz 6. stīgas 3. ladā un brīva zemā E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: You know C5, with finger 1 on string 5, fret 3. Slide the whole shape up two frets and it becomes D5. G5 sits at fret 3 too, one string lower than C5.
rows.translation: Jūs zināt C5 ar 1. pirkstu uz 5. stīgas 3. ladā. Pārbīdiet visu tvērienu divas ladas augstāk — tas kļūst par D5. Arī G5 atrodas 3. ladā, vienu stīgu zemāk par C5.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: power chords, open and movable, palm muting and your riff. Lock in with the click and keep the mutes tight.
rows.translation: Nekā jauna: kvintakordi ar brīvām stīgām un pārvietojami tvērieni, slāpēšana ar plaukstu un jūsu rifs. Saskaņojieties ar klikšķi un slāpējiet precīzi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your root is on string 5, fret 3. Which power chord is it?
rows.translation: Pamattonis ir uz 5. stīgas 3. ladā. Kurš kvintakords tas ir?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3.
rows.translation: 5. stīga kāpj no A: B 2. ladā, C 3. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which one is a power chord?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The F barre and B minor, the A minor pentatonic scale and your first solo.
rows.translation: F barē un B minors, A minora pentatonika un jūsu pirmais solo.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Full barre chords take weeks, so build up to them. You know the mini F. Next comes a five-string F, then the full barre.
rows.translation: Pilnu barē akordu apguve prasa nedēļas, tāpēc virzieties pakāpeniski. Jūs jau protat mazo F. Tālāk — F uz piecām stīgām, tad pilns barē.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Move finger 3 to string 5, fret 3, and put your little finger on string 4, fret 3. Five strings ring and the F sounds fuller.
rows.translation: Pārceliet 3. pirkstu uz 5. stīgas 3. ladu un uzlieciet mazo pirkstu uz 4. stīgas 3. ladā. Skan piecas stīgas, un F kļūst pilnīgāks.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Barre chords feel hard at first. What helps most?
rows.translation: Barē akordi sākumā ir grūti. Kas palīdz visvairāk?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Squeezing as hard as you can
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Strength and feel build slowly. Short, daily practice beats one long, painful session.
rows.translation: Spēks un izjūta aug lēni. Īsi ikdienas vingrinājumi ir labāki par vienu garu, sāpīgu nodarbību.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lay finger 1 flat across all six strings at fret 1. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 make an E shape in front of it. F is E moved up one fret.
rows.translation: Noguldiet 1. pirkstu pāri visām sešām stīgām 1. ladā. 2., 3. un 4. pirksts priekšā veido E tvērienu. F ir E vienu ladu augstāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Let your arm's weight pull the barre in, as if gently drawing the neck toward you. Your thumb only steadies. Roll finger 1 onto its side.
rows.translation: Lai rokas svars pievelk barē, it kā jūs maigi vilktu grifu sev klāt. Īkšķis tikai stabilizē. Pagrieziet 1. pirkstu uz sānu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The F barre is which open shape, moved up a fret?
rows.translation: Kuru brīvo stīgu tvērienu pārceļ vienu ladu augstāk, lai iegūtu F barē?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Finger 1 barres strings 1 to 5 at fret 2. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 build an A minor shape two frets higher. Skip string 6.
rows.translation: 1. pirksts veido barē pāri 1.–5. stīgai 2. ladā. 2., 3. un 4. pirksts divas ladas augstāk veido A minora tvērienu. Izlaidiet 6. stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Not ready to barre? Play the top four strings only: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: Vēl neesat gatavi barē? Spēlējiet tikai četras augšējās stīgas: 4. lada uz 4. un 3. stīgas, 3. lada uz 2. stīgas, 2. lada uz 1. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord is E moved up one fret with a barre?
rows.translation: Kurš akords ir E tvēriens vienu ladu augstāk ar barē?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The minor pentatonic scale has five notes. In A minor they're A, C, D, E and G. It's the sound of countless blues and rock solos.
rows.translation: Minora pentatonikā ir piecas notis. A minorā tās ir A, C, D, E un G. Tā skan neskaitāmi blūza un roka solo.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Finger 1 covers fret 5 on every string. Fingers 3 and 4 take frets 7 and 8. Two notes per string, one finger per fret.
rows.translation: 1. pirksts aptver 5. ladu uz katras stīgas. 3. un 4. pirksts spēlē 7. un 8. ladā. Divas notis uz stīgas, viens pirksts katrai ladai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret 5, fret 8 on string 6, then fret 5, fret 7 on string 5.
rows.translation: 5. lada, 8. lada uz 6. stīgas, tad 5. lada, 7. lada uz 5. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which notes are in A minor pentatonic?
rows.translation: Kuras notis ir A minora pentatonikā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A solo is a melody built from short phrases. Play a few notes, leave a gap, then answer. Ending on A, the root, sounds like a full stop.
rows.translation: Solo ir melodija no īsām frāzēm. Nospēlējiet dažas notis, atstājiet pauzi, tad atbildiet. Beigas uz A, pamattoņa, skan kā punkts teikuma beigās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note sounds most like a full stop in A minor?
rows.translation: Kura nots A minorā visvairāk skan kā punkts teikuma beigās?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A is the root, the home of A minor. Ending a phrase on it sounds finished.
rows.translation: A ir pamattonis, A minora mājas. Frāze, kas beidzas uz tā, skan pabeigti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A power ballad with a barre
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Glass Satellites is a Timbre Original: a power ballad on A minor, F, C and G. Your full F barre takes the second chord, and box 1 fits over the whole loop, so it gets a solo. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Glass Satellites ir Timbre oriģināldziesma — rokbalāde ar A minoru, F, C un G. Otrais akords ir pilns F barē, bet 1. forma der visam ciklam, tāpēc tajā skan solo. Visa dziesma atrodama sadaļā Dziesmas → Oriģināldziesmas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Over the F chord, which box-1 notes belong to it?
rows.translation: Kuras 1. formas notis pieder F akordam?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F is F, A and C. Box 1 holds A and C, so they sound settled over F.
rows.translation: F akords ir F, A un C. 1. formā ir A un C, tāpēc virs F tās skan stabili.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: barre chords, B minor, the pentatonic box and your solo. Breathe, keep the beat, and play it like you mean it.
rows.translation: Nekā jauna: barē akordi, B minors, pentatonikas forma un jūsu solo. Elpojiet, turiet ritmu un spēlējiet ar pārliecību.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which finger covers fret 5 in box 1?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Thumb on the bass, p-i-m-a, Travis picking and a fingerpicked ballad.
rows.translation: Īkšķis spēlē basu, p-i-m-a, Travis spēle un balāde ar pirkstiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fingerpicking means plucking with your fingers instead of a pick. Your thumb owns the bass strings, 6, 5 and 4, and plays on the beat like a bass drum.
rows.translation: Spēlē ar pirkstiem stīgas iesvārsta ar pirkstiem, nevis mediatoru. Īkšķim pieder basa stīgas — 6., 5. un 4. —, un tas spēlē katrā sitienā kā lielā bunga.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Thumb only: push down through strings 6, 5 and 4, one at a time.
rows.translation: Tikai īkšķis: virziet to lejup pāri 6., 5. un 4. stīgai, katrai atsevišķi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which strings does your thumb usually play?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The thumb takes the bass strings. Your fingers take the thinner ones.
rows.translation: Īkšķis spēlē basa stīgas. Pārējie pirksti — tievākās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold A minor. Your thumb plays the root on string 5, then rocks over to string 4, the chord's fifth. Root, fifth, root, fifth: that's an alternating bass.
rows.translation: Turiet A minoru. Īkšķis spēlē pamattoni uz 5. stīgas, tad pārceļas uz 4. stīgu — akorda kvintu. Pamattonis, kvinta, pamattonis, kvinta: tas ir mainīgais bass.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: No E minora uz A minoru
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fingerstyle borrows Spanish names: p for the thumb, i index, m middle, a ring. Rest i on string 3, m on string 2 and a on string 1, ready to pluck.
rows.translation: Spēlē ar pirkstiem aizgūti spāņu nosaukumi: p — īkšķis, i — rādītājpirksts, m — vidējais, a — zeltnesis. Uzlieciet i uz 3. stīgas, m uz 2., a uz 1., gatavus spēlēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: i, m, a: index on string 3, middle on 2, ring on 1.
rows.translation: i, m, a: rādītājpirksts uz 3. stīgas, vidējais uz 2., zeltnesis uz 1.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: p thumb, i index, m middle, a ring. The little finger usually rests.
rows.translation: p — īkšķis, i — rādītājpirksts, m — vidējais, a — zeltnesis. Mazais pirksts parasti atpūšas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each finger plucks up and slightly toward your palm, then relaxes. Keep your hand still above the strings and let the fingers do the moving.
rows.translation: Katrs pirksts iesvārsta stīgu augšup un mazliet uz plaukstas pusi, tad atslābst. Turiet plaukstu nekustīgu virs stīgām un ļaujiet kustēties pirkstiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Travis picking, named after Merle Travis, keeps the thumb alternating on every beat while the fingers pluck in between, on the ands.
rows.translation: Travis spēlē, kas nosaukta Merle Travis vārdā, īkšķis katrā sitienā pārmaiņus spēlē basa stīgas, bet pārējie pirksti spēlē starp sitieniem, uz „un”.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In Travis picking, what does the thumb do?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Alternates bass notes on every beat
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The thumb is the steady pulse: a bass note on every beat, rocking between two strings.
rows.translation: Īkšķis ir vienmērīgais pulss: basa nots katrā sitienā, pārmaiņus uz divām stīgām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Keep the thumb going. Between thumb notes, m plucks string 2 and i plucks string 3: thumb, m, thumb, i. Go slowly until it runs by itself.
rows.translation: Turpiniet īkšķa kustību. Starp īkšķa notīm m spēlē 2. stīgu, i — 3. stīgu: īkšķis, m, īkšķis, i. Spēlējiet lēni, līdz kustība notiek pati.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Between thumb notes, which finger plucks string 2?
rows.translation: Kurš pirksts starp īkšķa notīm iesvārsta 2. stīgu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In this pattern m takes string 2 and i takes string 3. The a finger rests for now.
rows.translation: Šajā rakstā m spēlē 2. stīgu, i — 3. stīgu. Pirksts a pagaidām atpūšas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: When the chord changes, the thumb lands on the new root right on beat one. The fingers keep plucking strings 2 and 3 as before.
rows.translation: Mainoties akordam, īkšķis spēlē jauno pamattoni tieši pirmajā sitienā. Pārējie pirksti turpina spēlēt 2. un 3. stīgu kā iepriekš.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chord changes. Where does your thumb go?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The bass tells the ear which chord you're on. Landing the root on beat one makes the change clear.
rows.translation: Bass ausij pasaka, kurš akords skan. Pamattonis pirmajā sitienā padara maiņu skaidru.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold each chord for the whole bar so every note rings into the next. Lift a finger only when the next shape needs it.
rows.translation: Turiet katru akordu visu takti, lai katra nots turpinātu skanēt līdz nākamajai. Paceliet pirkstu tikai tad, kad tas vajadzīgs jaunajam tvērienam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: An arpeggio plays a chord one note at a time. This one rolls p, i, m, a, then back down m, i. Six notes fill a bar of three, two to a beat.
rows.translation: Arpedžo ir akorda spēle pa vienai notij. Šis plūst p, i, m, a, tad atpakaļ m, i. Sešas notis aizpilda trīs sitienu takti — divas katrā sitienā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: After a plucks string 1, which finger comes next?
rows.translation: Kad a iesvārsta 1. stīgu, kurš pirksts spēlē nākamais?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The roll turns around at the top: p, i, m, a, then m and i on the way back.
rows.translation: Raksts augšā apgriežas: p, i, m, a, tad atpakaļceļā m un i.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: One bar each: A minor, F, C, G, then A minor, F, E, A minor. Your thumb finds each new root: strings 5, 4, 5 and 6.
rows.translation: Pa vienai taktij: A minors, F, C, G, tad A minors, F, E, A minors. Īkšķis atrod katru jauno pamattoni: uz 5., 4., 5. un 6. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Porchlight is a Timbre Original: a slow ballad in D. Fingerpick it: your thumb on each chord's root, then i, m and a up strings 3, 2 and 1. Let every note ring into the next. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Porchlight ir Timbre oriģināldziesma — lēna balāde D tonalitātē. Spēlējiet ar pirkstiem: īkšķis uz katra akorda pamattoņa, tad i, m un a augšup pa 3., 2. un 1. stīgu. Lai katra nots skan līdz nākamajai. Visa dziesma: Dziesmas → Oriģināldziesmas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In D, which string does your thumb play?
rows.translation: Kuru stīgu D akordā spēlē īkšķis?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D's root is open string 4. Strings 5 and 6 stay quiet in this chord.
rows.translation: D pamattonis ir brīva 4. stīga. Šajā akordā 5. un 6. stīga paliek klusas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: the alternating bass, p-i-m-a, Travis picking and the ballad. Keep the thumb steady and let every note ring.
rows.translation: Nekā jauna: mainīgais bass, p-i-m-a, Travis spēle un balāde. Turiet īkšķi vienmērīgā ritmā un ļaujiet katrai notij skanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In p-i-m-a, which letter is the thumb?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Between thumb notes, which finger plucks string 3?
rows.translation: Kurš pirksts starp īkšķa notīm iesvārsta 3. stīgu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The 12-bar in A, the quick change, a boogie bass line, the turnaround and your first blues licks.
rows.translation: 12 taktu blūzs A tonalitātē, agrā maiņa, bugi basa līnija, atgriešanās pāreja un pirmās blūza frāzes.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Blues chords sit on the first, fourth and fifth notes of the key. In E that's E7, A7 and B7. Move to the key of A and they become A7, D7 and E7.
rows.translation: Blūza akordi balstās uz tonalitātes pirmās, ceturtās un piektās pakāpes. E tonalitātē tie ir E7, A7 un B7. A tonalitātē tie kļūst par A7, D7 un E7.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the key of A, which chord does the job B7 did in E?
rows.translation: Kurš akords A tonalitātē dara to, ko B7 darīja E tonalitātē?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B7 is five letters up from E. Five letters up from A is E, so E7 takes its place.
rows.translation: B7 ir piecus burtus virs E. Piecus burtus virs A ir E, tāpēc tā vietā stājas E7.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Four bars of A7, two of D7, two of A7, then one each of E7, D7, A7 and E7. The last E7 turns you back to the top.
rows.translation: Četras A7 taktis, divas D7, divas A7, tad pa vienai E7, D7, A7 un E7 taktij. Pēdējais E7 atgriež jūs sākumā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In a quick change, bar 2 jumps to the four chord and straight back. In A: A7, D7, A7, A7. It adds motion right from the start.
rows.translation: Agrā maiņa 2. taktī pārlec uz ceturtās pakāpes akordu un uzreiz atgriežas. A tonalitātē: A7, D7, A7, A7. Tas rada kustību jau no sākuma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In a quick change in A, which chord is bar 2?
rows.translation: Kurš akords agrās maiņas blūzā A tonalitātē skan 2. taktī?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The four chord in A is D7. The quick change visits it in bar 2, then returns to A7.
rows.translation: Ceturtās pakāpes akords A tonalitātē ir D7. Agrā maiņa to spēlē 2. taktī, tad atgriežas uz A7.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The quick change works in any key. In E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Watch for B7 near the end, your four-finger chord.
rows.translation: Agrā maiņa darbojas jebkurā tonalitātē. E tonalitātē: E7, A7, E7, E7. Beigu tuvumā gaidiet B7 — akordu ar četriem pirkstiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A boogie line walks up the chord and back, each note twice, long-short like the shuffle. Over A7 it climbs A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, then walks back down.
rows.translation: Bugi līnija kāpj pa akordu un atpakaļ, katru noti spēlējot divreiz, gari–īsi kā šaflā. Virs A7 tā kāpj A, C diēzs, E, F diēzs, G, tad soļo lejup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open A, fret 4 on string 5, frets 2 and 4 on string 4, then open G.
rows.translation: Brīva A, 5. stīgas 4. lada, 4. stīgas 2. un 4. lada, tad brīva G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How do the two notes of each pair feel?
rows.translation: Kāda ir katra pāra divu nošu ilgumu izjūta?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: It's the shuffle again: a long note on the beat, a short one just before the next.
rows.translation: Atkal šafls: gara nots uz sitiena, īsa tieši pirms nākamā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Move it to D and E
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The same walk starts from D on string 4 and from E on string 6. Over D7: D, F sharp, A, B, C. Over E7: E, G sharp, B, C sharp, D.
rows.translation: Tas pats gājiens sākas no D uz 4. stīgas un no E uz 6. stīgas. Virs D7: D, F diēzs, A, B, C. Virs E7: E, G diēzs, B, C diēzs, D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Boogie, A to D and back
rows.translation: Bugi no A uz D un atpakaļ
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A lick that turns you around
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bars 11 and 12 often get a turnaround, a short lick that leads back to the top. This one walks down from A to E, one fret at a time.
rows.translation: 11. un 12. taktī bieži ir atgriešanās pāreja — īsa frāze, kas ved atpakaļ sākumā. Šī kāpj lejup no A uz E, pa vienai ladai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 4: fret 4, then 3, then 2. Let the E ring.
rows.translation: 4. stīga: 4. lada, tad 3., tad 2. Ļaujiet E skanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where does a turnaround usually go?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The last two bars. It leads the ear back to bar 1 for another time around.
rows.translation: Pēdējās divās taktīs. Tā ved ausi atpakaļ uz 1. takti nākamajam aplim.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Strum the first ten bars with the quick change, then switch to the lick for bars 11 and 12. That's how a blues band ends each time around.
rows.translation: Pirmās desmit taktis spēlējiet ar pārvilkumiem un agro maiņu, tad 11. un 12. taktī pārejiet uz frāzi. Tā blūza grupa noslēdz katru apli.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your A minor pentatonic box fits right over a blues in A. Its C rubs against the C sharp in A7, and that rub is the sound of the blues.
rows.translation: A minora pentatonikas forma der blūzam A tonalitātē. Tās C berzējas pret C diēzu A7 akordā, un šī berze ir blūza skanējums.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Over a blues in A, which note sounds most like home?
rows.translation: Kura nots blūzā A tonalitātē visvairāk skan kā mājas?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A is the root of the key. Licks that end on A sound settled; G and C leave you hanging.
rows.translation: A ir tonalitātes pamattonis. Frāzes, kas beidzas uz A, skan stabili; G un C atstāj nepabeigtības sajūtu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Blues phrases talk to each other. Play lick 1 as the question, then answer with lick 2, which lands on the low A.
rows.translation: Blūza frāzes sarunājas. Nospēlējiet 1. frāzi kā jautājumu, tad atbildiet ar 2. frāzi, kas beidzas uz zemās A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Neon Laundromat is a Timbre Original: funk that sits on one chord, A7. Its hook slides from C to C sharp, the same rub your blues licks make, and its chorus drops to E7. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Neon Laundromat ir Timbre oriģināldziesma — fanks uz viena akorda, A7. Galvenais motīvs slīd no C uz C diēzu, radot to pašu berzi kā blūza frāzēs, bet piedziedājums nolaižas uz E7. Visa dziesma atrodama sadaļā Dziesmas → Oriģināldziesmas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, then C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2, then open E.
rows.translation: A uz 3. stīgas 2. ladā, tad C un C diēzs uz 2. stīgas 1. un 2. ladā, tad brīva E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Over A7, which note rubs against the chord?
rows.translation: Kura nots virs A7 rada berzi ar akordu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A7 is A, C sharp, E and G. C, from your pentatonic box, rubs against its C sharp, and the hook slides from one to the other.
rows.translation: A7 ir A, C diēzs, E un G. C no pentatonikas formas berzējas pret C diēzu, un galvenais motīvs slīd no vienas nots uz otru.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Neon Laundromat doesn't shuffle. Play your boogie walk in even eighths and it becomes a bass line under the A7: A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, and back down.
rows.translation: Neon Laundromat nav šafla. Spēlējiet bugi gājienu vienādās astotdaļās, un tas kļūst par basa līniju zem A7: A, C diēzs, E, F diēzs, G un atpakaļ lejup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: the 12-bar in A and E, the quick change, the boogie line, the turnaround and your licks. Keep the shuffle swinging.
rows.translation: Nekā jauna: 12 taktu blūzs A un E tonalitātē, agrā maiņa, bugi līnija, atgriešanās pāreja un jūsu frāzes. Lai šafls turpina svingot.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In a quick change in E, which chord is bar 2?
rows.translation: Kurš akords agrās maiņas blūzā E tonalitātē skan 2. taktī?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bends and vibrato, and a second pentatonic box.
rows.translation: Hammer-on, pull-off, slaidi, bendi un vibrato, un otra pentatonikas forma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A hammer-on sounds a second note with the fretting hand alone. Pick a note, then bring another finger down hard, just behind a higher fret. The string keeps ringing.
rows.translation: Hammer-on liek otrai notij skanēt tikai ar grifa roku. Iesvārstiet noti, tad stingri uzsitiet citu pirkstu tieši aiz augstākas ladas. Stīga turpina skanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pick open string 3, then hammer finger 2 onto fret 2. Don't pick the second note.
rows.translation: Iesvārstiet brīvu 3. stīgu, tad uzsitiet 2. pirkstu 2. ladā. Otro noti ar spēlējošo roku neskariet.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 3: pick fret 5 with finger 1, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 7.
rows.translation: 3. stīga: turiet 5. ladu ar 1. pirkstu, iesvārstiet stīgu, tad uzsitiet 3. pirkstu 7. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What makes a hammer-on ring clearly?
rows.translation: Kas liek hammer-on notij skanēt skaidri?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Abas notis spēcīgi spēlēt ar mediatoru
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A fast, firm landing right behind the fret
rows.translation: Ātri un stingri uzlikt pirkstu tieši aiz ladas
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Speed and aim matter more than force. Land on the fingertip, right behind the fret, and the string keeps singing.
rows.translation: Ātrums un precizitāte ir svarīgāki par spēku. Uzlieciet pirksta galu tieši aiz ladas, un stīga turpinās dziedāt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A pull-off drops to a lower note. With both fingers down, pick the higher note, then flick the top finger off sideways so it plucks the string as it leaves.
rows.translation: Pull-off pāriet uz zemāku noti. Turot abus pirkstus piespiestus, iesvārstiet augstāko noti, tad augšējo pirkstu paraujiet sānis, lai, atlaižot stīgu, tas to iesvārstītu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 3, then flick finger 2 off to sound open G.
rows.translation: 2. lada uz 3. stīgas, tad paraujiet 2. pirkstu nost, lai atskanētu brīva G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fingers 1 and 3 on frets 5 and 7. Pick, then pull finger 3 off.
rows.translation: 1. un 3. pirksts 5. un 7. ladā. Iesvārstiet stīgu, tad paraujiet 3. pirkstu nost.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In a pull-off, the top finger…
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Flicks off sideways, plucking the string
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lifting straight up lets the note die. A small sideways flick plucks the lower note into life.
rows.translation: Paceļot taisni augšup, nots apklust. Neliels rāviens sānis iesvārsta zemāko noti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: To slide, pick a note and keep pressing as you glide the same finger to a new fret. The pressure carries the sound; only the first note is picked.
rows.translation: Slaidam iesvārstiet noti un turpiniet spiest, slīdot ar to pašu pirkstu uz jaunu ladu. Spiediens uztur skaņu; iesvārsta tikai pirmo noti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 7. Pick, then slide up to fret 9 without lifting.
rows.translation: 3. pirksts uz 3. stīgas 7. ladā. Iesvārstiet, tad, neatlaižot pirkstu, slīdiet augšup uz 9. ladu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: During a slide, what keeps the note sounding?
rows.translation: Kas slaida laikā uztur nots skanējumu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ease off and the note dies. Keep the same pressure all the way to the new fret.
rows.translation: Atlaižot spiedienu, nots apklust. Saglabājiet vienādu spiedienu līdz pat jaunajai ladai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now back: pick fret 9 and slide down to fret 7.
rows.translation: Tagad atpakaļ: iesvārstiet 9. ladā un slīdiet lejup uz 7. ladu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A bend pushes the string across the fret to raise its pitch. A whole-step bend, the size of two frets, from fret 7 must sound exactly like fret 9.
rows.translation: Bends pabīda stīgu šķērsām pāri ladai, paaugstinot skaņu. Pilna toņa bends, kas atbilst divām ladām, no 7. ladas skan tieši tāpat kā 9. lada.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 3, fret 9: this is your bend target. Let it ring and remember it.
rows.translation: 3. stīga, 9. lada: tā ir benda mērķa nots. Ļaujiet tai skanēt un iegaumējiet.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Put finger 3 on fret 7 with fingers 1 and 2 behind it on the same string. Push all three toward the ceiling, turning your wrist as if turning a doorknob.
rows.translation: Uzlieciet 3. pirkstu 7. ladā, aiz tā uz tās pašas stīgas — 1. un 2. pirkstu. Stumiet visus trīs uz griestu pusi, pagriežot plaukstas locītavu kā durvju rokturi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your bend from fret 7 sounds lower than fret 9. What now?
