rows.translation: Kurš variants ir G7 — akords ar lielāku spriedzi?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, A minor, F, G7 and G cover hundreds of songs. Make each shape clean, then keep the beat as you change.
rows.translation: C, A minors, F, G7 un G aptver simtiem dziesmu. Katru tvērienu uzlieciet tīri, tad mainiet, saglabājot ritmu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord uses only one finger?
rows.translation: Kurš akords izmanto tikai vienu pirkstu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Steady downs, down-ups and the island strum.
rows.translation: Vienmērīgi pārvilkumi lejup, lejup–augšup un salu pārvilkums.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Strum down on every beat: 1, 2, 3, 4. Use the nail of your index finger. When you change chords, your hand keeps moving.
rows.translation: Katrā sitienā pārvelciet lejup: 1, 2, 3, 4. Izmantojiet rādītājpirksta nagu. Mainot akordus, roka turpina kustēties.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What should your hand do while you change chords?
rows.translation: Ko rokai darīt akordu maiņas laikā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A late chord is better than a broken beat. Keep strumming, even if a string buzzes.
rows.translation: Novēlots akords ir labāks par pārrautu ritmu. Turpiniet pārvilkumus, pat ja kāda stīga džinkst.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Strum down on the numbers, up on each and. Your hand never stops moving.
rows.translation: Skaitiet 1 un 2 un 3 un 4 un. Uz skaitļiem pārvelciet lejup, uz katra „un” — augšup. Roka nekad neapstājas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Up strums mostly catch strings 1 and 2. Brush them with the pad of your finger, a little softer than the downs.
rows.translation: Pārvilkumi augšup pārsvarā aizskar 1. un 2. stīgu. Pārvelciet tās ar pirksta spilventiņu mazliet klusāk nekā lejup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Only at the end of a bar
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, down on 3, down-up on 4. Your hand still swings up after 1 and 3; it just misses the strings.
rows.translation: Lejup uz 1, lejup–augšup uz 2, lejup uz 3, lejup–augšup uz 4. Pēc 1 un 3 roka joprojām vēzējas augšup, tikai neaizskar stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What does your hand do on the and of 1?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A silent up stroke keeps your hand in time for the next down.
rows.translation: Kluss vēziens augšup notur roku ritmā nākamajam vēzienam lejup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, skip the down on 3, then up, down-up. The missing down gives it a lilt.
rows.translation: Lejup uz 1, lejup–augšup uz 2, izlaidiet vēzienu lejup uz 3, tad augšup, lejup–augšup. Izlaistais vēziens piešķir šūpojumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which strum do you skip in the island strum?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your hand still moves down on 3, it just misses the strings. That keeps the up after it in time.
rows.translation: Uz 3 roka joprojām kustas lejup, tikai neaizskar stīgas. Tā nākamais vēziens augšup paliek ritmā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The last up strum of a bar can be loose or open. Use it to move to the next chord, so beat 1 lands clean.
rows.translation: Takts pēdējais pārvilkums augšup var būt brīvs vai ar brīvām stīgām. Izmantojiet to nākamā akorda uzlikšanai, lai 1. sitiens skanētu tīri.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Downs, down-ups and the island strum. Keep your hand moving and let the chords come to you.
rows.translation: Lejup, lejup–augšup un salu pārvilkums. Turpiniet rokas kustību un ļaujiet akordiem nākt pie jums.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which pattern is the island strum?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play tunes note by note on strings 1 to 3.
rows.translation: Spēlējiet melodijas noti pa notij uz 1.–3. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C D E F G A B C. Start on open string 3 and climb across strings 2 and 1. Every note sits in the first three frets.
rows.translation: C D E F G A B C. Sāciet ar brīvu 3. stīgu un kāpiet pāri 2. un 1. stīgai. Visas notis atrodas pirmajās trīs ladās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 3 open and fret 2, then string 2 open and fret 1.
rows.translation: Brīva 3. stīga un 2. lada, tad brīva 2. stīga un 1. lada.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 2 fret 3, then string 1: open, fret 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: 2. stīgas 3. lada, tad 1. stīga: brīva, 2. lada, 3. lada.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many different note names are in the scale?
rows.translation: Cik dažādu nošu nosaukumu ir gammā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C to C is eight notes, but the top C repeats the first. Seven names, then they start again.
rows.translation: No C līdz C ir astoņas notis, bet augšējā C atkārto pirmo. Septiņi nosaukumi, tad tie sākas no jauna.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beethoven wrote this tune in 1824. It moves mostly by step, from one note to the next, on strings 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Bēthovens šo melodiju uzrakstīja 1824. gadā. Tā pārsvarā virzās pa pakāpēm, no vienas nots uz nākamo, uz 2. un 3. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening: E E F G, G F E D.
rows.translation: Sākums: E E F G, G F E D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first line ends on D. Where does the second line end?
rows.translation: Pirmā rinda beidzas uz D. Kur beidzas otrā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Same start, different finish. The second line comes home to C.
rows.translation: Tas pats sākums, citas beigas. Otrā rinda atgriežas mājās uz C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This traditional tune leaps from C up to G, then walks back down one note at a time. Every line ends on a longer note.
rows.translation: Šī tautas melodija lec no C augšup uz G, tad soļo atpakaļ lejup pa vienai notij. Katra rinda beidzas ar garāku noti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open string 3, string 2 fret 3, open string 1.
rows.translation: Brīva 3. stīga, 2. stīgas 3. lada, brīva 1. stīga.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Does this phrase go up or down?
rows.translation: Vai šī frāze virzās augšup vai lejup?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat, a half note two, a whole note four. Hold each one until the next note starts.
rows.translation: Ceturtdaļnots ilgst vienu sitienu, pusnots — divus, vesela nots — četrus. Turiet katru līdz nākamās nots sākumam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A dot adds half the note's length. A dotted half note lasts three beats; a dotted quarter lasts one and a half.
rows.translation: Punkts pievieno pusi nots ilguma. Pusnots ar punktu ilgst trīs sitienus; ceturtdaļnots ar punktu — pusotru.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many beats does a dotted half note last?
rows.translation: Cik sitienu ilgst pusnots ar punktu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: "Aura Lee" was published in 1861, with music by George R. Poulton. Play it slowly and let each note ring into the next.
rows.translation: Dziesma „Aura Lee” izdota 1861. gadā, tās mūzikas autors ir George R. Poulton. Spēlējiet lēni un ļaujiet katrai notij skanēt līdz nākamajai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 2 is F sharp, one fret above F. A sharp raises a note by one fret.
rows.translation: 2. lada uz 2. stīgas ir F diēzs, vienu ladu virs F. Diēzs paaugstina noti par vienu ladu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A sharp sign raises a note by how much?
rows.translation: Par cik diēza zīme paaugstina noti?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Watch the note highway and keep your place, even if you miss a note. The beat goes on, so you do too.
rows.translation: Vērojiet nošu celiņu un nezaudējiet vietu, pat ja kādu noti izlaižat. Ritms turpinās, un jūs arī.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where is F sharp on string 2?
rows.translation: Kur uz 2. stīgas ir F diēzs?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D minor, E minor, D, A and E7, then the four-chord song.
rows.translation: D minors, E minors, D, A un E7, tad četru akordu dziesma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Dm: F un vēl viens pirksts
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Second finger on fret 2 of string 4, third on fret 2 of string 3, first on fret 1 of string 2. String 1 rings open.
rows.translation: Otrais pirksts uz 4. stīgas 2. ladā, trešais uz 3. stīgas 2. ladā, pirmais uz 2. stīgas 1. ladā. 1. stīga skan brīva.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord is D minor closest to?
rows.translation: Kuram akordam D minors ir vistuvākais?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D minor is F with one more finger, on fret 2 of string 3.
rows.translation: D minors ir F ar vēl vienu pirkstu uz 3. stīgas 2. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of string 1, second on fret 3 of string 2, third on fret 4 of string 3. String 4 rings open.
rows.translation: Pirmais pirksts uz 1. stīgas 2. ladā, otrais uz 2. stīgas 3. ladā, trešais uz 3. stīgas 4. ladā. 4. stīga skan brīva.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E minor and G both leave which string open?
rows.translation: Kuru stīgu gan E minors, gan G atstāj brīvu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Put fingers 1, 2 and 3 side by side on fret 2 of strings 4, 3 and 2. String 1 rings open.
rows.translation: Uzlieciet 1., 2. un 3. pirkstu blakus 2. ladā uz 4., 3. un 2. stīgas. 1. stīga skan brīva.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Second finger on fret 2 of string 4, first finger on fret 1 of string 3. Strings 2 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Otrais pirksts uz 4. stīgas 2. ladā, pirmais uz 3. stīgas 1. ladā. 2. un 1. stīga skan brīva.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord has three fingers on the same fret?
rows.translation: Kurā akordā trīs pirksti ir vienā ladā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 4, second on fret 2 of string 3, third on fret 2 of string 1. String 2 rings open.
rows.translation: Pirmais pirksts uz 4. stīgas 1. ladā, otrais uz 3. stīgas 2. ladā, trešais uz 1. stīgas 2. ladā. 2. stīga skan brīva.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G7 pulls toward C. In the same way, E7 pulls toward A minor. Play them back to back and listen for the release.
rows.translation: G7 tiecas uz C. Tāpat E7 tiecas uz A minoru. Spēlējiet tos vienu pēc otra un sadzirdiet atrisinājumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Number the notes of the C scale and you can name chords by number: C is I, G is V, A minor is vi, F is IV. This order runs through countless songs.
rows.translation: Numurējiet C gammas notis, un akordus varēsiet nosaukt pēc pakāpes: C ir I, G ir V, A minors ir vi, F ir IV. Šī secība skan neskaitāmās dziesmās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Kurš akords C tonalitātē ir IV?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count up the scale from C: C, D, E, F. F is the fourth note, so F is the IV chord.
rows.translation: Skaitiet gammu augšup no C: C, D, E, F. F ir ceturtā nots, tāpēc F ir IV akords.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord is vi in C?
rows.translation: Kurš akords C tonalitātē ir vi?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lowercase numbers mean minor chords. The sixth note of C major is A.
rows.translation: Mazie romiešu cipari nozīmē minora akordus. C mažora sestā nots ir A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, A minor, F, G, G7, D minor, E minor, D, A and E7. Clean shapes first, then steady strums.
rows.translation: C, A minors, F, G, G7, D minors, E minors, D, A un E7. Vispirms tīri tvērieni, tad vienmērīgi pārvilkumi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Kurš akords C tonalitātē ir V?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Four public-domain songs with melody and chords.
rows.translation: Četras publiskā īpašuma dziesmas ar melodiju un akordiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Stephen Foster wrote this song in 1848. It counts in two: 1 and 2 and. Most notes are quick eighth notes.
rows.translation: Stephen Foster šo dziesmu uzrakstīja 1848. gadā. To skaita divos: 1 un 2 un. Vairums nošu ir ātras astotdaļnotis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening: C D E G, G A G E.
rows.translation: Sākums: C D E G, G A G E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Another Foster song, from 1850. The melody bounces between G and E, and a short two-note call answers each line.
rows.translation: Vēl viena Foster dziesma no 1850. gada. Melodija lēkā starp G un E, un īss divu nošu sauciens atbild katrai rindai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G G E G A G E.
rows.translation: G G E G A G E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Like most songs in C, it comes home to C.
rows.translation: Tāpat kā vairums dziesmu C tonalitātē, tā atgriežas mājās uz C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count 1 2 3, 1 2 3, with the weight on 1. This is waltz time. "Clementine", first printed in 1884, sways in three.
rows.translation: Skaitiet 1 2 3, 1 2 3, ar uzsvaru uz 1. Tas ir valša metrs. „Clementine”, pirmoreiz iespiesta 1884. gadā, šūpojas trijos.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 2 fret 1, open 3, open 1, then string 1 frets 3 and 1.
rows.translation: 2. stīgas 1. lada, brīva 3., brīva 1., tad 1. stīgas 3. un 1. lada.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 1. With F, it carries the whole song.
rows.translation: Pirmais pirksts uz 1. stīgas 1. ladā. Kopā ar F tas nes visu dziesmu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This traditional tune was in print by 1896. Each line ends on a long note, so count it out before the next one.
rows.translation: Šī tautas melodija bija iespiesta jau 1896. gadā. Katra rinda beidzas ar garu noti, tāpēc pirms nākamās izskaitiet tās ilgumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open 3, string 2 fret 1, open 1, string 2 fret 3, string 1 frets 1 and 3.
rows.translation: Brīva 3., 2. stīgas 1. lada, brīva 1., 2. stīgas 3. lada, 1. stīgas 1. un 3. lada.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The last line starts D, C sharp, C. How do those notes move?
rows.translation: Pēdējā rinda sākas D, C diēzs, C. Kā šīs notis virzās?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down one fret at a time
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each note is one fret lower on string 3: fret 2, fret 1, open.
rows.translation: Katra nots uz 3. stīgas ir vienu ladu zemāk: 2. lada, 1. lada, brīva stīga.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: When you strum a song, the melody lives in your head or in a friend's voice. Change chords where the tune leans, and keep the strum steady.
rows.translation: Spēlējot dziesmu ar pārvilkumiem, melodija skan galvā vai drauga balsī. Mainiet akordus vietās, uz kurām tiecas melodija, un saglabājiet vienmērīgu pārvilkumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A song in F usually ends on which chord?
rows.translation: Ar kuru akordu parasti beidzas dziesma F tonalitātē?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Songs come home to their key chord. In F, that's F.
rows.translation: Dziesmas atgriežas pie savas tonalitātes akorda. F tonalitātē tas ir F.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Four songs, a handful of chords and three strums. Play them like a small concert: count in, keep going, finish strong.
rows.translation: Četras dziesmas, saujiņa akordu un trīs pārvilkumi. Spēlējiet kā mazā koncertā: ieskaitiet, turpiniet un noslēdziet pārliecinoši.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, the keys of G, F and D, and moving a song to any key.
rows.translation: B bemols, D7, B minors un G minors, G, F un D tonalitātes un dziesmas pārcelšana jebkurā tonalitātē.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
rows.translation: Noguldiet 1. pirkstu pāri 2. un 1. stīgai 1. ladā. 2. pirksts ir uz 3. stīgas 2. ladā, 3. pirksts — uz 4. stīgas 3. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord shares finger 1's spot on string 2 with B flat?
rows.translation: Kuram akordam ar B bemolu ir kopīga 1. pirksta vieta uz 2. stīgas?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F also puts finger 1 on string 2, fret 1. Keep it there as you change.
rows.translation: Arī F liek 1. pirkstu uz 2. stīgas 1. ladā. Mainot akordu, turiet to turpat.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D7 and the key of G
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D7: a barre and one finger
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 2, and put finger 2 on string 1, fret 3.
rows.translation: Noguldiet 1. pirkstu pāri 4., 3. un 2. stīgai 2. ladā, bet 2. pirkstu uzlieciet uz 1. stīgas 3. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In G, the chords G, C and D7 do most of the work, with E minor for a darker color. D7 pulls back to G the way G7 pulls to C.
rows.translation: G tonalitātē galveno darbu dara G, C un D7, bet E minors dod tumšāku krāsu. D7 tiecas atpakaļ uz G tāpat kā G7 uz C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B minor and the key of D
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Bm: viens pirksts guļ pāri stīgām
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 2, then reach finger 3 to string 4, fret 4.
rows.translation: Noguldiet 1. pirkstu pāri 3., 2. un 1. stīgai 2. ladā, tad ar 3. pirkstu aizsniedziet 4. stīgas 4. ladu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D and B minor both press fret 2 on which strings?
rows.translation: Kuras stīgas gan D, gan B minors nospiež 2. ladā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Both chords hold fret 2 on strings 3 and 2. Only the outer strings change.
rows.translation: Abi akordi tur 3. un 2. stīgu 2. ladā. Mainās tikai ārējās stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In D, the chords D, G and A7 carry the song, and B minor adds a sad one. A7 is a single finger: string 3, fret 1.
rows.translation: D tonalitātē dziesmu nes D, G un A7, bet B minors pievieno skumju akordu. A7 vajag vienu pirkstu: 3. stīga, 1. lada.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A song's chords are steps of its key: I, IV and V. Change key and the numbers stay. In C that's C, F and G7; in G, it's G, C and D7; in F, F, B flat and C7.
rows.translation: Dziesmas akordi ir tās tonalitātes pakāpes: I, IV un V. Mainot tonalitāti, skaitļi paliek. C tonalitātē tie ir C, F un G7; G — G, C un D7; F — F, B bemols un C7.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the key of F, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Kurš akords F tonalitātē ir IV?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count up from F: F, G, A, B flat. The fourth note is B flat.
rows.translation: Skaitiet augšup no F: F, G, A, B bemols. Ceturtā nots ir B bemols.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: If a song sits too high or too low to sing, move it to another key. Same numbers, same song, just a better fit for the voice.
rows.translation: Ja dziesma dziedāšanai ir par augstu vai zemu, pārceliet to citā tonalitātē. Tie paši skaitļi, tā pati dziesma, tikai balsij ērtāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the key of D, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Kurš akords D tonalitātē ir V?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count up from D: D, E, F sharp, G, A. A is the fifth note, so A7 is the V chord.
rows.translation: Skaitiet augšup no D: D, E, F diēzs, G, A. A ir piektā nots, tāpēc A7 ir V akords.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 3 on string 2, fret 3, and finger 1 on string 1, fret 1. String 4 rings open.
rows.translation: 2. pirksts uz 3. stīgas 2. ladā, 3. pirksts uz 2. stīgas 3. ladā, 1. pirksts uz 1. stīgas 1. ladā. 4. stīga skan brīva.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D minor's family is D minor, G minor and A7. A7 pulls home to D minor, the way E7 pulls to A minor.
rows.translation: D minora saime ir D minors, G minors un A7. A7 velk mājup uz D minoru, tāpat kā E7 uz A minoru.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, and the keys of C, G, F and D. Clean shapes first, then a steady strum.
rows.translation: Nekā jauna: B bemols, D7, B minors un G minors, un C, G, F, D tonalitātes. Vispirms tīri tvērieni, tad vienmērīgs pārvilkums.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the key of G, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Kurš akords G tonalitātē ir V?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chunk, the island strum with a backbeat, swing and the ragtime chords, accents in 3-3-2, and the waltz.
rows.translation: Klikšķa pārvilkums, salu ritma pretakcenti, svings un regtaima akordi, 3-3-2 akcenti un valsis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A chunk is a strum that stops dead. Strum down and let the side of your palm land on the strings at the same moment: a short, dry click, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Klikšķa pārvilkums uzreiz apklust. Pārvelciet lejup un tajā pašā mirklī uzlieciet plaukstas malu uz stīgām: īss, sauss klikšķis kā mazā bunga.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Strum down on 1, chunk on 2, down-up on 3, chunk on 4. The chunks fall where a drummer hits the snare.
rows.translation: Pārvelciet lejup uz 1, ar klikšķi uz 2, lejup–augšup uz 3, ar klikšķi uz 4. Klikšķi skan tur, kur bundzinieks sit mazo bungu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two and four are the backbeat, where the snare drum plays. A chunk there gives the strum a drummer's punch.
rows.translation: Otrais un ceturtais sitiens veido pretakcentu, kur skan mazā bunga. Klikšķa pārvilkums tur dod bundzinieka spēku.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Swap one down for a chunk
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Take the island strum, D, DU, UDU, and turn the down on 2 into a chunk. The rhythm stays the same; the groove gets a backbeat.
rows.translation: Ņemiet salu pārvilkumu D, DU, UDU un vēzienu lejup uz 2 pārvērtiet klikšķī. Ritms paliek tas pats, bet iegūst pretakcentu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In this strum, which stroke becomes the chunk?
rows.translation: Kurš vēziens šajā pārvilkumā kļūst par klikšķi?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beat 1 rings out, beat 2 clicks. Everything else stays where the island strum had it.
rows.translation: 1. sitiens skan, 2. noklikšķ. Viss pārējais paliek salu pārvilkuma vietās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Swing splits each beat unevenly: a long down, then a short up. Say hum-pty, dum-pty as you strum. It's the bounce of old ukulele tunes.
rows.translation: Svings sadala sitienu nevienādi: garš vēziens lejup, tad īss augšup. Pārvelkot sakiet „tāā-ta, tāā-ta”. Tā ir seno ukuleles melodiju šūpošanās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, A7, D7, G7, then home to C. Each seventh chord pulls to the next, a little chain of tension. It powered countless songs a century ago.
rows.translation: C, A7, D7, G7, tad mājup uz C. Katrs septakords tiecas uz nākamo, veidojot mazu spriedzes ķēdi. Pirms gadsimta tā virzīja neskaitāmas dziesmas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord does D7 pull toward here?
rows.translation: Uz kuru akordu šeit tiecas D7?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D7 leads to G, and G7 leads home to C. Each chord sets up the next.
rows.translation: D7 ved uz G, bet G7 — mājup uz C. Katrs akords sagatavo nākamo.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Strum steady down-up eighths, but hit three of them harder: 1, the and of 2, and 4. The accents fall 3, 3 and 2 eighths apart.
rows.translation: Spēlējiet vienmērīgas astotdaļas lejup–augšup, bet trīs no tām spēcīgāk: 1, „2 un” un 4. Akcentus šķir 3, 3 un 2 astotdaļas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2 across the bar's eight eighths. Each 1 is an accent.
rows.translation: Pāri takts astoņām astotdaļām skaitiet 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2. Katrs 1 ir akcents.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: George Formby's split stroke on the banjo ukulele puts its big strums in the same three places, with single strings in between. Master the accents first.
rows.translation: George Formby dalītais vēziens uz bandžo ukuleles liek spēcīgos pārvilkumus tajās pašās trīs vietās, starp tiem spēlējot atsevišķas stīgas. Vispirms apgūstiet akcentus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In three, strum down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: D, DU, DU. Lean on 1 so the sway is clear.
rows.translation: Trijdaļu metrā pārvelciet lejup uz 1, tad lejup–augšup uz 2 un 3: D, DU, DU. Akcentējiet 1, lai šūpojums būtu skaidrs.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many strums fill this bar of three?
rows.translation: Cik pārvilkumu aizpilda šo trīs sitienu takti?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: one plus two plus two.
rows.translation: Lejup uz 1, tad lejup–augšup uz 2 un 3: viens plus divi plus divi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: chunks, the island strum with a chunk, swing, the 3-3-2 accents and the waltz. Keep the hand moving and let the accents speak.
rows.translation: Nekā jauna: klikšķa pārvilkumi, salu pārvilkums ar klikšķi, svings, 3-3-2 akcenti un valsis. Turpiniet rokas kustību un ļaujiet akcentiem runāt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In a swing strum, each beat splits into…
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: One finger per string, rolling patterns, the alternating thumb, and a tune picked from inside its chords.
rows.translation: Katrai stīgai savs pirksts, plūstoši raksti, pārmaiņus spēlējošs īkšķis un melodija akordu iekšienē.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rest your thumb on string 4, index on string 3, middle on string 2 and ring finger on string 1. Each one plucks only its own string.
rows.translation: Atbalstiet īkšķi uz 4. stīgas, rādītājpirkstu uz 3., vidējo uz 2., zeltnesi uz 1. Katrs spēlē tikai savu stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle, ring: strings 4, 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Īkšķis, rādītājpirksts, vidējais, zeltnesis: 4., 3., 2. un 1. stīga.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Thumb on 4, index on 3, middle on 2, ring on 1: one finger per string.
rows.translation: Īkšķis uz 4., rādītājpirksts uz 3., vidējais uz 2., zeltnesis uz 1.: katrai stīgai savs pirksts.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Because string 4 is a high G, the pattern zigzags: high, low, then climbing. That sparkle is the sound of fingerpicked ukulele.
rows.translation: Tā kā 4. stīga ir augstā G, raksts veido zigzagu: augstu, zemu, tad kāpums. Šis dzirkstošais skanējums raksturo ukuleles spēli ar pirkstiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minor, F, C, G7, in eighths
rows.translation: A minors, F, C, G7 astotdaļās
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pluck strings 4, 3, 2 and 1, then come back on 2 and 3: thumb, index, middle, ring, middle, index. Six notes fill a bar of three.
rows.translation: Spēlējiet 4., 3., 2. un 1. stīgu, tad atpakaļ 2. un 3.: īkšķis, rādītājpirksts, vidējais, zeltnesis, vidējais, rādītājpirksts. Sešas notis aizpilda trīs sitienu takti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: After the ring finger plucks string 1, which finger comes next?
rows.translation: Kad zeltnesis iesvārsta 1. stīgu, kurš pirksts seko?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The roll turns around at the top: ring on string 1, then middle on 2 and index on 3.
rows.translation: Raksts augšā apgriežas: zeltnesis uz 1. stīgas, tad vidējais uz 2. un rādītājpirksts uz 3.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Land the new chord as the thumb starts the next bar. The fingers keep rolling; only the shape under them changes.
rows.translation: Uzlieciet jauno akordu, kad īkšķis sāk nākamo takti. Pirksti turpina plūstošo rakstu; mainās tikai tvēriens zem tiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, A minor, D minor, G7
rows.translation: C, A minors, D minors, G7
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now the thumb rocks between strings 3 and 4 on the beats while your fingers pluck strings 2 and 1 in between. It's the ukulele's version of Travis picking.
rows.translation: Tagad īkšķis sitienos pārmaiņus spēlē 3. un 4. stīgu, bet pārējie pirksti starp tiem — 2. un 1. stīgu. Tā ir Travis spēles ukuleles versija.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In this pattern, what does the thumb do?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The thumb keeps the pulse, a note on every beat, while the fingers fill the gaps.
rows.translation: Īkšķis uztur pulsu — nots katrā sitienā —, kamēr pārējie pirksti aizpilda starpas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold the chord, pick the tune
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In chord melody, your fretting hand holds the chord and you pick the tune from inside it. Hold F, and C, F and A are already under your fingers.
rows.translation: Melodiju akordos spēlē, ar grifa roku turot akordu un izvēloties tā notis melodijai. Turiet F, un C, F un A jau ir zem pirkstiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold F: open string 3, string 2 at fret 1, open string 1. That's how Amazing Grace begins.
rows.translation: Turiet F: brīva 3. stīga, 2. stīga 1. ladā, brīva 1. stīga. Tā sākas Amazing Grace.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: When the tune leaves the chord, reach with a free finger. Over F, finger 3 takes G on string 2, fret 3, then lifts as the tune comes back.
rows.translation: Kad melodija atstāj akordu, sniedzieties ar brīvu pirkstu. Virs F 3. pirksts spēlē G uz 2. stīgas 3. ladā, tad paceļas, melodijai atgriežoties.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Over B flat, where is the tune's D?
rows.translation: Kur virs B bemola atrodas melodijas D?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B flat's finger 2 already holds D on string 3, fret 2. The tune walks right through the chord.
rows.translation: B bemola 2. pirksts jau tur D uz 3. stīgas 2. ladā. Melodija iet tieši cauri akordam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rolled chords between the verses and the melody inside the chords. The tune is the hymn New Britain, printed in 1829, with John Newton's words.
rows.translation: Starp pantiem akordi pa notīm, bet melodija — akordu iekšienē. Tā ir himnas New Britain melodija, iespiesta 1829. gadā, ar John Newton vārdiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why does the intro's last bar end on a long note?
rows.translation: Kāpēc ievada pēdējā takts beidzas ar garu noti?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: To leave room for the pickup
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The verse starts a beat early, on its pickup. A long last note keeps that beat clear.
rows.translation: Pants sākas vienu sitienu agrāk, uztaktī. Gara pēdējā nots atstāj šo sitienu brīvu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: one finger per string, the out-and-back roll, the alternating thumb and the melody inside the chord.
rows.translation: Nekā jauna: katrai stīgai savs pirksts, plūstošs raksts turp un atpakaļ, īkšķa mainīgā spēle un melodija akorda iekšienē.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle, ring play which strings?
rows.translation: Kuras stīgas spēlē īkšķis, rādītājpirksts, vidējais un zeltnesis?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Four public-domain songs arranged for ukulele, and how to lead a room through them.
rows.translation: Četras publiskā īpašuma dziesmas ukuleles aranžējumā un prasme vadīt kopdziedāšanu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, first printed in 1918, is made for singing together. On ukulele it sits in G, with G, C and D7, and a gospel A sharp on string 1, fret 1.
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside, pirmoreiz iespiesta 1918. gadā, ir radīta kopdziedāšanai. Uz ukuleles tā ir G tonalitātē ar G, C un D7, un gospeļa A diēzu uz 1. stīgas 1. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down by the riverside: B, B, A sharp, B, then A and G.
rows.translation: Down by the riverside: B, B, A diēzs, B, tad A un G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Cecil Sharp printed this English ballad in 1906. In F it uses F, B flat, C and C7, G minor and D minor, often two to a bar. Pick the chords between verses and let them ring.
rows.translation: Cecil Sharp šo angļu balādi iespieda 1906. gadā. F tonalitātē tajā ir F, B bemols, C un C7, G minors un D minors, bieži divi akordi taktī. Starp pantiem spēlējiet akordus pa notīm un ļaujiet tiem skanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The water is wide: open string 3, F at fret 1 twice, G at fret 3, then open A.
rows.translation: The water is wide: brīva 3. stīga, F 1. ladā divreiz, G 3. ladā, tad brīva A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Many bars here change halfway. Count the verse in two-beat halves, one chord each, and change on every other click.
rows.translation: Daudzās taktīs maiņa ir vidū. Skaitiet pantu divu sitienu pusēs, katrā viens akords, un mainiet katrā otrajā klikšķī.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Before the first strum, count out loud at the song's tempo: one, two, three, four. Everyone starts together, at the speed you set.
rows.translation: Pirms pirmā pārvilkuma skaļi skaitiet dziesmas tempā: viens, divi, trīs, četri. Visi sāk reizē jūsu noteiktajā ātrumā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Miss a chord? Keep strumming and catch the next one. A singing room follows the beat, not every note.
rows.translation: Izlaidāt akordu? Turpiniet pārvilkumus un noķeriet nākamo. Dziedošie seko ritmam, nevis katrai notij.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: You fumble a change mid-song. What now?
rows.translation: Dziesmas vidū neizdevās maiņa. Ko darīt?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Keep strumming and catch the next chord
rows.translation: Turpināt pārvilkumus un spēlēt nākamo akordu
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The beat carries everyone. Drop a chord if you must, never the rhythm.
rows.translation: Ritms nes visus. Ja vajag, izlaidiet akordu, bet nekad ritmu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Before the last line, nod or call out last time. Slow the final line a touch and let the last chord ring.
rows.translation: Pirms pēdējās rindas pamājiet vai pasakiet „pēdējo reizi”. Pēdējo rindu mazliet palēniniet un ļaujiet pēdējam akordam skanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Molly Malone was printed in 1876. It's a waltz: lean on beat 1 and let the tune sway. In F it uses F, G minor, C7, D minor and G7.
rows.translation: Molly Malone iespiesta 1876. gadā. Tas ir valsis: akcentējiet 1. sitienu un ļaujiet melodijai šūpoties. F tonalitātē tajā ir F, G minors, C7, D minors un G7.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In Dublin's fair city: open string 3, F at fret 1 four times, open A, back to F.
rows.translation: In Dublin's fair city: brīva 3. stīga, F 1. ladā četras reizes, brīva A, atpakaļ uz F.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord pulls hardest back to F?
rows.translation: Kurš akords visspēcīgāk tiecas atpakaļ uz F?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C7 is the V chord in F. Its seventh leans straight back home.
rows.translation: C7 ir V akords F tonalitātē. Tā septīma tiecas taisni mājup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This rowing song is in six-eight: six quick counts to a bar, felt as two big sways. Count 1 2 3, 4 5 6, and lean on 1 and 4.
rows.translation: Šī airēšanas dziesma ir sešu astotdaļu metrā: seši ātri skaitļi taktī, ko jūt kā divus lielus šūpojumus. Skaitiet 1 2 3, 4 5 6 un akcentējiet 1 un 4.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In six-eight, where do the big beats fall?
rows.translation: Kur sešu astotdaļu metrā ir lielie sitieni?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Six eighths group in two threes: 1 2 3, 4 5 6. The first of each three carries the sway.
rows.translation: Sešas astotdaļas grupē divos trijniekos: 1 2 3, 4 5 6. Katra trijnieka pirmais sitiens nes šūpojumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: four songs, counted in, kept going and finished clean. Play them back to back like a short concert.
rows.translation: Nekā jauna: četras dziesmas, kurām ieskaitīts sākums, saglabāts ritms un tīrs noslēgums. Spēlējiet tās citu pēc citas kā īsā koncertā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: From open strings to walking lines and grooves
rows.translation: No brīvām stīgām līdz soļojošām basa līnijām un ritmiem
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Meet E A D G, pluck with two fingers, play your first notes and a song.
rows.translation: Iepazīstiet E A D G, spēlējiet ar diviem pirkstiem, apgūstiet pirmās notis un dziesmu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Četras stīgas, zema un dziļa skaņa
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 4.
rows.translation: Resnākā stīga skan viszemāk. Spēlējot tā atrodas vistuvāk jūsu sejai. To saucam par 4. stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Strings count from the thinnest (1) to the thickest (4).
rows.translation: Stīgas skaita no tievākās (1) līdz resnākajai (4).
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: From thick to thin: E, A, D, G. They match the four lowest guitar strings, an octave down. Try: Every Amp Drives Grooves.
rows.translation: No resnākās līdz tievākajai: E, A, D, G. Tās atbilst četrām zemākajām ģitāras stīgām oktāvu zemāk. Iegaumējiet: Enerģiski Akordi Dāvā Gandarījumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pluck with the pads of your index and middle fingers, taking turns. Rest your thumb on the pickup or on string 4.
rows.translation: Iesvārstiet stīgas pārmaiņus ar rādītājpirksta un vidējā pirksta spilventiņiem. Īkšķi atbalstiet uz skaņas noņēmēja vai 4. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pluck across the string, not up and away. Your finger comes to rest on the next thicker string. This rest stroke sounds full and strong.
rows.translation: Velciet pāri stīgai, nevis augšup prom no tās. Pirksts apstājas uz nākamās resnākās stīgas. Šis vilciens ar atbalstu skan pilnīgi un spēcīgi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where does your finger stop after a rest stroke?
rows.translation: Kur pirksts apstājas pēc vilciena ar atbalstu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the air above the strings
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pulling through to the next string keeps the motion small and the tone strong.
rows.translation: Vilciens līdz nākamajai stīgai saglabā mazu kustību un spēcīgu toni.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open E, fret 3, open A, fret 3.
rows.translation: Brīva E, 3. lada, brīva A, 3. lada.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open strings, two-finger plucking and your first fretted notes. Keep your fingers taking turns and let each note ring.
rows.translation: Brīvās stīgas, spēle ar diviem pirkstiem un pirmās nospiestās notis. Mainiet pirkstus un ļaujiet katrai notij skanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which one is the open E string?
rows.translation: Kurš variants ir brīvā E stīga?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: B at fret 2 on string 3, open A, and G at fret 3 on string 4. Second finger for B, third for G.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb vajag trīs notis: B uz 3. stīgas 2. ladā, brīvu A un G uz 4. stīgas 3. ladā. B spēlē otrais pirksts, G — trešais.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 3, fret 2, second finger. That's B.
rows.translation: 3. stīga, 2. lada, otrais pirksts. Tā ir B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B A G A B B B: string 3, then G on string 4.
rows.translation: B A G A B B B: 3. stīga, tad G uz 4. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play the root of each chord and lock in with the beat.
rows.translation: Spēlējiet katra akorda pamattoni un precīzi iekļaujieties ritmā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every chord is built on one note, its root. The root of an A chord is A. Bass players play roots so the band knows where home is.
rows.translation: Katrs akords veidots uz vienas nots — tā pamattoņa. A akorda pamattonis ir A. Basģitāristi spēlē pamattoņus, lai grupa zinātu, kur ir mājas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What is the root of a D chord?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Root or not? Listen to the lowest note.
rows.translation: Pamattonis vai ne? Klausieties zemāko noti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Roots of A, D and E: all open strings.
rows.translation: A, D un E pamattoņi: visas ir brīvas stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Roots of A, D and E
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bass and kick drum land together. Aim for the exact moment of the click, not just near it. Timbre shows if you're early or late.
rows.translation: Bass un lielā bunga skan reizē. Trāpiet tieši klikšķa mirklī, nevis tikai tā tuvumā. Timbre parāda, vai esat par agru vai vēlu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: You keep landing a little after the click. What helps?
rows.translation: Jūs arvien spēlējat mazliet pēc klikšķa. Kas palīdz?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Feel the beat coming and pluck a touch earlier
rows.translation: Sajust tuvojošos sitienu un spēlēt agrāk
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your finger needs a moment to move. Start the pluck slightly earlier so the note speaks right on the beat.
rows.translation: Pirksta kustībai vajag mirkli. Sāciet iesvārstīt stīgu mazliet agrāk, lai nots atskanētu tieši uz sitiena.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A rest is a beat of silence. Stop the string by touching it lightly with a free finger, so the rest is as clean as the note.
rows.translation: Pauze ir klusuma sitiens. Apturiet stīgu, viegli pieskaroties tai ar brīvu pirkstu, lai pauze būtu tikpat tīra kā nots.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How do you stop a ringing string?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Touch it lightly with a free finger
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Muting is half of bass playing. Rest a finger lightly on the string to silence it.
rows.translation: Slāpēšana ir puse no basģitāras spēles. Viegli atbalstiet pirkstu uz stīgas, lai to apklusinātu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A chord chart tells you which chord is coming. Play its root on every beat until the chart changes.
rows.translation: Akordu shēma rāda nākamo akordu. Spēlējiet tā pamattoni katrā sitienā, līdz shēmā ir maiņa.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G on string 4 fret 3, C on string 3 fret 3, then open D.
rows.translation: G uz 4. stīgas 3. ladā, C uz 3. stīgas 3. ladā, tad brīva D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chart says C. Which note do you play?
rows.translation: Shēmā ir C. Kuru noti spēlējat?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Roots on the beat, clean rests and changes right on time. Keep your plucking fingers taking turns the whole way.
rows.translation: Pamattoņi uz sitiena, tīras pauzes un precīzas maiņas. Visu laiku mainiet spēlējošos pirkstus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What is the root of an E chord?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every note from fret 0 to 5 on strings 4 and 3, and the major scale shape.
rows.translation: Visas notis no 0. līdz 5. ladai uz 4. un 3. stīgas un mažora gammas forma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E to A on one string
rows.translation: No E līdz A uz vienas stīgas
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: On string 4, each fret is one note higher: E, F, F sharp, G, G sharp, then A at fret 5. Fret 5 sounds the same as open string 3.
rows.translation: Uz 4. stīgas katra lada ir nākamā nots augstāk: E, F, F diēzs, G, G diēzs, tad A 5. ladā. 5. lada skan tāpat kā brīva 3. stīga.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which fret on string 4 matches open string 3?
rows.translation: Kura 4. stīgas lada atbilst brīvai 3. stīgai?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Both are A. Each string is tuned to fret 5 of the string below it.
rows.translation: Abas ir A. Katra stīga ir noskaņota atbilstoši zemākās stīgas 5. ladai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: No A līdz D uz 3. stīgas
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 3 works the same way: A, B flat, B, C, C sharp, then D at fret 5. Fret 5 matches open string 2.
rows.translation: 3. stīga darbojas tāpat: A, B bemols, B, C, C diēzs, tad D 5. ladā. 5. lada atbilst brīvai 2. stīgai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Kura nots ir uz 3. stīgas 3. ladā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A on fret 5 of string 4 sounds the same as open string 3. Open strings ring longer; fretted notes are easier to stop and shape.
rows.translation: A uz 4. stīgas 5. ladā skan tāpat kā brīva 3. stīga. Brīvās stīgas skan ilgāk; nospiestās notis vieglāk apturēt un veidot.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret 5 on string 4, then open string 3.
rows.translation: 5. lada uz 4. stīgas, tad brīva 3. stīga.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret 5 on string 3, then open string 2.
rows.translation: 5. lada uz 3. stīgas, tad brīva 2. stīga.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which fret on string 3 matches open string 2?
rows.translation: Kura 3. stīgas lada atbilst brīvai 2. stīgai?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Both are D. Each string is tuned to fret 5 of the string below it.
rows.translation: Abas ir D. Katra stīga ir noskaņota atbilstoši zemākās stīgas 5. ladai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Let each finger cover one fret: index on fret 2, middle on 3, ring on 4, little on 5. Your thumb rests behind the neck, across from your middle finger.
rows.translation: Katram pirkstam sava lada: rādītājpirksts 2., vidējais 3., zeltnesis 4., mazais 5. ladā. Īkšķis balstās aiz grifa pretī vidējam pirkstam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Start on G, fret 3 of string 4, with your middle finger. Climb across three strings: G A B C D E F sharp G. The same shape works from any root.
rows.translation: Sāciet ar G uz 4. stīgas 3. ladā ar vidējo pirkstu. Kāpiet pāri trim stīgām: G A B C D E F diēzs G. Tas pats tvēriens der no jebkura pamattoņa.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Middle, little; then index, middle on string 3.
rows.translation: Vidējais, mazais; tad rādītājpirksts un vidējais uz 3. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Little finger; then index, ring, little on string 2.
rows.translation: Mazais; tad rādītājpirksts, zeltnesis un mazais uz 2. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: You move the shape so it starts on fret 5 of string 4. Which scale is it now?
rows.translation: Pārvietojat formu tā, lai tā sāktos uz 4. stīgas 5. ladā. Kura gamma tā tagad ir?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret 5 on string 4 is A, so the same shape plays A major.
rows.translation: 4. stīgas 5. lada ir A, tāpēc tā pati forma spēlē A mažoru.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ode to Joy works on bass too. Play it in G on strings 4 and 3, with your hand in the scale shape: index on fret 2.
rows.translation: Oda priekam der arī basģitārai. Spēlējiet to G tonalitātē uz 4. un 3. stīgas, roku turot gammas formā: rādītājpirksts 2. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first line ends on A. Where does the second line end?
rows.translation: Pirmā rinda beidzas uz A. Kur beidzas otrā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Same start, different finish. The second line comes home to G.
rows.translation: Tas pats sākums, citas beigas. Otrā rinda atgriežas mājās uz G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Name it, find it, play it
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Frets 0 to 5 on strings 4 and 3 give you every note from E up to D. Say each note's name as you play it.
rows.translation: No 0. līdz 5. ladai uz 4. un 3. stīgas atrodamas visas notis no E līdz D. Spēlējot nosauciet katru noti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Kura nots ir uz 4. stīgas 3. ladā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F, A, B, D on strings 4 and 3.
rows.translation: F, A, B, D uz 4. un 3. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Outline chords with the root, its fifth and its octave.
rows.translation: Iezīmējiet akordus ar pamattoni, kvintu un oktāvu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: One string over, two frets up
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The fifth of a chord sits on the next thinner string, two frets higher than the root. For open A, that's fret 2 of string 2: E.
rows.translation: Akorda kvinta ir uz nākamās tievākās stīgas, divas ladas virs pamattoņa. Brīvai A tā ir 2. stīgas 2. lada: E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What is the fifth of D?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count up the D major scale: D, E, F sharp, G, A. A is the fifth note.
rows.translation: Skaitiet augšup D mažora gammu: D, E, F diēzs, G, A. A ir piektā nots.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play the root on beat 1 and the fifth on beat 3. Two notes per bar outline the whole chord and leave room for the drums.
rows.translation: Spēlējiet pamattoni uz 1. sitiena un kvintu uz 3. Divas notis taktī iezīmē visu akordu un atstāj vietu bungām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In a root-fifth pattern, which note lands on beat 1?
rows.translation: Kura nots pamattoņa–kvintas rakstā skan uz 1. sitiena?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The root on beat 1 tells everyone which chord they're in.
rows.translation: Pamattonis uz 1. sitiena visiem pasaka, kurš akords skan.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two strings over, two frets up
rows.translation: Divas stīgas un divas ladas augstāk
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The octave is the same note name, higher. From a root on string 4 or 3, go two strings thinner and two frets up. Open A becomes fret 2 of string 1.
rows.translation: Oktāvai ir tas pats nots nosaukums, tikai augstāk. No pamattoņa uz 4. vai 3. stīgas pārejiet divas stīgas tievāk un divas ladas augstāk. Brīva A kļūst par 1. stīgas 2. ladu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G is on fret 3 of string 4. Where is the G an octave higher?
rows.translation: G ir uz 4. stīgas 3. ladā. Kur ir G oktāvu augstāk?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two strings thinner, two frets up: fret 5 of string 2. Open string 1 is the same G.
rows.translation: Divas stīgas tievāk, divas ladas augstāk: 2. stīgas 5. lada. Arī brīva 1. stīga ir tā pati G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Root, fifth, octave, then back to the fifth. Over A: open string 3, fret 2 of string 2, fret 2 of string 1. It fits any major or minor chord.
rows.translation: Pamattonis, kvinta, oktāva, tad atpakaļ uz kvintu. Virs A: brīva 3. stīga, 2. stīgas 2. lada, 1. stīgas 2. lada. Tas der jebkuram mažora vai minora akordam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open 3, string 2 fret 2, string 1 fret 2, back to string 2.
rows.translation: Brīva 3., 2. stīgas 2. lada, 1. stīgas 2. lada, atpakaļ uz 2. stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Move it to a fretted root
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: From G on fret 3 of string 4, use your index finger for the root and your ring finger for the fifth and octave, both on fret 5.
rows.translation: No G uz 4. stīgas 3. ladā pamattonim izmantojiet rādītājpirkstu, bet kvintai un oktāvai — zeltnesi, abām 5. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Index on the root, ring finger on fret 5 for the fifth and the octave.
rows.translation: Rādītājpirksts uz pamattoņa, zeltnesis 5. ladā kvintai un oktāvai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: You slide the shape so the root is fret 3 of string 3. Which chord is it now?
rows.translation: Pārbīdāt tvērienu, lai pamattonis būtu uz 3. stīgas 3. ladā. Kurš akords tagad skan?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret 3 of string 3 is C. Same shape, new root.
rows.translation: 3. stīgas 3. lada ir C. Tas pats tvēriens, jauns pamattonis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Root on the beat, fifth and octave to fill the bar. Keep the root strong and the other notes even.
rows.translation: Pamattonis uz sitiena, kvinta un oktāva aizpilda takti. Lai pamattonis ir spēcīgs, bet pārējās notis — vienmērīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What is the fifth of E?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The 12-bar blues, walking lines and chromatic approach notes.
rows.translation: 12 taktu blūzs, soļojošas basa līnijas un hromatiskās pieejas notis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The blues repeats a 12-bar loop: four bars of A, two of D, two of A, then E, D, A, E. Count the bars and you always know where you are.
rows.translation: Blūzs atkārto 12 taktu ciklu: četras A taktis, divas D, divas A, tad E, D, A, E. Skaitiet taktis, un vienmēr zināsiet, kur esat.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many bars of A open the 12-bar blues?
rows.translation: Cik A taktu sāk 12 taktu blūzu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bars 9 to 12 go E, D, A, E. The E in bar 12 turns the loop around.
rows.translation: No 9. līdz 12. taktij ir E, D, A, E. E 12. taktī atgriež ciklu sākumā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A new note on every beat
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A walking bass line plays a new note on every beat. Start with root, third, fifth, sixth: over A that's A, C sharp, E, F sharp.
rows.translation: Soļojoša basa līnija katrā sitienā spēlē jaunu noti. Sāciet ar pamattoni, tercu, kvintu, sekstu: virs A tās ir A, C diēzs, E, F diēzs.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open 3, fret 4; then string 2, frets 2 and 4.
rows.translation: Brīva 3., 4. lada; tad 2. stīga, 2. un 4. lada.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What makes a bass line walk?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open 2, fret 4; then string 1, frets 2 and 4.
rows.translation: Brīva 2., 4. lada; tad 1. stīga, 2. un 4. lada.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Soļojošais bass D un E tonalitātē
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: On beat 4, play a note one fret away from the next root. It pulls the ear forward, so the change feels like it arrives.
rows.translation: Uz 4. sitiena spēlējiet noti vienas ladas attālumā no nākamā pamattoņa. Tā velk ausi uz priekšu, un maiņa rada nonākšanas sajūtu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 3 fret 4, then open string 2: one fret up into D.
rows.translation: 3. stīgas 4. lada, tad brīva 2. stīga: vienu ladu augšup uz D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: You're heading to D in the next bar. Which note on beat 4 pulls best?
rows.translation: Nākamajā taktī pārejat uz D. Kura nots uz 4. sitiena vislabāk velk uz to?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C sharp is one fret below D. A half step slides right into the new root.
rows.translation: C diēzs ir vienu ladu zem D. Pustonis ieslīd tieši jaunajā pamattonī.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Put the walk on the form
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Same 12 bars, now with a walking line. Bars that lead into a new chord end on an approach note.
rows.translation: Tās pašas 12 taktis, tagad ar soļojošu līniju. Taktis pirms jauna akorda beidzas ar pieejas noti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why does bar 12 end on G sharp?
rows.translation: Kāpēc 12. takts beidzas ar G diēzu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: It leads back to A at the top
rows.translation: Tas ved atpakaļ uz A sākumā
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bar 12 turns the form around. G sharp sits one fret below A, the chord that starts the next time through.
rows.translation: 12. takts atgriež formu sākumā. G diēzs ir vienu ladu zem A — akorda, kas sāk nākamo apli.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The 12-bar blues works in any key. In E the chords are E, A and B. Walk with roots, thirds, fifths and sixths, and approach each change.
rows.translation: 12 taktu blūzs darbojas jebkurā tonalitātē. E tonalitātē akordi ir E, A un B. Soļojiet ar pamattoņiem, tercām, kvintām un sekstām un pieejiet katrai maiņai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the key of E, which chord comes in bar 9?
rows.translation: Kurš akords E tonalitātē skan 9. taktī?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 3 fret 2; string 2 frets 1 and 4; string 1 fret 1.
rows.translation: 3. stīgas 2. lada; 2. stīgas 1. un 4. lada; 1. stīgas 1. lada.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Eighth-note rock, dotted rhythms, space, and a Motown-style line.
rows.translation: Roks astotdaļās, punktēti ritmi, pauzes un Motown stila līnija.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Play a note on every count with your fingers taking turns. Even volume is the goal.
rows.translation: Skaitiet 1 un 2 un 3 un 4 un. Katrā skaitlī un „un” spēlējiet noti, mainot pirkstus. Mērķis ir vienmērīgs skaļums.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your eighth notes start to rush. What helps?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lock to the click and relax your hand
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A dotted quarter lasts one and a half beats. Play on 1, hold through 2, then play on the and of 2, then on 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Ceturtdaļnots ar punktu ilgst pusotru sitienu. Spēlējiet uz 1, turiet cauri 2, tad spēlējiet uz „2 un”, pēc tam uz 3 un 4.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Long-short on A, D and E
rows.translation: Gari–īsi ar A, D un E
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How long does a dotted quarter note last?
rows.translation: Cik ilgi skan ceturtdaļnots ar punktu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Silence is part of the groove
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Short notes with clean rests make a line bounce. Ease off the fretting finger, still touching the string, to stop each note right on time.
rows.translation: Īsas notis ar tīrām pauzēm liek līnijai lēkāt. Atlaidiet grifa pirksta spiedienu, joprojām skarot stīgu, lai katru noti apturētu precīzi laikā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How do you stop a fretted note cleanly?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ease off but keep touching it
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Release the pressure while your finger stays on the string. The note stops without a buzz.
rows.translation: Atlaidiet spiedienu, pirkstu atstājot uz stīgas. Nots apstājas bez džinkstēšanas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Busy, but always in the pocket
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Motown-era bass lines moved a lot: chord tones, notes that lean into the next chord, and pushes off the beat. This line is new, written in that spirit.
rows.translation: Motown laikmeta basa līnijas daudz kustējās: akorda notis, notis ar tieksmi uz nākamo akordu un akcenti starp sitieniem. Šī līnija ir jauna, rakstīta tajā pašā garā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first bar: C, E, G, then B flat leaning into A.
rows.translation: Pirmā takts: C, E, G, tad B bemols ar tieksmi uz A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What does B flat do at the end of bar 1?
rows.translation: Ko B bemols dara 1. takts beigās?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Leads down a fret into A
rows.translation: Ved vienu ladu lejup uz A
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: It's an approach note, one fret above A, the root of the next chord. It slides you into the next bar.
rows.translation: Tā ir pieejas nots vienu ladu virs A — nākamā akorda pamattoņa. Tā ieslīd nākamajā taktī.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Eighth notes, dotted rhythms and a moving line. Stay with the click, keep your fingers taking turns and enjoy the groove.
rows.translation: Astotdaļnotis, punktēti ritmi un kustīga līnija. Sekojiet klikšķim, mainiet pirkstus un izbaudiet ritmu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In an eighth-note groove, which counts get a note?
rows.translation: Kuros skaitījumos astotdaļu ritmā ir nots?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bow, finger and play in tune, from open strings to fiddle tunes
rows.translation: Lociņš, pirksti un tīra intonācija — no brīvām stīgām līdz tautas melodijām
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold it, bow it, tune it, play the open strings and your first song.
rows.translation: Turiet vijoli, spēlējiet ar lociņu, skaņojiet, apgūstiet brīvās stīgas un pirmo dziesmu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Četras stīgas no zemākās līdz augstākajai
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: With the violin under your chin, the strings run G, D, A, E from left to right. G is the thickest and lowest. E is the thinnest and highest, and we call it string 1.
rows.translation: Turot vijoli zem zoda, stīgas no kreisās uz labo ir G, D, A, E. G ir resnākā un zemākā. E ir tievākā un augstākā; to saucam par 1. stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The bridge is the thin wooden arch that holds the strings up. String pressure alone keeps it standing. If it starts to lean, ask a teacher or shop to set it straight.
rows.translation: Tiltiņš ir plāna koka arka, kas tur stīgas paceltas. To vietā notur tikai stīgu spiediens. Ja tas sāk sasvērties, lūdziet skolotājam vai darbnīcā to iztaisnot.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E is the thinnest string and the highest. Strings count from E (1) to G (4).
rows.translation: E ir tievākā un augstākā stīga. Stīgas skaita no E (1) līdz G (4).
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Before you use the bow, pluck. Rest your right thumb against the side of the fingerboard and pull the string with your first finger. Players call this pizzicato.
rows.translation: Pirms lociņa spēlējiet ar pirkstu. Atbalstiet labo īkšķi pret grifa sānu un ar pirmo pirkstu iesvārstiet stīgu. Mūziķi to sauc par picikato.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rest the violin on your lap like a small guitar. Pluck string 2, the A, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Novietojiet vijoli klēpī kā mazu ģitāru. Iesvārstiet 2. stīgu, A, un ļaujiet tai skanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now the thickest string, the G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Set the violin's lower edge on your left collarbone and turn your head to rest your jaw on the chin rest. The weight of your head holds it. No clamping.
rows.translation: Uzlieciet vijoles apakšējo malu uz kreisā atslēgkaula un pagrieziet galvu, žokli atbalstot uz zoda balsta. To notur galvas svars. Nesaspiediet.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Point the scroll forward and to your left, about level with the floor. Your left hand cradles the neck, thumb across from your first finger. Keep the wrist straight and soft.
rows.translation: Vērsiet gliemezi uz priekšu un pa kreisi, aptuveni paralēli grīdai. Kreisā roka balsta kakliņu, īkšķis ir pretī pirmajam pirkstam. Plaukstas locītavu turiet taisnu un brīvu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your collarbone and the weight of your head
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Let your head rest on the chin rest. A squeezing hand or a raised shoulder makes you tense, and tension pulls notes out of tune.
rows.translation: Ļaujiet galvai balstīties uz zoda balsta. Saspiešana ar roku vai pacelts plecs rada saspringumu, bet saspringums bojā intonāciju.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold the violin in place and pluck the D string, string 3.
rows.translation: Turiet vijoli vietā un ar pirkstu iesvārstiet D stīgu — 3. stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The wooden stick runs from the frog, where you hold it, to the tip. Horsehair stretches between them. Tighten the screw until a pencil just fits between hair and stick.
rows.translation: Koka kāts stiepjas no roktura, kur to turat, līdz galam. Starp tiem nostiepti zirga astri. Pievelciet skrūvi, līdz starp astriem un kātu tikko ietilpst zīmulis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick. Drape your fingers over the stick, with your little finger standing curved on top. Keep the whole hand soft.
rows.translation: Salieciet īkšķi un tā galu novietojiet vietā, kur rokturis satiekas ar kātu. Pirkstus pārlieciet pār kātu, mazo pirkstu izliektu atbalstot augšā. Turiet visu roku brīvu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bent, where the frog meets the stick
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Flat on top of the stick
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A bent thumb at the frog lets the hand stay soft and balance the bow.
rows.translation: Saliekts īkšķis pie roktura ļauj rokai palikt brīvai un līdzsvarot lociņu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bare hair slides over the string without a sound. Rub the cake of rosin along the hair a few times before you play. A light coat is enough.
rows.translation: Neapstrādāti astri slīd pār stīgu bez skaņas. Pirms spēles dažas reizes novelciet kolofonija gabalu gar astriem. Pietiek ar plānu kārtu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Set the bow on the A string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
rows.translation: Uzlieciet lociņu uz A stīgas vidū starp tiltiņu un grifu. Lēni velciet pa labi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now the D string. Lift your elbow a little, then pull slowly.
rows.translation: Tagad D stīga. Mazliet paceliet elkoni, tad lēni velciet.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: From low to high: G, D, A, E. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Good Dogs Always Eat.
rows.translation: No zemākās līdz augstākajai: G, D, A, E. Katra stīga ir piecus burtus virs iepriekšējās; šo intervālu sauc par kvintu. Iegaumējiet: Gudri Draugi Apgūst Etīdes.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your right elbow sets which string the bow plays. Raise it for G, lower it for E. Each string has its own level, like the steps of a stair.
rows.translation: Labais elkonis nosaka, kuru stīgu spēlē lociņš. G stīgai to paceliet, E — nolaidiet. Katrai stīgai ir savs līmenis kā kāpņu pakāpieni.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bow the G string, then D. Your elbow is highest for G.
rows.translation: Ar lociņu spēlējiet G stīgu, tad D. G stīgai elkonis ir visaugstāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now A, then E. Lower your elbow one step for each.
rows.translation: Tagad A, tad E. Katrai stīgai nolaidiet elkoni par vienu pakāpienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which string needs the highest elbow?
rows.translation: Kurai stīgai vajag visaugstāk paceltu elkoni?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The G string sits farthest to the left, so your arm lifts to reach it. E needs the lowest arm.
rows.translation: G stīga atrodas vistālāk pa kreisi, tāpēc roka paceļas, lai to aizsniegtu. E stīgai roka ir viszemāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and E.
rows.translation: Orķestri skaņojas pēc A. Timbre centos rāda katras stīgas novirzi no tās nots; 100 centi ir pustonis — mazākais solis uz klavierēm. Skaņojiet A, tad D, G un E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The small screws on the tailpiece are fine tuners. Turn one clockwise to raise the pitch, counterclockwise to lower it. Quarter turns are plenty.
rows.translation: Mazās skrūves uz stīgtura ir smalkās skaņošanas skrūves. Pulksteņrādītāja virzienā skaņa kļūst augstāka, pretēji — zemāka. Pietiek ar ceturtdaļapgriezieniem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A string is a little flat. What do you do?
rows.translation: Stīga skan mazliet par zemu. Ko darīt?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Flat means too low. Clockwise tightens the string and raises the pitch.
rows.translation: Par zemu nozīmē pārāk zemu skaņu. Griežot pulksteņrādītāja virzienā, stīga nospriegojas un skaņa paaugstinās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: If a fine tuner runs out of room, use the peg. Turn it a little while pushing it inward so it holds. If a string is far off, ask a teacher; pegs can slip.
rows.translation: Ja smalkās skrūves gājiens beidzas, izmantojiet tapu. Mazliet pagrieziet, reizē spiežot uz iekšu, lai tā turētos. Ja stīga stipri atskaņojusies, lūdziet skolotāja palīdzību; tapas var izslīdēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Tune your A string, then bow it and hold it steady.
rows.translation: Noskaņojiet A stīgu, tad spēlējiet ar lociņu, saglabājot vienmērīgu skaņu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now D, G and E. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
rows.translation: Tagad D, G un E. Katru noskaņojiet, tad spēlējiet ar lociņu un turiet skaņu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Violin on your collarbone, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
rows.translation: Vijole uz atslēgkaula, lociņa satvēriens brīvs, lociņš vidū starp tiltiņu un grifu. Tagad spēlējiet visu šajā nodaļā apgūto.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bow each open string from high to low. Hold each one steady.
rows.translation: Ar lociņu spēlējiet katru brīvo stīgu no augstākās līdz zemākajai. Katru turiet vienmērīgi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which string do you tune first?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A, so start there and tune the others after it.
rows.translation: Orķestri skaņojas pēc A, tāpēc sāciet ar to un tad skaņojiet pārējās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the A string: open A, first finger a whole step up for B, second finger another whole step up for C sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb dzīvo uz A stīgas: brīva A, pirmais pirksts toni augstāk dod B, otrais vēl toni augstāk — C diēzu. Vispirms spēlējiet ar pirkstu, tad ar lociņu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on the A string, a whole step up. That's B.
rows.translation: Pirmais pirksts uz A stīgas, toni augstāk. Tā ir B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Second finger a whole step above your first. That's C sharp.
rows.translation: Otrais pirksts toni virs pirmā. Tā ir C diēzs.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C sharp, B, A, B, then C sharp three times.
rows.translation: C diēzs, B, A, B, tad C diēzs trīsreiz.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Long, even bows, clean string crossings and your first rhythms.
rows.translation: Gari, vienmērīgi lociņa vilcieni, tīras stīgu pārejas un pirmie ritmi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A down-bow pulls the bow to the right, from frog to tip. An up-bow pushes it back to the left. In music, a down-bow mark looks like a little table and an up-bow like a V.
rows.translation: Vilciens lejup virza lociņu pa labi, no roktura uz galu. Vilciens augšup stumj to atpakaļ pa kreisi. Notīs lejupvilciena zīme izskatās kā mazs galdiņš, augšupvilciena — kā V.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which way does a down-bow move?
rows.translation: Uz kuru pusi kustas lociņš vilcienā lejup?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play halfway between the bridge and the end of the fingerboard. Keep the bow parallel to the bridge, like a train on its track.
rows.translation: Spēlējiet vidū starp tiltiņu un grifa galu. Turiet lociņu paralēli tiltiņam kā vilcienu uz sliedēm.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on A. Keep the sound even to the end.
rows.translation: Viens lēns vilciens lejup, tad viens augšup uz A. Saglabājiet vienmērīgu skaņu līdz galam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Quick notes need less bow, so use the middle half of the bow and keep every stroke the same length.
rows.translation: Ceturtdaļnots ilgst vienu sitienu. Ātrām notīm vajag mazāk lociņa, tāpēc izmantojiet lociņa vidējo pusi un vienāda garuma vilcienus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A half note lasts two beats. Use a longer, slower bow so the sound doesn't fade on the second beat.
rows.translation: Pusnots ilgst divus sitienus. Izmantojiet garāku, lēnāku vilcienu, lai otrajā sitienā skaņa neizdzistu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A half note lasts twice as long, so it gets a longer, slower stroke.
rows.translation: Pusnots ilgst divreiz ilgāk, tāpēc tai vajag garāku, lēnāku vilcienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: To cross strings, change levels with your elbow, not your wrist. Arrive at the new level just before the bow changes direction.
rows.translation: Pārejot starp stīgām, mainiet līmeni ar elkoni, nevis plaukstas locītavu. Jauno līmeni sasniedziet tieši pirms lociņa virziena maiņas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A, E, A, E. Let your elbow rock between the two levels.
rows.translation: A, E, A, E. Lai elkonis šūpojas starp abiem līmeņiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What moves the bow to a new string?
rows.translation: Kas pārvieto lociņu uz citu stīgu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Going from G to A skips the D string, so your elbow makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
rows.translation: No G uz A izlaiž D stīgu, tāpēc elkonim vajag lielāku kustību. Pārejiet plūstoši un neļaujiet vidējai stīgai atskanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Use small, quick bows near the middle of the bow.
rows.translation: Astotdaļnots ilgst pussitienu, tāpēc katrā sitienā ietilpst divas. Izmantojiet īsus, ātrus vilcienus lociņa vidū.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many eighth notes fit in one beat?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now mix them: a quarter, two eighths, then two quarters. Fiddlers lean on this rhythm. Say it first: long, short-short, long, long.
rows.translation: Tagad apvienojiet: ceturtdaļa, divas astotdaļas, tad divas ceturtdaļas. Tautas vijolnieki balstās uz šo ritmu. Vispirms pasakiet: gara, īsa–īsa, gara, gara.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Straight bows at the contact point, crossings led by the elbow, and steady rhythms. Here's a mix of all three.
rows.translation: Taisni lociņa vilcieni saskares punktā, elkoņa vadītas pārejas un vienmērīgi ritmi. Šeit tie visi apvienoti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Right on top of the bridge
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Over the end of the fingerboard
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Pirmās pirkstu notis: A un E
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Place fingers 1, 2 and 3, play the A major scale and your first song.
rows.translation: Novietojiet 1., 2. un 3. pirkstu, spēlējiet A mažora gammu un pirmo dziesmu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your instrument has no frets, so your ear places every note. Many players stick thin tapes on the fingerboard as a guide while they learn.
rows.translation: Jūsu instrumentam nav ladu, tāpēc katru noti novietojat pēc dzirdes. Mācoties daudzi uz grifa uzlīmē plānas lentes kā orientierus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Put your first fingertip on the A string at the first tape. That's B, a whole step above A; a whole step is two half steps. Press until the string meets the fingerboard.
rows.translation: Novietojiet pirmā pirksta galu uz A stīgas pie pirmās lentes. Tā ir B, toni virs A; tonis ir divi pustoņi. Spiediet, līdz stīga pieskaras grifam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open A, then B with your first finger. Hold B until it settles in tune.
rows.translation: Brīva A, tad B ar pirmo pirkstu. Turiet B, līdz tā skan tīri.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Timbre accepts a note within 30 cents, about a third of a half step. If you're sharp, nudge the finger toward the scroll. If you're flat, nudge it toward the bridge.
rows.translation: Timbre pieņem noti 30 centu robežās, aptuveni pustona trešdaļu. Ja skan par augstu, pabīdiet pirkstu uz gliemeža pusi. Ja par zemu — uz tiltiņa pusi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B, open A, B. Lift the finger and set it down in the same spot.
rows.translation: B, brīva A, B. Paceliet pirkstu un uzlieciet atpakaļ tajā pašā vietā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open A, then B. How far apart?
rows.translation: Brīva A, tad B. Cik liels attālums?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Second finger plays C sharp, a whole step above B, so leave a gap after first finger. This spot is called high 2, because it sits close to where third finger will go.
rows.translation: Otrais pirksts spēlē C diēzu, toni virs B, tāpēc aiz pirmā pirksta atstājiet atstarpi. To sauc par augsto 2. pirkstu, jo tas ir tuvu trešā pirksta vietai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A, B, C sharp. Keep first finger down while second plays.
rows.translation: A, B, C diēzs. Kamēr spēlē otrais, pirmo pirkstu turiet piespiestu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: From B to the next note: what kind of step?
rows.translation: No B uz nākamo noti: kāds solis?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How far is C sharp above B?
rows.translation: Cik augstu virs B ir C diēzs?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B to C sharp is two half steps, so second finger leaves a gap after first.
rows.translation: No B līdz C diēzam ir divi pustoņi, tāpēc otrais pirksts atstāj atstarpi aiz pirmā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B, C sharp, B, A. Land each note in tune before you move on.
rows.translation: B, C diēzs, B, A. Pirms turpināt, panāciet katras nots tīru intonāciju.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Third finger plays D, a half step above C sharp, so it sits right against second finger. On the A string the pattern is 1, then 2 and 3 together.
rows.translation: Trešais pirksts spēlē D, pustoni virs C diēza, tāpēc tas ir tieši blakus otrajam. Uz A stīgas raksts ir 1, tad 2 un 3 kopā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A, B, C sharp, D. Leave each finger down as you add the next.
rows.translation: A, B, C diēzs, D. Pievienojot nākamo pirkstu, iepriekšējos atstājiet piespiestus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: When your D is in tune, the open D string vibrates along with it. The two share a letter name, eight notes apart: an octave. Listen for the violin sounding fuller.
rows.translation: Kad D skan tīri, brīvā D stīga vibrē tai līdzi. Abām ir viens burta nosaukums ar astoņu nošu atstarpi — oktāvu. Klausieties, kā vijoles skanējums kļūst pilnīgāks.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Third-finger D, open D, then third-finger D again. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: D ar trešo pirkstu, brīva D, tad atkal D ar trešo. Klausieties līdzi skanošo stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which fingers touch on the A string?
