rows.translation: Kuri pirksti uz A stīgas saskaras?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B to C sharp is a whole step, so 1 and 2 have a gap. C sharp to D is a half step, so 2 and 3 touch.
rows.translation: No B līdz C diēzam ir tonis, tāpēc starp 1 un 2 ir atstarpe. No C diēza līdz D ir pustonis, tāpēc 2 un 3 saskaras.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: On the E string, first finger plays F sharp, high second G sharp, and third A. It's the A-string shape, one string higher. Lower your bow arm to the E level.
rows.translation: Uz E stīgas pirmais pirksts spēlē F diēzu, augstais otrais — G diēzu, trešais — A. Tas ir A stīgas tvēriens uz stīgas augstāk. Nolaidiet lociņa roku līdz E līmenim.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E, F sharp, G sharp, A. Same shape as on the A string.
rows.translation: E, F diēzs, G diēzs, A. Tas pats tvēriens kā uz A stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your third finger on E plays A. What can you check it against?
rows.translation: Trešais pirksts uz E stīgas spēlē A. Ar ko to var salīdzināt?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The open A string is an octave below, so it rings along when your A is in tune.
rows.translation: Brīvā A stīga ir oktāvu zemāk, tāpēc tā skan līdzi, kad jūsu A ir tīra.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Join the halves: A, B, C sharp, D on the A string, then E, F sharp, G sharp, A on the E string. Eight notes, A to A, one shape played twice.
rows.translation: Savienojiet puses: A, B, C diēzs, D uz A stīgas, tad E, F diēzs, G diēzs, A uz E stīgas. Astoņas notis no A līdz A, viens tvēriens divreiz.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Up the A major scale, slowly. Cross to E for the top four notes.
rows.translation: Lēni augšup pa A mažora gammu. Četras augšējās notis spēlējiet uz E stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This French melody from the 1700s uses only notes you've learned: A, B, C sharp, D on the A string, and E and F sharp on the E string.
rows.translation: Šī franču melodija no gadsimta, kas sākās 1700. gadā, izmanto tikai apgūtās notis: A, B, C diēzu, D uz A stīgas un E, F diēzu uz E stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which finger plays F sharp on the E string?
rows.translation: Kurš pirksts uz E stīgas spēlē F diēzu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Whole step, whole step, half step: that's the pattern on A and E. Land each note in tune and let the open strings ring with you.
rows.translation: Tonis, tonis, pustonis: tāds ir raksts uz A un E stīgas. Katru noti uzlieciet tīri un ļaujiet brīvajām stīgām skanēt līdzi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Second finger to third: what kind of step?
rows.translation: No otrā pirksta uz trešo: kāds solis?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B, C sharp, D, then open D. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: B, C diēzs, D, tad brīva D. Klausieties līdzi skanošo stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note does high 2 play on the E string?
rows.translation: Kuru noti augstais 2. pirksts spēlē uz E stīgas?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F sharp, G sharp, A on the E string, then open A an octave lower.
rows.translation: F diēzs, G diēzs, A uz E stīgas, tad brīva A oktāvu zemāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The same finger pattern on two lower strings, D major and three tunes.
rows.translation: Tas pats pirkstu raksts uz divām zemākām stīgām, D mažors un trīs melodijas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: On the D string, first finger plays E, high second F sharp, and third G. It's the A-string pattern, one string lower. Raise your bow arm a step.
rows.translation: Uz D stīgas pirmais pirksts spēlē E, augstais otrais — F diēzu, trešais — G. Tas ir A stīgas raksts uz stīgas zemāk. Paceliet lociņa roku par vienu līmeni.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, E, F sharp, G. Second and third fingers touch.
rows.translation: D, E, F diēzs, G. Otrais un trešais pirksts saskaras.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Third-finger G on the D string is an octave above the open G string. When it's in tune, the G string hums along.
rows.translation: G ar trešo pirkstu uz D stīgas ir oktāvu virs brīvās G stīgas. Kad nots ir tīra, G stīga dūc līdzi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Third-finger G, open G, third-finger G. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: G ar trešo pirkstu, brīva G, atkal G ar trešo. Klausieties līdzi skanošo stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: On the D string, which fingers touch?
rows.translation: Kuri pirksti saskaras uz D stīgas?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: It's the A-string pattern again: whole step, whole step, half step. The half step is between 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Atkal A stīgas raksts: tonis, tonis, pustonis. Pustonis ir starp 2 un 3.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, then A, B, C sharp, D on the A string. The D major scale is one finger shape played twice.
rows.translation: Spēlējiet D, E, F diēzu, G uz D stīgas, tad A, B, C diēzu, D uz A stīgas. D mažora gamma ir viens pirkstu tvēriens divreiz.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Up the D major scale. Cross to the A string on the fifth note.
rows.translation: Augšup pa D mažora gammu. Piektajai notij pārejiet uz A stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which notes are sharp in D major?
rows.translation: Kuras notis D mažorā ir ar diēzu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D major has two sharps, F sharp and C sharp. Both are high 2.
rows.translation: D mažorā ir divi diēzi: F diēzs un C diēzs. Abus spēlē ar augsto 2. pirkstu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lightly Row is an old German children's song. It walks up and down the D major scale on the D and A strings.
rows.translation: Lightly Row ir sena vācu bērnu dziesma. Tā soļo augšup un lejup pa D mažora gammu uz D un A stīgām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which finger plays the F sharps?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on the A string
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Third finger on the D string
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: On the G string, first finger plays A, high second B, and third C. Same shape again. Raise your bow arm to its highest level.
rows.translation: Uz G stīgas pirmais pirksts spēlē A, augstais otrais — B, trešais — C. Atkal tas pats tvēriens. Paceliet lociņa roku visaugstākajā līmenī.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, A, B, C. Swing your left elbow a little under the violin to reach.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C. Lai aizsniegtu, kreiso elkoni mazliet pavirziet zem vijoles.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: First-finger A on the G string, then the open A string. Same letter, an octave apart.
rows.translation: A ar pirmo pirkstu uz G stīgas, tad brīva A stīga. Tas pats burts, oktāvas starpība.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, A, B, C on the G string plus D, E, F sharp, G on the D string make G major. It's the first octave of a two-octave scale you'll finish in the next unit.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C uz G stīgas kopā ar D, E, F diēzu, G uz D stīgas veido G mažoru. Tā ir pirmā oktāva divu oktāvu gammai, ko pabeigsiet nākamajā nodaļā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Up the G major scale. Same shape on both strings.
rows.translation: Augšup pa G mažora gammu. Tas pats tvēriens uz abām stīgām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beethoven wrote this tune for his Ninth Symphony in 1824. It moves mostly by step, so your fingers walk.
rows.translation: Bēthovens šo melodiju uzrakstīja Devītajai simfonijai 1824. gadā. Tā pārsvarā virzās pa pakāpēm, tāpēc pirksti soļo.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each line ends long, short, long: a dotted quarter, an eighth and a half note. A dot after a note adds half its length.
rows.translation: Katra rinda beidzas gari, īsi, gari: ceturtdaļnots ar punktu, astotdaļnots un pusnots. Punkts aiz nots pievieno pusi tās ilguma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This old American fiddle tune rides the rhythm you bowed on open strings: long, short-short, long, long. Fiddlers play it at jams everywhere.
rows.translation: Šī senā amerikāņu vijoļmelodija balstās uz ritmu, ko spēlējāt uz brīvām stīgām: gara, īsa–īsa, gara, gara. Vijolnieki to spēlē kopmuzicēšanā visur.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which string does this tune never use?
rows.translation: Kuru stīgu šī melodija nekad neizmanto?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: It lives on the D, A and E strings.
rows.translation: Tā skan uz D, A un E stīgām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Whole step, whole step, half step works on every string so far. Raise your bow arm for the low strings and let the octaves ring.
rows.translation: Līdz šim uz katras stīgas darbojas tonis, tonis, pustonis. Zemajām stīgām paceliet lociņa roku un ļaujiet oktāvām skanēt līdzi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two octave checks: G with open G, then A with open A.
rows.translation: Divas oktāvu pārbaudes: G ar brīvo G, tad A ar brīvo A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In D major, which finger plays C sharp?
rows.translation: Kurš pirksts D mažorā spēlē C diēzu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Move second finger to change keys: G major in two octaves, A minor and fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: Pārvietojiet otro pirkstu, lai mainītu tonalitāti: G mažors divās oktāvās, A minors un tautas vijoļmelodijas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slide second finger back until it touches first. On the A string that's C natural, a half step below C sharp. Players call it low 2.
rows.translation: Bīdiet otro pirkstu atpakaļ, līdz tas skar pirmo. Uz A stīgas tas ir C bekars, pustoni zem C diēza. Spēlētāji to sauc par zemo 2. pirkstu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A, B, C, D. Second finger touches first; leave a gap before third.
rows.translation: A, B, C, D. Otrais pirksts skar pirmo; pirms trešā atstājiet atstarpi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: B, tad augstais 2. vai zemais 2. pirksts?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: High 2, low 2, high 2, low 2. Move only your second finger.
rows.translation: Augstais 2., zemais 2., augstais 2., zemais 2. Kustiniet tikai otro pirkstu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G major needs C natural on the A string and G natural on the E string, so second finger sits low there. On the G and D strings it stays high.
rows.translation: G mažoram vajag C bekaru uz A stīgas un G bekaru uz E stīgas, tāpēc otrais pirksts tur ir zemā pozīcijā. Uz G un D stīgām tas paliek augsts.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The A string in G major: second finger low, touching first.
rows.translation: A stīga G mažorā: otrais pirksts zemu, pieskaras pirmajam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now E, F sharp, G on the E string. Low 2 again.
rows.translation: Tagad E, F diēzs, G uz E stīgas. Atkal zemais 2. pirksts.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where does second finger go on the E string in G major?
rows.translation: Kur G mažorā atrodas otrais pirksts uz E stīgas?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G natural is a half step above F sharp, so second finger tucks right against first.
rows.translation: G bekars ir pustoni virs F diēza, tāpēc otrais pirksts ir cieši pie pirmā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Start on open G and climb to G on the E string: fifteen notes, two octaves. High 2 on the low strings, low 2 on the high ones.
rows.translation: Sāciet ar brīvu G un kāpiet līdz G uz E stīgas: piecpadsmit notis, divas oktāvas. Augstais 2. uz zemajām stīgām, zemais 2. uz augstajām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minor starts with first-finger A on the G string. Second finger is high on the G string for B, then low on the D string for F natural.
rows.translation: A minors sākas ar A, ko pirmais pirksts spēlē uz G stīgas. Otrais pirksts uz G stīgas ir augsts notij B, tad uz D stīgas zems notij F bekars.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minor, up. High 2 on the G string, low 2 on the D string.
rows.translation: A minors augšup. Augstais 2. uz G stīgas, zemais 2. uz D stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Kas padara šo gammu par minoru?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Its third note is a half step lower
rows.translation: Tās trešā nots ir pustoni zemāk
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: It starts on a lower string
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A to C sounds dark; A to C sharp sounds bright. One half step changes the whole mood.
rows.translation: No A uz C skan tumši, no A uz C diēzu — gaiši. Viens pustonis maina visu noskaņu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This minuet comes from the notebook Bach gave his wife Anna Magdalena in 1725. It's now credited to Christian Petzold. Count three beats to a bar.
rows.translation: Šis menuets ir no nošu burtnīcas, ko Bahs 1725. gadā uzdāvināja sievai Annai Magdalēnai. Tagad tā autorību piedēvē Kristianam Pecoldam. Skaitiet trīs sitienus taktī.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which C does the minuet use?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The minuet is in G major, so C is natural and second finger sits low on the A string.
rows.translation: Menuets ir G mažorā, tāpēc C ir bekars un otrais pirksts uz A stīgas ir zemā pozīcijā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F sharp is high 2 on the D string: low on A, high on D.
rows.translation: F diēzu spēlē augstais 2. pirksts uz D stīgas: zemu uz A, augstu uz D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The second half starts high: fourth finger reaches B on the E string. Then third, then low 2.
rows.translation: Otrā puse sākas augstu: ceturtais pirksts sniedzas līdz B uz E stīgas. Tad trešais, tad zemais 2.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is an Appalachian fiddle tune. It's in A but uses G natural: high 2 for C sharp on the A string, low 2 for G on the E string.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark ir Apalaču vijoļmelodija. Tā ir A tonalitātē, bet izmanto G bekaru: augstais 2. spēlē C diēzu uz A stīgas, zemais 2. — G uz E stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E, F sharp, G, F sharp. Keep second finger low, touching first.
rows.translation: E, F diēzs, G, F diēzs. Turiet otro pirkstu zemu, pie pirmā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which G does this tune use on the E string?
rows.translation: Kuru G šī melodija izmanto uz E stīgas?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G natural instead of G sharp gives Old Joe Clark its old-time sound.
rows.translation: G bekars G diēza vietā piešķir Old Joe Clark senlaicīgo skanējumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Soldier's Joy was printed in Scotland in the 1700s and is still played at dances across America. Its first part rocks on A, F sharp and D, the notes of a D major chord.
rows.translation: Soldier's Joy Skotijā iespieda gadsimtā, kas sākās 1700. gadā, un to joprojām spēlē dejās visā Amerikā. Pirmā daļa šūpojas uz A, F diēza un D — D mažora akorda notīm.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open A, high-2 F sharp on D, open D, F sharp. Rock your elbow between strings.
rows.translation: Brīva A, F diēzs ar augsto 2. uz D stīgas, brīva D, F diēzs. Šūpojiet elkoni starp stīgām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which finger plays G on the E string?
rows.translation: Kurš pirksts uz E stīgas spēlē G?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Soldier's Joy is in D major, so G is natural: high 2 for F sharp on D, low 2 for G on E.
rows.translation: Soldier's Joy ir D mažorā, tāpēc G ir bekars: augstais 2. spēlē F diēzu uz D, zemais 2. — G uz E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every key sets your second finger. Before you play, ask: high 2 or low 2, and on which string?
rows.translation: Katra tonalitāte nosaka otrā pirksta vietu. Pirms spēles jautājiet: augstais 2. vai zemais 2., un uz kuras stīgas?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F sharp, then high 2 or low 2?
rows.translation: F diēzs, tad augstais 2. vai zemais 2.?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Low 2 and high 2 on the A string, then low 2 and high 2 on the E string.
rows.translation: Zemais 2. un augstais 2. uz A stīgas, tad zemais 2. un augstais 2. uz E stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In A major, where does second finger sit on the A and E strings?
rows.translation: Kur A mažorā atrodas otrais pirksts uz A un E stīgām?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Low on A, high on E
rows.translation: Zemu uz A, augstu uz E
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Loud and soft, slurs, your fourth finger, a first step toward vibrato, and Ode to Joy complete.
rows.translation: Skaļi un klusi, legato, ceturtais pirksts, pirmais solis uz vibrato un pilna Oda priekam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Add arm weight, use more bow speed, and move the contact point closer to the bridge. Use all three together. For soft, do the opposite.
rows.translation: Pievienojiet rokas svaru, palieliniet lociņa ātrumu un pārvietojiet saskares punktu tuvāk tiltiņam. Izmantojiet visus trīs reizē. Klusai spēlei dariet pretējo.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Music marks loud with f, for forte, and soft with p, for piano. Growing louder is a crescendo; fading away is a diminuendo.
rows.translation: Notīs skaļi apzīmē ar f — forte, klusi ar p — piano. Pakāpeniski skaļāk ir crescendo, pakāpeniski klusāk — diminuendo.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: To play forte, where does the bow move?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Near the bridge the string takes more weight and speed, so it sounds louder without scratching.
rows.translation: Pie tiltiņa stīga uzņem lielāku svaru un ātrumu, tāpēc skan skaļāk bez skrāpēšanas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each note twice: forte, then piano. Stay in tune while the volume changes.
rows.translation: Katru noti divreiz: forte, tad piano. Mainot skaļumu, saglabājiet tīru intonāciju.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A curved line over notes is a slur: play them all in one bow. Your left hand changes notes while the bow keeps moving.
rows.translation: Loka līnija virs notīm ir legato līga: spēlējiet tās vienā lociņa vilcienā. Kreisā roka maina notis, kamēr lociņš turpina kustēties.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slur A to B in one down-bow, then B to A in one up-bow.
rows.translation: Savienojiet A ar B vienā vilcienā lejup, tad B ar A vienā vilcienā augšup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two notes in one bow means each gets half of it. Plan ahead and start a slur with enough bow left for both notes.
rows.translation: Divas notis vienā vilcienā nozīmē, ka katrai tiek puse. Plānojiet uz priekšu un sāciet legato ar pietiekami daudz lociņa abām notīm.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What does a slur tell you?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play the notes in one bow
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fourth finger reaches a whole step above third. On the D string that's A, the same note as the open A string. Keep the finger curved and let your hand lean toward it.
rows.translation: Ceturtais pirksts sniedzas toni virs trešā. Uz D stīgas tā ir A, tā pati nots kā brīvajai A stīgai. Turiet pirkstu izliektu un ļaujiet rokai pavirzīties tā virzienā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fourth-finger A on the D string, open A, then fourth finger again. Match them exactly.
rows.translation: A ar ceturto pirkstu uz D stīgas, brīva A, tad atkal ceturtais pirksts. Panāciet precīzu sakritību.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why use fourth finger instead of an open string?
rows.translation: Kāpēc brīvas stīgas vietā izmantot ceturto pirkstu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: It avoids a string crossing and sounds warmer
rows.translation: Nav stīgu pārejas, un skaņa ir siltāka
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open strings are out of tune
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A fingered note keeps the line on one string and blends with the notes around it. Open strings ring brighter.
rows.translation: Ar pirkstu nospiesta nots atstāj līniju uz vienas stīgas un saplūst ar apkārtējām notīm. Brīvās stīgas skan gaišāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Third-finger D, fourth-finger E on the A string, then open E. Listen for the match.
rows.translation: D ar trešo pirkstu, E ar ceturto uz A stīgas, tad brīva E. Klausieties sakritību.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D to A on one string
rows.translation: No D līdz A uz vienas stīgas
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Amazing Grace is sung to an early American tune called New Britain. Its pairs of quick notes are slurs. Let the long notes sing with full, slow bows.
rows.translation: Amazing Grace dzied ar senu amerikāņu melodiju New Britain. Tās ātro nošu pāri ir legato. Ļaujiet garajām notīm dziedāt ar pilniem, lēniem lociņa vilcieniem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G to B and back crosses strings. Rock smoothly from the elbow.
rows.translation: No G uz B un atpakaļ jāpāriet starp stīgām. Plūstoši šūpojiet elkoni.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How do you bow a quick pair, like B to G?
rows.translation: Kā ar lociņu spēlēt ātru pāri, piemēram, no B uz G?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: They're slurred, so they share one bow.
rows.translation: Tās ir legato, tāpēc abas spēlē vienā vilcienā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Vibrato is a small, even wave in pitch that makes long notes glow. The fingertip rolls slightly back from the note and returns, again and again, moved by the hand and arm.
rows.translation: Vibrato ir neliels, vienmērīgs skaņas augstuma vilnis, kas liek garām notīm mirdzēt. Plaukstas un rokas kustināts, pirksta gals mazliet ripo atpakaļ no nots un atgriežas, atkal un atkal.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Vibrato can't rescue a note that's out of tune; it only colors one that's centered. Most players add it once their fingers land in tune without searching.
rows.translation: Vibrato nevar izglābt neprecīzu noti; tas tikai iekrāso tīru skaņu. Vairums spēlētāju to pievieno, kad pirksti jau trāpa tīri bez meklēšanas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: When is a note ready for vibrato?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Kad tā ir mazliet par augstu
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Set second finger on the A string. Keep the fingertip in place, soften the knuckle, and slowly rock your hand toward the scroll and back. Small and even. A teacher's eye helps here.
rows.translation: Uzlieciet otro pirkstu uz A stīgas. Pirksta galu turiet vietā, atbrīvojiet locītavu un lēni šūpojiet roku uz gliemeža pusi un atpakaļ. Mazi un vienmērīgi. Šeit palīdz skolotāja skatiens.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now bow these without vibrato and center each one. That center is where vibrato starts.
rows.translation: Tagad spēlējiet šīs notis bez vibrato un katru precīzi noskaņojiet. Šis precīzais punkts ir vibrato sākums.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Arkansas Traveler was in print by 1847. Fiddlers slur its quickest notes in pairs, which gives the tune its skip. Start slow and keep the pairs even.
rows.translation: Arkansas Traveler bija iespiesta jau 1847. gadā. Vijolnieki ātrākās notis savieno legato pāros, piešķirot melodijai lēcienu. Sāciet lēni un turiet pārus vienmērīgus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why do fiddlers slur quick pairs?
rows.translation: Kāpēc vijolnieki ātrus pārus spēlē legato?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: It saves bow and adds a lilt
rows.translation: Tas taupa lociņu un dod šūpojumu
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: It keeps the strings in tune
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A, G, F sharp, A on the E string: third finger, low 2, first, third.
rows.translation: A, G, F diēzs, A uz E stīgas: trešais pirksts, zemais 2., pirmais, trešais.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Put it all together: in-tune fingers, straight bows, slurs and dynamics. Start piano, grow through the middle, and finish forte.
rows.translation: Apvienojiet visu: tīru pirkstu intonāciju, taisnus lociņa vilcienus, legato un dinamiku. Sāciet piano, vidū kāpiniet un beidziet forte.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Warm up: fourth finger against the open strings, A and then E.
rows.translation: Iesildīšanās: salīdziniet ceturto pirkstu ar brīvajām stīgām, A un tad E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sit, bow and play in tune, from open strings to The Swan
rows.translation: No brīvām stīgām līdz skaņdarbam Gulbis: sēdiet un tīri spēlējiet ar lociņu
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sit, set the endpin, hold the bow, play the open strings and your first song.
rows.translation: Sēdiet, noregulējiet balsta kāju, turiet lociņu, spēlējiet brīvās stīgas un pirmo dziesmu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: From low to high the strings are C, G, D and A. C is the thickest and lowest. A is the thinnest and highest, and we call it string 1.
rows.translation: No zemākās līdz augstākajai stīgas ir C, G, D un A. C ir resnākā un zemākā. A ir tievākā un augstākā; to saucam par 1. stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C is the thickest string and the lowest. Strings count from A (1) to C (4).
rows.translation: C ir resnākā un zemākā stīga. Stīgas skaita no A (1) līdz C (4).
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pluck string 1, the A, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Iesvārstiet 1. stīgu, A, un ļaujiet tai skanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now the thickest string, the C. Let it rumble.
rows.translation: Tagad resnāko stīgu, C. Ļaujiet tai dārdēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sit near the front edge of a chair, feet flat and knees apart, as if you could stand up easily. The cello rests between your knees.
rows.translation: Sēdiet pie krēsla priekšējās malas, pēdas uz grīdas, ceļi atstatus, it kā varētu viegli piecelties. Čells balstās starp ceļiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pull out the endpin until the cello's top edge meets your chest at the breastbone and the C peg sits near your left ear. Tighten the screw. A rest or strap keeps it from sliding.
rows.translation: Izvelciet balsta kāju, līdz čella augšējā mala skar krūšu kaulu un C tapa ir pie kreisās auss. Pievelciet skrūvi. Atbalsts vai siksna neļauj kājai slīdēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where does the top edge of the cello touch you?
rows.translation: Kur jums pieskaras čella augšējā mala?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The cello leans back against your chest, and your knees steady it lightly from the sides.
rows.translation: Čells atliecas pret krūtīm, un ceļi to viegli stabilizē no sāniem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sitting tall, pluck D, then G. Keep your shoulders loose.
rows.translation: Sēžot taisni, iesvārstiet D, tad G. Turiet plecus brīvus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick, across from your middle finger. Drape all four fingers over the stick and let the hand hang heavy.
rows.translation: Salieciet īkšķi un tā galu novietojiet roktura un kāta savienojumā pretī vidējam pirkstam. Visus četrus pirkstus pārlieciet pār kātu un ļaujiet rokai brīvi karāties ar savu svaru.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Set the bow on the D string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
rows.translation: Uzlieciet lociņu uz D stīgas vidū starp tiltiņu un grifu. Lēni velciet pa labi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now the A string. Move your whole arm to its level, then pull slowly.
rows.translation: Tagad A stīga. Pārvietojiet visu roku tās līmenī, tad lēni velciet.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: From low to high: C, G, D, A. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Cats Go Dancing Around.
rows.translation: No zemākās līdz augstākajai: C, G, D, A. Katra stīga ir piecus burtus virs iepriekšējās; šo intervālu sauc par kvintu. Iegaumējiet: Cilvēki Grib Dziedāt Allaž.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your right arm sets which string the bow plays. Each string has its own arm level, like the steps of a stair. Move the whole arm, not just the hand.
rows.translation: Labā roka nosaka, kuru stīgu spēlē lociņš. Katrai stīgai ir savs rokas līmenis kā kāpņu pakāpieni. Kustiniet visu roku, ne tikai plaukstu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bow the C string, then G. Let your arm settle at each level.
rows.translation: Ar lociņu spēlējiet C stīgu, tad G. Ļaujiet rokai nostāties katrā līmenī.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and C.
rows.translation: Orķestri skaņojas pēc A. Timbre centos rāda katras stīgas novirzi no tās nots; 100 centi ir pustonis — mazākais solis uz klavierēm. Skaņojiet A, tad D, G un C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now D, G and C. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
rows.translation: Tagad D, G un C. Katru noskaņojiet, tad spēlējiet ar lociņu un turiet skaņu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sit tall with the endpin set, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
rows.translation: Sēdiet taisni ar noregulētu balsta kāju, brīvi turiet lociņu vidū starp tiltiņu un grifu. Tagad spēlējiet visu šajā nodaļā apgūto.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the D string: open D, first finger a whole step up for E, third finger two whole steps up for F sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb skan uz D stīgas: brīva D, pirmais pirksts toni augstāk dod E, trešais divus toņus virs brīvās stīgas — F diēzu. Vispirms spēlējiet ar pirkstu, tad ar lociņu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on the D string, a whole step up. That's E.
rows.translation: Pirmais pirksts uz D stīgas, toni augstāk. Tā ir E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Third finger, a whole step above your first. That's F sharp.
rows.translation: Trešais pirksts toni virs pirmā. Tā ir F diēzs.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F sharp, E, D, E, then F sharp three times.
rows.translation: F diēzs, E, D, E, tad F diēzs trīsreiz.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on D. Keep the sound even to the end.
rows.translation: Viens lēns vilciens lejup, tad viens augšup uz D. Saglabājiet vienmērīgu skaņu līdz galam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, A, D, A. Let your arm rock between the two levels.
rows.translation: D, A, D, A. Lai roka šūpojas starp abiem līmeņiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Going from C to D skips the G string, so your arm makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
rows.translation: No C uz D izlaiž G stīgu, tāpēc rokai vajag lielāku kustību. Pārejiet plūstoši un neļaujiet vidējai stīgai atskanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: One finger per half step: play D major and your first melodies.
rows.translation: Katram pirkstam savs pustonis: spēlējiet D mažoru un pirmās melodijas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A half step is the smallest step in music. In first position your fingers sit a half step apart, starting a whole step (two half steps) above the open string. Thumb behind the neck, across from second finger.
rows.translation: Pustonis ir mazākais solis mūzikā. Pirmajā pozīcijā pirkstus šķir pustonis, sākot toni (divus pustoņus) virs brīvās stīgas. Īkšķis aiz grifa, pretī otrajam pirkstam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open D, then E with your first finger. Hold E until it settles in tune.
rows.translation: Brīva D, tad E ar pirmo pirkstu. Turiet E, līdz tā skan tīri.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Same finger on the A string: open A, then B.
rows.translation: Tas pats pirksts uz A stīgas: brīva A, tad B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open D, then E. How far apart?
rows.translation: Brīva D, tad E. Cik liels attālums?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on D and A
rows.translation: Pirmais pirksts uz D un A
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Third finger plays F sharp, a whole step above E. Let second finger hover over its spot between 1 and 3, so your hand keeps its shape.
rows.translation: Trešais pirksts spēlē F diēzu, toni virs E. Lai otrais pirksts paliek virs savas vietas starp 1 un 3, saglabājot rokas tvērienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, E, F sharp. Keep first finger down while third plays.
rows.translation: D, E, F diēzs. Kamēr spēlē trešais, pirmo pirkstu turiet piespiestu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: From E to the next note: what kind of step?
rows.translation: No E uz nākamo noti: kāds solis?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why does second finger stay over its spot?
rows.translation: Kāpēc otrais pirksts paliek virs savas vietas?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each finger owns a half step. Keeping all four in place makes every note land in the same spot each time.
rows.translation: Katram pirkstam pieder pustonis. Turot visus četrus vietā, katra nots ikreiz nonāk tajā pašā punktā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Same fingers on the A string: open A, B, C sharp.
rows.translation: Tie paši pirksti uz A stīgas: brīva A, B, C diēzs.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fourth finger plays G, a half step above F sharp. D, E, F sharp, G is the first half of the D major scale: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: Ceturtais pirksts spēlē G, pustoni virs F diēza. D, E, F diēzs, G ir D mažora gammas pirmā puse: brīva stīga, 1, 3, 4.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, E, F sharp, G: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: D, E, F diēzs, G: brīva stīga, 1, 3, 4.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fourth-finger G on the D string is an octave above the open G string: the same letter, eight notes higher. When it's in tune, the G string hums along.
rows.translation: G ar ceturto pirkstu uz D stīgas ir oktāvu virs brīvās G stīgas: tas pats burts astoņas notis augstāk. Kad nots ir tīra, G stīga dūc līdzi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fourth-finger G, open G, then fourth-finger G again. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: G ar ceturto pirkstu, brīva G, tad atkal G ar ceturto. Klausieties līdzi skanošo stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, then A, B, C sharp, D on the A string. The same fingers twice: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: Spēlējiet D, E, F diēzu, G uz D stīgas, tad A, B, C diēzu, D uz A stīgas. Tie paši pirksti divreiz: brīva stīga, 1, 3, 4.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which fingers play D major on each string?
rows.translation: Kuri pirksti spēlē D mažoru uz katras stīgas?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This French melody from the 1700s uses only notes you've learned: D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, and A and B on the A string.
rows.translation: Šī franču melodija no gadsimta, kas sākās 1700. gadā, izmanto tikai apgūtās notis: D, E, F diēzu, G uz D stīgas un A, B uz A stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which finger plays B on the A string?
rows.translation: Kurš pirksts spēlē B uz A stīgas?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on the D and A strings. Keep the hand's shape, land each note in tune, and let the octaves ring.
rows.translation: Brīva stīga, 1, 3, 4 uz D un A stīgām. Saglabājiet rokas tvērienu, katru noti uzlieciet tīri un ļaujiet oktāvām skanēt līdzi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Third finger to fourth: what kind of step?
rows.translation: No trešā pirksta uz ceturto: kāds solis?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two octave checks: G with open G, then fourth-finger D with open D.
rows.translation: Divas oktāvu pārbaudes: G ar brīvo G, tad D ar ceturto pirkstu un brīvo D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which finger plays C sharp on the A string?
rows.translation: Kurš pirksts uz A stīgas spēlē C diēzu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two low strings, C major and G major scales, and three classic melodies.
rows.translation: Divas zemās stīgas, C un G mažora gammas un trīs klasiskas melodijas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: On the G string, first finger plays A, third finger B, and fourth finger C. Same spacing as on D. Let your arm settle at the G string level.
rows.translation: Uz G stīgas pirmais pirksts spēlē A, trešais — B, ceturtais — C. Tās pašas atstarpes kā uz D. Ļaujiet rokai nostāties G stīgas līmenī.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: G, A, B, C: brīva stīga, 1, 3, 4.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, A, B, C on the G string plus D, E, F sharp, G on the D string make the G major scale. Same fingers on both strings.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C uz G stīgas kopā ar D, E, F diēzu, G uz D stīgas veido G mažora gammu. Tie paši pirksti uz abām stīgām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which finger plays C on the G string?
rows.translation: Kurš pirksts uz G stīgas spēlē C?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: On the C string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. The thick string needs a slow, heavy bow to speak.
rows.translation: Uz C stīgas pirmais pirksts spēlē D, trešais — E, ceturtais — F. Resnajai stīgai vajag lēnu, smagu lociņa vilcienu, lai tā atskanētu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, D, E, F: open, 1, 3, 4. Give each note time to speak.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F: brīva stīga, 1, 3, 4. Dodiet katrai notij laiku atskanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, D, E, F on the C string plus G, A, B, C on the G string is the C major scale. It has no sharps at all.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F uz C stīgas kopā ar G, A, B, C uz G stīgas ir C mažora gamma. Tajā nav neviena diēza.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Up the C major scale. At the top, listen for C ringing with the open C string.
rows.translation: Augšup pa C mažora gammu. Augšā klausieties, kā C skan līdzi brīvajai C stīgai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Second finger plays F natural on the D string, a half step below F sharp, and C natural on the A string. C major needs both.
rows.translation: Otrais pirksts spēlē F bekaru uz D stīgas, pustoni zem F diēza, un C bekaru uz A stīgas. C mažoram vajag abas notis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, E, F, G: open, 1, 2, 4. Second finger sits right next to first.
rows.translation: D, E, F, G: brīva stīga, 1, 2, 4. Otrais pirksts atrodas tieši blakus pirmajam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E, then second finger or third?
rows.translation: E, tad otrais vai trešais pirksts?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Cellists give each finger its own half step, so F takes second finger and F sharp takes third. A note just past the hand, like F sharp on the C string, needs an extension, a wider hand. This course picks keys that avoid it.
rows.translation: Čellisti katram pirkstam piešķir pustoni, tāpēc F spēlē otrais, F diēzu — trešais. Nots aiz tvēriena robežas, piemēram, F diēzs uz C stīgas, prasa paplašinātu tvērienu. Šajā kursā izvēlētas tonalitātes, kur tas nav vajadzīgs.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C major, second octave: second finger for F and for the top C.
rows.translation: C mažors, otrā oktāva: otrais pirksts notīm F un augšējai C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ode to Joy, an octave up
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Brahms wrote this lullaby in 1868. It rocks in three on the G and D strings. Use long, slow bows and let each phrase breathe.
rows.translation: Brāmss šo šūpuļdziesmu sarakstīja 1868. gadā. Tā šūpojas trijdaļu metrā uz G un D stīgām. Izmantojiet garus, lēnus lociņa vilcienus un ļaujiet katrai frāzei elpot.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, F sharp, E: fingers 4, 3, 1. This is the lullaby's high point.
rows.translation: G, F diēzs, E: 4., 3., 1. pirksts. Šī ir šūpuļdziesmas augstākā vieta.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Au clair de la lune is a French folk song from the 1700s. It lives on the G and D strings, with C under your fourth finger.
rows.translation: Au clair de la lune ir franču tautasdziesma no gadsimta, kas sākās 1700. gadā. Tā skan uz G un D stīgām, C spēlējot ar ceturto pirkstu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, C, B, A, G: open D, then fingers 4, 3, 1 and open G.
rows.translation: D, C, B, A, G: brīva D, tad 4., 3., 1. pirksts un brīva G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which notes in this tune are open strings?
rows.translation: Kuras šīs melodijas notis ir brīvas stīgas?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on every string, with second finger for F and C natural. Slow, heavy bows on the low strings.
rows.translation: Brīva stīga, 1, 3, 4 uz katras stīgas, otrais pirksts — F un C bekaram. Uz zemajām stīgām lēni, smagi lociņa vilcieni.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two octave checks: C with open C, then G with open G.
rows.translation: Divas oktāvu pārbaudes: C ar brīvo C, tad G ar brīvo G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these keys has no sharps?
rows.translation: Kurā no šīm tonalitātēm nav diēzu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slide to fourth position, check it by ear, and play The Swan and Amazing Grace.
rows.translation: Slīdiet uz ceturto pozīciju, pārbaudiet pēc dzirdes un spēlējiet skaņdarbus Gulbis un Amazing Grace.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A shift moves your whole hand to a new place on the string. Lighten the finger, slide it along the string without lifting, and let your thumb travel with the hand.
rows.translation: Pozīcijas maiņa pārvieto visu roku jaunā vietā uz stīgas. Samaziniet pirksta spiedienu, slīdiet pa stīgu to nepaceļot un ļaujiet īkšķim ceļot līdzi rokai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In fourth position, first finger plays D on the A string, the note fourth finger played in first position. Your thumb settles where the neck curves into the body.
rows.translation: Ceturtajā pozīcijā pirmais pirksts uz A stīgas spēlē D — noti, ko pirmajā pozīcijā spēlēja ceturtais. Īkšķis nostājas vietā, kur kakliņš pāriet korpusā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B with first finger, then slide that finger up to D. Keep it light on the way.
rows.translation: B ar pirmo pirkstu, tad slīdiet ar to augšup līdz D. Ceļā spiediet viegli.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Moving the hand as one unit keeps your finger spacing, so the next notes land in tune too.
rows.translation: Pārvietojot visu roku kopā, saglabājas pirkstu atstarpes, tāpēc arī nākamās notis skan tīri.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Shift up, back, and up again on first finger. Land each note in tune.
rows.translation: Ar pirmo pirkstu pārejiet augšup, atpakaļ un atkal augšup. Katru noti uzlieciet tīri.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In fourth position on the A string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. Same frame as first position: one finger per half step.
rows.translation: Ceturtajā pozīcijā uz A stīgas pirmais pirksts spēlē D, trešais — E, ceturtais — F. Tas pats tvēriens kā pirmajā pozīcijā: katram pirkstam savs pustonis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, E, F: fingers 1, 3, 4. Up here the notes sit a little closer together.
rows.translation: D, E, F: 1., 3., 4. pirksts. Šeit augšā notis ir mazliet tuvāk cita citai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open A, B, shift on first finger to D, then E with third.
rows.translation: Brīva A, B, ar pirmo pirkstu pārejiet uz D, tad E ar trešo.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In fourth position on the A string, which finger plays E?
rows.translation: Kurš pirksts ceturtajā pozīcijā uz A stīgas spēlē E?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Up to fourth position and back
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Check it with the open A
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In fourth position on the D string, first finger plays G and third plays A, the same note as the open A string. Play them one after the other and match them.
rows.translation: Ceturtajā pozīcijā uz D stīgas pirmais pirksts spēlē G, trešais — A, to pašu noti kā brīvā A stīga. Spēlējiet tās pēc kārtas un saskaņojiet.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: First-finger G, then third-finger A, both on the D string.
rows.translation: G ar pirmo pirkstu, tad A ar trešo, abas uz D stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fourth-position A, open A, fourth-position A. Make them one sound.
rows.translation: A ceturtajā pozīcijā, brīva A, A ceturtajā pozīcijā. Panāciet vienādu skaņu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play E with first finger in first position, then slide that finger up to G. That's three half steps, the same distance as B to D on the A string.
rows.translation: Spēlējiet E ar pirmo pirkstu pirmajā pozīcijā, tad ar to slīdiet augšup uz G. Tie ir trīs pustoņi, tikpat, cik no B līdz D uz A stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: First-finger E, then slide to first-finger G. Let the thumb travel too.
rows.translation: E ar pirmo pirkstu, tad slīdiet uz G ar pirmo. Lai arī īkšķis ceļo līdzi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The Swan comes from The Carnival of the Animals, written by Camille Saint-Saëns in 1886. This is its opening phrase, an octave lower and simplified.
rows.translation: Gulbis ir no cikla „Dzīvnieku karnevāls”, ko Kamils Sensānss sarakstīja 1886. gadā. Šī ir tā sākuma frāze, oktāvu zemāk un vienkāršota.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Long notes need slow bows. Keep the bow close to the bridge and spread it evenly, so each note lasts to its very end without fading.
rows.translation: Garām notīm vajag lēnus lociņa vilcienus. Turiet lociņu tuvu tiltiņam un vienmērīgi sadaliet tā garumu, lai katra nots skanētu līdz galam, neizdziestot.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, F sharp, B: fourth and third finger on D, then third finger on G.
rows.translation: G, F diēzs, B: ceturtais un trešais pirksts uz D, tad trešais uz G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How do you keep a long note from fading?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In Amazing Grace, the high D comes right after open A. While the A rings, slide your hand up to fourth position and land on D with first finger.
rows.translation: Dziesmā Amazing Grace augstā D seko uzreiz pēc brīvās A. Kamēr A skan, pārbīdiet roku ceturtajā pozīcijā un ar pirmo pirkstu nospēlējiet D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B, open A, then first-finger D in fourth position. Move while the A sounds.
rows.translation: B, brīva A, tad D ar pirmo pirkstu ceturtajā pozīcijā. Pārvietojieties, kamēr A skan.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: When is the easiest moment to shift?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the middle of a long note
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: While an open string sounds, your left hand is free, so the shift can't be heard.
rows.translation: Kamēr skan brīva stīga, kreisā roka ir brīva, tāpēc pozīcijas maiņu nedzird.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lighten the finger, move hand and thumb together, and check where you land. The open strings will tell you if you're right.
rows.translation: Samaziniet pirksta spiedienu, pārvietojiet roku un īkšķi kopā un pārbaudiet jauno vietu. Brīvās stīgas pateiks, vai trāpījāt pareizi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fourth-position A on the D string, then open A. Match them.
rows.translation: A ceturtajā pozīcijā uz D stīgas, tad brīva A. Saskaņojiet tās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In fourth position, which note does first finger play on the A string?
rows.translation: Kuru noti ceturtajā pozīcijā pirmais pirksts spēlē uz A stīgas?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: From paired strings to fiddle tunes and the bluegrass chop
rows.translation: No stīgu pāriem līdz tautas vijoļmelodijām un blūgrāsa īsajiem akordiem
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Meet the paired strings, tune them and play all four open notes.
rows.translation: Iepazīstiet stīgu pārus, noskaņojiet tos un spēlējiet visas četras brīvās notis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A mandolin has eight strings in four pairs, called courses. The two strings of a pair are tuned to the same note and played together, so you treat each pair as one string.
rows.translation: Mandolīnai ir astoņas stīgas četros pāros jeb stīgu kopās. Abas pāra stīgas skaņo uz vienu noti un spēlē reizē, tāpēc katru pāri uztver kā vienu stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The pair nearest your face is the lowest, pair 4. The pair nearest the floor is the highest, pair 1. When a lesson says string 3, it means the third pair.
rows.translation: Sejai tuvākais pāris ir zemākais — 4. pāris. Grīdai tuvākais ir augstākais — 1. pāris. Ja nodarbībā minēta 3. stīga, tas nozīmē trešo pāri.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How do you play a pair?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Both strings at once, as one note
rows.translation: Abas stīgas reizē kā vienu noti
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The two strings sit close together, so one pick stroke catches both. Together they ring as one fuller note.
rows.translation: Abas stīgas ir tuvu, tāpēc viens mediatora vēziens aizskar abas. Kopā tās skan kā viena pilnīgāka nots.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pick the lowest pair, pair 4, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Iesvārstiet zemāko pāri — 4. pāri — un ļaujiet tam skanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each pair has to match the tuner and match itself. If its two strings disagree, you hear a slow wobble. Tune one string, then bring its partner to the same note.
rows.translation: Katram pārim jāsakrīt gan ar skaņotāju, gan pašam ar sevi. Ja abas stīgas nesakrīt, dzirdama lēna viļņošanās. Noskaņojiet vienu, tad otru līdz tai pašai notij.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pair 3, the D pair. Tune both strings until the wobble stops.
rows.translation: 3. pāris, D pāris. Skaņojiet abas stīgas, līdz viļņošanās beidzas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: One pair has a slow wobble. What is wrong?
rows.translation: Vienā pārī dzirdama lēna viļņošanās. Kas nav pareizi?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: That wobble is called beating: the two strings are slightly apart. Tune them until it smooths out.
rows.translation: Šo viļņošanos sauc par skaņas sitieniem: abas stīgas mazliet atšķiras. Skaņojiet, līdz skaņa kļūst līdzena.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Loosen a little below the note, then tighten up to it. Approaching from below keeps the string from slipping flat later.
rows.translation: Atlaidiet mazliet zem nots, tad pievelciet līdz tai. Tuvojoties no apakšas, stīga vēlāk mazāk noslīd par zemu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pair 4, then pair 1. Bring each string up to the note from below.
rows.translation: 4. pāris, tad 1. pāris. Katru stīgu skaņojiet līdz notij no apakšas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold the pick between the pad of your thumb and the side of your curled index finger. Let only the tip show. Keep your wrist loose, as if shaking water off your hand.
rows.translation: Turiet mediatoru starp īkšķa spilventiņu un saliekta rādītājpirksta sānu. Ārā lai redzams tikai gals. Turiet plaukstas locītavu brīvu, it kā nokratot ūdeni.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How much of the pick should show?
rows.translation: Cik lielai mediatora daļai jābūt redzamai?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A short tip gives you control and a clean sound. Too much pick snags on the paired strings.
rows.translation: Īss gals dod kontroli un tīru skaņu. Pārāk garš mediatora gals aizķeras aiz dubultajām stīgām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Push the pick down through both strings of a pair in one small motion and stop just past them. Rest the heel of your hand lightly near the bridge.
rows.translation: Ar vienu mazu kustību virziet mediatoru lejup pāri abām pāra stīgām un apstājieties tūlīt aiz tām. Plaukstas pamatni viegli atbalstiet pie tiltiņa.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: From low to high, the pairs are G, D, A and E. Try: Good Dogs Always Eat. A violin is tuned the same way, so fiddle tunes sit naturally on a mandolin.
rows.translation: No zemākā līdz augstākajam pāri ir G, D, A un E. Iegaumējiet: Gudri Draugi Apgūst Etīdes. Vijole ir skaņota tāpat, tāpēc tautas vijoļmelodijas mandolīnai der dabiski.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Low to high: G, D, A, E.
rows.translation: No zemākās līdz augstākajai: G, D, A, E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now high to low: E, A, D, G.
rows.translation: Tagad no augstākās līdz zemākajai: E, A, D, G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Tuned pairs, a relaxed pick and four open notes. Play each one cleanly, with both strings of the pair ringing.
rows.translation: Noskaņoti pāri, brīvs mediatora satvēriens un četras brīvas notis. Katru spēlējiet tīri, lai skan abas pāra stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which pair is the highest in pitch?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pairs count from the highest, pair 1, to the lowest, pair 4.
rows.translation: Pārus skaita no augstākā, 1. pāra, līdz zemākajam, 4. pārim.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A, G, E, D. Find each pair by its name.
rows.translation: A, G, E, D. Atrodiet katru pāri pēc nosaukuma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the D pair: open D, E at fret 2 with your first finger, and F sharp at fret 4 with your second.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb skan uz D pāra: brīva D, E 2. ladā ar pirmo pirkstu un F diēzs 4. ladā ar otro.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pair 3, fret 2, first finger. That's E.
rows.translation: 3. pāris, 2. lada, pirmais pirksts. Tā ir E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pair 3, fret 4, second finger. That's F sharp.
rows.translation: 3. pāris, 4. lada, otrais pirksts. Tā ir F diēzs.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret notes cleanly, learn two frets per finger and play the D major scale.
rows.translation: Spiediet notis tīri, apgūstiet divas ladas katram pirkstam un spēlējiet D mažora gammu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Press both strings of a pair with one fingertip, just behind the metal fret. Mandolin strings are tight, so use the very tip and press only as hard as a clean note needs.
rows.translation: Ar vienu pirksta galu nospiediet abas pāra stīgas tieši aiz metāla ladas. Mandolīnas stīgas ir stingras, tāpēc izmantojiet pašu pirksta galu un tikai tik lielu spēku, cik vajag tīrai notij.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Right behind the fret takes the least pressure and gives the cleanest note.
rows.translation: Tieši aiz ladas vajag vismazāk spiediena, un nots skan vistīrāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open, fret 2, fret 4: D, E, F♯.
rows.translation: Brīvs pāris, 2. lada, 4. lada: D, E, F♯.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mandolin frets are close together, so each finger covers two. First finger plays frets 1 and 2, second finger 3 and 4, third finger 5 and 6, little finger 7.
rows.translation: Mandolīnas ladas ir tuvu, tāpēc katrs pirksts aptver divas. Pirmais spēlē 1. un 2. ladu, otrais 3. un 4., trešais 5. un 6., mazais — 7.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each finger covers two frets on mandolin, so the second finger handles frets 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Mandolīnai katrs pirksts aptver divas ladas, tāpēc otrais spēlē 3. un 4. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The A pair works the same way: open is A, fret 2 is B, fret 4 is C♯ and fret 5 is D. Your hand stays where it is.
rows.translation: A pāris darbojas tāpat: brīvs ir A, 2. lada ir B, 4. lada — C♯, 5. lada — D. Roka paliek vietā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open, then first, second and third fingers on pair 2.
rows.translation: Brīvs pāris, tad pirmais, otrais un trešais pirksts uz 2. pāra.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Join the two shapes and you have the D major scale: D, E, F♯, G on pair 3, then A, B, C♯, D on pair 2. It is home for a great many fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: Savienojiet abus tvērienus, un iegūsiet D mažora gammu: D, E, F♯, G uz 3. pāra, tad A, B, C♯, D uz 2. pāra. Tā ir mājas daudzām tautas vijoļmelodijām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What comes after G in the D major scale?
rows.translation: Kas D mažora gammā seko pēc G?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: After G on pair 3 comes A. Play it on the open A pair rather than reaching for fret 7.
rows.translation: Pēc G uz 3. pāra nāk A. Spēlējiet brīvo A pāri, nevis sniedzieties uz 7. ladu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beethoven's melody uses only the first five notes of D major, on pairs 3 and 2. Keep your fingers hovering close to the strings between notes.
rows.translation: Bēthovena melodija izmanto tikai D mažora pirmās piecas notis uz 3. un 2. pāra. Starp notīm turiet pirkstus tuvu stīgām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F♯ and G on pair 3, then the open A pair.
rows.translation: F♯ un G uz 3. pāra, tad brīvais A pāris.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where does the second phrase land?
rows.translation: Uz kuras nots beidzas otrā frāze?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first phrase stops on E and sounds unfinished. The second lands on D and sounds like home.
rows.translation: Pirmā frāze apstājas uz E un skan nepabeigti. Otrā nonāk uz D un skan kā mājas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: On the E pair, fret 2 is F♯, fret 3 is G and fret 5 is A. First, second and third fingers, just as before.
rows.translation: Uz E pāra 2. lada ir F♯, 3. lada — G, 5. lada — A. Pirmais, otrais un trešais pirksts, tāpat kā iepriekš.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret 3 sits in the second finger's zone, frets 3 and 4.
rows.translation: 3. lada atrodas otrā pirksta zonā — 3. un 4. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A to A over two pairs
rows.translation: No A līdz A pāri diviem pāriem
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fingers one, two and three on frets 2, 4 and 5, with open pairs in between. Play smoothly and let each note ring until the next.
rows.translation: Pirmais, otrais un trešais pirksts 2., 4. un 5. ladā, starp tiem brīvie pāri. Spēlējiet plūstoši un ļaujiet katrai notij skanēt līdz nākamajai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every other note of the scale: D, F♯, A, D.
rows.translation: Katra otrā gammas nots: D, F♯, A, D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: You need C♯ on pair 2. Which fret?
rows.translation: Vajag C♯ uz 2. pāra. Kura lada?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: On pair 2, fret 2 is B, fret 3 is C and fret 4 is C♯.
rows.translation: Uz 2. pāra 2. lada ir B, 3. lada ir C, 4. lada ir C♯.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Does the tune go up or down?
rows.translation: Vai melodija virzās augšup vai lejup?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D all the way up to A
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ode to Joy, up to speed
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Alternate your pick in eighth notes and make long notes sing with tremolo.
rows.translation: Mainiet mediatora virzienu astotdaļās un ar tremolo lieciet garajām notīm dziedāt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down on the beat, up between
rows.translation: Uz sitiena lejup, starp sitieniem augšup
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pick down on each beat and up on the and in between. Your hand swings like a pendulum, down, up, down, up, even when a note waits.
rows.translation: Uz katra sitiena spēlējiet ar vēzienu lejup, bet uz „un” starp sitieniem — augšup. Roka šūpojas kā svārsts: lejup, augšup, lejup, augšup, pat ja kāda nots vēl jāgaida.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which stroke lands on the beat?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down on the beat and up in between keeps your hand in time, like a drummer's sticks.
rows.translation: Vēziens lejup uz sitiena un augšup starp sitieniem palīdz rokai turēt ritmu gluži kā bundzinieka vālītēm.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: When you move to another pair, your hand keeps its down-up swing. The forearm carries you across; the wrist keeps the beat.
rows.translation: Pārejot uz citu pāri, roka turpina šūpoties lejup un augšup. Apakšdelms pārnes roku, bet plaukstas locītava uztur ritmu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: You cross to a new pair on an and. Which stroke?
rows.translation: Uz „un” pārejat uz jaunu pāri. Kurš vēziens?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every and gets an up stroke. Let the pendulum decide, not the string.
rows.translation: Uz katra „un” ir vēziens augšup. Ļaujiet izvēli noteikt svārsta kustībai, nevis stīgai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A mandolin note fades quickly. Tremolo keeps it singing: pick down and up fast and evenly on one pair, so the note sounds unbroken.
rows.translation: Mandolīnas nots ātri izdziest. Tremolo paildzina tās skanējumu: ātri un vienmērīgi spēlējiet uz viena pāra lejup un augšup, lai nots skanētu nepārtraukti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Keep the pick close to the strings and the strokes even. Speed comes later, once the motion is relaxed.
rows.translation: Turiet mediatoru tuvu stīgām un vēzienus vienmērīgus. Ātrums nāks vēlāk, kad kustība būs brīva.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Start by counting four strokes to each beat. As it gets easier, stop counting and keep the motion quick and steady. The beat lives in your foot, not in your pick.
rows.translation: Sāciet ar četriem vēzieniem uz katru sitienu. Kad tas padodas vieglāk, pārtrauciet skaitīt un saglabājiet ātru, vienmērīgu kustību. Sitienu uztur pēda, nevis mediators.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Amazing Grace moves in three beats to the bar. Tremolo through each long note and change notes right on the beat. Two notes are new: A and B on the G pair.
rows.translation: Amazing Grace katrā taktī ir trīs sitieni. Katru garo noti spēlējiet tremolo un mainiet notis precīzi uz sitiena. Divas notis ir jaunas: A un B uz G pāra.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pair 4, fret 2 with your first finger, then fret 4 with your second.
rows.translation: 4. pāris, 2. lada ar pirmo pirkstu, tad 4. lada ar otro.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How do you hold the long A at the end?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A single pick fades long before three beats are up. Tremolo keeps it ringing to the end of the bar.
rows.translation: Pēc viena vēziena nots izdziest krietni pirms trīs sitienu beigām. Tremolo saglabā skanējumu līdz takts beigām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down on the beat, up in between, and tremolo whenever a note needs to last. Keep every stroke small.
rows.translation: Uz sitiena lejup, starp sitieniem augšup, un tremolo ikreiz, kad notij jāskan ilgi. Katram vēzienam jābūt mazam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which stroke plays the and of beat 2?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every and gets an up stroke, wherever the note is.
rows.translation: Uz katra „un” ir vēziens augšup neatkarīgi no nots atrašanās vietas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, D, C, E minor and A, then the short, choked chord that drives bluegrass.
rows.translation: G, D, C, E minors un A, tad īsais, apslāpētais akords, kas virza blūgrāsu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 2, second finger on fret 3 of pair 1. Pairs 4 and 3 ring open.
rows.translation: Pirmais pirksts uz 2. pāra 2. ladas, otrais — uz 1. pāra 3. ladas. 4. un 3. pāris skan brīvi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Brush the pick down across all four pairs in one smooth motion, low to high. Small and light is enough; mandolin chords are bright.
rows.translation: Ar mediatoru vienā plūstošā kustībā velciet lejup pāri visiem četriem pāriem, no zemākā līdz augstākajam. Pietiek ar mazu, vieglu vēzienu; mandolīnas akordi skan spoži.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 4, second finger on fret 2 of pair 1. Pairs 3 and 2 ring open.
rows.translation: Pirmais pirksts uz 4. pāra 2. ladas, otrais — uz 1. pāra 2. ladas. 3. un 2. pāris skan brīvi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 3, second finger on fret 3 of pair 2. Pairs 4 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Pirmais pirksts uz 3. pāra 2. ladas, otrais — uz 2. pāra 3. ladas. 4. un 1. pāris skan brīvi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: From C, slide your second finger back to fret 2. The chord turns darker, though only one finger moved.
rows.translation: No C pārbīdiet otro pirkstu atpakaļ uz 2. ladu. Akords kļūst tumšāks, lai gan pārvietojās tikai viens pirksts.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret 2 on pairs 4 and 3, fret 4 on pair 2, fret 5 on pair 1: fingers one, two, three and four. No pair rings open.
rows.translation: 2. lada uz 4. un 3. pāra, 4. lada uz 2. pāra, 5. lada uz 1. pāra: pirmais, otrais, trešais un ceturtais pirksts. Neviens pāris neskan brīvi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why does it matter that no pair rings open?
rows.translation: Kāpēc svarīgi, ka neviens pāris neskan brīvi?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: You can silence it by easing off
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: It keeps the chord in tune
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: With every pair held down, relaxing your fingers stops the sound at once. That is the secret of the chop.
rows.translation: Kad visi pāri ir piespiesti, pirkstu atslābināšana uzreiz aptur skaņu. Tas ir īsā akorda noslēpums.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chop is a short chord on beats 2 and 4. Strum down, then ease your fretting fingers off the strings without lifting them, so the sound stops right away.
rows.translation: Īsais akords skan uz 2. un 4. sitiena. Velciet lejup, tad maziniet spiedējpirkstu spiedienu uz stīgām, tos nepaceļot, lai skaņa uzreiz apstātos.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Uz kuriem sitieniem skan īsais akords?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bass and guitar take beats 1 and 3. The mandolin answers on 2 and 4, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Bass un ģitāra spēlē uz 1. un 3. sitiena. Mandolīna atbild uz 2. un 4., gluži kā mazā bunga.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Let the chord sound for only a moment. If it hangs on, relax your fingers sooner. Your fingertips stay touching the strings the whole time.
rows.translation: Ļaujiet akordam skanēt tikai mirkli. Ja tas turpina skanēt, atslābiniet pirkstus agrāk. Pirkstu gali visu laiku paliek pie stīgām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Chops in G, C and D
rows.translation: Īsie G, C un D akordi
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your A shape works anywhere on the neck. Slide it up three frets for C and five frets for D. Keep all four fingers in place as you move.
rows.translation: A forma darbojas jebkurā vietā uz grifa. Pārbīdiet to trīs ladas augstāk, lai iegūtu C, un piecas — lai iegūtu D. Pārvietojoties saglabājiet visu četru pirkstu izvietojumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G needs a new stretch: first finger fret 2 on pair 2, second finger fret 3 on pair 1, third finger fret 5 on pair 3, little finger fret 7 on pair 4.
rows.translation: G prasa jaunu izstiepumu: pirmais pirksts uz 2. pāra 2. ladas, otrais uz 1. pāra 3. ladas, trešais uz 3. pāra 5. ladas, mazais pirksts uz 4. pāra 7. ladas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Strum open chords to learn the sound, then chop on 2 and 4 to drive the band. Keep the beat steady through every change.
rows.translation: Spēlējiet brīvo stīgu akordus, lai apgūtu skanējumu, tad īsos akordus uz 2. un 4., lai virzītu grupu. Visās maiņās turiet vienmērīgu pulsu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your chop keeps ringing. What fixes it?
rows.translation: Īsais akords turpina skanēt. Kā to labot?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lift your fingers off the neck
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ease off with your fretting fingers sooner
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chop is choked by the fretting hand. Relax the pressure but keep your fingertips on the strings.
rows.translation: Īso akordu apklusina roka, kas spiež stīgas. Maziniet spiedienu, bet pirkstu galus paturiet uz stīgām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Five traditional jam tunes, simplified, from Boil Them Cabbage Down to Old Joe Clark.
rows.translation: Piecas vienkāršotas tradicionālas kopspēles melodijas — no Boil Them Cabbage Down līdz Old Joe Clark.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This one lives on the E and A pairs and keeps coming back to F♯. Pick down on the beat and up in between, just like your eighth-note drills.
rows.translation: Tā skan uz E un A pāriem un arvien atgriežas pie F♯. Uz sitiena spēlējiet lejup, starp sitieniem augšup, tieši kā astotdaļnošu vingrinājumos.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F♯, G and A on pair 1 at frets 2, 3 and 5, then D on pair 2, fret 5.
rows.translation: F♯, G un A uz 1. pāra 2., 3. un 5. ladā, tad D uz 2. pāra 5. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where does the tune come to rest?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Like most tunes in D, it ends on D, the home note.
rows.translation: Tāpat kā vairums melodiju D tonalitātē, tā beidzas uz D — tonikas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The low part of Angeline the Baker uses only D, E, F♯, A and B. Both parts end on A instead of D, which sends the tune around again.
rows.translation: Angeline the Baker zemajā daļā ir tikai D, E, F♯, A un B. Abas daļas beidzas uz A, nevis D, tādēļ melodija aicina sākt vēlreiz.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note do both parts end on?
rows.translation: Uz kuras nots beidzas abas daļas?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ending on A instead of D leaves the tune hanging, so it rolls straight into the next time through.
rows.translation: Beigas uz A, nevis D, atstāj melodiju nepabeigtu, tādēļ tā uzreiz aizrit nākamajā atkārtojumā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Soldier's Joy was in print in Scotland by 1780 and has filled American jams ever since. Its first part bounces between D, F♯ and A.
rows.translation: Soldier's Joy Skotijā bija iespiesta jau 1780. gadā un kopš tā laika skanējusi daudzās amerikāņu kopspēlēs. Tās pirmā daļa lēkā starp D, F♯ un A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open A pair, pair 3 fret 4, open D, then fret 4 again.
rows.translation: Brīvais A pāris, 3. pāra 4. lada, brīvais D, tad atkal 4. lada.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, F♯ and A together spell which chord?
rows.translation: Kuru akordu kopā veido D, F♯ un A?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, F♯ and A are the three notes of D major. Fiddle tunes often trace their chords like this.
rows.translation: D, F♯ un A ir trīs D mažora skaņas. Vijoļmelodijas bieži šādi iezīmē savus akordus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Arkansas Traveler starts low, down on the G pair, then jumps up to the E pair for a part that tumbles down the scale. It was in print by the 1840s.
rows.translation: Arkansas Traveler sākas zemu uz G pāra, tad pārlec uz E pāri, kur daļa ripo lejup pa gammu. Melodija bija iespiesta jau 1840. gados.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pair 4, frets 2 and 4, then the open D pair.
rows.translation: 4. pāris, 2. un 4. lada, tad brīvais D pāris.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where does the high part begin?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: On A, fret 5 of the E pair
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: It opens on A at fret 5 of pair 1, then walks down through G, F♯ and E.
rows.translation: Tā sākas uz A 1. pāra 5. ladā, tad virzās lejup caur G, F♯ un E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A new key and a twist
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is in A, so you use C♯ and G♯. In the second part, G♯ drops to plain G on fret 3 of the E pair. That one note gives the tune its old-time sound.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark ir A tonalitātē, tāpēc spēlējat C♯ un G♯. Otrajā daļā G♯ pazeminās līdz G bekara notij E pāra 3. ladā. Šī viena nots piešķir melodijai senlaicīgu skanējumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G♯ on pair 3, fret 6; the open A pair; then G on pair 1, fret 3.
rows.translation: G♯ uz 3. pāra 6. ladā; brīvais A pāris; tad G uz 1. pāra 3. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note gives the second part its old-time sound?
rows.translation: Kura nots piešķir otrajai daļai senlaicīgu skanējumu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A major uses G♯. Lowering it to G gives the mixolydian sound that runs through old-time and bluegrass music.
rows.translation: A mažorā ir G♯. Pazeminot to līdz G, rodas miksolidiskais skanējums, kas raksturīgs senajai amerikāņu tautas mūzikai un blūgrāsam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play each tune through at a steady tempo. If a note slips, keep your picking hand moving and catch the next beat. That is how real jams work.
rows.translation: Izspēlējiet katru melodiju vienmērīgā tempā. Ja kāda nots paslīd garām, turpiniet mediatora rokas kustību un uztveriet nākamo sitienu. Tā notiek īstās kopspēlēs.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which tune swaps G♯ for G?
rows.translation: Kura melodija aizstāj G♯ ar G?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is in A but uses G in its second part. That lowered note is its signature.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark ir A tonalitātē, bet otrajā daļā lieto G. Šī pazeminātā nots ir tās raksturīgā pazīme.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Add the left-hand moves and rolling right hand that make a tune sound like bluegrass.
rows.translation: Pievienojiet kreisās rokas paņēmienus un ritošu labās rokas spēli, kas melodijai piešķir blūgrāsa skanējumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pick a note, then keep pressing as you glide the same finger up to a higher fret. The new note sounds without a second pick stroke. Light, steady pressure is the trick.
rows.translation: Iesvārstiet noti, tad turpiniet spiest, ar to pašu pirkstu slīdot uz augstāku ladu. Jaunā nots skan bez otra mediatora vēziena. Galvenais ir viegls, vienmērīgs spiediens.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What sounds the second note in a slide?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your finger pressing as it moves
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Only the first note is picked. Keep pressure on the string as you slide, or the note dies on the way.
rows.translation: Ar mediatoru iesvārsta tikai pirmo noti. Slīdot saglabājiet spiedienu uz stīgu, citādi nots pa ceļam izdziest.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pick an open pair, then snap a fingertip down just behind fret 2. The new note sounds from the tap alone, with no second pick stroke.
rows.translation: Iesvārstiet brīvu pāri, tad uzsitiet ar pirksta galu tieši aiz 2. ladas. Jaunā nots skan tikai no piesitiena, bez otra mediatora vēziena.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The reverse: with a finger on fret 2, pick, then pull the finger slightly sideways as you lift. That flick plucks the open note below.
rows.translation: Pretējā kustība: ar pirkstu 2. ladā iesvārstiet stīgu, tad, pirkstu paceļot, pavelciet to mazliet sānis. Šis rāviens iesvārsta zemāko brīvās stīgas noti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which moves sound a note without the pick?
rows.translation: Kuri paņēmieni ieskandina noti bez mediatora?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: All three sound a second note with the fretting hand. The pick plays only the first.
rows.translation: Visi trīs ieskandina otro noti ar stīgu spiedējroku. Mediators spēlē tikai pirmo.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fiddle tunes come alive with small ornaments. Here the two plain A notes that open Old Joe Clark become A, B, A: a hammer-on and a pull-off.
rows.translation: Mazi rotājumi atdzīvina vijoļmelodijas. Šeit divas vienkāršās A notis Old Joe Clark sākumā kļūst par A, B, A: hammer-on un pull-off paņēmiens.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In A, B, A, how many times do you pick?
rows.translation: Cik reižu jāspēlē ar mediatoru virknē A, B, A?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pick the first A, hammer on to B and pull off back to A. One pick, three notes.
rows.translation: Ar mediatoru iesvārstiet pirmo A, ar pirksta uzsitienu spēlējiet B un ar rāvienu atgriezieties uz A. Viens vēziens, trīs notis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Crosspicking picks single notes across three pairs in a repeating pattern, so a chord sounds like a ripple. Eight notes split three, three and two.
rows.translation: Šķērsspēlē atsevišķas notis spēlē uz trim pāriem atkārtotā rakstā, lai akords skanētu kā vilnītis. Astoņas notis sadalās pa trim, trim un divām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How are the eight notes of a crosspicking bar grouped?
rows.translation: Kā grupē astoņas notis šķērsspēles taktī?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A three-note pattern repeated across a bar of eight makes the accent shift each time. That is the rolling feel.
rows.translation: Atkārtojot trīs nošu rakstu astoņu nošu taktī, akcents katrreiz pārvietojas. Tas rada ritošo sajūtu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ripple through G, C and D
rows.translation: Vilnītis caur G, C un D
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slides, hammer-ons, chops and crosspicking. Take each one at your own pace, and keep the beat steady above all.
rows.translation: Slaidi, hammer-on paņēmieni, īsie akordi un šķērsspēle. Katru apgūstiet savā tempā, un vispirms rūpējieties par vienmērīgu pulsu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which beats does the chop land on?
rows.translation: Uz kuriem sitieniem spēlē īso akordu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Five-string, open G: rolls, old-time tunes and clawhammer
rows.translation: Piecas stīgas, vaļējais G: pirkstu raksti, senas melodijas un clawhammer
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Meet the five strings, tune to open G, find the drone string and play a song.
rows.translation: Iepazīstiet piecas stīgas, noskaņojiet vaļējā G skaņojumā, atrodiet burdona stīgu un nospēlējiet dziesmu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A banjo has four full-length strings and a fifth that starts partway up the neck, at its own little tuning peg. That short string is the banjo's signature sound.
