rows.translation: Bandžo ir četras pilna garuma stīgas un piektā, kas sākas augstāk uz grifa pie savas mazās skaņošanas tapas. Šī īsā stīga rada bandžo raksturīgo skanējumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 1 is the thin one nearest the floor. Strings 2, 3 and 4 follow toward your face. The short one on top is string 5.
rows.translation: 1. stīga ir tievā, kas atrodas vistuvāk grīdai. 2., 3. un 4. stīga seko virzienā uz jūsu seju. Īsā stīga augšā ir 5. stīga.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which string is the short one?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The fifth string lies next to string 4 but starts at the fifth fret, with its peg on the side of the neck.
rows.translation: Piektā stīga atrodas blakus 4. stīgai, bet sākas pie piektās ladas, un tās tapa ir grifa sānos.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pluck string 1, the thin one nearest the floor.
rows.translation: Iesvārstiet 1. stīgu — tievo, kas vistuvāk grīdai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now the short string, string 5. Pluck it with your thumb.
rows.translation: Tagad īso stīgu — 5. stīgu. Iesvārstiet to ar īkšķi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Standard banjo tuning is open G. From string 4 to string 1 it reads D, G, B, D, and the short fifth string is a high G. Strummed open, they make a G chord.
rows.translation: Standarta bandžo skaņojums ir vaļējais G. No 4. līdz 1. stīgai notis ir D, G, B, D, bet īsā piektā stīga ir augsts G. Brīvi pārvilktas, tās veido G akordu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Strings 4, 3, 2 and 1: D, G, B, D.
rows.translation: 4., 3., 2. un 1. stīga: D, G, B, D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What chord do the open strings make?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, B and D are the notes of a G chord. That is why this tuning is called open G.
rows.translation: G, B un D ir G akorda skaņas. Tāpēc šo skaņojumu sauc par vaļējo G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bluegrass banjo uses a plastic thumb pick and two metal finger picks, on index and middle. The finger picks point down, curving the same way as your fingertips.
rows.translation: Blūgrāsa bandžo spēlē lieto plastmasas īkšķa mediatoru un divus metāla pirkstu mediatorus — uz rādītājpirksta un vidējā pirksta. Pirkstu mediatori vērsti lejup un izliekti tāpat kā pirkstu gali.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: For now your thumb plays strings 3, 4 and 5, your index plays string 2 and your middle plays string 1. Rest your ring and little fingers lightly on the head.
rows.translation: Pagaidām īkšķis spēlē 3., 4. un 5. stīgu, rādītājpirksts — 2. stīgu, bet vidējais pirksts — 1. stīgu. Zeltneša un mazā pirksta galus viegli atbalstiet uz membrānas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Thumb takes strings 3, 4 and 5, index takes string 2 and middle takes string 1.
rows.translation: Īkšķis spēlē 3., 4. un 5. stīgu, rādītājpirksts — 2. stīgu, bet vidējais pirksts — 1. stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The fifth string is a drone: you play it open, between melody notes, and it rings over everything. In these lessons you never fret it.
rows.translation: Piektā stīga ir burdons: to spēlē brīvu starp melodijas notīm, un tā skan pāri visam. Šajās stundās to nekad nepiespiedīsiet.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: First string 5, then string 1. Which is higher?
rows.translation: Vispirms 5. stīga, tad 1. stīga. Kura ir augstāka?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why does the fifth string sound so high?
rows.translation: Kāpēc piektā stīga skan tik augstu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: It is short and tuned to high G
rows.translation: Tā ir īsa un noskaņota uz augstu G
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Being short lets it hold a high G. It sits on top of the melody like a bell.
rows.translation: Īsais garums ļauj tai turēt augstu G. Tā skan pāri melodijai kā zvaniņš.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Tuned to open G, picks on, thumb ready for the drone. Play each string cleanly and let it ring.
rows.translation: Vaļējais G skaņojums, mediatori uzvilkti, īkšķis gatavs burdonam. Katru stīgu spēlējiet tīri un ļaujiet tai skanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B, high G, low D, high D, G. Find each string by its note.
rows.translation: B, augsts G, zems D, augsts D, G. Atrodiet katru stīgu pēc tās nots.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 3, then string 5. Which is higher?
rows.translation: 3. stīga, tad 5. stīga. Kura ir augstāka?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: open string 2 is B, fret 2 on string 3 is A, and open string 3 is G. Your second finger frets the A; your thumb picks string 3.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb vajag trīs notis: brīvā 2. stīga ir B, 3. stīgas 2. lada ir A, bet brīvā 3. stīga ir G. Otrais pirksts piespiež A; īkšķis iesvārsta 3. stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The right-hand patterns behind the rolling bluegrass sound: pinch, alternating thumb and forward roll.
rows.translation: Ritošā blūgrāsa labās rokas raksti: divu stīgu iesvārstījums, raksts ar īkšķi pamīšus un raksts uz priekšu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A pinch is your thumb and middle finger plucking at the same moment, on strings 5 and 1. It sounds like a little two-note chord and often starts or ends a phrase.
rows.translation: Divu stīgu iesvārstījumā īkšķis un vidējais pirksts vienlaikus iesvārsta 5. un 1. stīgu. Tas skan kā mazs divu skaņu akords un bieži sāk vai noslēdz frāzi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pinch, or one note at a time?
rows.translation: Divas stīgas reizē vai pa vienai notij?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which strings does a pinch play?
rows.translation: Kuras stīgas spēlē divu stīgu iesvārstījumā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Thumb on the short fifth string and middle on string 1, at the same moment.
rows.translation: Īkšķis uz īsās piektās stīgas un vidējais pirksts uz 1. stīgas — vienlaikus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This roll is eight even notes: thumb on 3, index on 2, thumb on 5, middle on 1, then thumb on 4, index on 2, thumb on 5, middle on 1.
rows.translation: Šajā rakstā ir astoņas vienmērīgas notis: īkšķis uz 3., rādītājpirksts uz 2., īkšķis uz 5., vidējais pirksts uz 1., tad īkšķis uz 4., rādītājpirksts uz 2., īkšķis uz 5., vidējais pirksts uz 1.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which finger plays every other note?
rows.translation: Kurš pirksts spēlē katru otro noti?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Thumb, index, thumb, middle: the thumb plays every other note, which gives the roll its name.
rows.translation: Īkšķis, rādītājpirksts, īkšķis, vidējais pirksts: īkšķis spēlē katru otro noti, un no tā cēlies raksta nosaukums.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The forward roll moves one way, thumb then index then middle, over and over. Eight notes make thumb, index, middle twice, then thumb, index.
rows.translation: Rakstā uz priekšu kustība iet vienā virzienā: īkšķis, tad rādītājpirksts, tad vidējais pirksts, atkal un atkal. Astoņās notīs šo secību spēlē divreiz, pēc tam īkšķi un rādītājpirkstu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How does a forward roll fit into eight notes?
rows.translation: Kā raksts uz priekšu ietilpst astoņās notīs?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle twice, then thumb, index. The accent shifts as it goes, which makes the rolling sound.
rows.translation: Īkšķis, rādītājpirksts, vidējais pirksts divreiz, tad īkšķis un rādītājpirksts. Akcents pārvietojas, radot ritošo skanējumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A roll is only as good as its timing. Keep all eight notes even, like a ticking clock, and land the first note of each bar right on the beat.
rows.translation: Pirkstu raksta kvalitāti nosaka precīzs ritms. Visām astoņām notīm jābūt vienmērīgām kā pulksteņa tikšķiem, un katras takts pirmajai notij jāskan precīzi uz sitiena.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: You lose the beat in the middle of a roll. What now?
rows.translation: Raksta vidū pazaudējāt pulsu. Ko nu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Stop and start the bar over
rows.translation: Apstāties un sākt takti no jauna
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slow down until it feels right
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Keep the right hand moving and rejoin
rows.translation: Turpināt labās rokas kustību un pievienoties
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In a band the beat never waits. Keep the pattern going and catch the next bar.
rows.translation: Grupā pulss nekad negaida. Turpiniet rakstu un pievienojieties nākamajā taktī.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Pirkstu raksti no sākuma līdz beigām
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pinch, alternating thumb and forward roll, all on open strings. Keep the eighths even and let every string ring.
rows.translation: Divu stīgu iesvārstījums, raksts ar īkšķi pamīšus un raksts uz priekšu — viss uz brīvām stīgām. Astotdaļnotīm jābūt vienmērīgām, un katrai stīgai jāskan.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which roll goes thumb, index, middle, over and over?
rows.translation: Kurā rakstā arvien atkārtojas īkšķis, rādītājpirksts, vidējais pirksts?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret G, C, D7 and E minor and keep the roll going through the changes.
rows.translation: Veidojiet G, C, D7 un E minora akordus un turpiniet pirkstu rakstu visās maiņās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 4, third finger on fret 2 of string 1. Strings 3 and 5 ring open.
rows.translation: Pirmais pirksts uz 2. stīgas 1. ladas, otrais uz 4. stīgas 2. ladas, trešais uz 1. stīgas 2. ladas. 3. un 5. stīga skan brīvi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do you fret the fifth string for C?
rows.translation: Vai C akordam jāpiespiež piektā stīga?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The open high G belongs to the C chord, so it rings as it is. You never fret it in these lessons.
rows.translation: Brīvais augstais G ietilpst C akordā, tāpēc skan tāpat. Šajās stundās to nekad nepiespiedīsiet.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 3. Strings 4 and 1 ring open. Leave the fifth string out; its G clashes with D7.
rows.translation: Pirmais pirksts uz 2. stīgas 1. ladas, otrais uz 3. stīgas 2. ladas. 4. un 1. stīga skan brīvi. Piekto stīgu izlaidiet; tās G nesader ar D7.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The full D7, if you like
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The two-finger D7 has no F sharp. Add your little finger at fret 4 of string 1 and all four notes of D7 ring. Either shape works in the songs; the full one sounds richer.
rows.translation: Divu pirkstu D7 nav F diēza. Pievienojiet mazo pirkstu uz 1. stīgas 4. ladas, un skanēs visas četras D7 skaņas. Dziesmās der abas formas; pilnā skan bagātīgāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord wants to move on?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What does your thumb do on D7?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The open G of string 5 isn't part of D7. For now your thumb keeps to strings 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Brīvās 5. stīgas G neietilpst D7. Pagaidām īkšķis paliek uz 3. un 4. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G is home, C steps away and D7 pulls you back. Change on the first beat of each bar and keep your right hand moving.
rows.translation: G ir mājas, C dodas projām, bet D7 velk atpakaļ. Mainiet akordu katras takts pirmajā sitienā un turpiniet labās rokas kustību.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord pulls you back to G?
rows.translation: Kurš akords velk atpakaļ uz G?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D7 contains C, which leans down to B in the G chord. That pull is why so many songs end D7 to G.
rows.translation: D7 ietver C, kas tiecas lejup uz B G akordā. Šīs tieksmes dēļ tik daudzas dziesmas beidzas ar D7 pāreju uz G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Make C, then lift your first finger off string 2. Two fingers stay on fret 2, strings 4 and 1, and the chord turns darker: E minor.
rows.translation: Izveidojiet C, tad paceliet pirmo pirkstu no 2. stīgas. Divi pirksti paliek 4. un 1. stīgas 2. ladā, un akords kļūst tumšāks: E minors.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Raksts uz priekšu uz E minora
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Four chords and two rolls. Keep the right hand steady even while the left hand is busy changing.
rows.translation: Četri akordi un divi pirkstu raksti. Turiet labo roku vienmērīgu arī tad, kad kreisā rosīgi maina akordus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which string sits out on D7?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Alternating thumb: G, C, D7, G
rows.translation: Īkšķis pamīšus: G, C, D7, G
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Forward roll: G, E minor, C, D7, G
rows.translation: Raksts uz priekšu: G, E minors, C, D7, G
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Four traditional tunes, with the drone string ringing in among the melody.
rows.translation: Četras tradicionālas melodijas ar burdona stīgu starp melodijas notīm.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Here the melody is the main event: pick each note with the finger that owns its string. Strings 3, 2 and 1 carry this whole tune.
rows.translation: Šeit galvenā ir melodija: katru noti iesvārstiet ar pirkstu, kas atbild par tās stīgu. Visa melodija skan uz 3., 2. un 1. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 2 open, string 3 fret 2, string 3 open, string 2 fret 1, string 1 open.
rows.translation: Brīvā 2. stīga, 3. stīgas 2. lada, brīvā 3. stīga, 2. stīgas 1. lada, brīvā 1. stīga.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note does the tune end on?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Tunes in G come home to G, here the open third string.
rows.translation: Melodijas G tonalitātē atgriežas mājās uz G — šeit uz brīvās trešās stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Cripple Creek has a high part that uses the fifth string as a melody note, and a low part down on strings 3 and 4. Take each part slowly first.
rows.translation: Cripple Creek augstajā daļā piekto stīgu izmanto kā melodijas noti, bet zemā daļa skan uz 3. un 4. stīgas. Sākumā abas daļas spēlējiet lēni.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 5 open, then string 1 at fret 4 and fret 2.
rows.translation: Brīvā 5. stīga, tad 1. stīga 4. un 2. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where does the high G in the first bar come from?
rows.translation: No kurienes nāk augstais G pirmajā taktī?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The drone doubles as a melody note here. Your thumb plays it, right on the beat.
rows.translation: Burdons šeit ir arī melodijas nots. Īkšķis to spēlē precīzi uz sitiena.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A tune named for a mountain pass
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Cumberland Gap is the pass early settlers took into Kentucky. The tune climbs to E and F♯ on string 1, so your second and fourth fingers get busy.
rows.translation: Cumberland Gap ir pāreja, pa kuru agrīnie kolonisti devās uz Kentuki. Melodija kāpj līdz E un F♯ uz 1. stīgas, tādēļ otrajam un ceturtajam pirkstam būs darbs.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 1: fret 2, fret 4, fret 2, then open.
rows.translation: 1. stīga: 2. lada, 4. lada, 2. lada, tad brīva.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where do you play F♯ in this tune?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F♯ is four frets above the open D of string 1. The fifth string is never fretted here.
rows.translation: F♯ ir četras ladas virs brīvās 1. stīgas D. Piekto stīgu šeit nekad nepiespiež.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Shady Grove has the dark, old sound players call mountain minor. It comes to rest on A instead of G, and the high G of the fifth string sings against it.
rows.translation: Shady Grove piemīt tumšais, senatnīgais skanējums, ko spēlētāji sauc par kalnu minoru. Tā norimst uz A, nevis G, un pret to skan piektās stīgas augstais G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 3 fret 2, string 2 open, string 1 open, string 1 fret 2.
rows.translation: 3. stīgas 2. lada, brīvā 2. stīga, brīvā 1. stīga, 1. stīgas 2. lada.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which tune comes to rest on A instead of G?
rows.translation: Kura melodija norimst uz A, nevis G?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Shady Grove is in mountain minor, centered on A. The others come home to G.
rows.translation: Shady Grove ir kalnu minorā ar centru A. Pārējās atgriežas mājās uz G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sound notes with the fretting hand, then use them in Old Joe Clark.
rows.translation: Ieskandiniet notis ar stīgu spiedējroku, tad lietojiet šos paņēmienus melodijā Old Joe Clark.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pick an open string, then snap a fingertip down just behind fret 2. The new note sounds from the tap alone, with no second pick.
rows.translation: Iesvārstiet brīvu stīgu, tad uzsitiet ar pirksta galu tieši aiz 2. ladas. Jaunā nots skan tikai no piesitiena, bez otra mediatora vēziena.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pick string 3 open, then hammer fret 2 with your second finger.
rows.translation: Iesvārstiet brīvo 3. stīgu, tad uzsitiet ar otro pirkstu 2. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many times do you pick for a hammer-on?
rows.translation: Cik reižu hammer-on paņēmienā spēlē ar mediatoru?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The pick sounds the first note. The second comes from your finger striking the string.
rows.translation: Mediators ieskandina pirmo noti. Otrā rodas no pirksta uzsitiena pa stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret a note, pick it, then pull your finger slightly sideways as you lift. That flick plucks the open string, so a second note sounds without the pick.
rows.translation: Piespiediet noti, iesvārstiet to, tad, pirkstu paceļot, pavelciet to mazliet sānis. Šis rāviens iesvārsta brīvo stīgu, tāpēc otrā nots skan bez mediatora.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pick string 1 at fret 2, then pull off to open.
rows.translation: Iesvārstiet 1. stīgu 2. ladā, tad ar pull-off paņēmienu pārejiet uz brīvo stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which way does your finger move in a pull-off?
rows.translation: Kurā virzienā pirksts kustas pull-off paņēmienā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Along the string to the next fret
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lifting straight up only stops the note. A small sideways flick plucks the open string.
rows.translation: Paceļot taisni augšup, nots tikai apklust. Mazs rāviens sānis iesvārsta brīvo stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret string 3 at fret 2, pick it, and slide the same finger up to fret 4 while pressing. A to B in one smooth glide is a classic banjo sound.
rows.translation: Piespiediet 3. stīgu 2. ladā, iesvārstiet to un, saglabājot spiedienu, slīdiet ar to pašu pirkstu līdz 4. ladai. A līdz B vienā plūstošā slīdējumā ir klasisks bandžo skanējums.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Only the first note is picked. Keep pressing as you glide, or the note dies on the way.
rows.translation: Ar mediatoru spēlē tikai pirmo noti. Slīdot turpiniet spiest, citādi nots pa ceļam izdziest.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is in G, but its second part uses F instead of F♯, on string 1 at fret 3. That lowered note gives the tune its old-time sound.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark ir G tonalitātē, bet otrajā daļā F♯ vietā lieto F uz 1. stīgas 3. ladā. Šī pazeminātā nots piešķir melodijai senlaicīgo skanējumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 1: fret 2, fret 3, fret 2, open. Try hammering from 2 to 3.
rows.translation: 1. stīga: 2. lada, 3. lada, 2. lada, brīva. Mēģiniet ar pirksta uzsitienu pāriet no 2. uz 3. ladu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note gives the second part its old-time color?
rows.translation: Kura nots piešķir otrajai daļai senlaicīgo nokrāsu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G major uses F♯. Lowering it to F gives the mixolydian sound that runs through old-time and bluegrass music.
rows.translation: G mažorā ir F♯. Pazeminot to līdz F, rodas miksolidiskais skanējums, kas raksturīgs senajai amerikāņu tautas mūzikai un blūgrāsam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hammer-ons, pull-offs and slides, then Old Joe Clark. Pick only where you need to and let your fretting hand do the rest.
rows.translation: Hammer-on, pull-off un slaidi, tad Old Joe Clark. Mediatoru lietojiet tikai tur, kur vajag, un pārējo ļaujiet paveikt stīgu spiedējrokai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which move glides a fretted note up to a higher fret?
rows.translation: Kurš paņēmiens slīdina piespiestu noti uz augstāku ladu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A different right hand: strike down with a fingernail and catch the drone with your thumb.
rows.translation: Citāda labā roka: sitiet lejup ar nagu un aizķeriet burdona stīgu ar īkšķi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Clawhammer uses no picks. Curl your hand into a loose claw and strike down on a string with the back of your index or middle fingernail, moving from the wrist and forearm.
rows.translation: Clawhammer spēlē nelieto mediatorus. Brīvi salieciet pirkstus tvēriena formā un sitiet lejup pa stīgu ar rādītājpirksta vai vidējā pirksta naga virspusi, kustinot plaukstas locītavu un apakšdelmu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: As your hand strikes, the thumb comes to rest on the fifth string. On the next beat it pushes through that string as your hand lifts.
rows.translation: Kad roka sit, īkšķis atbalstās uz piektās stīgas. Nākamajā sitienā tas izspiežas cauri šai stīgai, kamēr roka paceļas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which way does your fingernail move in clawhammer?
rows.translation: Kurā virzienā nags kustas clawhammer spēlē?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Clawhammer strikes down with the nail. The fingers never pluck upward.
rows.translation: Clawhammer spēlē sit lejup ar nagu. Pirksti nekad nerauj stīgas augšup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The basic clawhammer rhythm sounds like its name. Bum: strike one note on the beat. Dit: brush down across the strings. Ty: your thumb plays string 5.
rows.translation: Clawhammer pamata ritms skan kā tā nosaukums. Bum: iesitiet vienu noti uz sitiena. Dit: velciet lejup pāri stīgām. Ti: īkšķis spēlē 5. stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which part of bum-ditty does the thumb play?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bum is a single note, dit is a brush and ty is the thumb on the fifth string.
rows.translation: Bum ir viena nots, dit — pārvilkums, bet ti — īkšķis uz piektās stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In clawhammer the melody notes fall on the bum strikes. The brush and thumb fill in around them, so tune and rhythm come out together.
rows.translation: Clawhammer spēlē melodijas notis iekrīt bum sitienos. Pārvilkums un īkšķis aizpilda starpas, tāpēc melodija un ritms skan kopā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where do the melody notes go in bum-ditty?
rows.translation: Kur bum-dit-ti rakstā liek melodijas notis?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The bum lands on the beat, so that is where the melody goes. Dit and ty keep the rhythm rolling.
rows.translation: Bum sakrīt ar sitienu, tāpēc tur skan melodija. Dit un ti uztur ritošo ritmu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Skip to My Lou was a party game in the 1840s. In clawhammer each melody note is a bum, followed by a brush and the thumb on string 5.
rows.translation: Skip to My Lou 1840. gados bija viesību rotaļa. Clawhammer spēlē katra melodijas nots ir bum, kam seko pārvilkums un īkšķis uz 5. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What does your thumb play after each brush?
rows.translation: Ko īkšķis spēlē pēc katra pārvilkuma?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bum, dit, ty: the ty is always the thumb on the short fifth string.
rows.translation: Bum, dit, ti: ti vienmēr ir īkšķis uz īsās piektās stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Everything in clawhammer comes back to bum-ditty. Keep the motion loose and the thumb ready, and the melody takes care of itself.
rows.translation: Clawhammer spēlē viss atgriežas pie bum-dit-ti. Kustībai jābūt brīvai, īkšķim gatavam, un melodija izveidosies pati.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which hand shape does clawhammer use?
rows.translation: Kādu rokas formu izmanto clawhammer spēlē?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Brīvi ieliekta roka, kas sit lejup
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hear intervals and chords, and sing back what you hear
rows.translation: Saklausiet intervālus un akordus un atdziediet dzirdēto
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Tell which of two notes is higher, from wide leaps down to the smallest step.
rows.translation: Nosakiet, kura no divām notīm ir augstāka — no platiem lēcieniem līdz vismazākajam solim.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pitch is how high or low a note sounds. On a keyboard, low notes sit on the left and high notes on the right. Your ear already knows the difference; here you sharpen it.
rows.translation: Skaņas augstums nosaka, cik augstu vai zemu skan nots. Uz klaviatūras zemās notis ir pa kreisi, augstās — pa labi. Jūsu dzirde jau pazīst atšķirību; šeit to pilnveidosiet.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: When the second note is higher, the melody moves up. When it's lower, it moves down. Trace the direction in the air with your hand as you listen.
rows.translation: Ja otrā nots ir augstāka, melodija virzās augšup. Ja zemāka — lejup. Klausoties ar roku gaisā parādiet virzienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Does the second note go up or down?
rows.translation: Vai otrā nots dodas augšup vai lejup?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The closer two notes are, the harder they are to tell apart. Let each note finish before you answer. Every answer, right or wrong, trains your ear.
rows.translation: Jo tuvāk ir divas notis, jo grūtāk tās atšķirt. Pirms atbildes noklausieties katru noti līdz galam. Katra atbilde — pareiza vai nepareiza — trenē dzirdi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Not sure? Hum the first note, then slide your voice to the second. Feel whether your voice climbs or sinks. Your body knows the direction.
rows.translation: Neesat droši? Izdūciet pirmo noti, tad slīdiniet balsi līdz otrajai. Sajūtiet, vai balss kāpj vai krīt. Ķermenis pazīst virzienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Many melodies move to the very next note of the scale: a small step. Steps sound smooth and close. Listen for a gentle lift or dip instead of a jump.
rows.translation: Daudzas melodijas virzās uz pašām nākamajām gammas notīm — maziem soļiem. Soļi skan plūstoši un tuvu. Klausieties maigu pacēlumu vai kritumu, nevis lēcienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold the first note in your head while the second one plays. Then compare them, like checking two heights side by side.
rows.translation: Paturiet pirmo noti prātā, kamēr skan otrā. Tad salīdziniet tās, it kā blakus pārbaudītu divus augstumus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The smallest step in most music is the half step, also called a semitone: from one key on a keyboard to the very next. It's a tiny move, and you can learn to hear it.
rows.translation: Vismazākais solis lielākajā daļā mūzikas ir pustonis: no viena klaviatūras taustiņa uz pašu nākamo. Tā ir pavisam maza kustība, un jūs varat iemācīties to sadzirdēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: With tiny steps, your first impression is usually right. Answer, and don't talk yourself out of it.
rows.translation: Ļoti mazos soļos pirmais iespaids parasti ir pareizs. Atbildiet un nepārlieciniet sevi par pretējo.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Wide leaps, small steps and half steps, high and low, all mixed together. Take a breath before each one.
rows.translation: Plati lēcieni, mazi soļi un pustoņi, augstu un zemu — viss sajaukts. Pirms katra ieelpojiet.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hear when two notes match, then match a note with your voice or instrument.
rows.translation: Sadzirdiet, kad divas notis sakrīt, tad atkārtojiet noti ar balsi vai instrumentu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two notes match when they have exactly the same pitch. Listen for whether the second note lands right on the first or slips away from it.
rows.translation: Divas notis sakrīt, ja tām ir tieši vienāds augstums. Klausieties, vai otrā nots trāpa tieši uz pirmās vai novirzās no tās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two voices sing exactly the same pitch. What's that called?
rows.translation: Divas balsis dzied tieši vienā augstumā. Kā to sauc?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Singing in unison means singing the very same note.
rows.translation: Dziedāt unisonā nozīmē dziedāt tieši to pašu noti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: To match a pitch, listen, hear the note again in your head, then sing or play it. Timbre shows whether you're high or low. Slide until you land on it.
rows.translation: Lai atkārtotu skaņas augstumu, klausieties, vēlreiz iztēlojieties noti un tad nodziediet vai nospēlējiet to. Timbre rāda, vai esat par augstu vai par zemu. Slīdiet, līdz trāpāt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing or play back the note you just heard.
rows.translation: Atdziediet vai atspēlējiet tikko dzirdēto noti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing or play back the second note you heard.
rows.translation: Atdziediet vai atspēlējiet otro dzirdēto noti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: If you're off, don't stop. Slide slowly up or down until the note locks in. That slide is how your ear and voice learn to agree.
rows.translation: Ja netrāpāt, neapstājieties. Lēni slīdiet augšup vai lejup, līdz nots sakrīt. Šādi dzirde un balss mācās saskanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Before you sing, replay the note silently in your head. Musicians call this audiation: hearing music that isn't sounding. It's the heart of a good ear.
rows.translation: Pirms dziedat, klusībā atkārtojiet noti prātā. Mūziķi to sauc par audiāciju: dzirdēt mūziku, kas neskan. Tas ir labas muzikālās dzirdes pamats.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing or play back the higher note.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing or play back the lower note.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now match two notes in a row. Sing the first, then move to the second. Notice whether your voice climbs or drops to get there.
rows.translation: Tagad atkārtojiet divas notis pēc kārtas. Nodziediet pirmo, tad pārejiet uz otro. Ievērojiet, vai balss līdz tai kāpj vai krīt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing or play back the notes you just heard, in order.
rows.translation: Atdziediet vai atspēlējiet tikko dzirdētās notis pareizajā secībā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Same or different, single notes and pairs. Listen all the way through before you sing, and slide until each note settles.
rows.translation: Vienādas vai atšķirīgas, atsevišķas notis un pāri. Pirms dziedat, noklausieties līdz galam un slīdiet, līdz katra nots nostājas vietā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hear half steps and whole steps, then the wider skip of a third.
rows.translation: Saklausiet pustoņus un toņus, tad platāko tercas lēcienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A half step moves to the very next key. A whole step skips one key, so it equals two half steps. Both sound like steps, but a whole step opens a little wider.
rows.translation: Pustonis ved uz pašu nākamo taustiņu. Tonis izlaiž vienu taustiņu, tātad ir divi pustoņi. Abi skan kā soļi, bet tonis paveras mazliet platāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many half steps make a whole step?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A whole step skips one key, so it's two half steps.
rows.translation: Tonis izlaiž vienu taustiņu, tātad ir divi pustoņi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Musicians call a step a second, because it moves to the next letter: C to D. A half step is a minor second. A whole step is a major second.
rows.translation: Mūziķi soli sauc par sekundu, jo tas ved uz nākamo burtu: no C uz D. Pustonis ir mazā sekunda. Tonis ir lielā sekunda.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E up to F is a...
rows.translation: No E augšup līdz F ir...
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E and F have no key between them: a half step, so a minor second.
rows.translation: Starp E un F nav neviena taustiņa: pustonis, tātad mazā sekunda.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C up to D is a...
rows.translation: No C augšup līdz D ir...
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C to D skips the black key between them: a whole step, so a major second.
rows.translation: No C līdz D izlaiž melno taustiņu starp tiem: tonis, tātad lielā sekunda.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A step moves to the next letter. A skip jumps over one, like C to E, skipping D. That gap is called a third. Skips sound more open than steps.
rows.translation: Solis ved uz nākamo burtu. Lēciens vienu izlaiž, piemēram, C līdz E, izlaižot D. Šo attālumu sauc par tercu. Lēcieni skan plašāk nekā soļi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D up to F is a...
rows.translation: No D augšup līdz F ir...
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D to F jumps over E, so it's a skip: a third.
rows.translation: No D līdz F pārlec pāri E, tātad tas ir lēciens — terca.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A major third spans four half steps and sounds bright. A minor third spans three and sounds darker, a little wistful. Listen for the brightness.
rows.translation: Lielā terca aptver četrus pustoņus un skan gaiši. Mazā terca aptver trīs un skan tumšāk, mazliet ilgpilni. Ieklausieties gaišumā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C up to E spans how many half steps?
rows.translation: Cik pustoņu ir no C augšup līdz E?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: four half steps, so it's a major third.
rows.translation: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: četri pustoņi, tātad lielā terca.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Half steps, whole steps and thirds, rising and falling. Decide step or skip first, then the exact size.
rows.translation: Pustoņi, toņi un tercas, augšup un lejup. Vispirms nosakiet, vai tas ir solis vai lēciens, tad precīzo lielumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Unison, octave, fifth and fourth, each linked to a tune you can hum.
rows.translation: Unisons, oktāva, kvinta un kvarta — katrs saistīts ar melodiju, ko varat izdūkt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: An interval is the distance between two notes. A unison is no distance at all: the same note twice. An octave runs from one letter to the same letter above, like C to C. It sounds like one note, only brighter.
rows.translation: Intervāls ir attālums starp divām notīm. Unisonā attāluma nav: tā pati nots divreiz. Oktāva ved no viena burta uz to pašu burtu augstāk, piemēram, no C uz C. Tā skan kā viena nots, tikai gaišāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Jingle Bells opens on one note repeated: a unison. Take Me Out to the Ball Game opens with a leap up an octave. Hum each opening to recall the sound.
rows.translation: Jingle Bells sākas ar vienas nots atkārtojumu — unisonu. Take Me Out to the Ball Game sākas ar lēcienu oktāvu augšup. Izdūciet katru sākumu, lai atsauktu atmiņā skanējumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why is it called an octave?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C: eight letter names, counting both ends.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C: astoņi burtu nosaukumi, skaitot abus galus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A perfect fifth spans seven half steps, like C up to G. It sounds open and strong. Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star leaps up a fifth after its first two notes.
rows.translation: Tīrā kvinta aptver septiņus pustoņus, piemēram, no C augšup līdz G. Tā skan plaši un spēcīgi. Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star pēc pirmajām divām notīm lec kvintu augšup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What's a perfect fifth above D?
rows.translation: Kas ir tīru kvintu virs D?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count five letters: D, E, F, G, A. D to A spans seven half steps.
rows.translation: Skaitiet piecus burtus: D, E, F, G, A. D līdz A aptver septiņus pustoņus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A perfect fourth spans five half steps, like C up to F. It sounds like a call to attention. Amazing Grace opens with a rising fourth.
rows.translation: Tīrā kvarta aptver piecus pustoņus, piemēram, no C augšup līdz F. Tā skan kā aicinājums pievērst uzmanību. Amazing Grace sākas ar augšupejošu kvartu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Both sound open. The fifth is wider and feels settled. The fourth feels like it wants to move on. If you're unsure, hum the tune for each.
rows.translation: Abas skan plaši. Kvinta ir platāka un šķiet mierīga. Kvarta šķiet gribam virzīties tālāk. Ja šaubāties, izdūciet katram intervālam atbilstošo melodiju.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A fifth spans seven half steps; a fourth spans five.
rows.translation: Kvinta aptver septiņus pustoņus; kvarta — piecus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: An interval keeps its name whether it rises or falls. G down to C is still a fifth. Listen to the size of the gap, not the direction.
rows.translation: Intervāls saglabā nosaukumu gan augšup, gan lejup. No G lejup līdz C joprojām ir kvinta. Klausieties attāluma lielumu, nevis virzienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: When two notes sound together, listen to the blend. An octave melts into one sound. A fifth sounds hollow and strong. A fourth sounds open but restless.
rows.translation: Kad divas notis skan kopā, klausieties kopskanējumu. Oktāva saplūst vienā skaņā. Kvinta skan tukši un spēcīgi. Kvarta skan plaši, bet nemierīgi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing or play a falling fifth: G down to C.
rows.translation: Nodziediet vai nospēlējiet lejupejošu kvintu: no G lejup līdz C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Unison, octave, fifth and fourth, rising, falling and together. If you get stuck, hum the tune for each.
rows.translation: Unisons, oktāva, kvinta un kvarta, augšup, lejup un kopā. Ja apjūkat, izdūciet katram atbilstošo melodiju.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Thirds, sixths and seconds in their major and minor sizes.
rows.translation: Tercas, sekstas un sekundas to lielajā un mazajā veidā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: When the Saints Go Marching In opens with a major third, bright and bold. Greensleeves opens with a minor third, softer and sadder. Hum both to fix the sounds.
rows.translation: When the Saints Go Marching In sākas ar lielo tercu — gaišu un drosmīgu. Greensleeves sākas ar mazo tercu — maigāku un skumjāku. Izdūciet abas, lai nostiprinātu skanējumus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many half steps are in a minor third?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minor third spans three half steps, like A to C. A major third spans four.
rows.translation: Mazā terca aptver trīs pustoņus, piemēram, no A līdz C. Lielā terca aptver četrus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A major sixth spans nine half steps; My Bonnie Lies Over the Ocean opens with one. A minor sixth spans eight and sounds darker. The Entertainer leaps up one right after its quick opening notes.
rows.translation: Lielā seksta aptver deviņus pustoņus; ar to sākas My Bonnie Lies Over the Ocean. Mazā seksta aptver astoņus un skan tumšāk. The Entertainer lec par mazo sekstu augšup tūlīt pēc ātrajām sākuma notīm.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C up to A is which interval?
rows.translation: Kurš intervāls ir no C augšup līdz A?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C to A spans nine half steps: a major sixth.
rows.translation: C līdz A aptver deviņus pustoņus — lielo sekstu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Frère Jacques opens with a major second, a whole step up. Für Elise opens by rocking down and up a minor second, a half step. Small sizes, big difference.
rows.translation: Frère Jacques sākas ar lielo sekundu — toni augšup. Skaņdarbs Elīzei sākumā šūpojas lejup un augšup pa mazo sekundu — pustoni. Mazi lielumi, liela atšķirība.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which interval is a half step?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minor second is one half step. A major second is two.
rows.translation: Mazā sekunda ir viens pustonis. Lielā sekunda ir divi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing or play the rocking half step: E, D♯, E.
rows.translation: Nodziediet vai nospēlējiet šūpojošos pustoni: E, D♯, E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: First judge the size: a step, a skip or a wide leap. Then judge the color: bright for major, darker for minor. Two easy choices beat one hard guess.
rows.translation: Vispirms novērtējiet lielumu: solis, tercas lēciens vai plats lēciens. Tad nokrāsu: lielie intervāli gaiši, mazie tumšāki. Divas vieglas izvēles ir labākas par vienu grūtu minējumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Minor intervals sound darker than their major partners.
rows.translation: Mazie intervāli skan tumšāk nekā to lielie pārinieki.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Seconds, thirds and sixths, major and minor, mixed with the fourths and fifths you already know.
rows.translation: Sekundas, tercas un sekstas, lielas un mazas, kopā ar jau pazīstamajām kvartām un kvintām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hear major and minor chords, then diminished, augmented and dominant seventh.
rows.translation: Saklausiet mažora un minora akordus, tad pamazinātos, palielinātos un dominantseptakordus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A chord is three or more notes sounding together. A major chord sounds bright and settled. A minor chord sounds darker. Only the middle note differs between them.
rows.translation: Akords ir trīs vai vairākas notis, kas skan kopā. Mažora akords skan gaiši un mierīgi. Minora akords skan tumšāk. Atšķiras tikai to vidējā nots.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A major chord turns minor. How many of its notes change?
rows.translation: Mažora akords kļūst par minora akordu. Cik tā nošu mainās?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Only the middle note, the third, drops a half step: C E G becomes C E♭ G.
rows.translation: Tikai vidējā nots — terca — pazeminās par pustoni: C E G kļūst par C E♭ G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing or play back the chord's notes, low to high.
rows.translation: Atdziediet vai atspēlējiet akorda notis no zemākās līdz augstākajai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Unsure? Focus on the middle note. In a major chord it sits four half steps above the bottom. In minor it sits one half step lower, which darkens everything.
rows.translation: Šaubāties? Pievērsieties vidējai notij. Mažora akordā tā ir četrus pustoņus virs apakšējās. Minorā tā ir pustoni zemāk, un tas visu padara tumšāku.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which notes spell a C minor chord?
rows.translation: Kuras notis veido C minora akordu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lower the middle note of C major by a half step: E becomes E♭.
rows.translation: Pazeminiet C mažora vidējo noti par pustoni: E kļūst par E♭.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A diminished chord stacks two minor thirds and sounds tight and uneasy. An augmented chord stacks two major thirds and sounds stretched, like a question left hanging.
rows.translation: Pamazināts akords sakārto vienu virs otras divas mazās tercas un skan saspiesti, nemierīgi. Palielināts akords sakārto divas lielās tercas un skan izstiepti kā neatbildēts jautājums.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which kind of chord is this?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord stacks two major thirds?
rows.translation: Kurš akords veidojas no divām lielajām tercām?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A major third plus a major third, like C E G♯, makes an augmented chord.
rows.translation: Lielā terca plus lielā terca, piemēram, C E G♯, veido palielinātu akordu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A dominant seventh chord is a major chord plus one more note on top: a minor seventh above the root, the note the chord is named for. It sounds bluesy and restless.
rows.translation: Dominantseptakords ir mažora akords ar vēl vienu noti virs tā: mazo septīmu virs pamattoņa — nots, kuras vārdā akords nosaukts. Tas skan blūzīgi un nemierīgi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G7 is G major (G B D) plus F, a minor seventh above G.
rows.translation: G7 ir G mažors (G B D) plus F — mazā septīma virs G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Major, minor, diminished, augmented and dominant seventh: bright, dark, tight, stretched, restless. Name the color, then the chord.
rows.translation: Mažors, minors, pamazināts, palielināts un dominantseptakords: gaišs, tumšs, saspiests, izstiepts, nemierīgs. Nosauciet nokrāsu, tad akordu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hear each note's place in a key, from do, the home note, to ti.
rows.translation: Saklausiet katras nots vietu tonalitātē — no do, tonikas, līdz ti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every key has a home note called the tonic. Singers call it do. Here you'll hear a chord that sets the key, then a single note to place.
rows.translation: Katrai tonalitātei ir māju nots, ko sauc par toniku. Dziedātāji to sauc par do. Šeit dzirdēsiet akordu, kas nosaka tonalitāti, tad atsevišķu noti, kuras vieta jāatrod.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Is the last note do, the home note?
rows.translation: Vai pēdējā nots ir do — tonika?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The notes of a major scale are do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, then do again. Each is a scale degree, numbered from do: do is 1, re is 2, up to ti, 7.
rows.translation: Mažora gammas notis ir do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, tad atkal do. Katra ir gammas pakāpe, skaitot no do: do ir 1, re ir 2, līdz ti — 7.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which scale degree is the last note?
rows.translation: Kura gammas pakāpe ir pēdējā nots?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing or play do, re, mi in C major: C, D, E.
rows.translation: Nodziediet vai nospēlējiet do, re, mi C mažorā: C, D, E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do, mi and sol are the notes of the home chord, so they sound stable and at rest. Mi sounds sweet, sol sounds strong and open, and do sounds finished.
rows.translation: Do, mi un sol ir tonikas akorda skaņas, tādēļ tās skan stabili un mierīgi. Mi skan maigi, sol — spēcīgi un plaši, bet do — pabeigti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In C major, which note is sol?
rows.translation: Kura nots C mažorā ir sol?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count up from do: C do, D re, E mi, F fa, G sol.
rows.translation: Skaitiet augšup no do: C do, D re, E mi, F fa, G sol.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing or play do, mi, sol in G major: G, B, D.
rows.translation: Nodziediet vai nospēlējiet do, mi, sol G mažorā: G, B, D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Re, fa, la and ti sound unfinished. Ti sits a half step below do and pulls hard upward. Fa leans down to mi. Re and la want to step to a neighbor.
rows.translation: Re, fa, la un ti skan nepabeigti. Ti ir pustoni zem do un stipri tiecas augšup. Fa tiecas lejup uz mi. Re un la vēlas spert soli uz blakus noti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note pulls most strongly up to do?
rows.translation: Kura nots visspēcīgāk tiecas augšup uz do?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ti sits just a half step below do, so it leans hard toward it.
rows.translation: Ti ir tikai pustoni zem do, tāpēc stipri tiecas uz to.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing or play ti rising to do in C major: B, then C.
rows.translation: Nodziediet vai nospēlējiet ti augšup uz do C mažorā: B, tad C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Set the key with a cadence
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A cadence is a short chord pattern that ends a phrase. Hearing one sets the key firmly. Sing do quietly to yourself, then measure the new note from there.
rows.translation: Kadence ir īss akordu raksts, kas noslēdz frāzi. To dzirdot, tonalitāte kļūst skaidra. Klusi pie sevis nodziediet do, tad no tā novērtējiet jauno noti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why play a cadence before the note?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chords point to do, so you can hear every other note in relation to it.
rows.translation: Akordi norāda uz do, tāpēc visas pārējās notis var dzirdēt attiecībā pret to.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing or play up the scale from do in C major: C, D, E, F, G.
rows.translation: Nodziediet vai nospēlējiet gammu augšup no do C mažorā: C, D, E, F, G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Chords set the key, then one note plays. Find do first, then name the note. Every key works the same way.
rows.translation: Akordi nosaka tonalitāti, tad skan viena nots. Vispirms atrodiet do, tad nosauciet noti. Visās tonalitātēs tas darbojas vienādi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing or play do, ti, do in D major: D, C♯, D.
rows.translation: Nodziediet vai nospēlējiet do, ti, do D mažorā: D, C♯, D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hear short melodies, pick out the one you heard, and sing it back.
rows.translation: Klausieties īsas melodijas, izvēlieties dzirdēto un atdziediet to.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Dictation means hearing a melody and writing it down. Here you pick it from a list. Find do from the chord, then follow each move: up or down, step or skip.
rows.translation: Diktāts nozīmē dzirdēt melodiju un to pierakstīt. Šeit jūs to izvēlaties no saraksta. Atrodiet do pēc akorda, tad sekojiet katrai kustībai: augšup vai lejup, solis vai lēciens.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Before naming notes, trace the shape with your hand: up, down or bending. Most wrong answers have the wrong shape, so you can rule them out fast.
rows.translation: Pirms nosaucat notis, ar roku parādiet formu: augšup, lejup vai izliekta. Lielākajai daļai nepareizo atbilžu ir nepareiza forma, tāpēc tās var ātri izslēgt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Steps sound smooth; skips jump out. When you hear a jump, check whether it lands on a note of the home chord: do, mi or sol.
rows.translation: Soļi skan plūstoši; lēcieni izceļas. Kad dzirdat lēcienu, pārbaudiet, vai tas nonāk uz tonikas akorda skaņas: do, mi vai sol.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A melody goes do, mi, sol. How does it move?
rows.translation: Melodija iet do, mi, sol. Kā tā virzās?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do to mi skips re, and mi to sol skips fa.
rows.translation: Do līdz mi izlaiž re, bet mi līdz sol izlaiž fa.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Longer melodies use the same tools. Lock in the first note against do, then take the rest one move at a time.
rows.translation: Garākās melodijās izmanto tos pašus paņēmienus. Nosakiet pirmo noti attiecībā pret do, tad ejiet tālāk pa vienai kustībai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A melody stops on ti. How does it sound?
rows.translation: Melodija apstājas uz ti. Kā tā skan?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ti leans up to do, so a melody that stops on ti feels like it's waiting.
rows.translation: Ti tiecas augšup uz do, tāpēc melodija, kas apstājas uz ti, šķiet gaidām turpinājumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Melodies often dip under do to ti, la or sol below. They're the same notes, just lower. Many tunes start on sol below and leap up to do.
rows.translation: Melodijas bieži nolaižas zem do uz zemākajiem ti, la vai sol. Tās ir tās pašas notis, tikai zemāk. Daudzas melodijas sākas uz zemākā sol un lec augšup uz do.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Amazing Grace starts on sol below do and leaps up. To which note?
rows.translation: Amazing Grace sākas uz sol zem do un lec augšup. Uz kuru noti?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sol up to do is a perfect fourth, the interval you learned with this tune.
rows.translation: Sol augšup līdz do ir tīrā kvarta — intervāls, ko apguvāt ar šo melodiju.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hear it, find it, sing it
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Chords first, then the melody. Find do, trace the shape, name each note, then sing or play it back.
rows.translation: Vispirms akordi, tad melodija. Atrodiet do, izsekojiet formai, nosauciet katru noti, tad atdziediet vai atspēlējiet.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How music works, from note names to the chords behind songs
rows.translation: Kā darbojas mūzika — no nošu nosaukumiem līdz dziesmu akordiem
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Seven letters, repeating octaves, and where every note lives on a keyboard.
rows.translation: Septiņi burti, atkārtotas oktāvas un katras nots vieta uz klaviatūras.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Music names its notes with just seven letters: A, B, C, D, E, F, G. After G the alphabet starts again at A, a little higher each time around.
rows.translation: Mūzikā notis nosauc tikai ar septiņiem burtiem: A, B, C, D, E, F, G. Pēc G alfabēts atkal sākas ar A, katrā aplī mazliet augstāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The musical alphabet stops at G and starts again at A.
rows.translation: Mūzikas alfabēts beidzas ar G un sākas no jauna ar A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which letter comes just before C?
rows.translation: Kurš burts ir tieši pirms C?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Going down, the alphabet runs C, B, A, then G.
rows.translation: Lejup alfabēts iet C, B, A, tad G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Moving forward through the letters, A to B to C, the notes go up. Moving backward, they go down. The letters loop like the hours on a clock.
rows.translation: Virzoties pa burtiem uz priekšu — A, tad B, tad C — notis iet augšup. Virzoties atpakaļ, tās iet lejup. Burti atkārtojas aplī kā stundas pulkstenī.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What are the next two letters after F?
rows.translation: Kādi ir nākamie divi burti pēc F?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F, G, then back around to A.
rows.translation: F, G, tad aplis atgriežas pie A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Backward through the alphabet means lower notes: E, D, C, B.
rows.translation: Atpakaļ pa alfabētu nozīmē zemākas notis: E, D, C, B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing C, D, E, climbing up the alphabet.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet C, D, E, kāpjot augšup pa alfabētu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Notes that share a letter sound alike even when one is higher. The distance from one C to the next C is an octave. The higher note vibrates exactly twice as fast.
rows.translation: Notis ar vienu burtu skan līdzīgi arī tad, ja viena ir augstāka. Attālums no viena C līdz nākamajam C ir oktāva. Augstākā nots svārstās tieši divreiz ātrāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do these two notes share a letter name?
rows.translation: Vai šīm divām notīm ir viens burta nosaukums?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A4 vibrates 440 times a second. How fast does A5 vibrate?
rows.translation: A4 svārstās 440 reizes sekundē. Cik ātri svārstās A5?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: An octave up doubles the vibration: 440 becomes 880.
rows.translation: Oktāva augšup divkāršo svārstību biežumu: 440 kļūst par 880.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Notes carry a number that tells you which octave they're in. Middle C, near the center of a piano, is C4. The number goes up by one at every C.
rows.translation: Notīm pievieno skaitli, kas norāda to oktāvu. Vidējais C pie klavieru centra ir C4. Skaitlis pieaug par vienu pie katra C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note is just above B3?
rows.translation: Kura nots ir tieši virs B3?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Octave numbers change at C, so the next note up from B3 is C4.
rows.translation: Oktāvu numuri mainās pie C, tāpēc nākamā nots virs B3 ir C4.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing middle C, then the C an octave higher.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet vidējo C, tad C oktāvu augstāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A keyboard's black keys come in groups of two and three. They're your map. C is the white key just left of each group of two.
rows.translation: Klaviatūras melnie taustiņi ir grupās pa diviem un trim. Tie ir jūsu karte. C ir baltais taustiņš tieši pa kreisi no katras divu grupas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C sits just left of the group of two black keys.
rows.translation: C atrodas tieši pa kreisi no divu melno taustiņu grupas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F and the group of three
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F is the white key just left of each group of three black keys. Find C and F first, and every other white key is a short count away.
rows.translation: F ir baltais taustiņš tieši pa kreisi no katras trīs melno taustiņu grupas. Vispirms atrodiet C un F, un līdz jebkuram citam baltajam taustiņam būs tikai nedaudz jāskaita.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F sits just left of the group of three black keys.
rows.translation: F atrodas tieši pa kreisi no trīs melno taustiņu grupas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D sits between the two black keys of the pair.
rows.translation: D atrodas starp abiem melnajiem taustiņiem pārī.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B is the white key just right of the group of three black keys.
rows.translation: B ir baltais taustiņš tieši pa labi no trīs melno taustiņu grupas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing F, G, A, starting from the F you just found.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet F, G, A, sākot no tikko atrastā F.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: From C, the white keys run C, D, E, F, G, A, B, then C again. Seven white keys hold one of each letter.
rows.translation: No C baltie taustiņi iet C, D, E, F, G, A, B, tad atkal C. Septiņos baltajos taustiņos katrs burts ir vienreiz.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G sits between the first two black keys of the group of three.
rows.translation: G atrodas starp pirmajiem diviem melnajiem taustiņiem trīs taustiņu grupā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E is the white key just right of the group of two black keys.
rows.translation: E ir baltais taustiņš tieši pa labi no divu melno taustiņu grupas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A sits between the last two black keys of the group of three.
rows.translation: A atrodas starp pēdējiem diviem melnajiem taustiņiem trīs taustiņu grupā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many white keys run from one C up to the next B?
rows.translation: Cik balto taustiņu ir no viena C augšup līdz nākamajam B?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, D, E, F, G, A, B: seven letters, seven white keys.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F, G, A, B: septiņi burti, septiņi baltie taustiņi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing up the white keys from middle C to the next C.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet baltos taustiņus augšup no vidējā C līdz nākamajam C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The alphabet, octaves and the keyboard map, all together. Use the black-key groups to find your way.
rows.translation: Alfabēts, oktāvas un klaviatūras karte — viss kopā. Orientējieties pēc melno taustiņu grupām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which two letters come right after E?
rows.translation: Kuri divi burti seko tieši pēc E?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E, F, G: forward through the alphabet.
rows.translation: E, F, G: uz priekšu pa alfabētu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Middle C is C4. What's the C an octave above it?
rows.translation: Vidējais C ir C4. Kurš C ir oktāvu virs tā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each octave up adds one to the number.
rows.translation: Katra oktāva augšup skaitlim pievieno vienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing G, A, B, C. The alphabet wraps from G back to A.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet G, A, B, C. Alfabēts pēc G atgriežas pie A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The black keys, the smallest step, and notes with two names.
rows.translation: Melnie taustiņi, vismazākais solis un notis ar diviem nosaukumiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A half step moves from one key to the very next, black or white, with nothing in between. It's the smallest distance on a keyboard and in most music.
rows.translation: Pustonis ved no viena taustiņa uz pašu nākamo — melnu vai baltu — bez nekā pa vidu. Tas ir vismazākais attālums uz klaviatūras un lielākajā daļā mūzikas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What is a half step above E?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E and F have no black key between them.
rows.translation: Starp E un F nav melnā taustiņa.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Look for the gaps with no black key: E to F and B to C. These white keys sit right next to each other, so they're only a half step apart.
rows.translation: Meklējiet vietas bez melnā taustiņa: E līdz F un B līdz C. Šie baltie taustiņi ir tieši blakus, tāpēc tos šķir tikai pustonis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which pair of white keys is a half step apart?
rows.translation: Kuru balto taustiņu pāri šķir pustonis?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B and C have no black key between them.
rows.translation: Starp B un C nav melnā taustiņa.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many half steps from C up to E?
rows.translation: Cik pustoņu ir no C augšup līdz E?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: four moves of one key each.
rows.translation: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: četras kustības, katra par vienu taustiņu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the two white-key half steps: E to F, then B to C.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet abus balto taustiņu pustoņus: E līdz F, tad B līdz C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A sharp (♯) raises a note by a half step. A flat (♭) lowers it by a half step. The black key just above C is C♯; the one just below D is D♭.
rows.translation: Diēzs (♯) paaugstina noti par pustoni. Bemols (♭) pazemina to par pustoni. Melnais taustiņš tieši virs C ir C♯; tieši zem D — D♭.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What does a sharp do to a note?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This black key sits just above F. What's its sharp name?
rows.translation: Šis melnais taustiņš ir tieši virs F. Kāds ir tā nosaukums ar diēzu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Raise F by a half step and you get F♯.
rows.translation: Paaugstiniet F par pustoni un iegūsiet F♯.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The same key sits just below G. What's its flat name?
rows.translation: Tas pats taustiņš ir tieši zem G. Kāds ir tā nosaukums ar bemolu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lower G by a half step and you get G♭.
rows.translation: Pazeminiet G par pustoni un iegūsiet G♭.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each black key can be named from the white key below it, with a sharp, or the white key above it, with a flat. C♯ and D♭ are the same key.
rows.translation: Katru melno taustiņu var nosaukt pēc baltā taustiņa zem tā, pievienojot diēzu, vai baltā taustiņa virs tā, pievienojot bemolu. C♯ un D♭ ir viens un tas pats taustiņš.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What is a half step below B?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lower B by a half step and you get B♭.
rows.translation: Pazeminiet B par pustoni un iegūsiet B♭.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: It's the right-hand key of the pair, just above D: D♯.
rows.translation: Tas ir pāra labais taustiņš tieši virs D — D♯.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing C, C♯, D: two half steps up.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet C, C♯, D: divus pustoņus augšup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A whole step equals two half steps: it skips exactly one key. C to D is a whole step, with C♯ in between. E to F♯ is too.
rows.translation: Tonis ir divi pustoņi: tas izlaiž tieši vienu taustiņu. C līdz D ir tonis ar C♯ pa vidu. Arī E līdz F♯ ir tonis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What is a whole step above C?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C to D skips one key, C♯.
rows.translation: C līdz D izlaiž vienu taustiņu — C♯.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What is a whole step above E?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E to F is only a half step, so a whole step up is F♯.
rows.translation: E līdz F ir tikai pustonis, tāpēc toni augstāk ir F♯.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What is a whole step above B?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B to C is a half step, so a whole step up is C♯.
rows.translation: B līdz C ir pustonis, tāpēc toni augstāk ir C♯.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What is a whole step below F?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F down to E is a half step; one more key down is E♭.
rows.translation: F lejup līdz E ir pustonis; vēl vienu taustiņu zemāk ir E♭.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing two whole steps up from E: E, F♯, G♯.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet divus toņus augšup no E: E, F♯, G♯.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two names for the same pitch are called enharmonic. C♯ and D♭ are one key with two names. Which name you use depends on the key you're in.
rows.translation: Divus viena skaņas augstuma nosaukumus sauc par enharmoniskiem. C♯ un D♭ ir viens taustiņš ar diviem nosaukumiem. Nosaukuma izvēle atkarīga no tonalitātes.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which pair names the same key?
rows.translation: Kurš pāris nosauc vienu un to pašu taustiņu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C♯ is a half step above C; D♭ is a half step below D. Same key.
rows.translation: C♯ ir pustoni virs C; D♭ ir pustoni zem D. Tas pats taustiņš.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G♯ and A♭ are the same black key.
rows.translation: G♯ un A♭ ir viens un tas pats melnais taustiņš.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: White keys can have sharp or flat names as well. E and F are a half step apart, so E♯ is the same key as F, and F♭ is the same key as E.
rows.translation: Arī baltajiem taustiņiem var būt nosaukumi ar diēzu vai bemolu. E un F šķir pustonis, tāpēc E♯ ir tas pats taustiņš, kas F, bet F♭ — tas pats, kas E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E♯ is played on which key?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E♯ is a half step above E, which is F.
rows.translation: E♯ ir pustoni virs E, tātad F.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B♯ is a half step above B, which is C.
rows.translation: B♯ ir pustoni virs B, tātad C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The black key between F and G is F♯. What's its other name?
rows.translation: Melnais taustiņš starp F un G ir F♯. Kāds ir tā otrs nosaukums?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing B♭, C, D. B♭ is the same key as A♯.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet B♭, C, D. B♭ ir tas pats taustiņš, kas A♯.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Half steps, whole steps, sharps, flats and two-name notes, all mixed together. Picture the keyboard as you answer.
rows.translation: Pustoņi, toņi, diēzi, bemoli un notis ar diviem nosaukumiem — viss sajaukts. Atbildot iztēlojieties klaviatūru.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What is a half step above B?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What is a whole step above A?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A to B skips one key, A♯.
rows.translation: A līdz B izlaiž vienu taustiņu — A♯.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E♭ and D♯ are the same black key.
rows.translation: E♭ un D♯ ir viens un tas pats melnais taustiņš.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: It's the top key of the group of three, just below B: A♯, also called B♭.
rows.translation: Tas ir augšējais taustiņš trīs taustiņu grupā, tieši zem B — A♯, ko sauc arī par B♭.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What is a whole step below D?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D to C skips one key, C♯.
rows.translation: D līdz C izlaiž vienu taustiņu — C♯.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing D, E, F♯, G: whole, whole, then half.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet D, E, F♯, G: tonis, tonis, tad pustonis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Treble clef lines and spaces, ledger lines, and a first look at bass clef.
rows.translation: Līnijas un starplīnijas vijoles atslēgā, palīglīnijas un pirmais ieskats basa atslēgā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Music is written on a staff: five lines with four spaces between them. Notes sit on a line or in a space. The higher a note sits, the higher it sounds.
rows.translation: Mūziku pieraksta nošu līnijkopā: piecas līnijas ar četrām starplīnijām. Notis atrodas uz līnijas vai starplīnijā. Jo augstāk novietota nots, jo augstāk tā skan.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many lines does a staff have?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Five lines, with four spaces between them.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: It sits higher on the staff, so it sounds higher.
rows.translation: Tā atrodas augstāk nošu līnijkopā, tāpēc skan augstāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Moving up one letter moves from a line to the next space, or from a space to the next line. Notes on neighboring lines are two letters apart.
rows.translation: Pārejot vienu burtu augšup, no līnijas pāriet nākamajā starplīnijā vai no starplīnijas uz nākamo līniju. Notis uz blakus līnijām šķir divi burtu soļi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A note on a line moves up one letter. Where does it land?
rows.translation: Nots uz līnijas pārvietojas vienu burtu augšup. Kur tā nonāk?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Letters alternate: line, space, line, space.
rows.translation: Burti mainās pamīšus: līnija, starplīnija, līnija, starplīnija.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The treble clef, or G clef, curls around the second line from the bottom. That line is the G above middle C. Higher instruments and voices read it.
rows.translation: Vijoles jeb G atslēga apvijas ap otro līniju no apakšas. Šī līnija ir G virs vidējā C. To lasa augstāki instrumenti un balsis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note is on the second line of the treble staff?
rows.translation: Kura nots ir uz otrās līnijas vijoles atslēgā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The treble clef curls around that line to mark G.
rows.translation: Vijoles atslēga apvijas ap šo līniju, lai norādītu G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: From bottom to top, the treble staff's lines are E, G, B, D, F. Remember them as Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: No apakšas augšup vijoles atslēgas līnijas ir E, G, B, D, F. Atcerieties tās ar teikumu Es Gribu Būt Dziesmu Fans.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The bottom line is E, the Every of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: Apakšējā līnija ir E — vārds Es teikumā Es Gribu Būt Dziesmu Fans.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The middle line is B, the Boy of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: Vidējā līnija ir B — vārds Būt teikumā Es Gribu Būt Dziesmu Fans.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The top line is F, the Fine of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: Augšējā līnija ir F — vārds Fans teikumā Es Gribu Būt Dziesmu Fans.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The fourth line up is D, the Does of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: Ceturtā līnija no apakšas ir D — vārds Dziesmu teikumā Es Gribu Būt Dziesmu Fans.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the bottom three lines: E, G, B.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet trīs apakšējās līnijas: E, G, B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The four spaces of the treble staff spell a word from bottom to top: F, A, C, E. The spaces spell FACE.
rows.translation: Četras starplīnijas vijoles atslēgā no apakšas augšup veido F, A, C, E. To burti veido angļu vārdu FACE — „seja”.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The bottom space is F, the first letter of FACE.
rows.translation: Apakšējā starplīnija ir F — pirmais burts vārdā FACE.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The third space up is C: F, A, C.
rows.translation: Trešā starplīnija no apakšas ir C: F, A, C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The second space up is A: F, A.
rows.translation: Otrā starplīnija no apakšas ir A: F, A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Put them together and the staff climbs E, F, G, A, B, C, D, E, F: line, space, line, space, all the way up.
rows.translation: Saliekot tās kopā, līnijkopā augšup iet E, F, G, A, B, C, D, E, F: līnija, starplīnija, līnija, starplīnija — līdz pašai augšai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The top space is E, the last letter of FACE.
rows.translation: Augšējā starplīnija ir E — pēdējais burts vārdā FACE.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The second line up is G, where the treble clef curls.
rows.translation: Otrā līnija no apakšas ir G, ap kuru apvijas vijoles atslēga.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the spaces from bottom to top: F, A, C, E.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet starplīnijas no apakšas augšup: F, A, C, E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: When a note goes above or below the staff, short extra lines called ledger lines extend it. Middle C sits on one ledger line just below the treble staff.
rows.translation: Kad nots paceļas virs līnijkopas vai nolaižas zem tās, to turpina īsas papildu līnijas — palīglīnijas. Vidējais C ir uz vienas palīglīnijas tieši zem līnijkopas vijoles atslēgā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: One ledger line below the treble staff is middle C.
rows.translation: Uz pirmās palīglīnijas zem līnijkopas vijoles atslēgā ir vidējais C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D hangs in the space just below the bottom line.
rows.translation: D atrodas starplīnijā tieši zem apakšējās līnijas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Above the top line, the pattern keeps going. G sits just above the top line, and A sits on the first ledger line above.
rows.translation: Virs augšējās līnijas raksts turpinās. G atrodas tieši virs augšējās līnijas, bet A — uz pirmās palīglīnijas virs tās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: One ledger line above the treble staff is A.
rows.translation: Uz pirmās palīglīnijas virs līnijkopas vijoles atslēgā ir A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count down: middle C on the first ledger line, B below it, A on the second ledger line.
rows.translation: Skaitiet lejup: vidējais C uz pirmās palīglīnijas, B zem tā, A uz otrās palīglīnijas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing middle C, then D and E, climbing from the ledger line onto the staff.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet vidējo C, tad D un E, kāpjot no palīglīnijas uz līnijkopu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Low instruments and voices read the bass clef, or F clef. Its two dots surround the fourth line up, marking the F below middle C.
rows.translation: Zemie instrumenti un balsis lasa basa jeb F atslēgu. Tās divi punkti aptver ceturto līniju no apakšas, norādot F zem vidējā C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note do the bass clef's dots mark?
rows.translation: Kuru noti norāda basa atslēgas punkti?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The bass clef is the F clef: its dots frame the F line.
rows.translation: Basa atslēga ir F atslēga: tās punkti aptver F līniju.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The bass staff's lines, bottom to top, are G, B, D, F, A: Good Boys Do Fine Always. The spaces are A, C, E, G: All Cows Eat Grass.
rows.translation: Basa atslēgas līnijas no apakšas augšup ir G, B, D, F, A: Gudri Bērni Dzied Folkloru Aizrautīgi. Starplīnijas ir A, C, E, G: Alla Cītīgi Elpo Gaisu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The bottom line of the bass staff is G, the Good of Good Boys Do Fine Always.
rows.translation: Apakšējā līnija basa atslēgā ir G — vārds Gudri teikumā Gudri Bērni Dzied Folkloru Aizrautīgi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The second space up is C: All Cows.
rows.translation: Otrā starplīnija no apakšas ir C: Alla Cītīgi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The top line of the bass staff is A, the Always of Good Boys Do Fine Always.
rows.translation: Augšējā līnija basa atslēgā ir A — vārds Aizrautīgi teikumā Gudri Bērni Dzied Folkloru Aizrautīgi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where is middle C in bass clef?
rows.translation: Kur basa atslēgā ir vidējais C?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: On a ledger line above the staff
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Middle C sits one ledger line above the bass staff, and one below the treble staff.
rows.translation: Vidējais C ir uz pirmās palīglīnijas virs līnijkopas basa atslēgā un zem līnijkopas vijoles atslēgā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the bass clef spaces: A, C, E, G.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet starplīnijas basa atslēgā: A, C, E, G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lines, spaces, ledger lines and both clefs. Use your memory sentences, then try to recognize each note at a glance.
rows.translation: Līnijas, starplīnijas, palīglīnijas un abas atslēgas. Izmantojiet atmiņas teikumus, tad mēģiniet katru noti pazīt ar vienu skatienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The third space up in bass clef is E: All Cows Eat.
rows.translation: Trešā starplīnija no apakšas basa atslēgā ir E: Alla Cītīgi Elpo.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing middle C, then E, G, and the C in the third space.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet vidējo C, tad E, G un C trešajā starplīnijā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Note values from whole to sixteenth, dots and rests, and the meters 4/4, 3/4 and 6/8.
