rows.translation: Nošu ilgumi no veselas nots līdz sešpadsmitdaļnotij, punkti un pauzes, taktsmēri 4/4, 3/4 un 6/8.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The beat is the steady pulse you tap your foot to. Beats are grouped into bars, also called measures. In most music, each bar holds four beats.
rows.translation: Sitiens ir vienmērīgais pulss, kam piesitat ar pēdu. Sitienus grupē taktīs, ko angliski sauc gan par bar, gan measure. Lielākajā daļā mūzikas katrā taktī ir četri sitieni.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count each bar out loud: 1, 2, 3, 4. Beat 1, the downbeat, usually feels strongest. Lean into it a little.
rows.translation: Katru takti skaitiet skaļi: 1, 2, 3, 4. 1. sitiens — stiprā taktsdaļa — parasti šķiet visspēcīgākais. Mazliet uzsveriet to.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What's another word for a bar?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bar and measure mean the same thing.
rows.translation: Angļu vārdi bar un measure nozīmē vienu un to pašu — takti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beat 1, the downbeat, starts each bar.
rows.translation: 1. sitiens — stiprā taktsdaļa — sāk katru takti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A note's shape tells you how long it lasts. In a four-beat bar, a whole note lasts all four beats, a half note two, and a quarter note one.
rows.translation: Nots forma norāda, cik ilgi tā skan. Četru sitienu taktī vesela nots ilgst visus četrus sitienus, pusnots — divus, bet ceturtdaļnots — vienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many beats does a half note last?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two half notes fill a four-beat bar.
rows.translation: Divas pusnotis aizpilda četru sitienu takti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many quarter notes fill a bar of four beats?
rows.translation: Cik ceturtdaļnošu aizpilda četru sitienu takti?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat, so four fill the bar.
rows.translation: Ceturtdaļnots ilgst vienu sitienu, tāpēc takti aizpilda četras.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A whole note lasts four beats, a half note two, a quarter note one.
rows.translation: Vesela nots ilgst četrus sitienus, pusnots — divus, ceturtdaļnots — vienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A bar can mix values, as long as they add up. A half note plus two quarter notes fills four beats: 2 + 1 + 1.
rows.translation: Taktī var apvienot dažādus ilgumus, ja to summa atbilst. Pusnots un divas ceturtdaļnotis aizpilda četrus sitienus: 2 + 1 + 1.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Count them 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and, saying and between the beats.
rows.translation: Astotdaļnots ilgst pussitienu, tāpēc katrā sitienā ietilpst divas. Skaitiet 1 un 2 un 3 un 4 un, starp sitieniem sakot „un”.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A sixteenth note lasts a quarter of a beat, so four fit in each beat. Count them 1 e and a, 2 e and a.
rows.translation: Sešpadsmitdaļnots ilgst ceturtdaļsitienu, tāpēc katrā sitienā ietilpst četras. Skaitiet 1 e un a, 2 e un a.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes equal one quarter note?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A quarter note is one beat, and four sixteenths fit in a beat.
rows.translation: Ceturtdaļnots ir viens sitiens, un sitienā ietilpst četras sešpadsmitdaļnotis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many eighth notes fill a bar of four beats?
rows.translation: Cik astotdaļnošu aizpilda četru sitienu takti?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two per beat, four beats: eight eighth notes.
rows.translation: Divas katrā sitienā, četri sitieni: astoņas astotdaļnotis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A dot after a note adds half its value. A half note lasts two beats, so a dotted half lasts three. A dotted quarter lasts one and a half.
rows.translation: Punkts aiz nots pievieno pusi tās ilguma. Pusnots ilgst divus sitienus, tāpēc punktēta pusnots — trīs. Punktēta ceturtdaļnots ilgst pusotru sitienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Half of two is one, so the dot adds one beat: 2 + 1 = 3.
rows.translation: Puse no diviem ir viens, tāpēc punkts pievieno vienu sitienu: 2 + 1 = 3.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A rest is a measured silence. Each note value has a matching rest: a quarter rest lasts one beat, a half rest two. Keep counting through them.
rows.translation: Pauze ir noteikta ilguma klusums. Katram nošu ilgumam ir atbilstoša pauze: ceturtdaļpauze ilgst vienu sitienu, puspauze — divus. Turpiniet skaitīt arī tajās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A quarter is one beat; the dot adds half of that.
rows.translation: Ceturtdaļnots ir viens sitiens; punkts pievieno pusi no tā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A four-beat bar has a half note and a quarter note. What fills the gap?
rows.translation: Četru sitienu taktī ir pusnots un ceturtdaļnots. Kas aizpilda tukšumu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: 2 + 1 = 3, so one beat is left: a quarter rest.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The two stacked numbers at the start of a piece are the time signature. The top number counts beats per bar. The bottom shows which note gets one beat: 4 means a quarter note.
rows.translation: Divi skaitļi viens virs otra skaņdarba sākumā ir taktsmērs. Augšējais skaita sitienus taktī. Apakšējais rāda, kura nots ir viens sitiens: 4 nozīmē ceturtdaļnoti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In 4/4, how many quarter-note beats are in a bar?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The top 4 means four beats; the bottom 4 makes each one a quarter note.
rows.translation: Augšējais 4 nozīmē četrus sitienus; apakšējais 4 padara katru par ceturtdaļnoti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In 3/4, each bar holds three quarter-note beats. Count 1, 2, 3, with the weight on 1. It's the lilt of a waltz.
rows.translation: 3/4 taktī ir trīs ceturtdaļnošu sitieni. Skaitiet 1, 2, 3 ar uzsvaru uz 1. Tā ir valša šūpošanās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which time signature is a waltz usually in?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In 6/8, each bar holds six eighth notes in two groups of three. It feels like two big beats, each split in three: 1 2 3, 4 5 6.
rows.translation: 6/8 taktī ir sešas astotdaļnotis divās grupās pa trim. To jūt kā divus lielus sitienus, katru sadalītu trīs daļās: 1 2 3, 4 5 6.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two beats, each split in three
rows.translation: Divi sitieni, katrs sadalīts trīs daļās
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Three beats, each split in two
rows.translation: Trīs sitieni, katrs sadalīts divās daļās
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The eighths group 1 2 3, 4 5 6, so you feel two strong pulses per bar.
rows.translation: Astotdaļnotis grupējas 1 2 3, 4 5 6, tāpēc katrā taktī jūt divus stiprus pulsus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In 3/4, which single note fills a whole bar?
rows.translation: Kura viena nots aizpilda visu 3/4 takti?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Three beats: a half note (2) plus its dot (1).
rows.translation: Trīs sitieni: pusnots (2) plus tās punkts (1).
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Note values, dots, rests and time signatures together. Count out loud as you tap; your voice keeps your hands honest.
rows.translation: Nošu ilgumi, punkti, pauzes un taktsmēri kopā. Piesitot skaitiet skaļi; balss palīdz rokām palikt precīzām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many beats does a whole note last in 4/4?
rows.translation: Cik sitienu 4/4 taktsmērā ilgst vesela nots?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes fit in one beat?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What does a dot add to a note?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A bar of 3/4 has a quarter note and a quarter rest. What's missing?
rows.translation: 3/4 taktī ir ceturtdaļnots un ceturtdaļpauze. Kā trūkst?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: 3/4 holds three beats; 1 + 1 = 2, so one beat remains.
rows.translation: 3/4 ir trīs sitieni; 1 + 1 = 2, tātad paliek viens sitiens.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many eighth notes are in a bar of 6/8?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The whole-and-half-step recipe, four major keys, and their key signatures.
rows.translation: Toņu un pustoņu shēma, četras mažora tonalitātes un to atslēgas zīmes.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A scale is a set of notes climbing in order from a home note to the same note an octave up. C major uses only white keys: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C.
rows.translation: Gamma ir nošu kopa, kas secīgi kāpj no tonikas līdz tai pašai notij oktāvu augstāk. C mažorā ir tikai baltie taustiņi: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many different letters are in a major scale?
rows.translation: Cik dažādu burtu ir mažora gammā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Seven letters, then the first one returns an octave higher.
rows.translation: Septiņi burti, tad pirmais atgriežas oktāvu augstāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Is this scale going up or down?
rows.translation: Vai šī gamma iet augšup vai lejup?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In C major, most neighbors are a whole step apart. Only E to F and B to C are half steps. That uneven spacing gives the scale its sound.
rows.translation: C mažorā lielāko daļu blakus nošu šķir tonis. Tikai E līdz F un B līdz C ir pustoņi. Šie nevienādie attālumi rada gammas skanējumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In C major, which steps are half steps?
rows.translation: Kuri soļi C mažorā ir pustoņi?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C to D and F to G
rows.translation: C līdz D un F līdz G
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E to F and B to C
rows.translation: E līdz F un B līdz C
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D to E and A to B
rows.translation: D līdz E un A līdz B
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E and F, and B and C, have no black key between them.
rows.translation: Starp E un F, kā arī B un C nav melnā taustiņa.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What's the home note of C major?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The home note, called the tonic, gives the scale its name.
rows.translation: Māju nots, ko sauc par toniku, dod gammai nosaukumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the C major scale, up from middle C.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet C mažora gammu augšup no vidējā C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every major scale follows one recipe of steps: whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. Start on any note, follow it, and you build a major scale.
rows.translation: Katra mažora gamma seko vienai soļu shēmai: tonis, tonis, pustonis, tonis, tonis, tonis, pustonis. Sāciet no jebkuras nots, ievērojiet to un izveidosiet mažora gammu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which is the major scale recipe? (W = whole, H = half)
rows.translation: Kura ir mažora gammas shēma? (W = tonis, H = pustonis)
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: W W H W W W H
rows.translation: W W H W W W H
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: W H W W H W W
rows.translation: W H W W H W W
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: W W W H W W H
rows.translation: W W W H W W H
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: Tonis, tonis, pustonis, tonis, tonis, tonis, pustonis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Number the scale's notes 1 to 8. Where are the half steps?
rows.translation: Numurējiet gammas notis no 1 līdz 8. Kur ir pustoņi?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Whole, whole, then half from 3 to 4; whole, whole, whole, then half from 7 to 8.
rows.translation: Tonis, tonis, tad pustonis no 3 līdz 4; tonis, tonis, tonis, tad pustonis no 7 līdz 8.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Starting on G, a whole step up lands on...
rows.translation: Sākot no G, tonis augšup ved uz...
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G to A skips one key, G♯.
rows.translation: G līdz A izlaiž vienu taustiņu — G♯.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the first four notes of D major: whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet pirmās četras D mažora notis: tonis, tonis, pustonis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Start on G and follow the recipe: G, A, B, C, D, E, then a whole step to F♯ and a half step home to G. G major has one sharp: F♯.
rows.translation: Sāciet no G un sekojiet shēmai: G, A, B, C, D, E, tad tonis līdz F♯ un pustonis mājup uz G. G mažoram ir viens diēzs — F♯.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why does G major need F♯ instead of F?
rows.translation: Kāpēc G mažoram vajag F♯, nevis F?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F is too low to sing
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E to F is only a half step
rows.translation: E līdz F ir tikai pustonis
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The recipe needs a whole step from note 6 to 7, then a half step from 7 up to G.
rows.translation: Shēmai vajag toni no 6. līdz 7. notij, tad pustoni no 7. augšup līdz G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note is in G major?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G major's seventh note is F♯.
rows.translation: G mažora septītā nots ir F♯.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many sharps are in G major?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the G major scale. Remember the F♯.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet G mažora gammu. Atcerieties F♯.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: From D, the recipe gives D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯, D. D major has two sharps: F♯ and C♯.
rows.translation: Sākot no D, shēma dod D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯, D. D mažoram ir divi diēzi — F♯ un C♯.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which two sharps are in D major?
rows.translation: Kuri divi diēzi ir D mažorā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Following the recipe from D lands on F♯ as note 3 and C♯ as note 7.
rows.translation: Sekojot shēmai no D, 3. nots ir F♯ un 7. nots — C♯.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: From F, the recipe needs a half step from A to the fourth note, so it's B♭, not B. F major: F, G, A, B♭, C, D, E, F. One flat: B♭.
rows.translation: Sākot no F, shēmai vajag pustoni no A līdz ceturtajai notij, tāpēc tā ir B♭, nevis B. F mažors: F, G, A, B♭, C, D, E, F. Viens bemols — B♭.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note is in F major?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F major's fourth note is B♭, a half step above A.
rows.translation: F mažora ceturtā nots ir B♭, pustoni virs A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which major key has two sharps?
rows.translation: Kurai mažora tonalitātei ir divi diēzi?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D major has F♯ and C♯.
rows.translation: D mažoram ir F♯ un C♯.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing up F major from F to C. The fourth note is B♭.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet F mažoru augšup no F līdz C. Ceturtā nots ir B♭.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rather than writing F♯ every time, music in G major puts one sharp at the start of each line. That's the key signature: it lists the notes that are always sharp or flat.
rows.translation: Lai nebūtu katrreiz jāraksta F♯, mūzikā G mažorā katras rindas sākumā liek vienu diēzu. Tās ir atslēgas zīmes: tās uzrāda notis, kam vienmēr ir diēzs vai bemols.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A key signature has one sharp, F♯. Which major key is it?
rows.translation: Atslēgas zīmēs ir viens diēzs — F♯. Kura mažora tonalitāte tā ir?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G major is the major key with just F♯.
rows.translation: G mažors ir mažora tonalitāte ar tikai F♯.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A key signature has one flat, B♭. Which major key is it?
rows.translation: Atslēgas zīmēs ir viens bemols — B♭. Kura mažora tonalitāte tā ir?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F major is the major key with just B♭.
rows.translation: F mažors ir mažora tonalitāte ar tikai B♭.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sharps always appear in the same order: F♯, C♯, G♯, and so on. The last sharp is a half step below the key's name. One sharp, F♯: G major.
rows.translation: Diēzi vienmēr parādās vienā secībā: F♯, C♯, G♯ un tā tālāk. Pēdējais diēzs ir pustoni zem tonalitātes nosaukuma nots. Viens diēzs, F♯: G mažors.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A key signature has two sharps, F♯ and C♯. Which major key is it?
rows.translation: Atslēgas zīmēs ir divi diēzi — F♯ un C♯. Kura mažora tonalitāte tā ir?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The last sharp, C♯, is a half step below D.
rows.translation: Pēdējais diēzs, C♯, ir pustoni zem D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which major key has no sharps or flats?
rows.translation: Kurai mažora tonalitātei nav diēzu vai bemolu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C major uses only white keys.
rows.translation: C mažorā ir tikai baltie taustiņi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The key signature shows B♭. Which Bs are played as B♭?
rows.translation: Atslēgas zīmēs ir B♭. Kuras B notis spēlē kā B♭?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A key signature applies to every B in every octave, unless the music marks otherwise.
rows.translation: Atslēgas zīmes attiecas uz katru B katrā oktāvā, ja vien notīs nav norādīts citādi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing D major, with its two sharps: F♯ and C♯.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet D mažoru ar diviem diēziem — F♯ un C♯.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The recipe, four keys and their signatures. When unsure, build the scale from its home note: whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: Shēma, četras tonalitātes un to atslēgas zīmes. Ja šaubāties, veidojiet gammu no tonikas: tonis, tonis, pustonis, tonis, tonis, tonis, pustonis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note belongs in G major?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G major's only sharp is F♯.
rows.translation: Vienīgais G mažora diēzs ir F♯.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which major key has one flat?
rows.translation: Kurai mažora tonalitātei ir viens bemols?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F major's one flat is B♭.
rows.translation: F mažora vienīgais bemols ir B♭.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which scale has the notes D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯?
rows.translation: Kurā gammā ir notis D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In every major scale, which step is a half step?
rows.translation: Kurš solis katrā mažora gammā ir pustonis?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Whole, whole, half: the first half step falls between notes 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Tonis, tonis, pustonis: pirmais pustonis ir starp 3. un 4. noti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which key signature belongs to G major?
rows.translation: Kuras atslēgas zīmes pieder G mažoram?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing F major, with its B♭.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet F mažoru ar tā B♭.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Name the distance between two notes by number and quality, and measure it in half steps.
rows.translation: Nosauciet attālumu starp divām notīm pēc pakāpju un toņu lieluma un izmēriet to pustoņos.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: An interval's number comes from counting letter names, including both ends. C up to E counts C, D, E: three letters, so it's a third.
rows.translation: Intervāla pakāpju lielumu nosaka, saskaitot burtu nosaukumus, ieskaitot abus galus. No C augšup līdz E skaita C, D, E: trīs burti, tātad terca.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C up to G is a...
rows.translation: No C augšup līdz G ir...
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, D, E, F, G: five letters.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F, G: pieci burti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E, F, G, A: four letters.
rows.translation: E, F, G, A: četri burti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sharps and flats don't change an interval's number. C to E♭ and C to E are both thirds: C, D, E either way. They differ in size, which comes next.
rows.translation: Diēzi un bemoli nemaina intervāla pakāpju lielumu. C līdz E♭ un C līdz E abas ir tercas: abos gadījumos C, D, E. Tās atšķiras pēc toņu lieluma, ko apskatīsim tālāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F up to D is a...
rows.translation: No F augšup līdz D ir...
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F, G, A, B, C, D: six letters.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B, C, D: seši burti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A up to E♭ is a...
rows.translation: No A augšup līdz E♭ ir...
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A, B, C, D, E: five letters. The flat doesn't change the count.
rows.translation: A, B, C, D, E: pieci burti. Bemols nemaina skaitu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G up to the next G is a...
rows.translation: No G augšup līdz nākamajam G ir...
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, A, B, C, D, E, F, G: eight letters, an octave.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C, D, E, F, G: astoņi burti — oktāva.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two intervals with the same number can differ in size. To measure exactly, count half steps. C up to E is four; C up to E♭ is three.
rows.translation: Divi intervāli ar vienādu pakāpju lielumu var atšķirties pēc toņu lieluma. Precīzam mērījumam skaitiet pustoņus. C augšup līdz E ir četri; C augšup līdz E♭ ir trīs.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many half steps from D up to F?
rows.translation: Cik pustoņu ir no D augšup līdz F?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, D♯, E, F: three moves.
rows.translation: D, D♯, E, F: trīs kustības.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A third of four half steps is a major third, like C to E. A third of three is a minor third, like C to E♭ or A to C.
rows.translation: Četru pustoņu terca ir lielā terca, piemēram, C līdz E. Trīs pustoņu terca ir mazā terca, piemēram, C līdz E♭ vai A līdz C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E up to G♯ is a...
rows.translation: No E augšup līdz G♯ ir...
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E to G♯ spans four half steps.
rows.translation: E līdz G♯ aptver četrus pustoņus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A up to C is a...
rows.translation: No A augšup līdz C ir...
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A to C spans three half steps.
rows.translation: A līdz C aptver trīs pustoņus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G up to B♭ is a...
rows.translation: No G augšup līdz B♭ ir...
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G to B♭ spans three half steps.
rows.translation: G līdz B♭ aptver trīs pustoņus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Unisons, fourths, fifths and octaves are called perfect. A perfect fourth spans five half steps, a perfect fifth seven, and an octave twelve.
rows.translation: Unisonus, kvartas, kvintas un oktāvas sauc par tīriem intervāliem. Tīrā kvarta aptver piecus pustoņus, tīrā kvinta — septiņus, bet oktāva — divpadsmit.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many half steps are in a perfect fifth?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C up to G: seven half steps.
rows.translation: C augšup līdz G: septiņi pustoņi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C up to F is a...
rows.translation: No C augšup līdz F ir...
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C to F spans five half steps.
rows.translation: C līdz F aptver piecus pustoņus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Watch out for B and F
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Most white-key fifths are perfect, but B up to F spans only six half steps. It's called a diminished fifth. When in doubt, count half steps.
rows.translation: Lielākā daļa balto taustiņu kvintu ir tīras, bet B augšup līdz F aptver tikai sešus pustoņus. To sauc par pamazinātu kvintu. Ja šaubāties, skaitiet pustoņus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these fifths is smaller than perfect?
rows.translation: Kura no šīm kvintām ir mazāka par tīru kvintu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B to F spans six half steps; a perfect fifth needs seven.
rows.translation: B līdz F aptver sešus pustoņus; tīrai kvintai vajag septiņus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A up to D is a...
rows.translation: No A augšup līdz D ir...
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A, B, C, D: four letters, five half steps.
rows.translation: A, B, C, D: četri burti, pieci pustoņi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Seconds, thirds, sixths and sevenths come in major and minor sizes. Minor is always one half step smaller than major.
rows.translation: Sekundām, tercām, sekstām un septīmām ir lielais un mazais veids. Mazais vienmēr ir par vienu pustoni šaurāks nekā lielais.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Minor second 1, major second 2. Minor third 3, major third 4. Minor sixth 8, major sixth 9. Minor seventh 10, major seventh 11.
rows.translation: Mazā sekunda 1, lielā sekunda 2. Mazā terca 3, lielā terca 4. Mazā seksta 8, lielā seksta 9. Mazā septīma 10, lielā septīma 11.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C up to A is a...
rows.translation: No C augšup līdz A ir...
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C to A spans nine half steps.
rows.translation: C līdz A aptver deviņus pustoņus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C up to B♭ is a...
rows.translation: No C augšup līdz B♭ ir...
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C to B♭ spans ten half steps.
rows.translation: C līdz B♭ aptver desmit pustoņus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E to F is a single half step.
rows.translation: E līdz F ir viens pustonis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many half steps are in a major seventh?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: One half step short of an octave.
rows.translation: Par vienu pustoni mazāk nekā oktāvā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E up to C is a...
rows.translation: No E augšup līdz C ir...
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E, F, G, A, B, C makes a sixth. It spans eight half steps, so it's minor.
rows.translation: E, F, G, A, B, C veido sekstu. Tā aptver astoņus pustoņus, tātad ir mazā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count letters for the number. Count half steps for the size. Together they name any interval.
rows.translation: Pakāpju lielumam skaitiet burtus. Toņu lielumam skaitiet pustoņus. Abi kopā nosauc jebkuru intervālu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F up to A is a...
rows.translation: No F augšup līdz A ir...
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F, G, A is a third, and four half steps makes it major.
rows.translation: F, G, A ir terca, un četri pustoņi to padara par lielo tercu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D up to A is a...
rows.translation: No D augšup līdz A ir...
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D to A spans seven half steps.
rows.translation: D līdz A aptver septiņus pustoņus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B up to D is a...
rows.translation: No B augšup līdz D ir...
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B, C, D is a third of three half steps: minor.
rows.translation: B, C, D ir trīs pustoņu terca — mazā terca.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many half steps are in a major sixth?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G up to F is a...
rows.translation: No G augšup līdz F ir...
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G to F covers seven letters and ten half steps: a minor seventh.
rows.translation: G līdz F aptver septiņus burtus un desmit pustoņus — mazo septīmu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Stack thirds into triads, build major and minor chords, and number the chords of a key.
rows.translation: Salieciet tercas trijskanī, veidojiet mažora un minora akordus un numurējiet tonalitātes akordus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A triad is three notes stacked in thirds. Start on any note, skip a letter, take the next, skip again. C, skip D, E, skip F, G: C E G.
rows.translation: Trijskanis ir trīs notis, kas sakārtotas tercās. Sāciet ar jebkuru noti, izlaidiet burtu, ņemiet nākamo, atkal izlaidiet. C, izlaidiet D, E, izlaidiet F, G: C E G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which notes make a triad built on G?
rows.translation: Kuras notis veido trijskani no G?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, skip A, B, skip C, D.
rows.translation: G, izlaidiet A, B, izlaidiet C, D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The note a triad is built on is its root. The middle note is the third and the top note is the fifth, named for their distance above the root.
rows.translation: Nots, uz kuras būvēts trijskanis, ir tā pamattonis. Vidējā nots ir terca, bet augšējā — kvinta; tās nosauktas pēc attāluma virs pamattoņa.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the triad F A C, which note is the root?
rows.translation: Kura nots trijskanī F A C ir pamattonis?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F is the bottom note the triad is built on.
rows.translation: F ir apakšējā nots, uz kuras būvēts trijskanis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the triad D F A, which note is the fifth?
rows.translation: Kura nots trijskanī D F A ir kvinta?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D up to A is a fifth: D, E, F, G, A.
rows.translation: D augšup līdz A ir kvinta: D, E, F, G, A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Using only white keys, which triad is built on E?
rows.translation: Kurš trijskanis veidojas no E, lietojot tikai baltos taustiņus?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E, skip F, G, skip A, B.
rows.translation: E, izlaidiet F, G, izlaidiet A, B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the C triad one note at a time: C, E, G.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet C trijskani pa vienai notij: C, E, G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A major triad has a major third on the bottom, four half steps, then a minor third on top. C E G is major. So are F A C and G B D.
rows.translation: Mažora trijskanim apakšā ir lielā terca — četri pustoņi — un virs tās mazā terca. C E G ir mažors. Tāpat arī F A C un G B D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Flip the thirds and you get minor: a minor third on the bottom, then a major third. Lower the middle note of C major and you get C minor: C E♭ G.
rows.translation: Samainiet tercas un iegūsiet minoru: apakšā mazā terca, tad lielā terca. Pazeminiet C mažora vidējo noti un iegūsiet C minoru: C E♭ G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D to F is a minor third; F to A is a major third.
rows.translation: D līdz F ir mazā terca; F līdz A ir lielā terca.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E to G♯ is a major third; G♯ to B is a minor third.
rows.translation: E līdz G♯ ir lielā terca; G♯ līdz B ir mazā terca.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Is A C E major or minor?
rows.translation: Vai A C E ir mažors vai minors?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A to C is a minor third, three half steps.
rows.translation: A līdz C ir mazā terca — trīs pustoņi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing A minor one note at a time: A, C, E.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet A minoru pa vienai notij: A, C, E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Build a triad on each note of a scale, using only that scale's notes, and you get the key's family of chords. C major has seven, one per note.
rows.translation: Uz katras gammas nots veidojiet trijskani, lietojot tikai šīs gammas notis, un iegūsiet tonalitātes akordu saimi. C mažoram ir septiņi — pa vienam katrai notij.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on D?
rows.translation: Kurš trijskanis veidojas uz D, lietojot tikai C mažora notis?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D F A: a minor third, then a major third.
rows.translation: D F A: mazā terca, tad lielā terca.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on G?
rows.translation: Kurš trijskanis veidojas uz G, lietojot tikai C mažora notis?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G B D: a major third, then a minor third.
rows.translation: G B D: lielā terca, tad mazā terca.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The triad on B is different: B D F. Both thirds are minor, so it's a diminished triad. It sounds tense and wants to move.
rows.translation: Trijskanis uz B ir citāds: B D F. Abas tercas ir mazās, tātad tas ir pamazināts trijskanis. Tas skan saspringti un vēlas virzīties tālāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In C major, which chords are major?
rows.translation: Kuri C mažora akordi ir mažora akordi?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C E G, F A C and G B D each have a major third on the bottom.
rows.translation: C E G, F A C un G B D apakšā katram ir lielā terca.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on A?
rows.translation: Kurš trijskanis veidojas uz A, lietojot tikai C mažora notis?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A C E: a minor third, then a major third.
rows.translation: A C E: mazā terca, tad lielā terca.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the diminished triad on B: B, D, F.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet pamazināto trijskani uz B: B, D, F.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Musicians number a key's chords with Roman numerals: I for the chord on note 1, up to vii for note 7. Uppercase means major, lowercase minor, and ° diminished.
rows.translation: Mūziķi tonalitātes akordus numurē ar romiešu cipariem: I akordam uz 1. nots līdz vii uz 7. nots. Lielie burti nozīmē mažoru, mazie — minoru, bet ° — pamazinātu akordu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every major key follows one pattern: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. In C major that's C, D minor, E minor, F, G, A minor and B diminished.
rows.translation: Katra mažora tonalitāte seko vienai shēmai: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. C mažorā tie ir C, D minors, E minors, F, G, A minors un B pamazinātais.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In C major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Kurš akords C mažorā ir IV?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The fourth note of C major is F.
rows.translation: C mažora ceturtā nots ir F.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In C major, which chord is vi?
rows.translation: Kurš akords C mažorā ir vi?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The sixth note is A, and lowercase vi means minor.
rows.translation: Sestā nots ir A, un mazie burti vi nozīmē minoru.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In G major, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Kurš akords G mažorā ir V?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count up from G: G, A, B, C, D. The fifth note is D, and V is major.
rows.translation: Skaitiet augšup no G: G, A, B, C, D. Piektā nots ir D, un V ir mažors.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why is ii written in lowercase?
rows.translation: Kāpēc ii raksta ar mazajiem burtiem?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In G major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Kurš akords G mažorā ir IV?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, A, B, C: the fourth note is C.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C: ceturtā nots ir C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Spell it, hear it, number it
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Stack thirds, check their sizes, then place the chord in its key: major on I, IV and V, minor on ii, iii and vi, diminished on vii°.
rows.translation: Salieciet tercas, pārbaudiet to lielumus, tad ievietojiet akordu tonalitātē: mažors uz I, IV un V, minors uz ii, iii un vi, pamazinātais uz vii°.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In C major, which chord is ii?
rows.translation: Kurš akords C mažorā ir ii?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In F major, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Kurš akords F mažorā ir V?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C: the fifth note is C.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C: piektā nots ir C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B to D and D to F are both minor thirds.
rows.translation: B līdz D un D līdz F abas ir mazās tercas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the G major triad: G, B, D.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet G mažora trijskani: G, B, D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How chords move in songs: I–IV–V, the pop loop, ii–V–I, the 12-bar blues and cadences.
rows.translation: Akordu kustība dziesmās: I–IV–V, popmūzikas cikls, ii–V–I, 12 taktu blūzs un kadences.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Countless folk, rock and country songs use just three chords: I, IV and V. In C major, that's C, F and G. Together they hold every note of the scale.
rows.translation: Neskaitāmas tautasdziesmas, roka un kantrī dziesmas izmanto tikai trīs akordus: I, IV un V. C mažorā tie ir C, F un G. Kopā tie ietver katru gammas noti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In G major, what are I, IV and V?
rows.translation: Kas G mažorā ir I, IV un V?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count up from G: note 1 is G, note 4 is C, note 5 is D.
rows.translation: Skaitiet augšup no G: 1. nots ir G, 4. nots ir C, 5. nots ir D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Does this end on the home chord?
rows.translation: Vai tas beidzas uz tonikas akorda?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: I feels like home. IV moves away. V builds tension that pulls back to I. That trip, out and back again, shapes a huge number of songs.
rows.translation: I šķiet kā mājas. IV dodas projām. V rada spriegumu, kas velk atpakaļ uz I. Šis ceļojums projām un atpakaļ veido ļoti daudzas dziesmas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord pulls most strongly back to I?
rows.translation: Kurš akords visspēcīgāk velk atpakaļ uz I?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: V builds tension that resolves to I.
rows.translation: V rada spriegumu, kas atrisinās uz I.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In D major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Kurš akords D mažorā ir IV?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, E, F♯, G: the fourth note is G.
rows.translation: D, E, F♯, G: ceturtā nots ir G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of I, IV, V, I in C: C, F, G, C.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet I, IV, V, I pamattoņus C tonalitātē: C, F, G, C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This four-chord loop runs under a huge number of pop songs. In C major it's C, G, A minor, F. The minor vi adds a touch of shade before IV lifts back toward home.
rows.translation: Šis četru akordu cikls ir ļoti daudzu popdziesmu pamatā. C mažorā tas ir C, G, A minors, F. Minora vi piešķir nelielu ēnu, pirms IV ceļ atpakaļ māju virzienā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In G major, what is I–V–vi–IV?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In G: I is G, V is D, vi is E minor, IV is C.
rows.translation: G tonalitātē: I ir G, V ir D, vi ir E minors, IV ir C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Start the same loop on vi and you get vi–IV–I–V: A minor, F, C, G. The chords are identical, but beginning on minor makes it sound more serious.
rows.translation: Sāciet to pašu ciklu ar vi un iegūsiet vi–IV–I–V: A minors, F, C, G. Akordi ir tie paši, bet sākums minorā liek skanēt nopietnāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In F major, which chord is vi?
rows.translation: Kurš akords F mažorā ir vi?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C, D: the sixth note is D, and vi is minor.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C, D: sestā nots ir D, un vi ir minors.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of I–V–vi–IV in C: C, G, A, F.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet I–V–vi–IV pamattoņus C tonalitātē: C, G, A, F.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: ii–V–I is the most common progression in jazz. In C major: D minor, G, C. Each root falls a fifth to the next, so the move feels like coming home.
rows.translation: Džezā visbiežākā akordu secība ir ii–V–I. C mažorā: D minors, G, C. Katrs pamattonis krīt kvintu līdz nākamajam, tāpēc kustība šķiet kā atgriešanās mājās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In C major, what is ii–V–I?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: ii is D minor, V is G, and I is C.
rows.translation: ii ir D minors, V ir G, bet I ir C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Jazz players usually add sevenths: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7. The extra notes make each move even smoother. The roots and the trip home stay the same.
rows.translation: Džeza spēlētāji parasti pievieno septīmas: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7. Papildu skaņas katru pāreju padara vēl plūstošāku. Pamattoņi un ceļojums mājup paliek tie paši.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In F major, what is ii–V–I?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C: ii is G minor and V is C.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C: ii ir G minors, bet V ir C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In ii–V–I, how do the roots move?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D down to G, then G down to C: a fifth each time.
rows.translation: D lejup līdz G, tad G lejup līdz C: katru reizi kvinta.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of ii–V–I in C: D, down to G, up to C.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet ii–V–I pamattoņus C tonalitātē: D, lejup līdz G, augšup līdz C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The 12-bar blues is a chord plan, twelve bars long, behind countless blues, rock and jazz tunes. It uses I, IV and V, often all as dominant seventh chords for a bluesy edge.
rows.translation: 12 taktu blūzs ir divpadsmit taktu akordu plāns neskaitāmu blūza, roka un džeza melodiju pamatā. Tas izmanto I, IV un V, bieži visus kā dominantseptakordus blūzīgai nokrāsai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Four bars of I. Two of IV, two of I. One of V, one of IV, two of I. Then it repeats. In A: A7 four times, D7 twice, A7 twice, E7, D7, A7 twice.
rows.translation: Četras I taktis. Divas IV, divas I. Viena V, viena IV, divas I. Tad atkārtojas. A tonalitātē: A7 četrreiz, D7 divreiz, A7 divreiz, E7, D7, A7 divreiz.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many bars of I open the 12-bar blues?
rows.translation: Ar cik I taktīm sākas 12 taktu blūzs?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Four bars of I, then IV arrives in bar 5.
rows.translation: Četras I taktis, tad 5. taktī pienāk IV.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the 12-bar blues, which chord is in bar 9?
rows.translation: Kurš akords 12 taktu blūzā ir 9. taktī?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bar 9 is the one bar of V, before IV in bar 10.
rows.translation: 9. takts ir vienīgā V takts pirms IV 10. taktī.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the key of E, what are the three blues chords?
rows.translation: Kādi ir trīs blūza akordi E tonalitātē?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In E, I is E, IV is A and V is B.
rows.translation: E tonalitātē I ir E, IV ir A, bet V ir B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of the blues in A: A, D, E, back to A.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet blūza pamattoņus A tonalitātē: A, D, E, atpakaļ uz A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A cadence is the chord move that ends a phrase, like punctuation. V to I is the strongest, a full stop. It's called an authentic cadence.
rows.translation: Kadence ir akordu pāreja, kas noslēdz frāzi, gluži kā pieturzīme. V uz I ir visspēcīgākā — punkts. To sauc par autentisko kadenci.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: IV to I is a plagal cadence, the soft amen at the end of many hymns. Stopping on V is a half cadence, like a comma. V to vi is deceptive: you expect home and get a surprise.
rows.translation: IV uz I ir plagālā kadence — maigais āmen daudzu himnu beigās. Apstāšanās uz V ir puskadence, kā komats. V uz vi ir pārtrauktā kadence: gaidāt mājas, bet saņemat pārsteigumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which cadence ends a phrase on V?
rows.translation: Kura kadence noslēdz frāzi uz V?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A half cadence pauses on V, like a comma.
rows.translation: Puskadence apstājas uz V, gluži kā komats.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which cadence is called the amen cadence?
rows.translation: Kuru kadenci sauc par āmen kadenci?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: IV to I is the soft amen at the end of many hymns.
rows.translation: IV uz I ir maigais āmen daudzu himnu beigās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Home, away and back again. Name the progression, then the cadence that ends it. Listen for where the music wants to rest.
rows.translation: Mājās, projām un atkal atpakaļ. Nosauciet akordu secību, tad kadenci, kas to noslēdz. Klausieties, kur mūzika vēlas norimt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In D major, what is I–V–vi–IV?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In D: I is D, V is A, vi is B minor, IV is G.
rows.translation: D tonalitātē: I ir D, V ir A, vi ir B minors, IV ir G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In which bar does the 12-bar blues first move to IV?
rows.translation: Kurā taktī 12 taktu blūzs pirmoreiz pāriet uz IV?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: V to I is the full stop of music.
rows.translation: V uz I ir mūzikas punkts.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of I–IV–V–I in G: G, C, D, G.
rows.translation: Nospēlējiet vai nodziediet I–IV–V–I pamattoņus G tonalitātē: G, C, D, G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Feel the beat, count it, and tap it in time
rows.translation: Sajūtiet pulsu, skaitiet un piesitiet ritmā
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Find the pulse, count to four, and tap in time.
rows.translation: Atrodiet pulsu, skaitiet līdz četri un piesitiet ritmā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The beat is a steady pulse
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The beat is the steady pulse you tap your foot to. It never rushes or drags, like footsteps on an easy walk. Every rhythm sits on top of it.
rows.translation: Sitiens ir vienmērīgais pulss, kam piesitat ar pēdu. Tas nesteidzas un nekavējas, gluži kā soļi mierīgā pastaigā. Uz tā balstās katrs ritms.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold your fingertip just above the screen and tap each time the click sounds. Let it bounce off the glass like a drumstick. Aim to land with the click, not after it.
rows.translation: Turiet pirksta galu tieši virs ekrāna un piesitiet ikreiz, kad skan klikšķis. Lai tas atlec no stikla kā bungu vālīte. Mērķējiet trāpīt reizē ar klikšķi, nevis pēc tā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A beat keeps the same space between pulses, like a clock ticking.
rows.translation: Pulss saglabā vienādus attālumus starp sitieniem kā pulksteņa tikšķi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many clicks did you hear?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Most music groups beats in fours. Count 1, 2, 3, 4 out loud with the click, then start again at 1. Saying the numbers helps your hands keep time.
rows.translation: Lielākā daļa mūzikas grupē sitienus pa četriem. Reizē ar klikšķi skaļi skaitiet 1, 2, 3, 4, tad atkal sāciet ar 1. Skaitļu izrunāšana palīdz rokām turēt ritmu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A bar is one group of beats. Here each bar holds four beats, written 4/4. Beat 1 starts every bar, so lean on it a little as you count.
rows.translation: Takts ir viena sitienu grupa. Šeit katrā taktī ir četri sitieni, ko raksta 4/4. 1. sitiens sāk katru takti, tāpēc skaitot mazliet to uzsveriet.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The strong click is beat 1. How many beats are in each bar?
rows.translation: Stiprais klikšķis ir 1. sitiens. Cik sitienu ir katrā taktī?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Counting starts again at 1 at the top of every bar.
rows.translation: Katras takts sākumā skaitīšana atkal sākas ar 1.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A note that lasts one beat is a quarter note. Four of them fill a bar of 4/4, so tapping on every beat means tapping quarter notes.
rows.translation: Nots, kas ilgst vienu sitienu, ir ceturtdaļnots. Četras aizpilda 4/4 takti, tāpēc piesist uz katra sitiena nozīmē piesist ceturtdaļnotis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now tap only on 1 and 3. Each tap is a half note, two beats long. Keep counting all four; the beats you skip still happen.
rows.translation: Tagad piesitiet tikai uz 1 un 3. Katrs piesitiens ir pusnots divu sitienu garumā. Turpiniet skaitīt visus četrus; izlaistie sitieni joprojām notiek.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: You tap on 1 and 3. What happens on 2 and 4?
rows.translation: Piesitat uz 1 un 3. Kas notiek uz 2 un 4?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The beat never stops. You count through the beats you don't tap.
rows.translation: Pulss nekad neapstājas. Skaitiet arī tos sitienus, uz kuriem nepiesitat.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A whole note lasts all four beats. Tap once on 1 and count 2, 3, 4 under your breath so the next 1 lands on time.
rows.translation: Vesela nots ilgst visus četrus sitienus. Piesitiet vienreiz uz 1 un pie sevis skaitiet 2, 3, 4, lai nākamais 1 pienāktu laikus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Tempo is the speed of the beat
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Tempo is how fast the beat goes, counted in beats per minute, or bpm. At 60 bpm the beat comes once a second, like a clock.
rows.translation: Temps ir sitienu ātrums, ko skaita sitienos minūtē jeb bpm. Tempā 60 bpm sitiens pienāk reizi sekundē, gluži kā pulkstenī.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: At 60 bpm, how often does the beat come?
rows.translation: Cik bieži pienāk sitiens tempā 60 bpm?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: 60 beats in 60 seconds is one beat each second.
rows.translation: 60 sitieni 60 sekundēs ir viens sitiens katru sekundi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Faster tempos need less effort, not more. Keep your hand loose and tap from the knuckle, not the wrist or shoulder.
rows.translation: Ātrākam tempam vajag mazāk pūļu, nevis vairāk. Turiet roku brīvu un piesitiet no pirksta pamatnes locītavas, nevis plaukstas locītavas vai pleca.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The tempo goes up. What should your taps do?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Wait a little behind the click
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Small, relaxed motions are quicker and easier to keep even.
rows.translation: Mazas, atbrīvotas kustības ir ātrākas un vieglāk saglabājamas vienmērīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This challenge mixes beats, bars, longer notes and tempo. Count out loud the whole way, and keep your taps small and relaxed.
rows.translation: Šajā pārbaudījumā apvienoti sitieni, taktis, garākas notis un temps. Visu laiku skaitiet skaļi, un piesitieniem jābūt maziem un brīviem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note lasts a whole bar of 4/4?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A whole note lasts four beats, the full bar of 4/4.
rows.translation: Vesela nots ilgst četrus sitienus — pilnu 4/4 takti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: bpm counts beats per minute, so 90 bpm is one and a half beats each second.
rows.translation: bpm skaita sitienus minūtē, tāpēc 90 bpm ir pusotrs sitiens sekundē.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Split each beat in two and count "and."
rows.translation: Sadaliet katru sitienu divās daļās un skaitiet „un”.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in every beat. Eight of them fill a bar of 4/4.
rows.translation: Astotdaļnots ilgst pussitienu, tāpēc katrā sitienā ietilpst divas. Astoņas aizpilda 4/4 takti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Say the number on each beat and "and" exactly halfway between: 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Tap on every word.
rows.translation: Uz katra sitiena sakiet skaitli, bet precīzi pa vidu — „un”: 1 un 2 un 3 un 4 un. Piesitiet uz katra vārda.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: An eighth note is half a beat, so two fill each beat.
rows.translation: Astotdaļnots ir pussitiens, tāpēc divas aizpilda katru sitienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The strong clicks are the beats. How many beats did you hear?
rows.translation: Stiprie klikšķi ir sitieni. Cik sitienu dzirdējāt?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now some beats get one tap and some get two. Keep saying every "and," even the ones you don't tap.
rows.translation: Tagad dažiem sitieniem ir viens piesitiens, citiem divi. Turpiniet izrunāt katru „un”, arī tos, uz kuriem nepiesitat.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How do you count this pattern?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beat 1 has two taps, 1 and. Beats 2, 3 and 4 get one tap each.
rows.translation: 1. sitienā ir divi piesitieni — 1 un. 2., 3. un 4. sitienā ir pa vienam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In eighths, each tap lands on a number or an "and." Before you tap a new pattern, say its counts once out loud.
rows.translation: Astotdaļnotīs katrs piesitiens iekrīt uz skaitļa vai „un”. Pirms piesitat jaunu rakstu, vienreiz skaļi izrunājiet tā skaitījumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beats 1 and 3 have two taps each; beats 2 and 4 have one.
rows.translation: 1. un 3. sitienā ir pa diviem piesitieniem; 2. un 4. — pa vienam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beat 1 has one tap, beats 2 and 3 have two, and beat 4 has one.
rows.translation: 1. sitienā ir viens piesitiens, 2. un 3. — pa diviem, bet 4. — viens.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The "and" should land exactly halfway between beats. If your eighths sound like a gallop, slow down and say the counts as you tap.
rows.translation: „Un” jāiekrīt precīzi starp sitieniem. Ja astotdaļnotis skan kā galops, palēniniet un piesitot izrunājiet skaitījumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your eighths sound uneven. What helps most?
rows.translation: Astotdaļnotis skan nevienmērīgi. Kas palīdz visvairāk?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slow down and count out loud
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Speed up until it smooths out
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slowing down gives you time to place each "and" in the middle. Counting keeps it there.
rows.translation: Palēninot iegūstat laiku novietot katru „un” vidū. Skaitīšana to tur notur.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hover just above the glass between taps. A short, light motion is easier to keep even at faster tempos.
rows.translation: Starp piesitieniem palieciet tieši virs stikla. Īsu, vieglu kustību ātrākā tempā ir vieglāk saglabāt vienmērīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This challenge mixes quarters and eighths. Say each pattern's counts once, then tap it with every "and" right in the middle.
rows.translation: Šajā pārbaudījumā sajauktas ceturtdaļnotis un astotdaļnotis. Vienreiz izrunājiet katra raksta skaitījumu, tad piesitiet, katru „un” liekot precīzi vidū.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Leave space on purpose, then tap between the beats.
rows.translation: Apzināti atstājiet tukšumu, tad piesitiet starp sitieniem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A rest is a silence with a set length. You still count it; you just don't tap. A quarter rest lasts one beat.
rows.translation: Pauze ir noteikta ilguma klusums. Jūs to joprojām skaitāt, tikai nepiesitat. Ceturtdaļpauze ilgst vienu sitienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What do you do on a rest?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A rest takes up time just like a note. Counting it keeps your place.
rows.translation: Pauze aizņem laiku tāpat kā nots. Skaitot saglabājat savu vietu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Leaving beat 1 empty is the hardest rest. Nod your head on 1 so you feel it without tapping, then come in on 2.
rows.translation: Atstāt 1. sitienu tukšu ir visgrūtākā pauze. Uz 1 pamājiet ar galvu, lai to sajustu bez piesitiena, tad pievienojieties uz 2.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: An eighth rest lasts half a beat. Count 1 and 2 and, rest on 2, and tap its "and" instead. It feels like a small push into beat 3.
rows.translation: Astotdaļpauze ilgst pussitienu. Skaitiet 1 un 2 un, uz 2 ieturiet pauzi, bet piesitiet uz tā „un”. Tas šķiet kā mazs grūdiens uz 3. sitienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: It sits halfway between beats 2 and 3, on the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: Tas atrodas pa vidu starp 2. un 3. sitienu — uz 2. sitiena „un”.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Syncopation puts a strong note between the beats, where your ear doesn't expect one. It makes a rhythm lean forward.
rows.translation: Sinkopēšana liek stipru noti starp sitieniem, kur dzirde to negaida. Tā liek ritmam tiekties uz priekšu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This pattern lands on 1, the "and" of 2, and 4. Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and, and tap only those three spots.
rows.translation: Šis raksts skan uz 1, 2. sitiena „un” un 4. Skaitiet 1 un 2 un 3 un 4 un un piesitiet tikai šajās trīs vietās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count the clicks from 1 to 8. Where do the strong ones fall?
rows.translation: Skaitiet klikšķus no 1 līdz 8. Kur iekrīt stiprie?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Syncopation shifts the weight off the beat, onto an "and" or a weak beat.
rows.translation: Sinkopēšana pārbīda uzsvaru no stiprā sitiena uz „un” vai vāju taktsdaļu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Offbeats are the "and" between beats. Nod on the numbers and tap only the ands, like the chop of a reggae guitar.
rows.translation: Starp sitieniem atrodas „un”. Uz skaitļiem mājiet ar galvu un piesitiet tikai uz „un”, gluži kā regeja ģitāras īsie akordi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first click is beat 1. Are the strong clicks on the numbers or the ands?
rows.translation: Pirmais klikšķis ir 1. sitiens. Vai stiprie klikšķi ir uz skaitļiem vai „un”?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Offbeats fall halfway between the beats, on every "and."
rows.translation: Tie iekrīt precīzi pa vidu starp sitieniem — uz katra „un”.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This challenge mixes rests, the "and" on its own, syncopation and offbeats. Count every eighth out loud, even when you don't tap.
rows.translation: Šajā pārbaudījumā apvienotas pauzes, atsevišķs „un”, sinkopes un piesitieni starp sitieniem. Skaļi skaitiet katru astotdaļu, arī tad, kad nepiesitat.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Tapping the "and" of 2 and skipping 3 moves the weight off the beat.
rows.translation: Piesitiens uz 2. sitiena „un” un 3. sitiena izlaišana pārvieto uzsvaru nost no sitiena.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold notes across the beat with ties and dotted rhythms.
rows.translation: Pagariniet notis pāri sitienam ar līgām un punktētiem ritmiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A tie is a curved line joining two notes. You play the first and hold it through the second, so the tied note gets no new tap.
rows.translation: Pagarinājuma līga ir izliekta līnija, kas savieno divas notis. Jūs spēlējat pirmo un turat to arī otrās laikā, tāpēc salīgotajai notij nav jauna piesitiena.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beat 2 is tied to beat 3. What do you do on 3?
rows.translation: 2. sitiens salīgots ar 3. sitienu. Ko darāt uz 3?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A tie stretches one note. You count 3, but the note from beat 2 keeps sounding.
rows.translation: Līga pagarina vienu noti. Jūs skaitāt 3, bet 2. sitiena nots turpina skanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Tie the "and" of 2 into beat 3. Tap on the "and," then let beat 3 pass while the note rings. It's syncopation, written another way.
rows.translation: Salīgojiet 2. sitiena „un” ar 3. sitienu. Piesitiet uz „un”, tad ļaujiet 3. sitienam paiet, kamēr nots skan. Tā ir citādi pierakstīta sinkope.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A dot after a note adds half its length. A half note lasts two beats, so a dotted half lasts three. Tap 1, count 2 and 3, tap 4.
rows.translation: Punkts aiz nots pievieno pusi tās ilguma. Pusnots ilgst divus sitienus, tāpēc punktēta pusnots — trīs. Piesitiet uz 1, skaitiet 2 un 3, piesitiet uz 4.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. How long is a dotted quarter?
rows.translation: Ceturtdaļnots ilgst vienu sitienu. Cik ilga ir punktēta ceturtdaļnots?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Half of one beat is a half beat. Add it and you get one and a half.
rows.translation: Puse viena sitiena ir pussitiens. Pievienojiet to un iegūsiet pusotru.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A dotted quarter lasts one and a half beats, so the next note lands on an "and." Count 1 and 2 and: tap 1, then the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: Punktēta ceturtdaļnots ilgst pusotru sitienu, tāpēc nākamā nots iekrīt uz „un”. Skaitiet 1 un 2 un: piesitiet uz 1, tad uz 2. sitiena „un”.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: You tapped this pattern with a rest in Unit 3. What changes with a dot?
rows.translation: 3. nodaļā piesitāt šo rakstu ar pauzi. Kas mainās ar punktu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The taps land in the same places. Only the length of the first note changes.
rows.translation: Piesitieni ir tajās pašās vietās. Mainās tikai pirmās nots ilgums.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A dotted quarter plus an eighth fills two beats: long, short. Count 1 and 2 and; tap 1 and the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: Punktēta ceturtdaļnots un astotdaļnots aizpilda divus sitienus: gari, īsi. Skaitiet 1 un 2 un; piesitiet uz 1 un 2. sitiena „un”.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A dotted quarter and an eighth together last how long?
rows.translation: Cik ilgi kopā skan punktēta ceturtdaļnots un astotdaļnots?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: One and a half plus a half is two.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which lasts as long as a dotted quarter?
rows.translation: Kas ilgst tikpat, cik punktēta ceturtdaļnots?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A quarter tied to an eighth
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The tie adds half a beat to the quarter, just like the dot does.
rows.translation: Līga ceturtdaļnotij pievieno pussitienu, tieši tāpat kā punkts.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This challenge mixes ties and dots. Count every eighth out loud; a held note still takes up its full time.
rows.translation: Šajā pārbaudījumā apvienotas līgas un punkti. Skaļi skaitiet katru astotdaļu; arī turēta nots aizņem visu savu laiku.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How long is a dotted half note?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A half note is two beats; the dot adds one more.
rows.translation: Pusnots ir divi sitieni; punkts pievieno vēl vienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A tie connects two notes. How many times do you tap?
rows.translation: Līga savieno divas notis. Cik reižu piesitat?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: You tap the first note and hold through the second.
rows.translation: Piesitat pirmo noti un turat arī otrās laikā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Split the beat in three, then swing your eighths.
rows.translation: Sadaliet sitienu trīs daļās, tad spēlējiet astotdaļnotis svingā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Triplets split the beat in three
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A triplet fits three even notes into one beat. Count 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let, with each syllable the same length.
rows.translation: Triole ietilpina trīs vienmērīgas notis vienā sitienā. Skaitiet 1-ta-ta, 2-ta-ta, katrai zilbei atvēlot vienādu ilgumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many triplet notes fit in one beat?
rows.translation: Cik trioles nošu ietilpst vienā sitienā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Triplets split each beat into three equal parts.
rows.translation: Trioles sadala katru sitienu trīs vienādās daļās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Are the clicks in groups of two or three?
rows.translation: Vai klikšķi ir grupās pa diviem vai trim?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Eighths split the beat in two; triplets split it in three. The beat itself stays put. Only the way you divide it changes.
rows.translation: Astotdaļnotis sadala sitienu divās daļās; trioles — trīs. Pats sitiens paliek vietā. Mainās tikai tā sadalījums.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: You count 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let. What are you tapping?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Three syllables per beat means three notes per beat: triplets.
rows.translation: Trīs zilbes katrā sitienā nozīmē trīs notis sitienā — trioles.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In swing, each pair of eighths turns long-short. The "and" moves late, onto the last part of a triplet. Think doo-ba, doo-ba.
rows.translation: Svingā katrs astotdaļnošu pāris kļūst garš–īss. „Un” iekrīt vēlāk, trioles pēdējā daļā. Iedomājieties dū-ba, dū-ba.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count 1-trip-let and tap only on "1" and "let." The gap in the middle is the swing.
rows.translation: Skaitiet 1-ta-ta un piesitiet tikai uz „1” un pēdējā „ta”. Atstarpe vidū rada svingu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In swing, where does the "and" land?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Swing delays the "and" to the last triplet, which gives the long-short lilt.
rows.translation: Svings aizkavē „un” līdz trioles pēdējai notij, radot garo–īso šūpojumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Jazz drummers play this on the ride cymbal: 1, 2, a swung "and," 3, 4, a swung "and." It sounds like ding, ding-a ding.
rows.translation: Džeza bundzinieki uz raida šķīvja spēlē šādi: 1, 2, svingots „un”, 3, 4, svingots „un”. Tas skan kā ding, ding-a ding.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How do you tap a swung "and"?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A swung "and" waits for the last triplet of the beat.
rows.translation: Svingots „un” nogaida līdz sitiena trioles pēdējai notij.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Straight eighths split the beat evenly; swung eighths go long-short. Tap one, then the other, and feel the difference.
rows.translation: Taisnas astotdaļnotis sadala sitienu vienādi; svingotās iet gari–īsi. Piesitiet vienas, tad otras un sajūtiet atšķirību.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This challenge mixes triplets, straight eighths and swing. Keep the beat steady while the way you split it changes.
rows.translation: Šajā pārbaudījumā apvienotas trioles, taisnas astotdaļnotis un svings. Saglabājiet vienmērīgu pulsu, kamēr mainās tā sadalījums.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Swing turns each pair of eighths into what?
rows.translation: Par ko svings pārvērš katru astotdaļnošu pāri?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first eighth stretches and the "and" arrives late.
rows.translation: Pirmā astotdaļa izstiepjas, un „un” pienāk vēlāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Waltz in three, march in two, rock in 6/8, and place the accents.
rows.translation: Valsis pa trim, maršs pa diviem, šūpošanās 6/8 un akcentu izvietošana.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In 3/4 time each bar has three beats: ONE, two, three. It's the waltz. Count 1, 2, 3 and lean on 1.
rows.translation: 3/4 taktsmērā katrā taktī ir trīs sitieni: VIENS, divi, trīs. Tas ir valsis. Skaitiet 1, 2, 3 un uzsveriet 1.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A half note fills two of the three beats. Tap 1, count 2, tap 3. It feels like the big step and small step of a waltz.
rows.translation: Pusnots aizpilda divus no trim sitieniem. Piesitiet uz 1, skaitiet 2, piesitiet uz 3. Sajūta ir kā valša lielais un mazais solis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many beats are in a bar of 3/4?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The top number of a time signature tells you how many beats are in each bar.
rows.translation: Taktsmēra augšējais skaitlis norāda sitienu skaitu katrā taktī.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: 2/4 has two beats per bar: ONE, two, like marching feet. The bars go by quickly, so beat 1 comes around often.
rows.translation: 2/4 ir divi sitieni taktī: VIENS, divi, kā maršējoši soļi. Taktis paiet ātri, tāpēc 1. sitiens atgriežas bieži.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which meter feels like a march?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two beats per bar match left, right, left, right.
rows.translation: Divi sitieni taktī atbilst kreisā, labā, kreisā, labā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In 6/8 each bar holds six eighth notes in two groups of three: ONE two three FOUR five six. It feels like two big, rocking beats.
rows.translation: 6/8 taktī ir sešas astotdaļnotis divās grupās pa trim: VIENS divi trīs ČETRI pieci seši. To jūt kā divus lielus, šūpojošus sitienus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The six eighths fall into two groups of three, so you feel two big beats.
rows.translation: Sešas astotdaļas sadalās divās grupās pa trim, tāpēc jūtat divus lielus sitienus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A favorite 6/8 pattern goes long-short, long-short: tap 1, 3, 4 and 6. It rocks like a lullaby or a sea shanty.
rows.translation: Iecienīts 6/8 raksts iet gari–īsi, gari–īsi: piesitiet uz 1, 3, 4 un 6. Tas šūpojas kā šūpuļdziesma vai jūrnieku darba dziesma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Six clicks per bar. Which meter is this?
rows.translation: Seši klikšķi taktī. Kurš taktsmērs tas ir?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: An accent is a note played stronger than the ones around it. Move the accents and the feel changes, even when every note stays the same.
rows.translation: Akcents ir nots, ko spēlē spēcīgāk par apkārtējām. Pārvietojiet akcentus, un sajūta mainīsies, pat ja katra nots paliek tā pati.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count all eight eighths and tap just the accents: 1, the "and" of 2, and 4. This 3-3-2 pattern drives a lot of pop and Latin music.
rows.translation: Skaitiet visas astoņas astotdaļas un piesitiet tikai akcentus: 1, 2. sitiena „un” un 4. Šis 3-3-2 raksts virza daudz popmūzikas un Latīņamerikas mūzikas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: An accent is about weight, not length. The note is simply played stronger.
rows.translation: Akcents attiecas uz uzsvaru, nevis ilgumu. Noti vienkārši spēlē spēcīgāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rock, pop and soul put the accent on beats 2 and 4. This is the backbeat. Count all four and tap only 2 and 4, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Rokā, popmūzikā un soulā uzsver 2. un 4. sitienu. Tas ir pretakcents. Skaitiet visus četrus un piesitiet tikai uz 2 un 4 kā mazā bunga.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first click is beat 1. Where are the strong clicks?
rows.translation: Pirmais klikšķis ir 1. sitiens. Kur ir stiprie klikšķi?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This challenge moves between meters and accents. Before each tap step, count one bar under your breath to find beat 1.
rows.translation: Šajā pārbaudījumā mainās metri un akcenti. Pirms katra piesitienu uzdevuma pie sevis noskaitiet vienu takti, lai atrastu 1. sitienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Six eighth notes per bar, felt in two groups of three.
rows.translation: Sešas astotdaļnotis taktī, ko jūt divās grupās pa trim.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Find your voice and sing in tune
rows.translation: Atrodiet savu balsi un dziediet tīri
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Stand tall, breathe low, hold your first steady note and sing a song.
rows.translation: Stāviet taisni, elpojiet zemu, noturiet pirmo stabilo noti un nodziediet dziesmu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and knees soft. Let your shoulders drop and your head float up, as if a string lifts it. Keep your jaw loose.
rows.translation: Stāviet ar pēdām gurnu platumā un brīviem ceļgaliem. Ļaujiet pleciem nolaisties un galvai tiekties augšup, it kā to celtu aukla. Turiet žokli brīvu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rest a hand on your belly and breathe in slowly. Your belly and lower ribs widen while your shoulders stay still. That low breath powers your voice.
rows.translation: Uzlieciet roku uz vēdera un lēni ieelpojiet. Vēders un apakšējās ribas paplašinās, bet pleci paliek nekustīgi. Šī zemā elpa dod balsij spēku.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: When you breathe in to sing, what should move?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A low breath widens your ribs and belly. Lifting your shoulders tightens your neck and throat.
rows.translation: Zema elpa paplašina ribas un vēderu. Plecu celšana sasprindzina kaklu un rīkli.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Timbre listens for the note's name, so a C sung low or high both count. Pick the octave that feels easy, never strained.
rows.translation: Timbre klausās nots nosaukumu, tāpēc der gan zemu, gan augstu dziedāts C. Izvēlieties oktāvu, kurā ir viegli un nekad nav sasprindzinājuma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Breathe low, then sing C on "ah" in a comfortable octave. Hold it steady.
rows.translation: Ieelpojiet zemu, tad dziediet C uz „ā” ērtā oktāvā. Turiet to stabili.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Once more: stand tall, breathe low, and let the note ring.
rows.translation: Vēlreiz: stāviet taisni, elpojiet zemu un ļaujiet notij skanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: To sustain is to hold a note at one steady pitch. Let the air out slowly and evenly, like fogging a mirror without stopping.
rows.translation: Noturēt noti nozīmē saglabāt vienu nemainīgu augstumu. Izlaidiet gaisu lēni un vienmērīgi, it kā nepārtraukti aizsvīdinātu spoguli.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing C on "ah" and hold it steady until it locks in.
rows.translation: Dziediet C uz „ā” un turiet stabili, līdz tas sakrīt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your note wobbles and fades. What helps most?
rows.translation: Nots svārstās un izdziest. Kas palīdz visvairāk?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Steady air makes a steady note. Extra volume and tension make it harder to control.
rows.translation: Vienmērīgs gaiss rada stabilu noti. Lielāks skaļums un sasprindzinājums apgrūtina kontroli.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now E. Same low breath, same easy "ah."
rows.translation: Tagad E. Tā pati zemā elpa, tas pats vieglais „ā”.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing "ah" with your jaw dropped and the tip of your tongue resting behind your lower teeth. The sound flows out instead of getting squeezed.
rows.translation: Dziediet „ā” ar nolaistu žokli un mēles galu aiz apakšējiem zobiem. Skaņa plūst ārā, nevis tiek saspiesta.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G this time. Drop your jaw and keep the "ah" open.
rows.translation: Šoreiz G. Nolaidiet žokli un turiet „ā” atvērtu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Matching pitch means singing the same note you hear. Listen, imagine the note for a moment, then sing softly and adjust until it settles.
rows.translation: Trāpīt skaņas augstumā nozīmē dziedāt to pašu noti, ko dzirdat. Klausieties, mirkli iztēlojieties noti, tad dziediet klusi un pielāgojiet, līdz tā nostājas vietā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing E softly, then adjust until it settles.
rows.translation: Klusi dziediet E, tad pielāgojiet, līdz tas nostājas vietā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Flat means under the target pitch; sharp means over it. If you're flat, lift a little. If you're sharp, ease down. Small moves work best.
rows.translation: Par zemu nozīmē zem mērķa augstuma; par augstu — virs tā. Ja esat par zemu, mazliet paceliet. Ja par augstu, viegli nolaidiet. Vislabāk darbojas mazas kustības.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Timbre says you're flat. What do you do?
rows.translation: Timbre rāda, ka esat par zemu. Ko darāt?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Flat means under the note, so lift the pitch slightly.
rows.translation: Par zemu nozīmē zem nots, tāpēc nedaudz paceliet skaņas augstumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two notes this time: D, then G. Take a breath between them.
rows.translation: Šoreiz divas notis: D, tad G. Starp tām ieelpojiet.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Humming with your lips closed is a gentle warm-up. You should feel a light buzz on your lips and nose. Keep it soft and easy.
rows.translation: Dūkšana ar aizvērtām lūpām ir saudzīga iesildīšanās. Lūpās un degunā vajadzētu just vieglu vibrāciju. Dūciet klusi un viegli.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hum C, E and G, one at a time. Keep it light.
rows.translation: Izdūciet C, E un G pa vienai notij. Saglabājiet vieglumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Close your lips loosely and blow so they flutter like a motorboat, then add your voice. It keeps your throat relaxed while your voice wakes up.
rows.translation: Brīvi sakļaujiet lūpas un pūtiet, lai tās plivinātos kā motorlaiva, tad pievienojiet balsi. Tas atslābina rīkli, kamēr balss mostas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lip trill on G, E, then C. If your lips stop, press your cheeks lightly.
rows.translation: Veiciet lūpu trilleri uz G, E, tad C. Ja lūpas apstājas, viegli piespiediet vaigus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A note feels tight or scratchy. What do you do?
rows.translation: Nots rada sasprindzinājumu vai skrāpējošu sajūtu. Ko darāt?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Stop, rest, and try it softer
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Strain is a signal to ease off. Rest, sip some water, and come back lighter.
rows.translation: Sasprindzinājums ir signāls mazināt slodzi. Atpūtieties, iedzeriet malku ūdens un atsāciet vieglāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Stand tall, breathe low, and start each note softly. Rest between steps if your voice feels tired.
rows.translation: Stāviet taisni, elpojiet zemu un sāciet katru noti klusi. Ja balss jūtas nogurusi, atpūtieties starp uzdevumiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E, then G. Hear each one before you sing it.
rows.translation: E, tad G. Pirms dziedat, sadzirdiet katru noti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sharp is over the target pitch; flat is under it.
