rows.translation: Par augstu ir virs mērķa augstuma; par zemu — zem tā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing D softly, then adjust until it settles.
rows.translation: Klusi dziediet D, tad pielāgojiet, līdz tas nostājas vietā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: E, D and C, each a step from the next. Sing it where it feels easy; Timbre hears the right note in any octave.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb vajag trīs notis: E, D un C, katra soli no nākamās. Dziediet tur, kur ir ērti; Timbre sadzird pareizo noti jebkurā oktāvā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E, D, C: three steps down to home.
rows.translation: E, D, C: trīs pakāpes lejup uz mājām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ma-ry had a lit-tle lamb: E D C D E E E.
rows.translation: Ma-ry had a lit-tle lamb: E D C D E E E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hear a note, sing it back, and move by small steps.
rows.translation: Sadzirdiet noti, atdziediet to un virzieties maziem soļiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Before you sing, hear the note in your head for a second. That pause lets your voice aim for the pitch instead of hunting for it.
rows.translation: Pirms dziedat, uz mirkli sadzirdiet noti prātā. Šī pauze ļauj balsij mērķēt uz augstumu, nevis to meklēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hear D in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: Sadzirdiet prātā D, tad nodziediet to.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hear F in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: Sadzirdiet prātā F, tad nodziediet to.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your first try lands flat. What next?
rows.translation: Pirmais mēģinājums ir par zemu. Ko tālāk?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Small changes find the note fastest. Lift gently and let it settle.
rows.translation: Mazas pārmaiņas atrod noti visātrāk. Maigi paceliet un ļaujiet tai nostāties vietā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hear A in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: Sadzirdiet prātā A, tad nodziediet to.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Three notes in a row: D, F, A.
rows.translation: Trīs notis pēc kārtas: D, F, A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Unison means two sounds on exactly the same pitch. When they match, they blend into one; when they're slightly off, you hear a wobble.
rows.translation: Unisons ir divas skaņas tieši vienā augstumā. Sakrītot tās saplūst vienā; ja mazliet atšķiras, dzirdat svārstīšanos.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing E and hold it in tune.
rows.translation: Dziediet E un noturiet tīru skaņojumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: To sing the same note twice, stop the air for a moment, then start again on a soft "da." Don't slide between them.
rows.translation: Lai nodziedātu vienu noti divreiz, uz mirkli apturiet gaisu, tad sāciet vēlreiz ar maigu „da”. Neslīdiet starp notīm.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing E three times on "da," with a tiny gap each time.
rows.translation: Dziediet E trīsreiz uz „da”, katrreiz ar mazu atstarpi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A step is the next note
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A step moves to the next note of a scale, up or down. Steps are the smallest, easiest moves to sing in tune.
rows.translation: Solis ved uz nākamo gammas noti augšup vai lejup. Soļi ir mazākās kustības, ko visvieglāk nodziedāt tīri.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Did it go up or down?
rows.translation: Vai tas gāja augšup vai lejup?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A half step is the smallest step, like E to F, with no note between. Most neighboring scale notes, like C and D, are a whole step apart: two half steps.
rows.translation: Pustonis ir vismazākais solis, piemēram, E līdz F, bez nots starp tiem. Lielāko daļu blakus gammas nošu, piemēram, C un D, šķir tonis — divi pustoņi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E, up a half step to F, and back.
rows.translation: E, pustoni augšup uz F un atpakaļ.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hear each note in your head first, start softly, and adjust in small moves. Give repeated notes a fresh start.
rows.translation: Vispirms sadzirdiet katru noti prātā, sāciet klusi un pielāgojiet ar mazām kustībām. Atkārtotas notis sāciet no jauna.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hear G in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: Sadzirdiet prātā G, tad nodziediet to.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B, up a half step to C, and back.
rows.translation: B, pustoni augšup uz C un atpakaļ.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E to F has no note between them. C to D and G to A are whole steps.
rows.translation: Starp E un F nav nots. C līdz D un G līdz A ir toņi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing do-re-mi, the major scale, and five-note patterns.
rows.translation: Dziediet do-re-mi, mažora gammu un piecu nošu rakstus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Solfege gives each step of the scale a syllable: do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do. Do is home, wherever the scale starts.
rows.translation: Solmizācija katrai gammas pakāpei dod zilbi: do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do. Do ir mājas neatkarīgi no tā, kur sākas gamma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing do, re, mi on C, D, E.
rows.translation: Dziediet do, re, mi uz C, D, E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which syllable is home, the first step of the scale?
rows.translation: Kura zilbe ir mājas — gammas pirmā pakāpe?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do is the first step and the note a scale comes back to.
rows.translation: Do ir pirmā pakāpe un nots, uz kuru gamma atgriežas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now back down: mi, re, do.
rows.translation: Tagad atpakaļ lejup: mi, re, do.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: the first five steps carry many simple tunes. Sing them up and back down on one breath if it feels easy.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: pirmās piecas pakāpes veido daudzas vienkāršas melodijas. Ja ir ērti, dziediet tās augšup un atpakaļ lejup vienā elpā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: C up to G.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: C augšup līdz G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Between which two steps is there a half step?
rows.translation: Starp kurām divām pakāpēm ir pustonis?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mi to fa (E to F) is a half step. The other steps from do to sol are whole steps.
rows.translation: Mi līdz fa (E līdz F) ir pustonis. Pārējie soļi no do līdz sol ir toņi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sol back down to do: G down to C.
rows.translation: Sol atpakaļ lejup līdz do: G lejup līdz C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The major scale runs from do up to the next do: eight notes. Mi to fa and ti to do are half steps; every other step is a whole step.
rows.translation: Mažora gamma iet no do augšup līdz nākamajam do — astoņas notis. Mi līdz fa un ti līdz do ir pustoņi; visi pārējie soļi ir toņi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do to do: C up to the next C.
rows.translation: Do līdz do: C augšup līdz nākamajam C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where are the half steps in a major scale?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mi-fa and ti-do are half steps. That pattern gives the major scale its sound.
rows.translation: Mi-fa un ti-do ir pustoņi. Šī shēma rada mažora gammas skanējumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Take a low breath before you start so you don't run out near the top. Let high notes get lighter, not louder, and keep your jaw loose.
rows.translation: Pirms sākuma ieelpojiet zemu, lai augšā nepietrūktu elpas. Augstajām notīm jābūt vieglākām, nevis skaļākām, un žoklim — brīvam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Back down from C to C. Keep each lower note bright so it doesn't sag flat.
rows.translation: Atpakaļ lejup no C līdz C. Saglabājiet katru zemāko noti gaišu, lai tā nenoslīdētu par zemu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Short patterns like do-re-mi-re-do build accuracy fast. Sing one, then start it a step higher and let the scale guide you.
rows.translation: Īsi raksti, piemēram, do-re-mi-re-do, ātri attīsta precizitāti. Nodziediet vienu, tad sāciet to soli augstāk un ļaujiet gammai jūs vadīt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do up to sol and back: C to G to C.
rows.translation: Do augšup līdz sol un atpakaļ: C līdz G līdz C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing C-D-E-D-C, then the same shape one step higher. What's the top note now?
rows.translation: Dziediet C-D-E-D-C, tad to pašu formu vienu pakāpi augstāk. Kura tagad ir augšējā nots?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: One step higher, the shape becomes D, E, F, E, D.
rows.translation: Vienu pakāpi augstāk forma kļūst D, E, F, E, D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Breathe low before each scale, keep the top light, and keep lower notes bright on the way down.
rows.translation: Pirms katras gammas elpojiet zemu, augšā saglabājiet vieglumu un lejupceļā zemākās notis turiet gaišas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many notes are in a major scale, do to do?
rows.translation: Cik nošu ir mažora gammā no do līdz do?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do: eight notes, with do at both ends.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do: astoņas notis ar do abos galos.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Leap by thirds, fifths and octaves, and land in tune.
rows.translation: Leciet tercās, kvintās un oktāvās un nonāciet tīrā skaņojumā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: An interval is the distance between two notes. Skip one scale step and you get a third, like do to mi. Hear mi in your head before you leave do.
rows.translation: Intervāls ir attālums starp divām notīm. Izlaidiet vienu gammas pakāpi un iegūsiet tercu, piemēram, do līdz mi. Pirms atstājat do, sadzirdiet mi prātā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do to mi and back: C, E, C.
rows.translation: Do līdz mi un atpakaļ: C, E, C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Vēl viena terca: D, F, D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C to E skips over D, so it spans three scale notes: a third.
rows.translation: C līdz E izlaiž D, tāpēc aptver trīs gammas notis — tercu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do to sol spans five scale notes, a fifth. It sounds open and strong. Picture the steps in between, then jump straight to sol.
rows.translation: Do līdz sol aptver piecas gammas notis — kvintu. Tā skan plaši un spēcīgi. Iztēlojieties pakāpes pa vidu, tad leciet tieši uz sol.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do to sol and back: C, G, C.
rows.translation: Do līdz sol un atpakaļ: C, G, C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do, mi, sol: two thirds stack up to a fifth.
rows.translation: Do, mi, sol: divas tercas kopā veido kvintu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Counting both ends, how many scale notes from do to sol?
rows.translation: Cik gammas nošu ir no do līdz sol, skaitot abus galus?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: five notes, so it's a fifth.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: piecas notis, tātad kvinta.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Tas pats nosaukums, astoņas notis augšup
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: An octave leaps from do to the next do, eight scale notes up. The two notes share a name and blend so well they almost sound like one.
rows.translation: Oktāva lec no do uz nākamo do, astoņas gammas notis augšup. Abām notīm ir viens nosaukums, un tās saplūst tik labi, ka gandrīz skan kā viena.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Before an octave leap, breathe low and keep your chin level. Think of the top note as light and easy, not a stretch upward.
rows.translation: Pirms oktāvas lēciena ieelpojiet zemu un turiet zodu līmenī. Domājiet par augšējo noti kā vieglu un ērtu, nevis stiepšanos augšup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, then G, then the high C. Use the G as a stepping stone.
rows.translation: C, tad G, tad augstais C. Izmantojiet G kā starppakāpienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why do the two notes of an octave blend so well?
rows.translation: Kāpēc abas oktāvas notis tik labi saplūst?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The top one vibrates twice as fast
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The top note vibrates exactly twice as fast as the bottom one, so their waves line up.
rows.translation: Augšējā nots svārstās tieši divreiz ātrāk par apakšējo, tāpēc to viļņi sakrīt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hear each leap in your head before you sing it. Land lightly on the top note, then step home.
rows.translation: Pirms dziedat, sadzirdiet katru lēcienu prātā. Viegli nonāciet uz augšējās nots, tad soļojiet mājup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: High do, sol, mi, do: back down.
rows.translation: Augstais do, sol, mi, do: atpakaļ lejup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What is the interval from do to the next do?
rows.translation: Kāds intervāls ir no do līdz nākamajam do?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do to the next do spans eight scale notes: an octave.
rows.translation: Do līdz nākamajam do aptver astoņas gammas notis — oktāvu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Five public-domain tunes, melody only, at an easy pace.
rows.translation: Piecas publiskajā domēnā esošas melodijas, tikai melodija, ērtā tempā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This traditional melody leaps up, then steps back down home. Sing it on "loo" and give each repeated note a fresh start.
rows.translation: Šī tradicionālā melodija lec augšup, tad soļo lejup uz mājām. Dziediet to uz „lū” un katru atkārtoto noti sāciet no jauna.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening leap: C up to G, step to A, back to G.
rows.translation: Sākuma lēciens: C augšup līdz G, solis līdz A, atpakaļ uz G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The middle phrase: does it go up or down?
rows.translation: Vidējā frāze: vai tā iet augšup vai lejup?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This melody from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony moves almost entirely by step. Keep it smooth and even, like walking up and down a staircase.
rows.translation: Šī Bēthovena Devītās simfonijas melodija virzās gandrīz tikai pa pakāpēm. Saglabājiet plūdumu un vienmērību kā ejot augšup un lejup pa kāpnēm.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The five notes the tune lives on: F up to C.
rows.translation: Piecas melodijas notis: F augšup līdz C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first phrase ends with a dotted note. How does it feel?
rows.translation: Pirmā frāze beidzas ar punktētu noti. Kāda ir sajūta?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The dotted note is held longer, then a short note leads into the last one.
rows.translation: Punktēto noti tur ilgāk, tad īsa nots ved uz pēdējo.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This traditional Scottish melody starts with a pickup, a note before the first full bar. Sing it lightly, then lean on the next note.
rows.translation: Šī tradicionālā skotu melodija sākas ar uztakti — noti pirms pirmās pilnās takts. Dziediet to viegli, tad uzsveriet nākamo noti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The climb in the third bar: F, A, C, up to D.
rows.translation: Kāpiens trešajā taktī: F, A, C, augšup līdz D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The loudest note of a song
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A note before the first full bar
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A pickup leads into beat 1 of the first full bar.
rows.translation: Uztakts ved uz pirmās pilnās takts 1. sitienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This American hymn tune from the early 1800s is in 3/4: count 1, 2, 3. Long notes often turn into a quick pair, so keep the pair light.
rows.translation: Šī amerikāņu himnas melodija no 1800. gadā sāktā gadsimta sākuma ir 3/4: skaitiet 1, 2, 3. Garās notis bieži pāriet ātrā pārī, tāpēc saglabājiet pāra vieglumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The quick turn: F, up to A, back to F.
rows.translation: Ātrais pavērsiens: F, augšup līdz A, atpakaļ uz F.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many beats are in each bar of this hymn?
rows.translation: Cik sitienu ir katrā šīs himnas taktī?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: It's in 3/4: three beats per bar, with the weight on 1.
rows.translation: Tā ir 3/4: trīs sitieni taktī ar uzsvaru uz 1.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This American folk song from the 1800s moves slowly, with wide leaps. Breathe at each rest, and hear every leap before you sing it.
rows.translation: Šī amerikāņu tautasdziesma no 1800. gadā sāktā gadsimta virzās lēni, ar platiem lēcieniem. Ieelpojiet katrā pauzē un pirms dziedāšanas sadzirdiet katru lēcienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening leap: low G up to C. Any octave counts.
rows.translation: Sākuma lēciens: zemais G augšup līdz C. Der jebkura oktāva.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The big leap: G up to high C, then step down.
rows.translation: Lielais lēciens: G augšup līdz augstajam C, tad pa pakāpēm lejup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where should you breathe in this song?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Never; sing it in one breath
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The rests mark the ends of phrases. Breathe there so each line has full support.
rows.translation: Pauzes iezīmē frāžu beigas. Ieelpojiet tur, lai katrai rindai būtu pilns elpas balsts.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Five tunes back to back, one phrase each. Breathe at every rest, and give repeated notes a fresh start.
rows.translation: Piecas melodijas pēc kārtas, pa vienai frāzei no katras. Ieelpojiet katrā pauzē un atkārtotās notis sāciet no jauna.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these songs is in 3/4?
rows.translation: Kura no šīm dziesmām ir 3/4 taktsmērā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Amazing Grace counts 1, 2, 3 in every bar.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold notes steady, shape loud and soft, and warm up well.
rows.translation: Turiet notis stabili, veidojiet skaļu un klusu skanējumu un labi iesildieties.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pitch drifts when the air behind it changes. Keep a low, even breath and watch the note stay centered from start to finish.
rows.translation: Skaņas augstums novirzās, ja mainās to balstošais gaiss. Saglabājiet zemu, vienmērīgu elpu un vērojiet, kā nots paliek centrā no sākuma līdz beigām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold G and keep it centered.
rows.translation: Turiet G un saglabājiet to centrā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Notes often sag flat as your air runs out. Stop a little before you're empty, then take a fresh low breath.
rows.translation: Kad gaiss izsīkst, notis bieži noslīd par zemu. Apstājieties mazliet pirms elpas beigām, tad no jauna ieelpojiet zemu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your long notes go flat at the end. What helps?
rows.translation: Garās notis beigās noslīd par zemu. Kas palīdz?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: End the note sooner and breathe
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pitch sags when you run low on air. Ending a bit early keeps the whole note in tune.
rows.translation: Skaņas augstums krītas, kad trūkst gaisa. Pabeidzot mazliet agrāk, visa nots paliek tīrā skaņojumā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Vibrato is a gentle, regular wave in pitch, around five to seven times a second. It grows out of a relaxed throat and steady breath, not out of shaking.
rows.translation: Vibrato ir maigs, regulārs skaņas augstuma vilnis apmēram piecas līdz septiņas reizes sekundē. Tas rodas no brīvas rīkles un stabilas elpas, nevis kratīšanas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where does healthy vibrato come from?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A relaxed throat and steady breath
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Vibrato appears when the voice is free and supported. Forcing it from the jaw or belly makes a wobble.
rows.translation: Vibrato parādās, kad balss ir brīva un balstīta. Spiežot to ar žokli vai vēderu, rodas ļodzīga skaņa.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Learn to hold a straight, steady note before you chase vibrato. When your voice is relaxed and supported, vibrato often appears on its own.
rows.translation: Pirms tiecaties pēc vibrato, iemācieties noturēt taisnu, stabilu noti. Kad balss ir brīva un balstīta, vibrato bieži parādās pats.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A straight, steady A. No wave, just a clear line.
rows.translation: Taisns, stabils A. Bez viļņa, tikai skaidra līnija.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What's the best first goal for a new singer?
rows.translation: Kāds ir labākais pirmais mērķis jaunam dziedātājam?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A steady tone is the foundation. Vibrato that grows from it sounds natural.
rows.translation: Stabils tonis ir pamats. No tā izaugošs vibrato skan dabiski.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Dynamics are how loud or soft you sing. Get louder with more breath energy, not by squeezing your throat. The pitch should stay put.
rows.translation: Dinamika ir tas, cik skaļi vai klusi dziedat. Kļūstiet skaļāki ar lielāku elpas enerģiju, nevis saspiežot rīkli. Skaņas augstumam jāpaliek vietā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing E softly, then louder on the same pitch.
rows.translation: Dziediet E klusi, tad skaļāk tajā pašā augstumā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: As you get louder, what can happen to pitch?
rows.translation: Kas var notikt ar augstumu, dziedot skaļāk?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Extra push tends to raise the pitch, and very soft notes can sag flat. Watch the note either way.
rows.translation: Papildu spiediens mēdz celt augstumu, bet ļoti klusas notis var noslīdēt par zemu. Abos gadījumos vērojiet noti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A swell grows from soft to louder and back on one breath. Start quietly, grow gently, then fade, all on the same pitch.
rows.translation: Vienā elpā skaņa aug no klusas līdz skaļākai un atpakaļ. Sāciet klusi, maigi pastipriniet, tad apklusiniet — visu laiku vienā augstumā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Swell on G: soft, louder, soft. Keep it centered.
rows.translation: Pastipriniet G: klusi, skaļāk, klusi. Saglabājiet to centrā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A short warm-up eases your voice in: breathe low, hum, lip trill, then sing a scale. Start in the middle of your range and stay comfortable.
rows.translation: Īsa iesildīšanās saudzīgi sagatavo balsi: elpojiet zemu, dūciet, veiciet lūpu trilleri, tad dziediet gammu. Sāciet diapazona vidū un palieciet ērtā zonā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your voice feels tired after practice. What's best?
rows.translation: Pēc vingrināšanās balss jūtas nogurusi. Kas ir vislabāk?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rest helps a tired voice recover. If hoarseness lingers for a few weeks, check with a doctor.
rows.translation: Atpūta palīdz nogurušai balsij atjaunoties. Ja aizsmakums saglabājas dažas nedēļas, konsultējieties ar ārstu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Warm up first. Then hold each note steady, shape it soft and loud, and breathe before you run out.
rows.translation: Vispirms iesildieties. Tad katru noti turiet stabili, veidojiet klusu un skaļu skanējumu un ieelpojiet, pirms gaiss beidzies.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Vibrato is a gentle, even wave around the note, a few times a second.
rows.translation: Vibrato ir maigs, vienmērīgs vilnis ap noti dažas reizes sekundē.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: To sing louder, what do you add?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Breath energy makes a bigger sound without strain.
rows.translation: Elpas enerģija rada lielāku skaņu bez sasprindzinājuma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play the melody, or strum the chords and sing
rows.translation: Spēlējiet melodiju vai velciet akordus un dziediet
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Six famous tunes, one note at a time, on the top strings. Slow tempos, big wins.
rows.translation: Sešas slavenas melodijas pa vienai notij uz augšējām stīgām. Lēni tempi, lieli panākumi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In 1877, Thomas Edison recited this rhyme to test his new phonograph. The tune uses C and D on string 2, then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: 1877. gadā Tomass Edisons deklamēja šo pantiņu, lai izmēģinātu jauno fonogrāfu. Melodijā ir C un D uz 2. stīgas, tad brīvais E un G uz 1. stīgas 3. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, then string 2 at frets 3 and 1, and back.
rows.translation: E D C D E E E: brīvā 1. stīga, tad 2. stīga 3. un 1. ladā un atpakaļ.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D D D at fret 3 on string 2. Then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: D D D 2. stīgas 3. ladā. Tad brīvais E un G uz 1. stīgas 3. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This melody was first printed in France in 1761, and Mozart later wrote twelve variations on it. It leaps up, then steps down across strings 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Šī melodija pirmoreiz iespiesta Francijā 1761. gadā, un Mocarts vēlāk uzrakstīja par to divpadsmit variācijas. Tā lec augšup, tad soļo lejup pa 2. un 3. stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open G, a leap up to D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, and back to D.
rows.translation: Brīvais G, lēciens augšup līdz D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, brīvais E un atpakaļ uz D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Step down in pairs: C at fret 1, open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G.
rows.translation: Lejup pa pāriem: C 1. ladā, brīvais B, A 3. stīgas 2. ladā, brīvais G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which other song uses this same tune?
rows.translation: Kura cita dziesma izmanto šo pašu melodiju?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The alphabet song and Baa, Baa, Black Sheep both borrow this French melody.
rows.translation: Alfabēta dziesma un Baa, Baa, Black Sheep abas aizņemas šo franču melodiju.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beethoven finished his Ninth Symphony in 1824, and this melody is now the anthem of the European Union. Here you'll play the whole tune, middle section included.
rows.translation: Bēthovens pabeidza Devīto simfoniju 1824. gadā, un šī melodija tagad ir Eiropas Savienības himna. Šeit spēlēsiet visu melodiju, ieskaitot vidusdaļu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening: E E F G G F E D, one step at a time.
rows.translation: Sākums: E E F G G F E D, pa vienai pakāpei.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the middle section, E and F share a single beat. Count one, two-and, three, four, and play E on two and F on the and.
rows.translation: Vidusdaļā E un F dala vienu sitienu. Skaitiet viens, divi-un, trīs, četri, un spēlējiet E uz divi, F uz „un”.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The middle: quick E F pairs on string 1, then down to open G on string 3.
rows.translation: Vidusdaļa: ātri E F pāri uz 1. stīgas, tad lejup līdz brīvajam G uz 3. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Frère Jacques is a French round, first printed around 1780: a second player starts the same tune two bars later, and the parts fit together.
rows.translation: Frère Jacques ir franču kanons, pirmoreiz iespiests ap 1780. gadu: otrs spēlētājs sāk to pašu melodiju divas taktis vēlāk, un partijas sader kopā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In a round, the second player…
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Everyone plays the same melody, each starting a little later. The phrases are built to fit on top of each other.
rows.translation: Visi spēlē to pašu melodiju, katrs sākot mazliet vēlāk. Frāzes veidotas tā, lai skanētu cita virs citas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The quick part: D E D C on strings 2 and 1, then B and G.
rows.translation: Ātrā daļa: D E D C uz 2. un 1. stīgas, tad B un G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The ending dips from open G to open D on string 4, then comes back.
rows.translation: Beigas nolaižas no brīvā G uz brīvo D 4. stīgā, tad atgriežas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: James Lord Pierpont published this song in 1857 as One Horse Open Sleigh. You'll play its famous chorus, all on strings 1 and 2.
rows.translation: James Lord Pierpont šo dziesmu publicēja 1857. gadā ar nosaukumu One Horse Open Sleigh. Spēlēsiet tās slaveno piedziedājumu, visu uz 1. un 2. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open E, G at fret 3, down to C and D on string 2, then home to E.
rows.translation: Brīvais E, G 3. ladā, lejup uz C un D 2. stīgā, tad mājup uz E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In that phrase, C rings for a beat and a half and D slips in on the and of four. Count one, two, three, four-and.
rows.translation: Šajā frāzē C skan pusotru sitienu, un D ieslīd uz ceturtā sitiena „un”. Skaitiet viens, divi, trīs, četri-un.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The second line sits on F at fret 1, then settles onto open E.
rows.translation: Otrā rinda paliek uz F 1. ladā, tad norimst uz brīvā E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This traditional spiritual became a jazz standard after Louis Armstrong recorded it in 1938. It uses C, D, E, F and G on strings 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Šī tradicionālā spiričuela kļuva par džeza standartu pēc tam, kad Luiss Ārmstrongs to ierakstīja 1938. gadā. Tajā ir C, D, E, F un G uz 2. un 1. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening: C on string 2, then E, F and G climbing string 1.
rows.translation: Sākums: C uz 2. stīgas, tad E, F un G kāpj pa 1. stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new notes here: all six tunes from this unit, each a little faster than before. Name the opening by ear, then play.
rows.translation: Šeit nav jaunu nošu: visas sešas šīs nodaļas melodijas, katra mazliet ātrāk nekā iepriekš. Pēc dzirdes nosauciet sākumu, tad spēlējiet.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Campfire songs and a sea song, with easy chords to strum on the simplest ones.
rows.translation: Ugunskura dziesmas un jūras dziesma ar viegliem akordiem vienkāršāko dziesmu pavadīšanai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Stephen Foster published this song in 1848, and gold seekers heading to California made it their anthem. The verse sits on strings 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Stīvens Fosters publicēja šo dziesmu 1848. gadā, un zelta meklētāji ceļā uz Kaliforniju padarīja to par savu himnu. Pants skan uz 3., 2. un 1. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open B, D at fret 3, open E, then back down to open G and A at fret 2.
rows.translation: Brīvais B, D 3. ladā, brīvais E, tad atpakaļ lejup uz brīvo G un A 2. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The last bar: B B A A, then home to open G.
rows.translation: Pēdējā takts: B B A A, tad mājup uz brīvo G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G sounds like home, and D7 pulls back toward it. The verse is three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: G skan kā mājas, un D7 velk atpakaļ uz to. Pantā ir trīs G taktis, viena D7, divas G, tad D7 un G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Stephen Foster wrote this racing song in 1850, two years after Oh! Susanna. It uses the same notes and the same two chords.
rows.translation: Stīvens Fosters šo sacīkšu dziesmu sarakstīja 1850. gadā, divus gadus pēc Oh! Susanna. Tajā ir tās pašas notis un tie paši divi akordi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D D B D, up to open E, then D and B. Strings 2 and 1.
rows.translation: D D B D, augšup uz brīvo E, tad D un B. 2. un 1. stīga.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Twice in the first line, a quick B leads into an A that rings for three beats. Pick the A once and let it ring.
rows.translation: Pirmajā rindā divreiz ātrs B ved uz A, kas skan trīs sitienus. A iesvārstiet vienreiz un ļaujiet tam skanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This farmyard song was first printed in 1917, but people sang versions of it long before. Its tune reaches down to D and E on string 4.
rows.translation: Šī lauku sētas dziesma pirmoreiz iespiesta 1917. gadā, taču tās versijas dziedātas jau krietni agrāk. Melodija sniedzas lejup līdz D un E uz 4. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open G three times, down to open D, E at fret 2 on string 4, back to D.
rows.translation: Brīvais G trīsreiz, lejup uz brīvo D, E 4. stīgas 2. ladā, atpakaļ uz D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Then up: open B twice, A at fret 2 on string 3, and home to open G.
rows.translation: Tad augšup: brīvais B divreiz, A 3. stīgas 2. ladā un mājup uz brīvo G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Here each chord lasts two beats, so the strum counts one, two. The order is G, G, C, G, then G, D7, G, G. Change early.
rows.translation: Šeit katrs akords ilgst divus sitienus, tāpēc pārvilkumu skaita viens, divi. Secība ir G, G, C, G, tad G, D7, G, G. Mainiet laikus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: British soldiers first sang this tune to mock American colonists. By the end of the Revolution, the Americans had made it their own.
rows.translation: Britu karavīri sākotnēji dziedāja šo melodiju, lai izsmietu Amerikas kolonistus. Revolūcijas beigās amerikāņi to bija padarījuši par savu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C C D E, C E D, then a drop to open G on string 3.
rows.translation: C C D E, C E D, tad kritiens uz brīvo G 3. stīgā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first half ends on B. How does that feel?
rows.translation: Pirmā puse beidzas uz B. Kāda ir sajūta?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B sits just below C and leans toward it. The second half answers by landing on C.
rows.translation: B ir tieši zem C un tiecas uz to. Otrā puse atbild, nonākot uz C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The last line: down from F on string 1, dip to open G, then climb back to C.
rows.translation: Pēdējā rinda: lejup no F 1. stīgā, nolaišanās līdz brīvajam G, tad kāpiens atpakaļ uz C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chorus sits low: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, then F and E on string 4 and C on string 5.
rows.translation: Piedziedājums skan zemu: A 3. stīgas 2. ladā, brīvais B, tad F un E uz 4. stīgas un C uz 5. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: George Poulton published this ballad in 1861. Nearly a century later, its melody became the tune of Love Me Tender.
rows.translation: George Poulton publicēja šo balādi 1861. gadā. Gandrīz gadsimtu vēlāk tās melodija kļuva par Love Me Tender melodiju.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Up to C, down to open B and back, then D, a dip to A, and D again.
rows.translation: Augšup uz C, lejup uz brīvo B un atpakaļ, tad D, nolaišanās līdz A un atkal D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Aura Lee is a slow ballad. Keep each finger down until the next note sounds, so the notes join smoothly.
rows.translation: Aura Lee ir lēna balāde. Katru pirkstu turiet piespiestu, līdz skan nākamā nots, lai notis savienotos plūstoši.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The high part: open E, F at fret 1, then down to D, A, and D again.
rows.translation: Augstā daļa: brīvais E, F 1. ladā, tad lejup uz D, A un atkal D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This song from the north of England is about Bobby Shafto, gone to sea. Its words were in print by 1805, and fiddlers played its tune for dances by 1770.
rows.translation: Šī dziesma no Anglijas ziemeļiem ir par Bobby Shafto, kurš devies jūrā. Vārdi bija iespiesti jau 1805. gadā, bet vijolnieki tās melodiju dejām spēlēja jau 1770. gadā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open B, D at fret 3, back to B and open G, then B, D and B again.
rows.translation: Brīvais B, D 3. ladā, atpakaļ uz B un brīvo G, tad atkal B, D un B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The second line dips to F sharp: string 4, fret 4, with your little finger. Keep your hand over the first four frets so it's ready.
rows.translation: Otrā rinda nolaižas līdz F diēzam: 4. stīga, 4. lada ar mazo pirkstu. Turiet roku virs pirmajām četrām ladām, lai tā būtu gatava.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, C at fret 1 on string 2, A, down to F sharp, and back up.
rows.translation: A 3. stīgas 2. ladā, C 2. stīgas 1. ladā, A, lejup līdz F diēzam un atpakaļ augšup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first three lines end the same way: two notes of one beat, then one of two beats. Gone to sea, on his knee, marry me.
rows.translation: Pirmās trīs rindas beidzas vienādi: divas viena sitiena notis, tad viena divu sitienu nots. Gone to sea, on his knee, marry me.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The verse needs only the two chords from Oh! Susanna: two bars of G, two of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: Pantam vajag tikai abus Oh! Susanna akordus: divas G taktis, divas D7, divas G, tad D7 un G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new notes or chords: all six songs from this unit, one after another, each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Nav jaunu nošu vai akordu: visas sešas šīs nodaļas dziesmas cita pēc citas, katra mazliet ātrāk nekā iepriekš.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Famous themes by Pachelbel, Dvořák, Brahms, Petzold, Grieg and Beethoven, in first position.
rows.translation: Slavenas Pahelbela, Dvoržāka, Brāmsa, Pecolda, Grīga un Bēthovena tēmas pirmajā pozīcijā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Johann Pachelbel wrote this canon over 300 years ago. Its bass repeats the same eight notes the whole way through while violins weave melodies above.
rows.translation: Johans Pahelbels šo kanonu sarakstīja pirms vairāk nekā 300 gadiem. Tā bass visu laiku atkārto tās pašas astoņas notis, kamēr vijoles virs tā auž melodijas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The bass, moved up an octave: D, A, B, F sharp, G, D, G, A.
rows.translation: Bass, pārcelts oktāvu augstāk: D, A, B, F diēzs, G, D, G, A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What does the bass do all through the Canon?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Plays a new tune each time
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A repeating bass like this is called a ground. Everything else in the piece is built on top of it.
rows.translation: Šādu atkārtotu basu sauc par basso ostinato. Viss pārējais skaņdarbā veidots virs tā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A sharp is one fret above its letter. The melody uses C sharp on string 2, fret 2, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.
rows.translation: Diēzs ir vienu ladu virs sava burta nots. Melodijā ir C diēzs uz 2. stīgas 2. ladā un F diēzs uz 4. stīgas 4. ladā. To aizsniedziet ar mazo pirkstu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first violin line: down from F sharp on string 1, then back up to C sharp.
rows.translation: Pirmās vijoles līnija: lejup no F diēza uz 1. stīgas, tad atpakaļ augšup līdz C diēzam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Antonín Dvořák wrote this theme for English horn in 1893, in his Symphony From the New World, while he was living in New York.
rows.translation: Antonīns Dvoržāks šo tēmu angļu ragam sarakstīja 1893. gadā simfonijā No Jaunās pasaules, dzīvojot Ņujorkā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, back to E, then D and C on string 2.
rows.translation: Brīvais E, G 1. stīgas 3. ladā, atpakaļ uz E, tad D un C uz 2. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Most bars open with a long note and a quick one. Count one, two-and, three: the quick note lands on the and of two.
rows.translation: Lielākā daļa taktu sākas ar garu un ātru noti. Skaitiet viens, divi-un, trīs: ātrā nots iekrīt uz otrā sitiena „un”.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The ending: D, E, D, then settle on C and let it ring.
rows.translation: Beigas: D, E, D, tad norimstiet uz C un ļaujiet tam skanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Johannes Brahms wrote this lullaby in 1868 for a friend's newborn son. It sways in three, like a cradle: a long note, then two quick ones.
rows.translation: Johanness Brāmss šo šūpuļdziesmu sarakstīja 1868. gadā drauga jaundzimušajam dēlam. Tā šūpojas pa trim kā šūpulis: gara nots, tad divas ātras.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening rocks between open B and D at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: Sākums šūpojas starp brīvo B un D 2. stīgas 3. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open G on string 3, then the same note an octave higher: G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: Brīvais G uz 3. stīgas, tad tā pati nots oktāvu augstāk: G 1. stīgas 3. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This minuet appears in a 1725 notebook Bach gave his wife, Anna Magdalena. Scholars now credit it to his fellow composer Christian Petzold.
rows.translation: Šis menuets ir 1725. gada nošu burtnīcā, ko Bahs uzdāvināja sievai Annai Magdalēnai. Pētnieki tagad to piedēvē viņa kolēģim komponistam Kristianam Pecoldam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, then climb from open G: A, B, C, D. Then two open Gs.
rows.translation: D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, tad kāpiet no brīvā G: A, B, C, D. Tad divi brīvie G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minuet is a dance in three. Most bars start with a long beat, then quick pairs: one, two-and, three-and.
rows.translation: Menuets ir deja trijdaļu metrā. Vairums taktu sākas ar garu sitienu, tad ātriem pāriem: viens, divi-un, trīs-un.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open E, back to C and D on string 2, then E, F sharp and G on string 1.
rows.translation: Brīvais E, atpakaļ uz C un D 2. stīgā, tad E, F diēzs un G uz 1. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The ending: A B A G, then F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, and home to G.
rows.translation: Beigas: A B A G, tad F diēzs 4. stīgas 4. ladā un mājup uz G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The second section starts low: open B, A, open D, then C sharp at fret 4 and B at fret 2 on string 5, and open A.
rows.translation: Otrā daļa sākas zemu: brīvais B, A, brīvais D, tad C diēzs 4. ladā un B 2. ladā uz 5. stīgas un brīvais A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the Hall of the Mountain King
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Grieg wrote this for the play Peer Gynt in 1875. It pictures trolls in their king's hall, and it starts quietly and keeps speeding up.
rows.translation: Grīgs to sarakstīja lugai Pērs Gints 1875. gadā. Tā attēlo troļļus viņu karaļa zālē, sākas klusi un arvien paātrinās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Climb from open string 6: F sharp at fret 2, G at fret 3, open A, B at fret 2.
rows.translation: Kāpiet no brīvās 6. stīgas: F diēzs 2. ladā, G 3. ladā, brīvais A, B 2. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The creeping part: A sharp at fret 1 on string 5, then open A with F at fret 1 on string 6.
rows.translation: Lavīgā daļa: A diēzs 5. stīgas 1. ladā, tad brīvais A ar F 6. stīgas 1. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where is A sharp on string 5?
rows.translation: Kur uz 5. stīgas ir A diēzs?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A sharp is one fret above A, and A is open string 5. So A sharp is fret 1.
rows.translation: A diēzs ir vienu ladu virs A, un A ir brīvā 5. stīga. Tātad A diēzs ir 1. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beethoven wrote this piano piece in 1810, but it wasn't published until 1867, forty years after he died. This simplified version keeps the famous opening.
rows.translation: Bēthovens šo klavierskaņdarbu sarakstīja 1810. gadā, bet to publicēja tikai 1867. gadā, četrdesmit gadus pēc viņa nāves. Šī vienkāršotā versija saglabā slaveno sākumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rock between open E and D sharp at fret 4 on string 2, then walk down B, D, C to A.
rows.translation: Šūpojieties starp brīvo E un D diēzu 2. stīgas 4. ladā, tad ejiet lejup caur B, D, C līdz A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each bar has three beats. After the long A comes a short rest, then three quick notes climb: C, E, A. Lift your finger for the rest, but keep counting.
rows.translation: Katrā taktī ir trīs sitieni. Pēc garā A ir īsa pauze, tad trīs ātras notis kāpj: C, E, A. Pauzē paceliet pirkstu, bet turpiniet skaitīt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A, then C on string 5, E and A. Then B, E, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, and B.
rows.translation: A, tad C uz 5. stīgas, E un A. Tad B, E, G diēzs 3. stīgas 1. ladā un B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The middle: each phrase dips to a low note, then steps down. E G F E, D F E D, C E D C.
rows.translation: Vidusdaļa: katra frāze nolaižas uz zemu noti, tad soļo lejup. E G F E, D F E D, C E D C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new notes: the six themes from this unit, from Pachelbel to Beethoven, each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Nav jaunu nošu: sešas šīs nodaļas tēmas no Pahelbela līdz Bēthovenam, katra mazliet ātrāk nekā iepriekš.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these pieces is in three?
rows.translation: Kurš no šiem skaņdarbiem ir trijdaļu metrā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minuet is a dance in three. The Canon and the trolls' march both count in four.
rows.translation: Menuets ir deja trijdaļu metrā. Gan Kanonu, gan troļļu maršu skaita pa četriem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A Gold Rush ballad, two beloved hymns and a Shaker song from America's songbook.
rows.translation: Zelta drudža balāde, divas iemīļotas himnas un šeikeru dziesma no Amerikas dziesmu pūra.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This American song was published in 1884 and looks back to the California Gold Rush of 1849. It's in three, on strings 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Šī amerikāņu dziesma publicēta 1884. gadā un atskatās uz Kalifornijas zelta drudzi 1849. gadā. Tā ir trijdaļu metrā uz 3., 2. un 1. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Clementine starts with two quick notes before beat one. What are they called?
rows.translation: Clementine sākas ar divām ātrām notīm pirms pirmā sitiena. Kā tās sauc?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into the first strong beat. Here they fall on the and of beat three.
rows.translation: Uztakts ir dažas notis, kas ved uz pirmo stipro sitienu. Šeit tās iekrīt uz trešā sitiena „un”.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The turn in the middle: G at fret 3 on string 1, down to D, then back up to F.
rows.translation: Pavērsiens vidū: G 1. stīgas 3. ladā, lejup uz D, tad atpakaļ augšup uz F.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: John Newton wrote the words in 1779. The tune, called New Britain, was first printed in 1829 and joined to his words in 1835.
rows.translation: John Newton vārdus sarakstīja 1779. gadā. Melodija New Britain pirmoreiz iespiesta 1829. gadā un ar viņa vārdiem savienota 1835. gadā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The high line: up to D at fret 3 on string 2, then B G, B A, G E D.
rows.translation: Augstā rinda: augšup līdz D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, tad B G, B A, G E D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Samuel Francis Smith wrote these American words in 1831, to a tune Britain already sang as God Save the King.
rows.translation: Samuel Francis Smith šos amerikāņu vārdus sarakstīja 1831. gadā melodijai, ko Britānijā jau dziedāja kā God Save the King.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A dot makes a note half again as long. In bar two, F sharp rings for a beat and a half, G slips in on the and of two, and A lands on three.
rows.translation: Punkts pagarina noti par pusi tās ilguma. Otrajā taktī F diēzs skan pusotru sitienu, G ieslīd uz otrā sitiena „un”, bet A nonāk uz trīs.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The last line: B C B A G, then B C D, up to open E, and down C B A G.
rows.translation: Pēdējā rinda: B C B A G, tad B C D, augšup uz brīvo E un lejup C B A G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Joseph Brackett wrote Simple Gifts in 1848 for the Shakers, who danced as they sang. Aaron Copland later built part of his ballet Appalachian Spring around it.
rows.translation: Joseph Brackett dziesmu Simple Gifts sarakstīja 1848. gadā šeikeriem, kuri dziedot dejoja. Ārons Koplends vēlāk uz tās balstīja daļu sava baleta Apalaču pavasaris.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The second part starts high: G at fret 3 on string 1, then E D, and E F E D C.
rows.translation: Otrā daļa sākas augstu: G 1. stīgas 3. ladā, tad E D un E F E D C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two notes share each beat in this tune. How do you count them?
rows.translation: Šajā melodijā divas notis dala katru sitienu. Kā tās skaitīt?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two even notes per beat are eighth notes. Say the number on the first and "and" on the second.
rows.translation: Divas vienmērīgas notis sitienā ir astotdaļnotis. Uz pirmās sakiet skaitli, uz otrās — „un”.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: the four songs from this unit, each a little faster than before. Three of them sway in three. Simple Gifts dances in four.
rows.translation: Nav jaunu ideju: četras šīs nodaļas dziesmas, katra mazliet ātrāk nekā iepriekš. Trīs šūpojas pa trim. Simple Gifts dejo pa četriem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What does a dot after a note do?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Makes it half again as long
rows.translation: Pagarina to par pusi tās ilguma
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A dotted quarter lasts a beat and a half. The note after it is usually quick, to fill out the beat.
rows.translation: Punktēta ceturtdaļnots ilgst pusotru sitienu. Nākamā nots parasti ir ātra, lai aizpildītu sitienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Carols and a New Year's song, in two, three, four and six.
rows.translation: Ziemassvētku dziesmas un Jaungada dziesma — pa diviem, trim, četriem un sešiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Pavasara dziesma kļūst par svētku dziesmu
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This tune was printed in 1582 in Piae Cantiones, a songbook from Finland, as a song about spring. John Mason Neale gave it Christmas words in 1853.
rows.translation: Šī melodija iespiesta 1582. gadā Somijas dziesmu grāmatā Piae Cantiones kā dziesma par pavasari. John Mason Neale tai deva Ziemassvētku vārdus 1853. gadā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The last line climbs from open D on string 4: E, F sharp at fret 4, open G, then A.
rows.translation: Pēdējā rinda kāpj no brīvā D uz 4. stīgas: E, F diēzs 4. ladā, brīvais G, tad A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Then from D at fret 3 on string 2, step down to G, touch C, and land on G.
rows.translation: Tad no D 2. stīgas 3. ladā soļojiet lejup līdz G, pieskarieties C un nonāciet uz G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Deck the Halls comes from Nos Galan, a Welsh New Year's Eve song from the 1700s. The English words came in 1862.
rows.translation: Deck the Halls cēlusies no Nos Galan — velsiešu Vecgada vakara dziesmas no gadsimta, kas sākās 1700. gadā. Angļu vārdi radās 1862. gadā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The third line climbs: C sharp at fret 2 on string 2, D, then E, F sharp and G on string 1.
rows.translation: Trešā rinda kāpj: C diēzs 2. stīgas 2. ladā, D, tad E, F diēzs un G uz 1. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A7 needs two fingers on fret 2: finger 1 on string 4, finger 3 on string 2. Start your strum on string 5. That C sharp on string 2 is the one the melody climbs through.
rows.translation: A7 vajag divus pirkstus 2. ladā: 1. pirkstu uz 4. stīgas, 3. pirkstu uz 2. stīgas. Sāciet pārvilkumu no 5. stīgas. Šis C diēzs uz 2. stīgas ir tas, caur kuru kāpj melodija.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
rows.translation: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This carol comes from England's West Country, where singers went door to door on winter nights and hoped for a treat in return.
rows.translation: Šī Ziemassvētku dziesma nāk no Anglijas rietumiem, kur dziedātāji ziemas naktīs gāja no durvīm pie durvīm un cerēja pretī saņemt cienastu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2 and open string 4 are both D. How far apart are they?
rows.translation: D 2. stīgas 3. ladā un brīvā 4. stīga abi ir D. Cik tālu tie ir viens no otra?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: An octave is the same letter, eight steps higher or lower. The two Ds blend, but one sounds brighter.
rows.translation: Oktāva ir tas pats burts astoņas pakāpes augstāk vai zemāk. Abi D saplūst, bet viens skan gaišāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B A G, then leap from D at fret 3 on string 2 down to open D. Then E, A, F sharp, G.
rows.translation: B A G, tad leciet no D 2. stīgas 3. ladā lejup uz brīvo D. Tad E, A, F diēzs, G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Auld lang syne is Scots for old long since, meaning days gone by. Robert Burns sent the words to a songbook in 1788, and this melody was printed with them in 1799.
rows.translation: Auld lang syne skotu valodā nozīmē sen pagājušu laiku — aizgājušās dienas. Robert Burns 1788. gadā nosūtīja vārdus dziesmu grāmatai, un šo melodiju kopā ar tiem iespieda 1799. gadā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chorus reaches up: B, D, open E, then G at fret 3 on string 1. Back down: D, B B G.
rows.translation: Piedziedājums sniedzas augšup: B, D, brīvais E, tad G 1. stīgas 3. ladā. Atpakaļ lejup: D, B B G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lowell Mason arranged this tune in 1839, borrowing phrases from Handel's Messiah. It opens with a G major scale, straight down from G to G.
rows.translation: Lowell Mason šo melodiju aranžēja 1839. gadā, aizņemoties frāzes no Hendeļa Mesijas. Tā sākas ar G mažora gammu taisni lejup no G līdz G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This carol counts in two. In bar one, G fills beat one, F sharp takes most of beat two, and E slips in at the very end.
rows.translation: Šo Ziemassvētku dziesmu skaita pa diviem. Pirmajā taktī G aizpilda pirmo sitienu, F diēzs aizņem lielāko daļu otrā, un E ieslīd pašās beigās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The middle repeats open B and steps up to D, then repeats A at fret 2 on string 3 and steps up to C.
rows.translation: Vidusdaļa atkārto brīvo B un kāpj līdz D, tad atkārto A 3. stīgas 2. ladā un kāpj līdz C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Franz Xaver Gruber wrote Silent Night in 1818 for Christmas Eve in Oberndorf, Austria. At its first performance, the only accompaniment was a guitar.
rows.translation: Francis Ksāvers Grūbers dziesmu Klusa nakts, svēta nakts sarakstīja 1818. gada Ziemassvētku vakaram Oberndorfā, Austrijā. Pirmajā izpildījumā vienīgais pavadījums bija ģitāra.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Silent Night is in 6/8: six quick counts per bar, grouped one-two-three, four-five-six. Each group sways like one slow beat.
rows.translation: Klusa nakts, svēta nakts ir 6/8: seši ātri skaitījumi taktī, grupēti viens-divi-trīs, četri-pieci-seši. Katra grupa šūpojas kā viens lēns sitiens.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The ending climbs to G at fret 3 on string 1, rings on F sharp, then walks down to open D.
rows.translation: Beigas kāpj līdz G 1. stīgas 3. ladā, skan uz F diēza, tad soļo lejup līdz brīvajam D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D uses the top four strings. Finger 1 on string 3, fret 2; finger 2 on string 1, fret 2; finger 3 on string 2, fret 3. Strum from open string 4.
rows.translation: D izmanto četras augšējās stīgas. 1. pirksts uz 3. stīgas 2. ladā; 2. pirksts uz 1. stīgas 2. ladā; 3. pirksts uz 2. stīgas 3. ladā. Velciet no brīvās 4. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Joseph Mohr (1818), English by John Freeman Young (1859)
rows.translation: Joseph Mohr (1818), angliski — John Freeman Young (1859)
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: six songs in two, three, four and six, each a little faster than before. Feel where every bar begins.
rows.translation: Nav jaunu ideju: sešas dziesmas pa diviem, trim, četriem un sešiem, katra mazliet ātrāk nekā iepriekš. Sajūtiet katras takts sākumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Silent Night is in 6/8. How are its six counts grouped?
rows.translation: Klusa nakts, svēta nakts ir 6/8. Kā grupēti seši skaitījumi?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: 6/8 sways in two big beats, each split into three: one-two-three, four-five-six.
rows.translation: 6/8 šūpojas divos lielos sitienos, katrs sadalīts trīs daļās: viens-divi-trīs, četri-pieci-seši.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two Mozart themes and two old airs: rests, minor keys, a wide range and third position.
rows.translation: Divas Mocarta tēmas un divas senas melodijas: pauzes, minors, plašs diapazons un trešā pozīcija.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mozart finished this serenade for strings in 1787. Its opening leaps up through the notes of a G chord, then answers with the notes of D7.
rows.translation: Mocarts šo serenādi stīgām pabeidza 1787. gadā. Tās sākums lec augšup pa G akorda skaņām, tad atbild ar D7 skaņām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A rest is a silent beat. Touch the string with your fretting fingers so the silence is crisp, then come back in exactly on time.
rows.translation: Pauze ir kluss sitiens. Ar stīgu spiedējpirkstiem pieskarieties stīgai, lai klusums būtu skaidrs, tad atsāciet precīzi laikā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The answer: C at fret 1 on string 2, A at fret 2 on string 3, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, then open D.
rows.translation: Atbilde: C 2. stīgas 1. ladā, A 3. stīgas 2. ladā, F diēzs 4. stīgas 4. ladā, tad brīvais D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening climbs through a chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Sākums kāpj pa akorda skaņām. Mažors vai minors?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Greensleeves was sung in England by the 1580s, and Shakespeare mentions it in The Merry Wives of Windsor. Here it's in E minor, low and dark.
rows.translation: Greensleeves Anglijā dziedāja jau 1580. gados, un Šekspīrs to piemin lugā Jautrās vindzorietes. Šeit tā ir E minorā, zema un tumša.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In E minor, D sharp sits one fret below E and pulls toward it. Find D sharp at string 4, fret 1, and C sharp at string 5, fret 4.
rows.translation: E minorā D diēzs ir vienu ladu zem E un tiecas uz to. Atrodiet D diēzu 4. stīgas 1. ladā un C diēzu 5. stīgas 4. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each half ends: G, F sharp, E, then D sharp, C sharp, D sharp, and home to E.
rows.translation: Katra puse beidzas: G, F diēzs, E, tad D diēzs, C diēzs, D diēzs un mājup uz E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chorus starts high: D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, open B, then down to open D.
rows.translation: Piedziedājums sākas augstu: D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, C diēzs 2. ladā, brīvais B, tad lejup uz brīvo D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Greensleeves is built on this chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Greensleeves balstās uz šī akorda. Mažors vai minors?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This melody was first printed in George Petrie's collection of Irish music in 1855. The words of Danny Boy were set to it much later, in 1913.
rows.translation: Šī melodija pirmoreiz iespiesta George Petrie īru mūzikas krājumā 1855. gadā. Danny Boy vārdus tai pievienoja daudz vēlāk — 1913. gadā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The high point: three As, up to F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, then E E D B D, A F sharp D.
rows.translation: Augstākais punkts: trīs A, augšup līdz F diēzam 1. stīgas 2. ladā, tad E E D B D, A F diēzs D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This tune runs from string 5 to string 1. What keeps every string in reach?
rows.translation: Šī melodija sniedzas no 5. līdz 1. stīgai. Kas ļauj aizsniegt katru stīgu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: With your thumb low behind the neck, your fingers arch and reach from string 5 to string 1 without straining.
rows.translation: Ar īkšķi zemu aiz grifa pirksti izliecas un bez sasprindzinājuma aizsniedz no 5. līdz 1. stīgai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mozart finished his Symphony No. 40 in 1788. It's one of only two symphonies he wrote in a minor key, and it opens with this restless, sighing theme.
rows.translation: Mocarts 40. simfoniju pabeidza 1788. gadā. Tā ir viena no tikai divām viņa simfonijām minorā un sākas ar šo nemierīgo, nopūtu pilno tēmu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slide your hand up so finger 1 rests at fret 3. Each finger now covers one fret: 3, 4, 5 and 6. Move your thumb up too, behind finger 2.
rows.translation: Pārbīdiet roku augšup, lai 1. pirksts būtu 3. ladā. Tagad katrs pirksts aptver vienu ladu: 3, 4, 5 un 6. Pārvietojiet arī īkšķi augstāk, aiz 2. pirksta.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In third position, which finger plays fret 3?
rows.translation: Kurš pirksts trešajā pozīcijā spēlē 3. ladu?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A position is named for where finger 1 sits. In third position, finger 1 plays fret 3 and finger 4 reaches fret 6.
rows.translation: Pozīciju nosauc pēc 1. pirksta vietas. Trešajā pozīcijā 1. pirksts spēlē 3. ladu, un 4. pirksts aizsniedz 6. ladu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E flat at fret 4 and D at fret 3 on string 2, then finger 4 up to B flat at fret 6 on string 1.
rows.translation: E bemols 4. ladā un D 3. ladā uz 2. stīgas, tad 4. pirksts augšup līdz B bemolam 1. stīgas 6. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The last phrase: F sharp, reaching finger 1 back to fret 2. Then E flat, D, C at fret 5 on string 3, and B flat.
rows.translation: Pēdējā frāze: F diēzs, sniedzot 1. pirkstu atpakaļ uz 2. ladu. Tad E bemols, D, C 3. stīgas 5. ladā un B bemols.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: two Mozart themes, two old airs and third position, each a little faster than before. Breathe between pieces.
rows.translation: Nav jaunu ideju: divas Mocarta tēmas, divas senas melodijas un trešā pozīcija, katra mazliet ātrāk nekā iepriekš. Starp skaņdarbiem ievelciet elpu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In E minor, which note leans up into E?
rows.translation: Kura nots E minorā tiecas augšup uz E?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D sharp sits one fret below E. That half step pulls hard toward home, which is why Greensleeves uses it at every cadence.
rows.translation: D diēzs ir vienu ladu zem E. Šis pustonis stipri velk mājup, tāpēc Greensleeves to izmanto katrā kadencē.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Five new songs on the open chords you know: campfire pop, a ballad, stomp-folk, reggae and country.
rows.translation: Piecas jaunas dziesmas ar zināmajiem brīvo stīgu akordiem: ugunskura pops, balāde, ritmisks folks, regejs un kantrī.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Kite Weather is bright, easy pop: four chords on a loop, G, D, E minor and C, at a relaxed 88 beats per minute. Listen for the hook jumping up to F sharp in its second bar.
rows.translation: Kite Weather ir gaišs, viegls pops: četri akordi ciklā — G, D, E minors un C — mierīgā tempā 88 sitieni minūtē. Klausieties, kā galvenais motīvs otrajā taktī uzlec līdz F diēzam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Does the hook climb or fall at first?
rows.translation: Vai galvenais motīvs sākumā kāpj vai krīt?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B and back, then open E and F sharp at fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, brīvais B un atpakaļ, tad brīvais E un F diēzs 1. stīgas 2. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Porchlight drifts along at 70 beats per minute. A ballad is a slow song that tells a story, so give every chord room to ring. Listen for the long note that closes each line.
rows.translation: Porchlight lēni plūst tempā 70 sitieni minūtē. Balāde ir lēna dziesma, kas stāsta stāstu, tāpēc dodiet katram akordam vietu skanēt. Klausieties garo noti katras rindas beigās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Does this phrase end at home?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chorus climbs string 1: open E, F sharp at fret 2, G at fret 3, then steps back down to D.
rows.translation: Piedziedājums kāpj pa 1. stīgu: brīvais E, F diēzs 2. ladā, G 3. ladā, tad soļo atpakaļ lejup līdz D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Moth and Ember is the kind of song a whole room stomps along to: heavy downstrokes, a chant of a hook, 96 beats per minute. It starts dark in A minor and brightens on D.
rows.translation: Moth and Ember ir dziesma, kurai visa telpa piesit līdzi kājas: smagi vēzieni lejup, skandējams galvenais motīvs, 96 sitieni minūtē. Tā sākas tumši A minorā un kļūst gaišāka uz D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Climb A minor: A at fret 2 on string 3, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E. Then step back down.
rows.translation: Kāpiet pa A minoru: A 3. stīgas 2. ladā, C 2. stīgas 1. ladā, brīvais E. Tad soļojiet atpakaļ lejup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The hook's second bar copies the first, a few notes higher. What is that called?
rows.translation: Galvenā motīva otrā takts atkārto pirmo dažas notis augstāk. Kā to sauc?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A sequence repeats a melodic shape from a new starting note. It makes a hook easy to remember.
rows.translation: Sekvence atkārto melodisko formu no jaunas sākuma nots. Tā palīdz galveno motīvu viegli atcerēties.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Low Tide Radio is laid-back reggae at 80 beats per minute. The guitar plays only on the and of each beat, a short chop called a skank, while bass and drums hold the beat.
rows.translation: Low Tide Radio ir nesteidzīgs regejs tempā 80 sitieni minūtē. Ģitāra spēlē tikai uz katra sitiena „un” — īsu akordu, ko sauc par skank —, kamēr bass un bungas tur pulsu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Strum down on each and, then ease your fretting fingers off the strings so the chord stops. Chk, chk, chk, chk. The silence between chops is half the groove.
rows.translation: Uz katra „un” velciet lejup, tad maziniet spiedējpirkstu spiedienu uz stīgām, lai akords apklustu. Čak, čak, čak, čak. Klusums starp īsajiem akordiem veido pusi ritma sajūtas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, open B, then A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: Brīvais E, D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, C diēzs 2. ladā, brīvais B, tad A 3. stīgas 2. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Dust on the Dashboard rolls along at 100 beats per minute. Country players split the bar: boom, a bass note on beats one and three, then chick, a strum on two and four.
rows.translation: Dust on the Dashboard ripo tempā 100 sitieni minūtē. Kantrī spēlētāji sadala takti: bum — basa nots uz viens un trīs, tad čak — pārvilkums uz divi un četri.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: On boom, pick only the chord's lowest note, its root: open string 5 for A, open string 4 for D, open string 6 for E. On chick, brush the thinner strings.
rows.translation: Uz bum spēlējiet tikai akorda zemāko noti — pamattoni: brīvo 5. stīgu A akordam, brīvo 4. stīgu D, brīvo 6. stīgu E. Uz čak pārvelciet tievākās stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which string is the boom for a D chord?
rows.translation: Kura stīga ir bum D akordam?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D's root is open string 4, the same string a D strum starts from.
rows.translation: D pamattonis ir brīvā 4. stīga — tā pati, no kuras sāk D pārvilkumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, C sharp at fret 2 on string 2, then open E and F sharp at fret 2.
rows.translation: A 3. stīgas 2. ladā, brīvais B, C diēzs 2. stīgas 2. ladā, tad brīvais E un F diēzs 2. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new chords or notes: the five songs from this unit, each a touch faster. Name each hook by ear, then play.
rows.translation: Nav jaunu akordu vai nošu: piecas šīs nodaļas dziesmas, katra mazliet ātrāk. Pēc dzirdes nosauciet katru galveno motīvu, tad spēlējiet.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which song's hook starts like this?
rows.translation: Kuras dziesmas galvenais motīvs sākas šādi?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In reggae, where does the guitar chop?
rows.translation: Kur regejā ģitāra spēlē īsos akordus?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: On the and of each beat
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The skank lands between the beats, while bass and drums hold the downbeats.
rows.translation: Skank iekrīt starp sitieniem, kamēr bass un bungas tur sitienus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Five songs on three chords each: a campfire chorus, a country two-step, a waltz, easy reggae and bedroom pop.
rows.translation: Piecas trīs akordu dziesmas: ugunskura piedziedājums, kantrī tūsteps, valsis, viegls regejs un guļamistabas pops.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lantern Hill is a campfire song on three chords, G, C and D, at 92 beats per minute. The chorus is made for a crowd, so by the second time around, sing it out.
rows.translation: Lantern Hill ir ugunskura dziesma ar trim akordiem — G, C un D — tempā 92 sitieni minūtē. Piedziedājums radīts cilvēku pulkam, tāpēc otrajā reizē dziediet no sirds.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, open E again, then G at fret 3 on string 1 and back down.
rows.translation: Brīvais E, D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, atkal brīvais E, tad G 1. stīgas 3. ladā un atpakaļ lejup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Gravel Road Two-Step is dance-hall country in A at 116 beats per minute. Pick the root on one and three, strum on two and four, and add a quick up after each strum.
rows.translation: Gravel Road Two-Step ir deju zāles kantrī A tonalitātē tempā 116 sitieni minūtē. Spēlējiet pamattoni uz viens un trīs, velciet uz divi un četri un pēc katra pārvilkuma pievienojiet ātru vēzienu augšup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In a two-step, where do the bass notes fall?
rows.translation: Uz kuriem sitieniem tūstepā iekrīt basa notis?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The bass walks with the dancers' feet on one and three; the strums fill two and four.
rows.translation: Bass soļo kopā ar dejotāju kājām uz viens un trīs; pārvilkumi aizpilda divi un četri.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, then C sharp at fret 2 and A on string 3.
rows.translation: F diēzs 1. stīgas 2. ladā, brīvais E, D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, tad C diēzs 2. ladā un A uz 3. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: First Frost counts in three at 108 beats per minute: one, two, three, with the weight on one. D, G and A carry it all, and every line ends on a long, held note.
rows.translation: First Frost skaita pa trim tempā 108 sitieni minūtē: viens, divi, trīs ar uzsvaru uz viens. Visu nes D, G un A, un katra rinda beidzas ar garu, turētu noti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, D at fret 3 on string 2, twice. Then E, F sharp at fret 2, E, D and A.
rows.translation: G 1. stīgas 3. ladā, D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, divreiz. Tad E, F diēzs 2. ladā, E, D un A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hammock Season is easy reggae in C at 76 beats per minute. The guitar plays only on beats two and four: one short, bright upstroke on the top strings, then silence.
rows.translation: Hammock Season ir viegls regejs C tonalitātē tempā 76 sitieni minūtē. Ģitāra spēlē tikai uz otrā un ceturtā sitiena: viens īss, spožs vēziens augšup uz augšējām stīgām, tad klusums.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Brush up across strings 1 to 3, then relax your fretting hand so the chord stops at once. Chk on two, chk on four. The quiet beats are what make it sway.
rows.translation: Velciet augšup pāri 1. līdz 3. stīgai, tad atslābiniet stīgu spiedējroku, lai akords uzreiz apklustu. Čak uz divi, čak uz četri. Klusie sitieni rada šūpojumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Glow-in-the-Dark Stars is soft bedroom pop at 84 beats per minute: E minor, C and G, strummed light. Most lines start just after the beat, so let them float in.
rows.translation: Glow-in-the-Dark Stars ir maigs guļamistabas pops tempā 84 sitieni minūtē: viegli pārvilkti E minors, C un G. Vairums rindu sākas tūlīt pēc sitiena, tāpēc ļaujiet tām iepeldēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open E twice, G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, G again, then D at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: Brīvais E divreiz, G 1. stīgas 3. ladā, brīvais E, atkal G, tad D 2. stīgas 3. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E minor, C and G share one note. Which?
rows.translation: E minoram, C un G ir viena kopīga nots. Kura?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E minor is E, G and B; C is C, E and G; G is G, B and D. G sits in all three, so the changes feel smooth.
rows.translation: E minors ir E, G un B; C ir C, E un G; G ir G, B un D. G ir visos trijos, tāpēc maiņas šķiet plūstošas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In reggae, where does the guitar play?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Reggae's guitar answers the beat: a short upstroke on two and four, silence in between.
rows.translation: Regeja ģitāra atbild pulsam: īss vēziens augšup uz divi un četri, starp tiem klusums.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The four-chord loop five ways: two summer anthems, a roller-rink bop, a pop song in 6/8 and a stadium chorus.
rows.translation: Četru akordu cikls piecos veidos: divas vasaras himnas, skrituļslidu pops, popdziesma 6/8 un stadiona piedziedājums.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sparkler Season rides the most famous loop in pop: C, G, A minor and F, the one, five, six and four of C. Hundreds of hits share these chords; a new tune and new words make each one its own.
rows.translation: Sparkler Season balstās slavenākajā popmūzikas ciklā: C, G, A minors un F — C tonalitātes viens, pieci, seši un četri. Simtiem hitu ir šie akordi; jauna melodija un vārdi katru padara savdabīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The mini F covers strings 4 to 1: finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1, finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
rows.translation: Mazais F aptver 4. līdz 1. stīgu: 1. pirksts guļ pāri 2. un 1. stīgai 1. ladā, 2. pirksts uz 3. stīgas 2. ladā, 3. pirksts uz 4. stīgas 3. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Roller Rink is bright dance pop at 120 beats per minute: G, E minor, C and D, the one, six, four and five. Strum even eighths and feel the kick drum land on every beat.
rows.translation: Roller Rink ir gaišs deju pops tempā 120 sitieni minūtē: G, E minors, C un D — viens, seši, četri un pieci. Velciet vienmērīgas astotdaļnotis un sajūtiet lielo bungu uz katra sitiena.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1 three times, F sharp at fret 2, open E.
rows.translation: D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, brīvais E, G 1. stīgas 3. ladā trīsreiz, F diēzs 2. ladā, brīvais E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Echo Canyon plays E minor, C, G and D at 80 beats per minute. Big strum on one, let it ring, then build on three and four. The half-time beat makes it feel huge.
rows.translation: Echo Canyon spēlē E minoru, C, G un D tempā 80 sitieni minūtē. Liels pārvilkums uz viens, ļaujiet skanēt, tad kāpiniet uz trīs un četri. Uz pusi lēnāka pulsa sajūta piešķir plašumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Kite Weather plays G, D, E minor and C. Echo Canyon plays E minor, C, G and D. What changed?
rows.translation: Kite Weather spēlē G, D, E minoru un C. Echo Canyon spēlē E minoru, C, G un D. Kas mainījies?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Same four chords, same key. Starting on E minor puts the sad chord first, so the loop sounds darker.
rows.translation: Tie paši četri akordi, tā pati tonalitāte. Sākot ar E minoru, skumjais akords ir pirmais, tāpēc cikls skan tumšāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1 and open E, twice. Then G again and D at fret 3 on string 2, twice.
rows.translation: G 1. stīgas 3. ladā un brīvais E, divreiz. Tad atkal G un D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, divreiz.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open Windows sways in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: six quick counts felt as two big swings. C, F, A minor and G roll under a chorus that opens wide.
rows.translation: Open Windows šūpojas 6/8 tempā 120 skaitījumi minūtē: seši ātri skaitījumi, ko jūt kā divus lielus vēzienus. C, F, A minors un G rit zem plaši atvērtā piedziedājuma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, D at fret 3, open E, F at fret 1 on string 1, E, G at fret 3, E, G, then C.
rows.translation: C 2. stīgas 1. ladā, D 3. ladā, brīvais E, F 1. stīgas 1. ladā, E, G 3. ladā, E, G, tad C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Scoreboard Lights is a stadium anthem in D at 100 beats per minute: D, A, B minor and G, the same one, five, six, four loop in a new key. Drive steady eighths.
rows.translation: Scoreboard Lights ir stadiona himna D tonalitātē tempā 100 sitieni minūtē: D, A, B minors un G — tas pats viens, pieci, seši, četri cikls jaunā tonalitātē. Virziet vienmērīgas astotdaļnotis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This B minor uses the top four strings only: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1. The full barre comes later.
rows.translation: Šis B minors izmanto tikai četras augšējās stīgas: 4. lada uz 4. un 3. stīgas, 3. lada uz 2. stīgas, 2. lada uz 1. stīgas. Pilnais barē būs vēlāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, D at fret 3 on string 2, then G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp, open E.
rows.translation: A 3. stīgas 2. ladā, brīvais B, D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, tad G 1. stīgas 3. ladā, F diēzs, brīvais E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these is the four-chord loop in C?
rows.translation: Kurš no šiem ir četru akordu cikls C tonalitātē?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The one, five, six and four of C are C, G, A minor and F.
rows.translation: C tonalitātes viens, pieci, seši un četri ir C, G, A minors un F.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1
