rows.source: Blues, a waltz, 6/8 folk, lo-fi and funk, with seventh chords, sus chords and swung rhythms.
rows.translation: Blūzs, valsis, 6/8 folks, lo-fi un fanks ar septakordiem, sus akordiem un svingotiem ritmiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rust Belt Shuffle is a blues at 80 beats per minute: twelve bars of E7, A7 and B7, strummed long-short. The melody swings the same way, so lean into every long note.
rows.translation: Rust Belt Shuffle ir blūzs tempā 80 sitieni minūtē: divpadsmit E7, A7 un B7 taktis ar gariem–īsiem pārvilkumiem. Melodija svingo tāpat, tāpēc uzsveriet katru garo noti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open B, D at fret 3, open E and back. Then G and G sharp on string 3, sliding into open B.
rows.translation: Brīvais B, D 3. ladā, brīvais E un atpakaļ. Tad G un G diēzs uz 3. stīgas, ieslīdot brīvajā B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Carousel at Closing Time turns in three, like a fairground ride winding down: oom-pah-pah at 96 beats per minute. Count one, two, three, with the weight on one.
rows.translation: Carousel at Closing Time griežas pa trim kā atrakcija, kas palēninās: um-pā-pā tempā 96 sitieni minūtē. Skaitiet viens, divi, trīs ar uzsvaru uz viens.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, A on string 3, then C sharp at fret 2, open E and G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, A uz 3. stīgas, tad C diēzs 2. ladā, brīvais E un G 1. stīgas 3. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Cedar Smoke sways in 6/8: six quick counts per bar, felt as two big beats, one-two-three, four-five-six. At 100 counts a minute it rocks like a slow boat.
rows.translation: Cedar Smoke šūpojas 6/8: seši ātri skaitījumi taktī, ko jūt kā divus lielus sitienus — viens-divi-trīs, četri-pieci-seši. Tempā 100 skaitījumi minūtē tas līgojas kā lēna laiva.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bar four holds Dsus4: a D chord with your little finger on string 1, fret 3. It hangs in the air. Bar eight drops to plain D, and the song lands.
rows.translation: Ceturtajā taktī ir Dsus4: D akords ar mazo pirkstu uz 1. stīgas 3. ladā. Tas karājas gaisā. Astotajā taktī nolaižas uz parastu D, un dziesma piezemējas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B and back, then open E on string 1, and down again.
rows.translation: D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, brīvais B un atpakaļ, tad brīvais E uz 1. stīgas un atkal lejup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rain on the Skylight is lo-fi: soft seventh chords over a lazy, swung beat at 72 beats per minute. Strum down on one, then down-up on three, the up a little late.
rows.translation: Rain on the Skylight ir lo-fi: maigi septakordi pār laisku, svingotu pulsu tempā 72 sitieni minūtē. Velciet lejup uz viens, tad lejup–augšup uz trīs, augšup mazliet vēlāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted. Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted. For Dm7, finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 lies flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1.
rows.translation: Am7 ir A minors ar paceltu 3. pirkstu. Cmaj7 ir C ar paceltu 1. pirkstu. Dm7 veido ar 2. pirkstu uz 3. stīgas 2. ladā un 1. pirkstu pāri 2. un 1. stīgai 1. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Neon Laundromat stays on one chord, A7, the whole way through. A vamp like this lives on rhythm: tight, choppy strums at 96 beats per minute and a hook that dodges the beat.
rows.translation: Neon Laundromat visu laiku paliek uz viena akorda — A7. Šāds atkārtots pavadījums dzīvo ritmā: cieši, īsi pārvilkumi tempā 96 sitieni minūtē un galvenais motīvs, kas izvairās no sitiena.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Funk players call beat one the one. Hit it hard, keep your strumming hand swinging in eighths, and ease your fingers off after each strum so it goes chk.
rows.translation: Fanka spēlētāji pirmo sitienu sauc par „viens”. Uzsitiet tam spēcīgi, turpiniet pārvilkumu rokas šūpošanos astotdaļnotīs un pēc katra pārvilkuma atslābiniet pirkstus, lai skanētu čak.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3, then back down.
rows.translation: A 3. stīgas 2. ladā, C un C diēzs 2. stīgas 1. un 2. ladā, brīvais E, G 3. ladā, tad atpakaļ lejup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many quick counts fill a bar of 6/8?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: 6/8 has six eighth-note counts, felt as two groups of three.
rows.translation: 6/8 ir seši astotdaļu skaitījumi, ko jūt divās grupās pa trim.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lo-fi, one-drop reggae, funk, a 6/8 slow dance and bedroom pop, on seventh chords that make a groove glow.
rows.translation: Lo-fi, one-drop regejs, fanks, lēna 6/8 deja un guļamistabas pops ar septakordiem, kas liek ritmam mirdzēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Late Checkout is lo-fi at 72 beats per minute: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7 on a loop. Strum down on one, then down-up on three with the up a little late, and swing the tune the same way.
rows.translation: Late Checkout ir lo-fi tempā 72 sitieni minūtē: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 un Am7 ciklā. Velciet lejup uz viens, tad lejup–augšup uz trīs, augšup mazliet vēlāk, un tāpat svingojiet melodiju.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G7 is G with string 1 at fret 1 instead of fret 3: fingers 3 and 2 on strings 6 and 5, finger 1 on string 1. It leans hard toward C.
rows.translation: G7 ir G ar 1. stīgu 1., nevis 3. ladā: 3. un 2. pirksts uz 6. un 5. stīgas, 1. pirksts uz 1. stīgas. Tas stipri tiecas uz C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Saltwater Sunday is reggae in A minor at 76 beats per minute. The guitar plays a double chop on two and four, chk-a, chk-a, while the drums drop their weight on three.
rows.translation: Saltwater Sunday ir regejs A minorā tempā 76 sitieni minūtē. Ģitāra spēlē dubultu īso akordu uz divi un četri — čak-a, čak-a —, kamēr bungas liek uzsvaru uz trīs.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 1 on string 2, fret 1, finger 3 on string 1, fret 2. Am7 to D7 and back is the sunny, minor-but-bright sound of the whole song.
rows.translation: D7: 2. pirksts uz 3. stīgas 2. ladā, 1. pirksts uz 2. stīgas 1. ladā, 3. pirksts uz 1. stīgas 2. ladā. Am7 uz D7 un atpakaļ rada visas dziesmas saulaino, minorīgo, tomēr gaišo skanējumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pocket Change is funk at 100 beats per minute: a vamp on Em7, with A7 for the chorus. Your strumming hand never stops moving in eighths; only some strokes ring.
rows.translation: Pocket Change ir fanks tempā 100 sitieni minūtē: atkārtots Em7 pavadījums ar A7 piedziedājumā. Pārvilkumu roka nekad nepārstāj kustēties astotdaļnotīs; skan tikai daži vēzieni.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Between the strokes that ring, lay your fretting fingers lightly across the strings and keep strumming: the muted strokes go chk. Press down only for the hits.
rows.translation: Starp skanošajiem vēzieniem viegli uzlieciet spiedējpirkstus pāri stīgām un turpiniet vilkt: slāpētie vēzieni skan čak. Piespiediet tikai akcentiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, then C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2. Twice.
rows.translation: A 3. stīgas 2. ladā, tad C un C diēzs 2. stīgas 1. un 2. ladā. Divreiz.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Kitchen Slow Dance is a soul ballad in 6/8 at 108 counts a minute, two slow sways a bar. Cmaj7, Am7, Dm7 and G7 carry the verse; Fmaj7 and Em7 open up the chorus.
rows.translation: Kitchen Slow Dance ir soula balāde 6/8 tempā 108 skaitījumi minūtē, divi lēni šūpojumi taktī. Cmaj7, Am7, Dm7 un G7 nes pantu; Fmaj7 un Em7 atver piedziedājumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fmaj7 is the mini F with string 1 left open. Em7 takes one finger: finger 2 on string 5, fret 2, every other string open.
rows.translation: Fmaj7 ir mazais F ar brīvu 1. stīgu. Em7 vajag vienu pirkstu: 2. pirkstu uz 5. stīgas 2. ladā, visas pārējās stīgas brīvas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, E, D at fret 3 on string 2, open E again, then open B.
rows.translation: Brīvais E, G 1. stīgas 3. ladā, E, D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, atkal brīvais E, tad brīvais B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Houseplants is soft bedroom pop at 88 beats per minute: Gmaj7, Em7, Cmaj7 and D. Seventh chords make it dreamy. Strum once on one, then brush soft ups on the ands.
rows.translation: Houseplants ir maigs guļamistabas pops tempā 88 sitieni minūtē: Gmaj7, Em7, Cmaj7 un D. Septakordi piešķir sapņainumu. Velciet vienreiz uz viens, tad viegli augšup uz „un”.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Gmaj7 is G with string 1 at fret 2 instead of fret 3. Bm7 puts three fingers at fret 2, on strings 5, 3 and 1, and lets strings 4 and 2 ring open.
rows.translation: Gmaj7 ir G ar 1. stīgu 2., nevis 3. ladā. Bm7 liek trīs pirkstus 2. ladā uz 5., 3. un 1. stīgas, bet 4. un 2. stīgai ļauj skanēt brīvi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1 and open E, twice, then D at fret 3 on string 2 and F sharp at fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: G 1. stīgas 3. ladā un brīvais E divreiz, tad D 2. stīgas 3. ladā un F diēzs 1. stīgas 2. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord has a major seventh?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Cmaj7 adds B, a half step under C. G7 and Am7 add a flat seventh, a whole step under the root.
rows.translation: Cmaj7 pievieno B — pustoni zem C. G7 un Am7 pievieno pazeminātu septīmu — toni zem pamattoņa.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Punk, garage rock, doo-wop, surf and heartland rock, with power chords, a riff and sus chords.
rows.translation: Panks, garāžroks, dūvops, sērfroks un Amerikas vidienes roks ar kvintakordiem, rifu un sus akordiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Static on Channel Nine is punk: four power chords, palm-muted eighths, 104 beats per minute. The verse mutters on low notes; the chorus is a gang shout, so dig in.
rows.translation: Static on Channel Nine ir panks: četri kvintakordi, ar plaukstu slāpētas astotdaļnotis, 104 sitieni minūtē. Pants murmina zemās notīs; piedziedājums ir kopīgs sauciens, tāpēc spēlējiet enerģiski.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, down to D at fret 3 on string 2, then F sharp at fret 2 and D again.
rows.translation: G 1. stīgas 3. ladā, lejup uz D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, tad F diēzs 2. ladā un atkal D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Basement Weather is garage rock at 92 beats per minute: a riff on the low strings, then power chords that punch back. Rest your palm at the bridge to keep the riff tight.
rows.translation: Basement Weather ir garāžroks tempā 92 sitieni minūtē: rifs uz zemajām stīgām, tad kvintakordi, kas sit pretī. Atbalstiet plaukstu pie tiltiņa, lai rifs būtu ciešs.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open string 5, C at fret 3 on the same string, then open string 4, and back.
rows.translation: Brīvā 5. stīga, C tās pašas stīgas 3. ladā, tad brīvā 4. stīga un atpakaļ.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 6, open A, G again, then open low E.
rows.translation: G 6. stīgas 3. ladā, brīvais A, atkal G, tad brīvais zemais E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Answer the riff with power chords on one, the and of two, and four: A5, G5, C5, D5. Between hits, ease your fretting fingers off so the chords stop short.
rows.translation: Atbildiet rifam ar kvintakordiem uz viens, otrā sitiena „un” un četri: A5, G5, C5, D5. Starp akcentiem maziniet spiedējpirkstu spiedienu, lai akordi īsi aprautos.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Jukebox Moon is a slow dance in 1950s doo-wop style: C, A minor, F and G7, around and around, at 72 beats per minute. Strum every beat, with a quick swung up into each new bar.
rows.translation: Jukebox Moon ir lēna deja 1950. gadu dūvopa stilā: C, A minors, F un G7 atkal un atkal tempā 72 sitieni minūtē. Velciet uz katra sitiena ar ātru svingotu vēzienu augšup uz katru jauno takti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open G, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E, then D and C. Next, A at fret 2 on string 3 and back up.
rows.translation: Brīvais G, C 2. stīgas 1. ladā, brīvais E, tad D un C. Pēc tam A 3. stīgas 2. ladā un atpakaļ augšup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Boardwalk Comet is surf rock: a twangy melody over A minor, G, F and E, galloping along at 104 beats per minute. Picture reverb, salt spray and a wave about to break.
rows.translation: Boardwalk Comet ir sērfroks: dzinkstoša melodija virs A minora, G, F un E galopē tempā 104 sitieni minūtē. Iztēlojieties reverberāciju, sāļas šļakatas un vilni pirms lūšanas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A on string 3, C at fret 1, open E and back down. Then open B, D at fret 3, and up to G on string 1.
rows.translation: A uz 3. stīgas, C 1. ladā, brīvais E un atpakaļ lejup. Tad brīvais B, D 3. ladā un augšup līdz G uz 1. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Over the E chord the tune plays G sharp, not G. Where is G sharp on string 3?
rows.translation: Virs E akorda melodija spēlē G diēzu, nevis G. Kur uz 3. stīgas ir G diēzs?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G is open string 3, so G sharp is one fret up. It leans hard toward A, the home note.
rows.translation: G ir brīvā 3. stīga, tāpēc G diēzs ir vienu ladu augstāk. Tas stipri tiecas uz A — toniku.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mile Marker Zero is open-road rock at 100 beats per minute: big ringing chords and a chorus for driving with the windows down. Listen for D lifting to Dsus4 and back.
rows.translation: Mile Marker Zero ir atklāta ceļa roks tempā 100 sitieni minūtē: lieli, skanīgi akordi un piedziedājums braukšanai ar nolaistiem logiem. Klausieties, kā D paceļas uz Dsus4 un atgriežas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Asus4 is A with your little finger added on string 2, fret 3. Like Dsus4, it leans forward and wants to fall back home.
rows.translation: Asus4 ir A ar mazo pirkstu uz 2. stīgas 3. ladā. Tāpat kā Dsus4, tas tiecas uz priekšu un grib krist atpakaļ mājās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F sharp at fret 2 and G at fret 3 on string 1, then down to D at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: F diēzs 2. ladā un G 3. ladā uz 1. stīgas, tad lejup uz D 2. stīgas 3. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these styles swings, long-short?
rows.translation: Kurš no šiem stiliem svingo gari–īsi?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Doo-wop rides a gentle swing. Punk and surf drive on straight, even eighths.
rows.translation: Dūvops balstās maigā svingā. Panks un sērfroks virzās ar taisnām, vienmērīgām astotdaļnotīm.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Punk-pop, riff rock, dark 6/8 rock, an indie anthem and desert rock, on power chords and low-string riffs.
rows.translation: Pankpops, rifu roks, tumšs 6/8 roks, indīhimna un tuksneša roks ar kvintakordiem un zemo stīgu rifiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Last Bell is punk-pop at 152 beats per minute: C5, G5, A5 and F5, the four-chord loop as power chords. All downstrokes in steady eighths, palm resting on the strings by the bridge.
rows.translation: Last Bell ir pankpops tempā 152 sitieni minūtē: C5, G5, A5 un F5 — četru akordu cikls kvintakordos. Visi vēzieni lejup vienmērīgās astotdaļnotīs, plauksta balstās uz stīgām pie tiltiņa.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F5 is the G5 shape two frets lower: finger 1 on string 6, fret 1, fingers 3 and 4 on strings 5 and 4 at fret 3.
rows.translation: F5 ir G5 forma divas ladas zemāk: 1. pirksts uz 6. stīgas 1. ladā, 3. un 4. pirksts uz 5. un 4. stīgas 3. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1 and open E, twice. Then D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, open E and D.
rows.translation: G 1. stīgas 3. ladā un brīvais E divreiz. Tad D 2. stīgas 3. ladā divreiz, brīvais E un D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Copper Wire is built on a riff: a short, catchy line on the low strings that the whole band locks onto. It runs at 112 beats per minute in E, with power chords in the chorus.
rows.translation: Copper Wire balstās rifā: īsā, lipīgā līnijā uz zemajām stīgām, kurai pieslēdzas visa grupa. Tā skan E tonalitātē tempā 112 sitieni minūtē ar kvintakordiem piedziedājumā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open string 6 twice, G at fret 3, open E, open string 5, G again, then open E.
rows.translation: Brīvā 6. stīga divreiz, G 3. ladā, brīvais E, brīvā 5. stīga, atkal G, tad brīvais E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The second bar turns around: B at fret 2 on string 5, open A, G at fret 3 on string 6, open A.
rows.translation: Otrā takts griežas atpakaļ: B 5. stīgas 2. ladā, brīvais A, G 6. stīgas 3. ladā, brīvais A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Cold Lake is dark alternative rock in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: E5, C5, G5 and D5. Keep the verse quiet and low so the chorus can open up.
rows.translation: Cold Lake ir tumšs alternatīvais roks 6/8 tempā 120 skaitījumi minūtē: E5, C5, G5 un D5. Pantu turiet klusu un zemu, lai piedziedājums varētu atvērties.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, G again, then D at fret 3 on string 2. Let each ring.
rows.translation: G 1. stīgas 3. ladā, brīvais E, atkal G, tad D 2. stīgas 3. ladā. Ļaujiet katrai notij skanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Parking Lot Cathedral is indie rock at 128 beats per minute: D5, A5, B5 and G5, the four-chord loop again, now as power chords. Big, open, driving eighths.
rows.translation: Parking Lot Cathedral ir indīroks tempā 128 sitieni minūtē: D5, A5, B5 un G5 — atkal četru akordu cikls, tagad kvintakordos. Lielas, atvērtas, dzenošas astotdaļnotis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B5 is the A5 shape moved up two frets: finger 1 on string 5, fret 2, fingers 3 and 4 on strings 4 and 3 at fret 4.
rows.translation: B5 ir A5 forma, pārvietota divas ladas augstāk: 1. pirksts uz 5. stīgas 2. ladā, 3. un 4. pirksts uz 4. un 3. stīgas 4. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, G at fret 3, open E.
rows.translation: D 2. stīgas 3. ladā divreiz, F diēzs 1. stīgas 2. ladā, brīvais E, G 3. ladā, brīvais E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Halogen is desert rock in D minor at 104 beats per minute: a hypnotic riff on strings 4 and 5, a low, steady voice, then F5, C5 and G5 opening up the chorus.
rows.translation: Halogen ir tuksneša roks D minorā tempā 104 sitieni minūtē: hipnotisks rifs uz 4. un 5. stīgas, zema, stabila balss, tad F5, C5 un G5 atver piedziedājumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open string 4 twice, F at fret 3, open D, open string 3, F again, then open D.
rows.translation: Brīvā 4. stīga divreiz, F 3. ladā, brīvais D, brīvā 3. stīga, atkal F, tad brīvais D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F at fret 1 on string 1, open E, C at fret 1 on string 2, then G at fret 3 on string 1, E and C.
rows.translation: F 1. stīgas 1. ladā, brīvais E, C 2. stīgas 1. ladā, tad G 1. stīgas 3. ladā, E un C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which song's riff starts like this?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A power chord is a root and its fifth, with no third, so it is neither major nor minor.
rows.translation: Kvintakords ir pamattonis un tā kvinta bez tercas, tāpēc tas nav ne mažors, ne minors.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A ballad, a sea story in 6/8, a music-box waltz, a bright folk strummer and a dark song in A minor.
rows.translation: Balāde, jūras stāsts 6/8, mūzikas lādītes valsis, gaišs folks ar pārvilkumiem un tumša dziesma A minorā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Letters in a Shoebox tells a story in C at 72 beats per minute. The verse walks C, G, A minor, E minor, F, C, F and G, a chain of chords that has carried ballads for centuries.
rows.translation: Letters in a Shoebox stāsta C tonalitātē tempā 72 sitieni minūtē. Pants iet C, G, A minors, E minors, F, C, F un G — akordu virkne, kas nesusi balādes gadsimtiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, D at fret 3, open E, F at fret 1 on string 1, G at fret 3, then D again.
rows.translation: C 2. stīgas 1. ladā, D 3. ladā, brīvais E, F 1. stīgas 1. ladā, G 3. ladā, tad atkal D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Keeper's Daughter is a story song in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: E minor, D, C and B7. Three verses tell the story, and the chorus answers each one.
rows.translation: Keeper's Daughter ir stāsta dziesma 6/8 tempā 120 skaitījumi minūtē: E minors, D, C un B7. Trīs panti stāsta notikumus, un piedziedājums atbild katram.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open B, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, then C at fret 1 on string 2, E and C.
rows.translation: Brīvais B, brīvais E, G 1. stīgas 3. ladā, brīvais E, tad C 2. stīgas 1. ladā, E un C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Snow Globe Town is a quick waltz in G at 120 beats per minute, like a music box: one strong beat, two light ones. G, D, E minor and C, with B7 in the bridge.
rows.translation: Snow Globe Town ir ātrs valsis G tonalitātē tempā 120 sitieni minūtē kā mūzikas lādīte: viens stiprs sitiens, divi viegli. G, D, E minors un C ar B7 pārejā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C at fret 1, D, C, then open B: a slow fall, like snow.
rows.translation: Brīvais E, D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, C 1. ladā, D, C, tad brīvais B: lēns kritiens kā sniegam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Thistle and Thread is a bright folk strummer in A at 116 beats per minute. Asus4 and Asus2 decorate the A chord: change one finger and the chord sparkles.
rows.translation: Thistle and Thread ir gaišs folks ar pārvilkumiem A tonalitātē tempā 116 sitieni minūtē. Asus4 un Asus2 izrotā A akordu: mainiet vienu pirkstu, un akords iemirdzas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: From A, put finger 4 on string 2, fret 3 for Asus4. Lift the finger off string 2 and let it ring open for Asus2. Both fall back to A.
rows.translation: No A uzlieciet 4. pirkstu uz 2. stīgas 3. ladā, lai iegūtu Asus4. Paceliet pirkstu no 2. stīgas un ļaujiet tai skanēt brīvi Asus2. Abi atgriežas uz A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, E twice, C sharp, open B, then A.
rows.translation: F diēzs 1. stīgas 2. ladā, brīvais E, D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, E divreiz, C diēzs, brīvais B, tad A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ghost Light is a slow, dark ballad in A minor at 70 beats per minute. The verse sinks from A minor through F and C to E major, which pulls hard back to A minor.
rows.translation: Ghost Light ir lēna, tumša balāde A minorā tempā 70 sitieni minūtē. Pants slīgst no A minora caur F un C līdz E mažoram, kas stipri velk atpakaļ uz A minoru.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E major in A minor brings one new note. Which?
rows.translation: E mažors A minorā ienes vienu jaunu noti. Kuru?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minor's own notes have G. E major needs G sharp, a half step under A, so it leans hard toward home.
rows.translation: A minora paša notīs ir G. E mažoram vajag G diēzu pustoni zem A, tāpēc tas stipri tiecas mājup.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F at fret 1 on string 1, open E, G at fret 3, then D at fret 3 on string 2. Hold each long.
rows.translation: F 1. stīgas 1. ladā, brīvais E, G 3. ladā, tad D 2. stīgas 3. ladā. Katru turiet ilgi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many beats fill a bar of 3/4?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: 3/4 counts one, two, three, with the weight on one: the waltz.
rows.translation: 3/4 skaita viens, divi, trīs ar uzsvaru uz viens — valsis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Indie pop, a power ballad, highlife, neo-soul and an anthem with a key change, with F and B minor barres.
rows.translation: Indīpops, roka balāde, highlife, neosouls un himna ar tonalitātes maiņu, izmantojot F un B minora barē.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Late Bus Home is indie pop for the ride back through a sleeping city: D, B minor, G and A at 100 beats per minute. Each line starts just after the beat, so wait a breath.
rows.translation: Late Bus Home ir indīpops braucienam mājup cauri guļošai pilsētai: D, B minors, G un A tempā 100 sitieni minūtē. Katra rinda sākas tūlīt pēc sitiena, tāpēc mirkli nogaidiet.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play the full B minor barre at fret 2 if you can. If not, use the top four strings: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: Ja varat, spēlējiet pilno B minora barē 2. ladā. Ja ne, izmantojiet četras augšējās stīgas: 4. lada uz 4. un 3. stīgas, 3. lada uz 2. stīgas, 2. lada uz 1. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, D at fret 3 on string 2, then open E and F sharp at fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: A 3. stīgas 2. ladā, D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, tad brīvais E un F diēzs 1. stīgas 2. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Glass Satellites is a slow, soaring ballad at 76 beats per minute: A minor, F, C and G. Strum big on one and let it ring, then build on three and four.
rows.translation: Glass Satellites ir lēna, augšup lidojoša balāde tempā 76 sitieni minūtē: A minors, F, C un G. Plaši velciet uz viens un ļaujiet skanēt, tad kāpiniet uz trīs un četri.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lay finger 1 flat across all six strings at fret 1 and build an E shape in front of it. Not there yet? Use the mini F on the top four strings for now.
rows.translation: Noguldiet 1. pirkstu pāri visām sešām stīgām 1. ladā un priekšā izveidojiet E formu. Vēl nesanāk? Pagaidām izmantojiet mazo F uz četrām augšējām stīgām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, open E twice, D at fret 3, C again, then A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: C 2. stīgas 1. ladā, brīvais E divreiz, D 3. ladā, atkal C, tad A 3. stīgas 2. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Market Day borrows from highlife, the bright guitar pop of Ghana and Nigeria: G, B minor, C and D at 104 beats per minute. The hook bounces off the beat, so keep your body moving.
rows.translation: Market Day aizņemas no highlife — Ganas un Nigērijas gaišā ģitārpopa: G, B minors, C un D tempā 104 sitieni minūtē. Galvenais motīvs atlec starp sitieniem, tāpēc turpiniet kustināt ķermeni.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B, D again, open E, then back to D and B.
rows.translation: D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, brīvais B, atkal D, brīvais E, tad atpakaļ uz D un B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bar two keeps bar one's rhythm but swaps one note. Why?
rows.translation: Otrā takts saglabā pirmās ritmu, bet maina vienu noti. Kāpēc?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bar two moves E up to F sharp, a note of B minor. Same rhythm, new chord, new note.
rows.translation: Otrā takts paceļ E uz F diēzu — B minora skaņu. Tas pats ritms, jauns akords, jauna nots.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Velvet Hour is neo-soul at 74 beats per minute: four lush seventh chords stepping down, Fmaj7, Em7, Dm7 and Cmaj7. Strum once on one, then brush soft ups on the ands.
rows.translation: Velvet Hour ir neosouls tempā 74 sitieni minūtē: četri sulīgi septakordi soļo lejup — Fmaj7, Em7, Dm7 un Cmaj7. Velciet vienreiz uz viens, tad maigi augšup uz „un”.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fmaj7 is the mini F with string 1 left open. Em7 takes one finger: finger 2 on string 5, fret 2, every other string open. Dm7 and Cmaj7 you know from Rain on the Skylight.
rows.translation: Fmaj7 ir mazais F ar brīvu 1. stīgu. Em7 vajag vienu pirkstu: 2. pirkstu uz 5. stīgas 2. ladā, pārējās stīgas brīvas. Dm7 un Cmaj7 jau zināt no Rain on the Skylight.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chords walk down F, E, D. Where does the loop land?
rows.translation: Akordi soļo lejup F, E, D. Uz kā cikls nonāk?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each chord sits one step below the last, and the walk ends on C, the home chord.
rows.translation: Katrs akords atrodas vienu pakāpi zem iepriekšējā, un ceļš beidzas uz C — tonikas akorda.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: An anthem with a key change
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rooftop Choir is a stadium-sized anthem at 92 beats per minute. You play the chorus in C, then one bar of A lifts everything a whole step, and the chorus returns in D.
rows.translation: Rooftop Choir ir stadiona mēroga himna tempā 92 sitieni minūtē. Spēlējat piedziedājumu C tonalitātē, tad viena A takts visu paceļ par toni, un piedziedājums atgriežas D tonalitātē.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A key change up a whole step moves every note up…
rows.translation: Tonalitātes maiņa toni augšup paceļ katru noti par…
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A whole step is two half steps, and each fret is a half step. C becomes D, and G becomes A.
rows.translation: Tonis ir divi pustoņi, un katra lada ir pustonis. C kļūst par D, bet G — par A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord lifts Rooftop Choir from C into D?
rows.translation: Kurš akords paceļ Rooftop Choir no C uz D?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A leads home to D. Landing on it turns the whole song toward the new key.
rows.translation: A ved mājup uz D. Nonākšana uz tā pavērš visu dziesmu jaunās tonalitātes virzienā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Synth-pop, gospel-pop, dark pop, indie pop and a 6/8 finale, with five new barre chords.
rows.translation: Sintpops, gospeļpops, tumšs pops, indīpops un 6/8 fināls ar pieciem jauniem barē akordiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slow Motion Strobe is synth-pop at 118 beats per minute: F sharp minor, D, A and E. The strum is pushed: two of its hits land on the and, just before the beat.
rows.translation: Slow Motion Strobe ir sintpops tempā 118 sitieni minūtē: F diēza minors, D, A un E. Pārvilkums steidzas priekšā: divi akcenti iekrīt uz „un” tieši pirms sitiena.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Barre finger 1 across all six strings at fret 2, then put fingers 3 and 4 on strings 5 and 4 at fret 4: the E minor shape, moved up two frets.
rows.translation: Ar 1. pirkstu veidojiet barē pāri visām sešām stīgām 2. ladā, tad 3. un 4. pirkstu lieciet uz 5. un 4. stīgas 4. ladā: E minora forma, pārvietota divas ladas augstāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bright Side of the Block is a gospel-pop sing-along in D at 100 beats per minute: D, F sharp minor, G and A. Clap on two and four and sing the chorus like the whole street joins in.
rows.translation: Bright Side of the Block ir gospeļpopa kopdziesma D tonalitātē tempā 100 sitieni minūtē: D, F diēza minors, G un A. Plaukšķiniet uz divi un četri un dziediet piedziedājumu, it kā pievienotos visa iela.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Barre finger 1 across strings 5 to 1 at fret 2, then build an A minor shape two frets up with fingers 2, 3 and 4. Leave string 6 silent.
rows.translation: Ar 1. pirkstu veidojiet barē pāri 5. līdz 1. stīgai 2. ladā, tad ar 2., 3. un 4. pirkstu izveidojiet A minora formu divas ladas augstāk. 6. stīgu atstājiet klusu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp at fret 2, E, G, then E.
rows.translation: D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, brīvais E, G 1. stīgas 3. ladā, F diēzs 2. ladā, E, G, tad E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Over You Soon is dark pop in B minor at 84 beats per minute: B minor, G, D and A. Strum once on one, then soft ups on the ands, and keep it hushed.
rows.translation: Over You Soon ir tumšs pops B minorā tempā 84 sitieni minūtē: B minors, G, D un A. Velciet vienreiz uz viens, tad klusi augšup uz „un”, saglabājot pieklusinātu skanējumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp at fret 2, D at fret 3 on string 2, then F sharp, open E and D.
rows.translation: G 1. stīgas 3. ladā, F diēzs 2. ladā, D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, tad F diēzs, brīvais E un D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Spray Paint Sunrise is indie pop at 124 beats per minute: E, B, C sharp minor and A, the four-chord loop with two barres. Drive steady eighths and let it run.
rows.translation: Spray Paint Sunrise ir indīpops tempā 124 sitieni minūtē: E, B, C diēza minors un A — četru akordu cikls ar diviem barē. Virziet vienmērīgas astotdaļnotis un ļaujiet tam plūst.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B is an A shape barred at fret 2: finger 1 across strings 5 to 1, three fingers at fret 4. C sharp minor is an A minor shape barred at fret 4.
rows.translation: B ir A forma ar barē 2. ladā: 1. pirksts pāri 5. līdz 1. stīgai, trīs pirksti 4. ladā. C diēza minors ir A minora forma ar barē 4. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G sharp at fret 4 on string 1, F sharp, open E, open B, then D sharp at fret 4 on string 2, C sharp, D sharp.
rows.translation: G diēzs 1. stīgas 4. ladā, F diēzs, brīvais E, brīvais B, tad D diēzs 2. stīgas 4. ladā, C diēzs, D diēzs.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Constellation Prize closes the course: an anthem in 6/8 at 126 counts a minute, in F. F and B flat are both barres, with C and D minor between them.
rows.translation: Constellation Prize noslēdz kursu: himna F tonalitātē 6/8 tempā 126 skaitījumi minūtē. Gan F, gan B bemols ir barē ar C un D minoru starp tiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Barre finger 1 across strings 5 to 1 at fret 1, then put fingers 2, 3 and 4 on strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 3. Leave string 6 silent.
rows.translation: Ar 1. pirkstu veidojiet barē pāri 5. līdz 1. stīgai 1. ladā, tad 2., 3. un 4. pirkstu lieciet uz 4., 3. un 2. stīgas 3. ladā. 6. stīgu atstājiet klusu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, F at fret 1 on string 1 twice, G at fret 3, F twice, open E, then F.
rows.translation: D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, F 1. stīgas 1. ladā divreiz, G 3. ladā, F divreiz, brīvais E, tad F.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: F sharp minor is which shape, barred at fret 2?
rows.translation: Kura forma ar barē 2. ladā veido F diēza minoru?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Barre at fret 2 and the E minor shape sits in front of your first finger: F sharp minor.
rows.translation: Barē 2. ladā, un E minora forma atrodas pirmā pirksta priekšā — F diēza minors.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Famous tunes everyone knows, start to finish
rows.translation: Visiem pazīstamas melodijas no sākuma līdz beigām
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Folk songs and a spiritual everyone can sing, with simple chord charts to strum.
rows.translation: Tautasdziesmas un spiričuela, ko visi var dziedāt, ar vienkāršām akordu shēmām pārvilkumiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This tune began as a spiritual. In the 1890s railroad crews in the Midwest gave it new words, and Carl Sandburg printed it in 1927. It climbs from low B up to D on string 2.
rows.translation: Šī melodija sākās kā spiričuela. 1890. gados Vidējo Rietumu dzelzceļnieki tai deva jaunus vārdus, un Carl Sandburg to iespieda 1927. gadā. Tā kāpj no zemā B līdz D uz 2. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first line: open D, E, four open Gs, a dip to B on string 5, then home to G.
rows.translation: Pirmā rinda: brīvais D, E, četri brīvie G, nolaišanās līdz B uz 5. stīgas, tad mājup uz G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The words She'll be come before beat one. What are they?
rows.translation: Vārdi She'll be skan pirms pirmā sitiena. Kas tie ir?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into the first strong beat. Here they run up to the word com-.
rows.translation: Uztakts ir dažas notis, kas ved uz pirmo stipro sitienu. Šeit tās kāpj līdz vārda daļai com-.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Three chords: G, C and D7
rows.translation: Trīs akordi: G, C un D7
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Most of the song sits on G. D7 comes at the end of the second line, and C colors the fourth. Change on the word that starts the bar.
rows.translation: Lielākā daļa dziesmas paliek uz G. D7 pienāk otrās rindas beigās, bet C iekrāso ceturto. Mainiet uz vārda, kas sāk takti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This African American spiritual is older than the Civil War and was first printed in 1918. Its line ain't gonna study war no more became a song of the peace movement.
rows.translation: Šī afroamerikāņu spiričuela ir senāka par Pilsoņu karu un pirmoreiz iespiesta 1918. gadā. Tās rinda ain't gonna study war no more kļuva par miera kustības dziesmu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lay down my burden: open B, a drop to open D, then up through E, G and A to B.
rows.translation: Lay down my burden: brīvais B, kritiens uz brīvo D, tad augšup caur E, G un A līdz B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A sharp sits between A and B, at fret 3 on string 3. It slides up into open B, the bluesy lift that gives gospel its sound.
rows.translation: A diēzs atrodas starp A un B, 3. stīgas 3. ladā. Tas ieslīd augšup brīvajā B — blūzīgs pacēlums, kas rada gospeļa skanējumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down by the riverside: B, B, A sharp at fret 3, B, then A and G.
rows.translation: Down by the riverside: B, B, A diēzs 3. ladā, B, tad A un G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The high road and the low road
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This Scottish song was first printed in 1841. The low road is often heard as the road a soldier's spirit takes home, faster than the living on the high road.
rows.translation: Šī skotu dziesma pirmoreiz iespiesta 1841. gadā. Zemo ceļu bieži saprot kā ceļu, pa kuru karavīra gars dodas mājup ātrāk nekā dzīvie pa augsto ceļu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: By yon bonnie banks: open D, then G, G, A, B and back down to G.
rows.translation: By yon bonnie banks: brīvais D, tad G, G, A, B un atpakaļ lejup uz G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This tune moves in quarter notes and pairs of eighths. Count one, two-and, three, four-and, and the lilt comes by itself.
rows.translation: Šī melodija virzās ceturtdaļnotīs un astotdaļu pāros. Skaitiet viens, divi-un, trīs, četri-un, un šūpojums rodas pats.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This song was printed in 1876 and credited in 1884 to James Yorkston of Edinburgh. It is now Dublin's unofficial anthem, and Molly and her cart stand as a statue in the city.
rows.translation: Šī dziesma iespiesta 1876. gadā, un 1884. gadā tās autorība piedēvēta James Yorkston no Edinburgas. Tagad tā ir Dublinas neoficiālā himna, un pilsētā ir Mollijas un viņas ratiņu statuja.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In Dublin's fair city: open D, four open Gs, up to open B and back to G.
rows.translation: In Dublin's fair city: brīvais D, četri brīvie G, augšup uz brīvo B un atpakaļ uz G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count one, two, three and lean on one. In many bars the middle note is long: one, two, and a quick note just before the next one.
rows.translation: Skaitiet viens, divi, trīs un uzsveriet viens. Daudzās taktīs vidējā nots ir gara: viens, divi, tad ātra nots tieši pirms nākamā viens.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Cecil Sharp collected and published this ballad in 1906, from verses that go back to the 1700s. Play it slowly and let every long note ring.
rows.translation: Cecil Sharp šo balādi savāca un publicēja 1906. gadā no pantiem, kas sniedzas līdz gadsimtam, kurš sākās 1700. gadā. Spēlējiet lēni un ļaujiet katrai garajai notij skanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The water is wide, I cannot get o'er: up from open D to B, then gently back down to D.
rows.translation: The water is wide, I cannot get o'er: augšup no brīvā D līdz B, tad maigi atpakaļ lejup līdz D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Wide rings for two beats and two for two and a half. Keep counting while the string rings, so the next word lands on time.
rows.translation: Wide skan divus sitienus, bet two — divarpus. Turpiniet skaitīt, kamēr stīga skan, lai nākamais vārds iekrīt laikā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which word holds over two notes in the first verse?
rows.translation: Kurš vārds pirmajā pantā stiepjas pāri divām notīm?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fly starts on C and slides down to a long A. Singers call one syllable over several notes a melisma.
rows.translation: Fly sākas uz C un slīd lejup līdz garam A. Dziedātāji vienu zilbi uz vairākām notīm sauc par melismu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new notes: the five songs from this unit, one after another, a little faster than before. Name each one from its first notes.
rows.translation: Nav jaunu nošu: piecas šīs nodaļas dziesmas cita pēc citas, mazliet ātrāk nekā iepriekš. Nosauciet katru pēc pirmajām notīm.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A Welsh lullaby, a Highland boat song and three carols, in German, Latin and English.
rows.translation: Velsiešu šūpuļdziesma, Hailendas laivas dziesma un trīs Ziemassvētku dziesmas vācu, latīņu un angļu valodā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The tune Ar Hyd y Nos was printed in Wales in 1784, and Harold Boulton wrote these English words in 1884. One phrase comes three times, with a higher one in the middle.
rows.translation: Melodija Ar Hyd y Nos iespiesta Velsā 1784. gadā, un Harold Boulton šos angļu vārdus sarakstīja 1884. gadā. Viena frāze skan trīsreiz ar augstāku frāzi pa vidu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sleep, my child, and peace attend thee: open G, down to F sharp and E, then G, A, G, F sharp and D.
rows.translation: Sleep, my child, and peace attend thee: brīvais G, lejup uz F diēzu un E, tad G, A, G, F diēzs un D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which phrase of the verse climbs highest?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The third phrase, soft the drowsy hours, rises to C, D and E. The other three phrases share one tune.
rows.translation: Trešā frāze, soft the drowsy hours, paceļas līdz C, D un E. Pārējām trim frāzēm ir viena melodija.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Harold Boulton set these words in 1884 to a Highland rowing tune collected by Anne MacLeod. They tell of Bonnie Prince Charlie escaping to the Isle of Skye in 1746.
rows.translation: Harold Boulton šos vārdus 1884. gadā pielika Hailendas airēšanas melodijai, ko savākusi Anne MacLeod. Tie stāsta par prinča Čārlza aizbēgšanu uz Skajas salu 1746. gadā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This song rocks in six-eight: two big beats a bar, each split in three. Count one-two-three, four-five-six, like oars pulling and coming back.
rows.translation: Šī dziesma šūpojas sešu astotdaļu taktī: divi lieli sitieni taktī, katrs sadalīts trīs daļās. Skaitiet viens-divi-trīs, četri-pieci-seši kā airu vilcienus un atgriešanos.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Speed, bonnie boat, like a bird on the wing: open D, E, D, three open Gs, then A, B, A and up to D.
rows.translation: Speed, bonnie boat, like a bird on the wing: brīvais D, E, D, trīs brīvie G, tad A, B, A un augšup uz D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ernst Anschütz wrote these words in Leipzig in 1824, to a much older folk tune. You'll sing them in German, the language they were written in.
rows.translation: Ernsts Anšics šos vārdus sarakstīja Leipcigā 1824. gadā daudz senākai tautas melodijai. Dziedāsiet vāciski — valodā, kurā tie uzrakstīti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: O Tannenbaum, o Tannenbaum: open D, three open Gs, then A at fret 2 and three open Bs.
rows.translation: O Tannenbaum, o Tannenbaum: brīvais D, trīs brīvie G, tad A 2. ladā un trīs brīvie B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Tan-nen is a dotted note and a very short one, then baum rings on. Say the words as you tap, and the rhythm follows.
rows.translation: Tan-nen ir punktēta nots un ļoti īsa nots, tad baum turpina skanēt. Piesitot sakiet vārdus, un ritms sekos.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The Latin hymn Adeste Fideles was printed with this tune in 1751, and Frederick Oakeley's English words followed in 1841. You'll sing a verse in each language.
rows.translation: Latīņu himna Adeste Fideles ar šo melodiju iespiesta 1751. gadā, un Frederick Oakeley angļu vārdi sekoja 1841. gadā. Dziedāsiet pa pantam katrā valodā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: O come, all ye faithful: open G twice, down to open D, back to G, A, and D again.
rows.translation: O come, all ye faithful: brīvais G divreiz, lejup uz brīvo D, atpakaļ uz G, A un atkal D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many times does the refrain sing O come, let us adore him?
rows.translation: Cik reižu piedziedājumā dzied O come, let us adore him?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Three times, each a little higher, before Christ the Lord brings the tune home.
rows.translation: Trīsreiz, katru mazliet augstāk, pirms Christ the Lord atved melodiju mājās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Latin hymn (1751); English words Frederick Oakeley (1841)
rows.translation: Latīņu himna (1751); angļu vārdi — Frederick Oakeley (1841)
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This carol was first printed in 1823, in a collection of old Christmas carols. Its tune walks up the scale and back, which is why it is so easy to remember.
rows.translation: Šī Ziemassvētku dziesma pirmoreiz iespiesta 1823. gadā senu svētku dziesmu krājumā. Tās melodija soļo augšup pa gammu un atpakaļ, tāpēc to ir tik viegli atcerēties.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Up the D scale: F sharp and E, open D, then E, F sharp, open G, A, open B, C sharp at fret 2 and D.
rows.translation: Augšup pa D gammu: F diēzs un E, brīvais D, tad E, F diēzs, brīvais G, A, brīvais B, C diēzs 2. ladā un D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The tune starts with two quick notes, F sharp and E, before beat one. Then a long D and a run of eighths climb to A.
rows.translation: Melodija sākas ar divām ātrām notīm — F diēzu un E — pirms pirmā sitiena. Tad garš D un astotdaļu virkne kāpj līdz A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Five songs from this unit: two ballads and three carols. No new notes, just one after another, each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Piecas šīs nodaļas dziesmas: divas balādes un trīs Ziemassvētku dziesmas. Nav jaunu nošu, tikai cita pēc citas, katra mazliet ātrāk nekā iepriekš.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these counts in six?
rows.translation: Kuru no šīm skaita pa sešiem?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The Skye Boat Song rocks in six-eight. O Christmas Tree is in three, and All Through the Night in four.
rows.translation: The Skye Boat Song šūpojas sešu astotdaļu taktī. O Christmas Tree ir trijdaļu metrā, bet All Through the Night — četrdaļu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A pipe march, a Russian folk dance, the Blue Danube and the can-can.
rows.translation: Dūdu maršs, krievu tautas deja, Zilā Donava un kankāns.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This Scottish march was in print by 1878, and pipe bands play it all over the world. Pipers play it without words, and so will you.
rows.translation: Šis skotu maršs bija iespiests jau 1878. gadā, un dūdu ansambļi to spēlē visā pasaulē. Dūdinieki to spēlē bez vārdiem, un tāpat darīsiet arī jūs.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A dotted note and a quick one give a march its snap: long, then short. In the first bar, the second D is long and E slips in just before beat two.
rows.translation: Punktēta nots un ātra nots piešķir maršam asumu: gari, tad īsi. Pirmajā taktī otrais D ir garš, un E ieslīd tieši pirms otrā sitiena.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Up the D chord: open D twice, E, F sharp at fret 4, D, F sharp, A, then D on string 2.
rows.translation: Augšup pa D akordu: brīvais D divreiz, E, F diēzs 4. ladā, D, F diēzs, A, tad D uz 2. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Nikolay Nekrasov's poem about traveling peddlers was printed in 1861, and this folk tune was published with it in 1898. A video game made it famous worldwide almost a century later.
rows.translation: Nikolaja Ņekrasova dzejolis par ceļojošiem tirgotājiem iespiests 1861. gadā, un šī tautas melodija ar to publicēta 1898. gadā. Gandrīz gadsimtu vēlāk videospēle to padarīja slavenu visā pasaulē.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening: open B, down to F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, up G and A, then G, F sharp, E.
rows.translation: Sākums: brīvais B, lejup līdz F diēzam 4. stīgas 4. ladā, augšup G un A, tad G, F diēzs, E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The second half reaches higher: A, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E, then down D, C, B and G.
rows.translation: Otrā puse sniedzas augstāk: A, C 2. stīgas 1. ladā, brīvais E, tad lejup D, C, B un G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This tune is in E minor. Which note sounds like home?
rows.translation: Šī melodija ir E minorā. Kura nots skan kā mājas?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Both halves end on E, the home note of E minor. You hear it as the place the tune settles.
rows.translation: Abas puses beidzas uz E — E minora tonikas. To dzirdat kā vietu, kur melodija norimst.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Johann Strauss II first performed this waltz in Vienna in 1867, and Vienna still plays it every New Year's Day. Its tune climbs a chord, then answers with two high notes.
rows.translation: Johans Štrauss II šo valsi pirmoreiz atskaņoja Vīnē 1867. gadā, un Vīnē to joprojām spēlē katrā Jaungada dienā. Melodija kāpj pa akordu, tad atbild ar divām augstām notīm.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 6 twice, B on string 5, open D, then leap up to D at fret 3 on string 2 and down to open B.
rows.translation: G 6. stīgas 3. ladā divreiz, B uz 5. stīgas, brīvais D, tad lēciens augšup līdz D 2. stīgas 3. ladā un lejup uz brīvo B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each phrase starts low on the bass strings and leaps up an octave. Look at the high note before you play the low ones, so your hand knows where it's going.
rows.translation: Katra frāze sākas zemu uz basa stīgām un lec oktāvu augšup. Pirms spēlējat zemās notis, paskatieties uz augsto, lai roka zinātu, kurp tā dodas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Jacques Offenbach wrote this galop for his 1858 operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Paris dance halls later made it the music of the can-can.
rows.translation: Žaks Ofenbahs šo galopu sarakstīja savai 1858. gada operetei Orfejs pazemē. Parīzes deju zāles vēlāk to padarīja par kankāna mūziku.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A long open G, then A, C, B, A, and two Ds at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: Garš brīvais G, tad A, C, B, A un divi D 2. stīgas 3. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Most of the tune runs in eighth notes. Keep the pick small and alternate down and up, so you never fall behind.
rows.translation: Lielākā daļa melodijas iet astotdaļnotīs. Mediatora kustībai jābūt mazai, un mainiet vēzienus lejup un augšup, lai nekad neatpaliktu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The big run: open G, leap to G at fret 3 on string 1, then step all the way down to A.
rows.translation: Lielais skrējiens: brīvais G, lēciens līdz G 1. stīgas 3. ladā, tad pa pakāpēm līdz pat A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Four tunes from this unit: a pipe march, a Russian folk song, a Viennese waltz and a French galop. Each one a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Četras šīs nodaļas melodijas: dūdu maršs, krievu tautasdziesma, Vīnes valsis un franču galops. Katra mazliet ātrāk nekā iepriekš.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these is a waltz, in three?
rows.translation: Kura no šīm ir valsis trijdaļu metrā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A waltz counts one, two, three. The can-can and the pipe march both count in four.
rows.translation: Valsi skaita viens, divi, trīs. Kankānu un dūdu maršu abus skaita pa četriem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Joplin, Sousa, Bizet and Grieg: syncopation, six-eight and key changes.
rows.translation: Džoplins, Sūza, Bizē un Grīgs: sinkopes, sešas astotdaļas un tonalitāšu maiņas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Scott Joplin published The Entertainer in 1902, and a 1973 film made it famous again. In ragtime the tune leans off the beat while the bass keeps steady time.
rows.translation: Skots Džoplins publicēja The Entertainer 1902. gadā, un 1973. gada filma to atkal padarīja slavenu. Regtaimā melodija tiecas starp sitieniem, kamēr bass tur vienmērīgu ritmu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open D, D sharp at fret 1, E at fret 2 on string 4, then leap to C at fret 1 on string 2 and back, three times.
rows.translation: Brīvais D, D diēzs 1. ladā, E 2. ladā uz 4. stīgas, tad lēciens līdz C 2. stīgas 1. ladā un atpakaļ trīsreiz.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Syncopation puts the accent between the beats. In the opening, each C lands on an and. Count one-and-two-and and feel the C pull ahead.
rows.translation: Sinkopēšana liek akcentu starp sitieniem. Sākumā katrs C iekrīt uz „un”. Skaitiet viens-un-divi-un un sajūtiet, kā C velk uz priekšu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The ending run circles C, D and E on strings 2 and 1, then lands through B and D on C.
rows.translation: Beigu skrējiens riņķo ap C, D un E uz 2. un 1. stīgas, tad caur B un D nonāk uz C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: John Philip Sousa published The Liberty Bell in 1893, and a British TV comedy later made it its theme. It's in six-eight: two big beats a bar, like left, right.
rows.translation: Džons Filips Sūza publicēja The Liberty Bell 1893. gadā, un britu televīzijas komēdija vēlāk to padarīja par savu tēmu. Tas ir sešu astotdaļu taktī: divi lieli sitieni taktī kā kreisā, labā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Many beats start with a short silence. Stop the string with your fretting hand, then come back in on the next eighth.
rows.translation: Daudzi sitieni sākas ar īsu klusumu. Apturiet stīgu ar spiedējroku, tad atsāciet uz nākamās astotdaļas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open B three times, A sharp at fret 3 on string 3, B again, then up to G on string 1 and down D, D, B.
rows.translation: Brīvais B trīsreiz, A diēzs 3. stīgas 3. ladā, atkal B, tad augšup līdz G uz 1. stīgas un lejup D, D, B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Georges Bizet's opera Carmen opened in Paris in 1875. Its prelude starts with this festive march, then plays the tune of the famous Toreador Song.
rows.translation: Žorža Bizē opera Karmena pirmizrādi piedzīvoja Parīzē 1875. gadā. Tās prelūdija sākas ar šo svinīgo maršu, tad spēlē slavenās Toreadora dziesmas melodiju.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Four As at fret 2 on string 3, then down to E at fret 2 on string 4, open D and E.
rows.translation: Četri A 3. stīgas 2. ladā, tad lejup līdz E 4. stīgas 2. ladā, brīvais D un E.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The march is in A major, with C sharp and G sharp. The Toreador tune moves to F major, with B flat at fret 3 on string 3. Watch for the change.
rows.translation: Maršs ir A mažorā ar C diēzu un G diēzu. Toreadora melodija pāriet F mažorā ar B bemolu 3. stīgas 3. ladā. Vērojiet maiņu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: What happens at the end of the Toreador tune?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: It climbs to a long E
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: It climbs to a long high E, the note that leads back home to A major for the march.
rows.translation: Tā kāpj līdz garam augstajam E — notij, kas ved mājup uz A mažoru maršam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Edvard Grieg wrote Morning Mood in 1875 for the play Peer Gynt. The flute plays the theme, the oboe answers, and the music climbs like the rising sun.
rows.translation: Edvards Grīgs skaņdarbu Rīts sarakstīja 1875. gadā lugai Pērs Gints. Flauta spēlē tēmu, oboja atbild, un mūzika kāpj kā uzlecoša saule.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The theme uses just G, A, B, D and E. A five-note scale like this is called pentatonic, and it sounds calm and open.
rows.translation: Tēma izmanto tikai G, A, B, D un E. Šādu piecu nošu gammu sauc par pentatonisku, un tā skan mierīgi un plaši.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G, then back up A and B.
rows.translation: D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, brīvais B, A 3. stīgas 2. ladā, brīvais G, tad atpakaļ augšup A un B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many different notes does the theme use?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, A, B, D and E: a pentatonic scale. There is no C and no F sharp in the whole theme.
rows.translation: G, A, B, D un E — pentatoniskā gamma. Visā tēmā nav ne C, ne F diēza.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The four pieces from this unit, back to back: ragtime, a march, an opera prelude and a sunrise. Each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Četri šīs nodaļas skaņdarbi pēc kārtas: regtaims, maršs, operas prelūdija un saullēkts. Katrs mazliet ātrāk nekā iepriekš.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these pieces uses only five notes in its theme?
rows.translation: Kurš no šiem skaņdarbiem savā tēmā izmanto tikai piecas notis?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Morning Mood's theme is pentatonic: G, A, B, D and E. The others use many more.
rows.translation: Skaņdarba Rīts tēma ir pentatoniska: G, A, B, D un E. Pārējie izmanto daudz vairāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Four Christmas carols to sing by candlelight: Wesley and Mendelssohn, a lullaby, and two tunes from America.
rows.translation: Četras Ziemassvētku dziesmas sveču gaismai: Veslijs un Mendelsons, šūpuļdziesma un divas melodijas no Amerikas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Charles Wesley wrote the words in 1739. In 1856 an English organist set them to a tune from a choral piece by Felix Mendelssohn, and the carol has been sung that way since.
rows.translation: Čārlzs Veslijs vārdus sarakstīja 1739. gadā. 1856. gadā angļu ērģelnieks tos pielika melodijai no Fēliksa Mendelsona kora skaņdarba, un kopš tā laika dziesmu dzied šādi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open D, open G twice, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, G, then open B twice and A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: Brīvais D, brīvais G divreiz, F diēzs 4. stīgas 4. ladā, G, tad brīvais B divreiz un A 3. stīgas 2. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Her-ald is long-short: her- lands on three and holds, and -ald slips in on the and of four. Count one, two, three, four-and.
rows.translation: Her-ald ir gari–īsi: her- iekrīt uz trīs un turas, bet -ald ieslīd uz ceturtā sitiena „un”. Skaitiet viens, divi, trīs, četri-un.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chorus moves C, A minor, D7 and G. Change on the word that starts each half bar, and keep the strum light under the high E.
rows.translation: Piedziedājums iet C, A minors, D7 un G. Mainiet uz vārda, kas sāk katru pustakti, un zem augstā E saglabājiet vieglu pārvilkumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: These words first appeared in an American children's book in 1885, and James R. Murray gave them this gentle tune in 1887. It rocks in three, like a cradle.
rows.translation: Šie vārdi pirmoreiz parādījās amerikāņu bērnu grāmatā 1885. gadā, un James R. Murray tiem deva šo maigo melodiju 1887. gadā. Tā šūpojas pa trim kā šūpulis.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: It starts high: D at fret 3 on string 2, then steps down C, B, A, G and F sharp all the way to open D.
rows.translation: Sākas augstu: D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, tad pa pakāpēm lejup C, B, A, G un F diēzs līdz pat brīvajam D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first line walks down from high D to low D. How far is that?
rows.translation: Pirmā rinda iet lejup no augstā D līdz zemajam D. Cik tālu tas ir?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D down to D is an octave: eight steps of the scale, the same note name, one register lower.
rows.translation: D lejup līdz D ir oktāva: astoņas gammas pakāpes, tas pats nots nosaukums, vienu reģistru zemāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold G for most of a line, C for crib for a bed, and D7 to lead home. In three, strum down on one and lightly on two and three.
rows.translation: G turiet lielāko rindas daļu, C uz crib for a bed un D7 ceļam mājup. Trijdaļu metrā velciet lejup uz viens un viegli uz divi un trīs.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Nezināms autors (1885); 3. pants — John T. McFarland (1892)
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Phillips Brooks wrote these words in 1868 for the children of his Philadelphia church, and its organist, Lewis Redner, wrote the tune for their Christmas service.
rows.translation: Phillips Brooks šos vārdus sarakstīja 1868. gadā savas Filadelfijas baznīcas bērniem, bet tās ērģelnieks Lewis Redner sacerēja melodiju Ziemassvētku dievkalpojumam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open B three times, A sharp at fret 3 on string 3, B again, then D, C and a drop to E on string 4.
rows.translation: Brīvais B trīsreiz, A diēzs 3. stīgas 3. ladā, atkal B, tad D, C un kritiens līdz E uz 4. stīgas.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A sharp at fret 3 on string 3 leans into open B, a half step up. It gives O little town its gentle sway.
rows.translation: A diēzs 3. stīgas 3. ladā tiecas uz brīvo B pustoni augstāk. Tas piešķir O little town maigo šūpojumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which word dips down to the low D in the first verse?
rows.translation: Kurš vārds pirmajā pantā nolaižas līdz zemajam D?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Thee, in how still we see thee lie
rows.translation: Thee rindā how still we see thee lie
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: How still we see thee lie: the tune falls to open D on thee, then lifts to B on lie.
rows.translation: How still we see thee lie: melodija nokrīt līdz brīvajam D uz thee, tad paceļas līdz B uz lie.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: It Came Upon the Midnight Clear
rows.translation: It Came Upon the Midnight Clear
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Edmund Sears wrote these words in Massachusetts in 1849, and Richard Storrs Willis wrote the tune a year later. It swings in two big beats a bar, each split in three.
rows.translation: Edmund Sears šos vārdus sarakstīja Masačūsetsā 1849. gadā, bet Richard Storrs Willis melodiju sacerēja gadu vēlāk. Tā šūpojas divos lielos sitienos taktī, katrs sadalīts trīs daļās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In six-eight a quarter and an eighth make one big beat: long, short. Count one-two-three, four-five-six, and play on one, three, four and six.
rows.translation: Sešu astotdaļu taktī ceturtdaļnots un astotdaļnots veido vienu lielu sitienu: gari, īsi. Skaitiet viens-divi-trīs, četri-pieci-seši un spēlējiet uz viens, trīs, četri un seši.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open G, a leap to open E on string 1, then B, D, C, A, and back to G with a turn through A.
rows.translation: Brīvais G, lēciens līdz brīvajam E uz 1. stīgas, tad B, D, C, A un atpakaļ uz G ar pagriezienu caur A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The middle of the verse drops to low E and climbs through G sharp, at fret 1 on string 3, to A. Under it the chord moves from E7 to A minor.
rows.translation: Panta vidus nokrīt līdz zemajam E un kāpj caur G diēzu 3. stīgas 1. ladā līdz A. Zem tā akords pāriet no E7 uz A minoru.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The four carols from this unit, one after another, each a little faster. Keep the chords soft and let the tune sing.
rows.translation: Četras šīs nodaļas Ziemassvētku dziesmas cita pēc citas, katra mazliet ātrāk. Akordus turiet klusus un ļaujiet melodijai dziedāt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these carols counts in three?
rows.translation: Kuru no šīm Ziemassvētku dziesmām skaita pa trim?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Away in a Manger is a waltz: one, two, three. The other two count in four.
rows.translation: Away in a Manger ir valsis: viens, divi, trīs. Abas pārējās skaita pa četriem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: King's College's opening carol, Holst's midwinter carol, a folk carol and a grand processional.
rows.translation: King's College sākuma dziesma, Holsta ziemas vidus dziesma, tautas Ziemassvētku dziesma un svinīga procesija.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Cecil Frances Alexander wrote these words for children in 1848. Since 1919 a single young voice has sung the first verse to open the Christmas Eve carols at King's College, Cambridge.
rows.translation: Cecil Frances Alexander šos vārdus bērniem sarakstīja 1848. gadā. Kopš 1919. gada viena jauna balss dzied pirmo pantu, atklājot Ziemassvētku vakara dziesmas King's College Kembridžā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open D, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, open G, then a turn: G, F sharp, G, A, A, G.
rows.translation: Brīvais D, F diēzs 4. stīgas 4. ladā, brīvais G, tad pavērsiens: G, F diēzs, G, A, A, G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Da-vid's spreads each syllable over two eighth notes. Play both, but sing them as one smooth sound.
rows.translation: Da-vid's katru zilbi izstiepj pāri divām astotdaļnotīm. Spēlējiet abas, bet dziediet kā vienu plūstošu skaņu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where is the highest note of the carol?
rows.translation: Kur ir Ziemassvētku dziesmas augstākā nots?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mary was that mother mild starts on open E, the top of the tune.
rows.translation: Mary was that mother mild sākas uz brīvā E — melodijas augstākā punkta.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A poem and a quiet tune
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Christina Rossetti wrote this poem in 1872, and Gustav Holst set it to music for a hymn book in 1906. Its lines are short and calm, like snow falling.
rows.translation: Christina Rossetti šo dzejoli sarakstīja 1872. gadā, un Gustavs Holsts tam sacerēja mūziku himnu grāmatai 1906. gadā. Rindas ir īsas un mierīgas kā krītošs sniegs.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open B twice, C at fret 1 and D at fret 3 on string 2, then back down B, A and G.
rows.translation: Brīvais B divreiz, C 1. ladā un D 3. ladā uz 2. stīgas, tad atpakaļ lejup B, A un G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Many words land on half notes: -ter in mid-winter, i-ron. Let each ring for two full beats before you move on.
rows.translation: Daudzi vārdi iekrīt uz pusnotīm: -ter vārdā mid-winter, i-ron. Ļaujiet katrai skanēt divus pilnus sitienus, pirms ejat tālāk.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Long ago stretches three syllables over how many notes?
rows.translation: Pāri cik notīm Long ago izstiepj trīs zilbes?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Long takes two notes, a- takes two, and go takes one: five notes for three syllables.
rows.translation: Long aizņem divas notis, a- — divas, bet go — vienu: piecas notis trim zilbēm.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Under frost-y wind made moan the chords move A minor to D7, a lean that pulls the line back to G.
rows.translation: Zem frost-y wind made moan akordi pāriet no A minora uz D7 — tieksme, kas velk rindu atpakaļ uz G.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This carol is centuries old. The song collector Cecil Sharp heard it sung in a Cotswold town and printed this tune in 1911. It dances in three.
rows.translation: Šī Ziemassvētku dziesma ir gadsimtiem sena. Dziesmu vācējs Cecil Sharp dzirdēja to dziedam Kotsvoldas pilsētā un iespieda šo melodiju 1911. gadā. Tā dejo pa trim.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Four open Gs, then a leap to open E on string 1, down to D at fret 3 on string 2 and open B.
rows.translation: Četri brīvie G, tad lēciens līdz brīvajam E uz 1. stīgas, lejup uz D 2. stīgas 3. ladā un brīvo B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: From open G to open E is a sixth. Keep your pick close to the strings and cross from string 3 to string 1 in one move.
rows.translation: No brīvā G līdz brīvajam E ir seksta. Turiet mediatoru tuvu stīgām un pārejiet no 3. uz 1. stīgu vienā kustībā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Angels from the Realms of Glory
rows.translation: Angels from the Realms of Glory
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: James Montgomery printed these words in his Sheffield newspaper on Christmas Eve, 1816. Henry Smart's tune, from 1867, gives it a grand, marching sound.
rows.translation: James Montgomery šos vārdus iespieda savā Šefīldas avīzē 1816. gada Ziemassvētku vakarā. Henry Smart 1867. gada melodija piešķir tai svinīgu marša skanējumu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A on string 3, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, D at fret 3 on string 2, A, then F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, E and D.
rows.translation: A uz 3. stīgas, F diēzs 4. stīgas 4. ladā, D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, A, tad F diēzs 1. stīgas 2. ladā, E un D.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This key has two sharps, F sharp and C sharp. C sharp sits at fret 2 on string 2.
rows.translation: Šai tonalitātei ir divi diēzi — F diēzs un C diēzs. C diēzs ir 2. stīgas 2. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where is the highest note of the chorus?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Worship Christ starts on G at fret 3 on string 1, the top of the whole carol.
rows.translation: Worship Christ sākas uz G 1. stīgas 3. ladā — visas Ziemassvētku dziesmas augstākā punkta.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The carols from this unit, back to back. Most move in long notes: let each one ring full length before the next.
rows.translation: Šīs nodaļas Ziemassvētku dziesmas pēc kārtas. Vairums virzās garās notīs: ļaujiet katrai skanēt pilnu ilgumu pirms nākamās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these counts in three?
rows.translation: Kuru no šīm skaita pa trim?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The Holly and the Ivy is in three. The other two count in four.
rows.translation: The Holly and the Ivy ir trijdaļu metrā. Abas pārējās skaita pa četriem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Five great hymns in long, singing notes, from 1708 to 1861.
rows.translation: Piecas izcilas himnas garās, dziedošās notīs no 1708. līdz 1861. gadam.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: O God, Our Help in Ages Past
rows.translation: O God, Our Help in Ages Past
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: William Croft wrote this tune, St Anne, in 1708, and Isaac Watts's words were first printed in 1719. Each verse is four short lines, the plainest hymn shape there is.
rows.translation: William Croft šo melodiju St Anne sarakstīja 1708. gadā, un Isaac Watts vārdi pirmoreiz iespiesti 1719. gadā. Katram pantam ir četras īsas rindas — visvienkāršākā himnas forma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open G, E at fret 2 on string 4, A at fret 2 on string 3, G, then C at fret 1 on string 2, C, open B and C.
rows.translation: Brīvais G, E 4. stīgas 2. ladā, A 3. stīgas 2. ladā, G, tad C 2. stīgas 1. ladā, C, brīvais B un C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every line starts on the beat before the bar: O, our, our, and. Count four, then sing the first word on it.
rows.translation: Katra rinda sākas uz sitiena pirms takts: O, our, our, and. Skaitiet četri, tad uz tā nodziediet pirmo vārdu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chart leans on A minor, F and G7. God, our sits on A minor, and a-ges past moves from G7 to C.
rows.translation: Akordu shēma balstās uz A minora, F un G7. God, our ir uz A minora, bet a-ges past pāriet no G7 uz C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Reginald Heber wrote these words, printed in 1826, and John Bacchus Dykes wrote the tune in 1861. Its first line climbs the notes of a G major chord.
rows.translation: Reginald Heber sarakstīja šos vārdus, kas iespiesti 1826. gadā, bet John Bacchus Dykes melodiju sacerēja 1861. gadā. Pirmā rinda kāpj pa G mažora akorda skaņām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Up the G chord: open G twice, open B twice, then D at fret 3 on string 2, held long.
rows.translation: Augšup pa G akordu: brīvais G divreiz, brīvais B divreiz, tad ilgi turēts D 2. stīgas 3. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Holy, holy, holy climbs which notes?
rows.translation: Pa kurām notīm kāpj Holy, holy, holy?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, B and D are the notes of a G major chord, so the tune climbs the chord itself.
rows.translation: G, B un D ir G mažora akorda skaņas, tāpēc melodija kāpj pa pašu akordu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This hymn moves in long notes: halves of two beats and a whole note of four at the end. Count every beat, even while a note rings.
rows.translation: Šī himna virzās garās notīs: pusnotis divu sitienu garumā un vesela nots četru sitienu garumā beigās. Skaitiet katru sitienu arī tad, kad nots skan.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Henry Francis Lyte wrote these words in 1847, and William Henry Monk wrote the tune Eventide for them in 1861. Football crowds in England have sung it before the cup final since 1927.
rows.translation: Henry Francis Lyte šos vārdus sarakstīja 1847. gadā, bet William Henry Monk tiem sacerēja melodiju Eventide 1861. gadā. Anglijas futbola līdzjutēji to dzied pirms kausa fināla kopš 1927. gada.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open B twice, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G, then D at fret 3 and E on string 1, back through D and C to B.
rows.translation: Brīvais B divreiz, A 3. stīgas 2. ladā, brīvais G, tad D 3. ladā un E uz 1. stīgas, atpakaļ caur D un C līdz B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every note here is a quarter, a half or a whole. Count four steady beats a bar and let the long notes ring.
rows.translation: Katra nots šeit ir ceturtdaļnots, pusnots vai vesela nots. Skaitiet četrus vienmērīgus sitienus taktī un ļaujiet garajām notīm skanēt.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note leads into the D at the end of the second line?
rows.translation: Kura nots ved uz D otrās rindas beigās?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: C sharp, at fret 2 on string 2, rises a half step into D, the way a leading note does.
rows.translation: C diēzs 2. stīgas 2. ladā paceļas pustoni līdz D, kā to dara ievadskaņa.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sarah Flower Adams wrote these words in London in 1841, and Lowell Mason, an American music teacher, gave them this tune in 1856.
rows.translation: Sarah Flower Adams šos vārdus sarakstīja Londonā 1841. gadā, bet amerikāņu mūzikas skolotājs Lowell Mason tiem deva šo melodiju 1856. gadā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G twice, then E at fret 2 on string 4 twice.
rows.translation: Brīvais B, A 3. stīgas 2. ladā, brīvais G divreiz, tad E 4. stīgas 2. ladā divreiz.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each line has a long-short pair: a dotted quarter, then a quick eighth, as in -er, my and God, to. Let the long note lean into the short one.
rows.translation: Katrā rindā ir garš–īss pāris: punktēta ceturtdaļnots, tad ātra astotdaļnots, piemēram, -er, my un God, to. Ļaujiet garajai notij tiekties uz īso.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: For the Beauty of the Earth
rows.translation: For the Beauty of the Earth
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Folliott Pierpoint wrote these words in 1864, on a spring day in the English countryside. They are sung to Dix, a German tune from 1838.
rows.translation: Folliott Pierpoint šos vārdus sarakstīja 1864. gadā pavasara dienā Anglijas laukos. Tos dzied ar Dix — vācu melodiju no 1838. gada.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open G, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, G, A at fret 2 on string 3, G, then C at fret 1 on string 2 twice and open B.
rows.translation: Brīvais G, F diēzs 4. stīgas 4. ladā, G, A 3. stīgas 2. ladā, G, tad C 2. stīgas 1. ladā divreiz un brīvais B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: For the starts with two eighth notes on the: F sharp and G, one syllable sung over both. Play them evenly inside one beat.
rows.translation: For the sākas ar divām astotdaļnotīm uz the: F diēzs un G, viena zilbe pāri abām. Spēlējiet tās vienmērīgi viena sitiena ietvaros.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The hymns from this unit, back to back, from the oldest tune to the newest. Let the long notes ring and the chords change on the word.
rows.translation: Šīs nodaļas himnas pēc kārtas, no senākās melodijas līdz jaunākajai. Ļaujiet garajām notīm skanēt un mainiet akordus uz vārda.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these tunes is the oldest?
rows.translation: Kura no šīm melodijām ir vissenākā?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: William Croft wrote St Anne in 1708, almost 150 years before the other two.
rows.translation: William Croft melodiju St Anne sarakstīja 1708. gadā, gandrīz 150 gadus pirms pārējām divām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Three songs families sang around the piano, then Holst's Jupiter.
rows.translation: Trīs dziesmas, ko ģimenes dziedāja pie klavierēm, tad Holsta Jupiters.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Henry Bishop wrote this tune for a London opera in 1823, to words by the American actor John Howard Payne. Within a few years it was one of the best-loved songs in the world.
rows.translation: Henry Bishop šo melodiju sarakstīja Londonas operai 1823. gadā ar amerikāņu aktiera John Howard Payne vārdiem. Dažu gadu laikā tā kļuva par vienu no pasaulē iemīļotākajām dziesmām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open G, A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, C at fret 1 and D at fret 3 on string 2, then back to B.
rows.translation: Brīvais G, A 3. stīgas 2. ladā, brīvais B, C 1. ladā un D 3. ladā uz 2. stīgas, tad atpakaļ uz B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The verse starts just before beat one, on a dotted eighth and a sixteenth. Count four-e-and-a: 'Mid lands on four, and its short turn on a.
rows.translation: Pants sākas tieši pirms pirmā sitiena ar punktētu astotdaļnoti un sešpadsmitdaļnoti. Skaitiet četri-e-un-a: 'Mid iekrīt uz četri, bet tā īsais pagrieziens — uz a.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chorus begins on one long note. How long is it?
rows.translation: Piedziedājums sākas ar vienu garu noti. Cik ilga tā ir?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Home! is a whole note: hold D at fret 3 on string 2 for the whole bar.
rows.translation: Home! ir vesela nots: turiet D 2. stīgas 3. ladā visu takti.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hard Times Come Again No More
rows.translation: Hard Times Come Again No More
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1
