rows.source: Stephen Foster published this song in 1854. It asks the listener to stop and think of people who have less, and singers still return to it today.
rows.translation: Stīvens Fosters šo dziesmu publicēja 1854. gadā. Tā aicina klausītāju apstāties un padomāt par cilvēkiem, kuriem ir mazāk, un dziedātāji pie tās atgriežas joprojām.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open D, E and F sharp on string 4, three more F sharps, then A at fret 2 on string 3 and back to F sharp.
rows.translation: Brīvais D, E un F diēzs uz 4. stīgas, vēl trīs F diēzi, tad A 3. stīgas 2. ladā un atpakaļ uz F diēzu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The verse sings several words on one note. Keep each F sharp short and even, and let the words carry the line.
rows.translation: Pants vairākus vārdus dzied uz vienas nots. Katram F diēzam jābūt īsam un vienmērīgam, un ļaujiet vārdiem nest rindu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chorus lifts to G under the long note on wear-y, then rests on D for hard times. A7 brings each line home.
rows.translation: Piedziedājums paceļas uz G zem garās nots uz wear-y, tad norimst uz D pie hard times. A7 atved katru rindu mājās.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Thomas Moore set these words to an old Irish air and printed them in 1813. Later, Mendelssohn wrote a fantasia on the tune, and Flotow put it in his opera Martha.
rows.translation: Thomas Moore šos vārdus pielika senai īru melodijai un iespieda 1813. gadā. Vēlāk Mendelsons uzrakstīja fantāziju par šo melodiju, bet Flotovs to iekļāva operā Marta.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open D, E and F sharp on string 4, then a leap to D at fret 3 on string 2, and down C sharp, B and A.
rows.translation: Brīvais D, E un F diēzs uz 4. stīgas, tad lēciens līdz D 2. stīgas 3. ladā un lejup C diēzs, B un A.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Most beats split long-short: a dotted eighth and a sixteenth. Play the long note full and let the short one lead into the next beat.
rows.translation: Lielākā daļa sitienu dalās gari–īsi: punktēta astotdaļnots un sešpadsmitdaļnots. Garo noti spēlējiet pilnu, un īsā lai ved uz nākamo sitienu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the middle, no rosebud is nigh climbs through A sharp to B. The chord turns to B minor there, the saddest moment of the song.
rows.translation: Vidū no rosebud is nigh kāpj caur A diēzu uz B. Tur akords pāriet B minorā — dziesmas skumjākajā brīdī.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Gustav Holst wrote The Planets between 1914 and 1916. This broad tune is the heart of Jupiter. In 1921 he made it a hymn tune and named it Thaxted, after the town where he lived.
rows.translation: Gustavs Holsts Planētas sarakstīja starp 1914. un 1916. gadu. Šī plašā melodija ir daļas Jupiters sirds. 1921. gadā viņš to pārvērta himnas melodijā un nosauca Thaxted — pilsētas vārdā, kur dzīvoja.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E at fret 2 on string 4, open G, A at fret 2, then C at fret 1 on string 2, open B, G, and up C, D, C, B.
rows.translation: E 4. stīgas 2. ladā, brīvais G, A 2. ladā, tad C 2. stīgas 1. ladā, brīvais B, G un augšup C, D, C, B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The middle of the tune dips to C at fret 3 on string 5. Reach for it with your third finger, then come straight back up to string 4.
rows.translation: Melodijas vidus nolaižas līdz C 5. stīgas 3. ladā. Sniedzieties pēc tā ar trešo pirkstu, tad uzreiz atgriezieties augšup uz 4. stīgu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Like a slow waltz: one, two, three. Each phrase starts with two eighth notes before beat one.
rows.translation: Kā lēns valsis: viens, divi, trīs. Katra frāze sākas ar divām astotdaļnotīm pirms pirmā sitiena.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Before records, families sang these songs around the piano at home. Here they are back to back, with Holst's big tune to finish.
rows.translation: Pirms ierakstu laikmeta ģimenes mājās šīs dziesmas dziedāja pie klavierēm. Šeit tās skan pēc kārtas ar Holsta plašo melodiju noslēgumā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which two of these count in three?
rows.translation: Kurus divus no šiem skaita pa trim?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The Last Rose of Summer and Jupiter
rows.translation: The Last Rose of Summer un Jupiters
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hard Times and The Last Rose of Summer
rows.translation: Hard Times un The Last Rose of Summer
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The Last Rose of Summer and Jupiter are both in three. Home! Sweet Home! and Hard Times count in four.
rows.translation: The Last Rose of Summer un Jupiters abi ir trijdaļu metrā. Home! Sweet Home! un Hard Times skaita pa četriem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Vivaldi's Spring, Mozart's Turkish rondo and Sousa's best-known march.
rows.translation: Vivaldi Pavasaris, Mocarta turku rondo un Sūzas pazīstamākais maršs.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Antonio Vivaldi published four violin concertos called The Four Seasons in 1725. Spring opens with this bright tune, then the solo violin plays birdsong and running brooks.
rows.translation: Antonio Vivaldi 1725. gadā publicēja četrus vijoļkoncertus ar nosaukumu Gadalaiki. Pavasaris sākas ar šo gaišo melodiju, tad solo vijole spēlē putnu dziesmas un tekošus strautus.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: E at fret 2 on string 4, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3 three times, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, E, then open B.
rows.translation: E 4. stīgas 2. ladā, G diēzs 3. stīgas 1. ladā trīsreiz, F diēzs 4. stīgas 4. ladā, E, tad brīvais B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The key of E has four sharps. In first position G sharp is at fret 1 on string 3, D sharp at fret 1 on string 4, and C sharp at fret 2 on string 2.
rows.translation: E tonalitātei ir četri diēzi. Pirmajā pozīcijā G diēzs ir 3. stīgas 1. ladā, D diēzs — 4. stīgas 1. ladā, C diēzs — 2. stīgas 2. ladā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each beat can split into four sixteenths. In the theme, the quick F sharp, E pair falls in the second half of beat two.
rows.translation: Katrs sitiens var sadalīties četrās sešpadsmitdaļnotīs. Tēmā ātrais F diēza un E pāris iekrīt otrā sitiena otrajā pusē.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mozart published this rondo in 1784 as the last movement of a piano sonata. Its march copies the sound of Turkish military bands, which Vienna loved at the time.
rows.translation: Mocarts šo rondo publicēja 1784. gadā kā klaviersonātes pēdējo daļu. Tā maršs atdarina turku militāro orķestru skanējumu, ko tolaik Vīnē mīlēja.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: B at fret 2 on string 5, open A, G sharp at fret 4 on string 6, A, then C at fret 3 on string 5, open D, C, B and C.
rows.translation: B 5. stīgas 2. ladā, brīvais A, G diēzs 6. stīgas 4. ladā, A, tad C 5. stīgas 3. ladā, brīvais D, C, B un C.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The theme circles A: B, A, G sharp, A. Each circle is four sixteenths. Then it climbs a step and circles again.
rows.translation: Tēma riņķo ap A: B, A, G diēzs, A. Katrs aplis ir četras sešpadsmitdaļnotis. Tad tas kāpj vienu pakāpi un riņķo atkal.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The march moves from A minor to A major: C becomes C sharp, at fret 2 on string 2. The tune sounds suddenly bright.
rows.translation: Maršs pāriet no A minora uz A mažoru: C kļūst par C diēzu 2. stīgas 2. ladā. Melodija pēkšņi skan gaiši.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: John Philip Sousa wrote this march at the end of 1896, and it was published in 1897. It is the official national march of the United States. This is its big trio tune.
rows.translation: Džons Filips Sūza šo maršu sarakstīja 1896. gada beigās, un tas publicēts 1897. gadā. Tas ir ASV oficiālais nacionālais maršs. Šī ir tā plašā trio melodija.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, C at fret 1, open B, then a dip to A sharp at fret 3 on string 3 and back to B.
rows.translation: D 2. stīgas 3. ladā, C 1. ladā, brīvais B, tad nolaišanās līdz A diēzam 3. stīgas 3. ladā un atpakaļ uz B.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The trio holds notes across the bar line. Keep counting through them: one, two, three, four, then on into the next bar.
rows.translation: Trio tur notis pāri takts svītrai. Turpiniet skaitīt: viens, divi, trīs, četri un tālāk nākamajā taktī.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The tune keeps dipping a half step below B. Which note is that?
rows.translation: Melodija arvien nolaižas pustoni zem B. Kura nots tā ir?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A sharp, at fret 3 on string 3, sits a half step below open B and leans right back into it.
rows.translation: A diēzs 3. stīgas 3. ladā ir pustoni zem brīvā B un tiecas tieši atpakaļ uz to.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Vivaldi, Mozart and Sousa, back to back: a violin concerto, a piano rondo and a band march, each arranged for your guitar.
rows.translation: Vivaldi, Mocarts un Sūza pēc kārtas: vijoļkoncerts, klavieru rondo un pūtēju orķestra maršs, katrs aranžēts jūsu ģitārai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these pieces was written for a band?
rows.translation: Kurš no šiem skaņdarbiem rakstīts pūtēju orķestrim?
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sousa wrote his marches for a military band. Spring is for violin and strings, and the rondo is for piano.
rows.translation: Sūza savus maršus rakstīja militāram pūtēju orķestrim. Pavasaris ir vijolei un stīgām, bet rondo — klavierēm.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The whole songbook in ukulele keys, start to finish
rows.translation: Visa dziesmu grāmata ukuleles tonalitātēs no sākuma līdz beigām
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: The tunes everyone learns first: slow tempos, short phrases, big wins.
rows.translation: Melodijas, ko visi apgūst vispirms: lēni tempi, īsas frāzes, lieli panākumi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in C. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Šī versija ir C tonalitātē. Ceturtā stīga noskaņota augstu, tāpēc melodija paliek uz 1. līdz 3. stīgas, un katrs akords shēmā ir ukuleles forma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in F. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Šī versija ir F tonalitātē. Ceturtā stīga noskaņota augstu, tāpēc melodija paliek uz 1. līdz 3. stīgas, un katrs akords shēmā ir ukuleles forma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Campfire and folk songs with easy chord charts, to play or to sing over.
rows.translation: Ugunskura dziesmas un tautasdziesmas ar vieglām akordu shēmām spēlēšanai vai dziedāšanai līdzi.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in G. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Šī versija ir G tonalitātē. Ceturtā stīga noskaņota augstu, tāpēc melodija paliek uz 1. līdz 3. stīgas, un katrs akords shēmā ir ukuleles forma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: New songs on open chords: campfire pop, a ballad, stomp-folk, reggae and country.
rows.translation: Jaunas dziesmas ar brīvo stīgu akordiem: ugunskura pops, balāde, ritmisks folks, regejs un kantrī.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in D minor. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Šī versija ir D minorā. Ceturtā stīga noskaņota augstu, tāpēc melodija paliek uz 1. līdz 3. stīgas, un katrs akords shēmā ir ukuleles forma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Campfire folk songs everyone can sing, with simple chord charts to strum.
rows.translation: Ugunskura tautasdziesmas, ko visi var dziedāt, ar vienkāršām akordu shēmām pārvilkumiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in A. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Šī versija ir A tonalitātē. Ceturtā stīga noskaņota augstu, tāpēc melodija paliek uz 1. līdz 3. stīgas, un katrs akords shēmā ir ukuleles forma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in D. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Šī versija ir D tonalitātē. Ceturtā stīga noskaņota augstu, tāpēc melodija paliek uz 1. līdz 3. stīgas, un katrs akords shēmā ir ukuleles forma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Old favorites from America's songbook, to strum and to sing.
rows.translation: Senas iemīļotas melodijas no Amerikas dziesmu pūra — spēlēšanai ar pārvilkumiem un dziedāšanai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in A minor. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Šī versija ir A minorā. Ceturtā stīga noskaņota augstu, tāpēc melodija paliek uz 1. līdz 3. stīgas, un katrs akords shēmā ir ukuleles forma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lullabies, ballads and carols to play slowly and let ring.
rows.translation: Šūpuļdziesmas, balādes un Ziemassvētku dziesmas lēnai, skanīgai spēlei.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Famous classical themes, from a Baroque canon to a Romantic lullaby.
rows.translation: Slavenas klasiskās tēmas no baroka kanona līdz romantiskai šūpuļdziesmai.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Punk-pop, riff rock, dark 6/8 rock, an indie anthem and desert rock, on power chords.
rows.translation: Pankpops, rifu roks, tumšs 6/8 roks, indīhimna un tuksneša roks ar kvintakordiem.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two Mozart themes and two old airs, with minor keys and a wide range.
rows.translation: Divas Mocarta tēmas un divas senas melodijas ar minora tonalitātēm un plašu diapazonu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in E minor. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Šī versija ir E minorā. Ceturtā stīga noskaņota augstu, tāpēc melodija paliek uz 1. līdz 3. stīgas, un katrs akords shēmā ir ukuleles forma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: A ballad, a sea story in 6/8, a music-box waltz, a bright folk strummer and a dark song in a minor key.
rows.translation: Balāde, jūras stāsts 6/8, mūzikas lādītes valsis, gaišs folks ar pārvilkumiem un tumša dziesma minorā.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Indie pop, a power ballad, highlife, neo-soul and an anthem with a key change.
rows.translation: Indīpops, roka balāde, highlife, neosouls un himna ar tonalitātes maiņu.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Synth-pop, gospel-pop, dark pop, indie pop and a 6/8 finale, full of syncopation.
rows.translation: Sintpops, gospeļpops, tumšs pops, indīpops un 6/8 fināls, pilns sinkopju.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Folk songs, carols and classical themes in mandolin keys
rows.translation: Tautasdziesmas, Ziemassvētku dziesmas un klasiskās tēmas mandolīnas tonalitātēs
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in C, in first position: two frets to a finger across the four pairs, and every chord in the chart is a mandolin shape.
rows.translation: Šī versija ir C tonalitātē pirmajā pozīcijā: divas ladas katram pirkstam uz četriem pāriem, un katrs akords shēmā ir mandolīnas forma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in G, in first position: two frets to a finger across the four pairs, and every chord in the chart is a mandolin shape.
rows.translation: Šī versija ir G tonalitātē pirmajā pozīcijā: divas ladas katram pirkstam uz četriem pāriem, un katrs akords shēmā ir mandolīnas forma.
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in D, in first position: two frets to a finger across the four pairs, and every chord in the chart is a mandolin shape.
rows.translation: Šī versija ir D tonalitātē pirmajā pozīcijā: divas ladas katram pirkstam uz četriem pāriem, un katrs akords shēmā ir mandolīnas forma.

rows.source: This edition is in C, in first position: the tune moves across the four strings with fingers 1 to 4, and the chord chart is there for whoever plays along with you.

rows.source: Roots and fifths under every song in the book
rows.translation: Pamattoņi un kvintas zem katras grāmatas dziesmas
rows.author: lv drafting AI 1

rows.source: Roots and fifths, as a bass player first backs a band: the chord's root where it starts, its fifth between, low in first position. The song stays in C, where the band plays it.
rows.translation: Pamattoņi un kvintas, kā basģitārists sāk pavadīt grupu: akorda pamattonis tā sākumā, kvinta pa vidu, zemu pirmajā pozīcijā. Dziesma paliek C tonalitātē, kur to spēlē grupa.
